recipes.title: 10 Minute Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute ground beef in skillet, drain fat.
Add remaining ingredients; heat to boil.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Stir occasionally. Serve over hot cooked spaghetti.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: 3 Bean Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine corn oil, vinegar, sugar and salt. Add beans and onion.
Toss to coat well.
Cover.
Refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Makes 4 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: A Meal In A Loaf
instructions: Cut bread in half lengthwise; carefully scoop out inside and break into bite-size pieces.
Combine ground chuck and onion in a large saucepan; cook until meat is brown.
Stir in soup and bread pieces.
Spoon meat mixture into bottom half of bread shell and cover with top half of bread shell.
Wrap loaf in foil; bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
To serve, cut into slices.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Aim Cookies
instructions: Mix the sugar, brown sugar and margarine until smooth.
Add the egg, salt and vanilla and mix well.
Stir in baking soda, flour and chocolate chips.
Chill for best results.
Make dough into balls one inch in diameter.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until pale brown.
Yields 24 AIM cookies.

recipes.title: Alabama Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add shortening, sugar, flour and milk; mix and knead.
Roll out and cut into biscuits.
Place into pan and let rise, about 1 hour.
Bake at 475° until done. Makes 16 to 20 biscuits.

recipes.title: Alaska Snow Crab Dip
instructions: Drain crabmeat.
Blend and mix remaining ingredients together. Fold in crabmeat.
Chill until ready to serve, approximately 2 hours.
Serve with crackers.
Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: All-American Meatballs(Microwave Cooking)
instructions: Combine ground beef, onion, soup mix, parsley flakes and egg in large bowl.
Shape into 12 (1 1/2-inch) meatballs.
Set aside.
In a 2-quart casserole dish, mix beef broth and Worcestershire sauce. Add meatballs.
Cook covered on 70% Power (Roast) for 10 minutes. Combine cornstarch and water in small bowl until smooth.
Stir into meatballs and cover.
Cook on 70% Power (Roast) for 3 to 4 minutes or until sauce is thickened (200° if using probe).
Let stand covered 5 minutes before serving.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Almond Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix all together and beat with mixer.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 2 big loaves or 3 to 4 small loaves.

recipes.title: Amazing Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Bring broth to a rolling boil.
Rub flour on both sides of the tortillas, using all of the flour.
Cut tortillas into 1 1/2-inch strips.
Drop in boiling broth.
Reduce heat and simmer in a covered pot.
Let simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in chicken and milk until heated throughout.
Let stand off heat 10 minutes, covered. Serves 4; 1 bread, 1 1/2 protein, 37 optional calories.

recipes.title: Ambrosia Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Chill 5 to 6 hours or overnight. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: American Style Lasagne
instructions: Brown beef, garlic and Parmesan cheese.
Add tomato sauce, seasonings and onion.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Cook noodles. In a large casserole, alternate layers of meat sauce, noodles, cheese and cottage cheese. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Amy'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt cheese in microwave until creamy and smooth; add tomatoes, chicken broth and chicken.
Cook spaghetti and blend with cheese mixture.
Keep warm in chafing dish or slow cooker. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Annette'S Potato Salad
instructions: In large pot, boil 6 cups water.
Add potatoes and cook 20 to 25 minutes.
Drain water and cool for 15 minutes.
In large bowl, add remaining ingredients with potatoes and toss gently.
Add additional mayonnaise, if needed, and refrigerate.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Another Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes with skins on and eggs the night before; chill in refrigerator.
Chop all ingredients and mix well.
Blend salad dressing, mustard and horseradish in separate bowl.
Add dressing mixture to salad mixture and mix.
Salt and pepper to taste. Chill and serve.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Ants On A Log

ingredients.notes: cleaned, ends cut off and halved

instructions: Spread the peanut butter on the celery.
Place 4 to 5 raisins in a row on top of the peanut butter.
Serves 4 with 106 calories each.

recipes.title: Appalachian Pear Relish
instructions: Peel and core pears.
Seed both kinds of the peppers.
Coarsely grind pears, peppers and onions.
Place ground mixture in a large pot, adding the vinegar and sugar.
In a muslin bag, combine celery seed, pickling spices and mustard seed.
Tie bag shut and place in the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes. Remove spice bag.
Pour into sterilized canning jars and seal tightly.
Store pear relish in cellar or a cool, dry place.
Yields 8 pints.

recipes.title: Apple Bean Bake
instructions: Cook apples in melted butter until tender.
Add sugars.
Cook until sugars melt.
Add last four ingredients; stir together well. Combine with beans.
Mix well!
Pour all into 2-quart casserole. Bake at 400° about 1 hour.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Apple Cheese Crisp
instructions: Peel and slice apples.
Place in a greased baking dish.
Pour water and lemon juice on top.
Combine sugar, cinnamon, flour, margarine and cheese until crumbly.
Sprinkle over apples.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Rice
instructions: Combine juice and water in medium saucepan; bring to a boil. Add rice and cinnamon stick.
Cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Yields 3 cups.

recipes.title: Apple Cobbler Superb
instructions: Pare and core apples; slice thin.
Drop apple slices into maple syrup; stir to coat apples.
Spread evenly in greased, shallow 2-quart baking dish.
Cream butter to consistency of mayonnaise.
Add sugar while continuing to cream.
Beat in egg. Mix and sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Add alternately with milk to butter and sugar mixture.
Spoon over apples, spreading smoothly with rubber spatula.
Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes, or until topping is golden brown and cake tester comes out clean. May be served warm with plain cream and additional maple syrup, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Crunchies
instructions: In small bowl, mix peanut butter and cereal.
Cube apple and add to mixture.
Toss until cubes are covered.
Yields 1 to 2 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Date Cake
instructions: This makes 1 large cake in tube pan or 2 loaf pan cakes.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 25 minutes or bake loaf pans for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Apple Oatmeal Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour, oats, baking powder and soda.
Stir in buttermilk, eggs and margarine. Add more buttermilk if batter is too thick. Stir in grated apples.
Makes 12 to 14 small pancakes.

recipes.title: Apple Or Peach Cobbler
instructions: Peel and core fruit and place in baking dish.
Slice each piece of bread into 5 narrow strips and place over fruit.
Mix sugar, milk, flour, and lemon juice.
Stir in margarine.
Add egg and mix well.
Pour over fruit and bread strips.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until fruit is tender.
Serves 6-8.

recipes.title: Apple Salad
instructions: Mix yogurt or cream well.
Add apples, grapes and celery to dressing to prevent apples from discoloring; add nuts.
Mix lightly, chill.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Spice Drops
instructions: Cream sugars and butter. Add egg and apple juice. Mix flour, cinnamon, baking soda, nutmeg and add to the creamed mixture. Fold in apples and walnuts.
Drop by teaspoon on a greased pan. Bake at 375° for 12 to 14 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Apple Sweet Yams
instructions: Peel and cube the yams.
Cook until tender.
Peel, core and cube the apples.
Layer the potatoes and the apples in a 2-quart baking dish, set aside.
Put the rest of the ingredients into a saucepan.
Bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes.
Pour the liquid over the potatoes and the apples.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Whole Wheat Waffles
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Put other ingredients in blender, blend just until apple is pureed.
Add to flour mix.
Bake in preheated waffle iron.
Makes 8.

recipes.title: Apple-Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill.
Serve on bed of lettuce. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Apple-Glazed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Pour apple juice in a frying pan over low heat; stir in cinnamon and salt.
Add sweet potatoes.
Cook over low heat, turning sweet potatoes several times until they are well coated and most of juice is absorbed (about 6 minutes).
Yields 5 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Apple-Tuna Salad

ingredients.notes: drained and broken in large chunks

instructions: In large salad bowl, combine lettuce, apple, mandarin orange sections, tuna and walnuts; toss together.
Combine mayonnaise, soy sauce and lemon juice; mix well. To serve, add dressing to salad; toss gently.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Applesauce Spice Bread
instructions: Sift together flour, sugar, salt, soda, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves and allspice.
Add applesauce, shortening and water.
Beat 2 minutes.
Add eggs. Beat 2 minutes more.
Stir in raisins and nuts.
Pour into two (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans.
Bake in 350° oven for 55 to 60 minutes.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Apricot And Walnut Brown Rice Stuffing
instructions: Cook onion and celery in margarine in large skillet over medium-high heat until crisp.
Add rice, apricots, walnuts, raisins, parsley, thyme, salt, sage, pepper and chicken broth. Turn into 2-quart baking dish.
Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Stuffing may be baked inside poultry. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Arkansas Travelers
instructions: Cream butter.
Add vanilla and sugar.
Beat in eggs.
Mix thoroughly.
Add peanut butter.
Sift in flour and baking powder. Roll into small balls and place on greased cookie sheet.
Flatten with tines of a fork that has been dipped in water.
Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Arroz Rojo(Red Rice)
instructions: Rinse rice.
Mash garlic with salt to make a paste.
Heat oil in a large pot or Dutch oven.
Add rice; cook and stir over medium heat until lightly browned.
Add onion and garlic paste; cook and stir until onion is tender.
Stir in tomato sauce and chicken broth.
Cover and simmer until most of the liquid has been absorbed.
Reduce heat to very low; steam for 30 to 45 minutes, until rice is tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Artichoke Spinach Salad

ingredients.notes: washed and torn into bite size pieces

instructions: For dressing, whisk olive oil with vinegar, lemon juice, mustard, sugar, dill and pepper.
In a large bowl, combine spinach, cabbage, artichoke hearts, ham and cheese.
Pour dressing over salad.
Toss gently.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Asparagus Chinese Style
instructions: Snap off the tough stems of asparagus spears.
Cut the stalks into 1/2-inch slices.
Heat oil in a 12-inch skillet, add garlic, salt, and asparagus.
Saute over moderate heat for 2 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Mix cornstarch, water, and soy sauce.
Add to asparagus, stir and bring to a boil again.
Stir for 1 minute, add pepper and serve at once.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Asparagus Divine
instructions: Arrange cooked asparagus in baking dish.
Place chicken on top.
Combine cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder and pour over chicken.
Top with cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Asparagus With Dill Sauce
instructions: Wash asparagus and trim tough ends.
Steam for 4 to 5 minutes until barely tender.
Drain.
Mix sauce ingredients in a cup and pour over asparagus.
Stir and warm over low heat for 2 minutes. Makes 3 servings.

recipes.title: Asparagus With Sauce
instructions: Heat the salad oil in a skillet.
Add bacon and cook, stirring, until the bacon is golden and crisp.
Add the asparagus; cook until heated through, then slowly add the bouillon and soy sauce and cook for 3 minutes.

While this is cooking, stir the cornstarch into the cold water until it forms a smooth paste, then stir this into the mixture in the skillet and continue cooking, stirring constantly, until the sauce is smooth and thick and clear.
Add the Accent; give it one last stir, then serve.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Asparagus With Sesame Butter
instructions: Place asparagus spears in a large skillet; add boiling water and salt.
Cook for 5 to 7 minutes or until tender.
Remove asparagus and keep warm.
Drain cooking liquid, reserving 1/2 cup in a small saucepan.
Combine cornstarch and cold water; stir into liquid.
Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly; cook and stir 1 minute more.
Stir in butter until melted.
Spoon over asparagus; sprinkle with sesame seed and serve immediately.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Atlanta Gas Light Deviled Pecans
instructions: Melt butter; add salt, onion salt and chili powder.
Stir in pecans, coating well.
Spread in 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.
Drain and cool on paper towels.
Makes 4 cups.

recipes.title: Atlanta Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: In large skillet, brown chops in hot oil (375°); remove chops. Add celery, onion and green pepper; cook lightly.
Drain fat. Stir in remaining ingredients; add chops.
Bring to boil.
Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Aunt Beaulah'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook all vegetables (onions, peppers and garlic) with tomatoes until all are well cooked.
Run through food mill.
Mix rest with vegetables.
Cook until thick, at least an hour or more.
Take out bay leaves.
Pack in hot jars.
Have lids hot.
Can process in hot water bath.
Makes about 8 pints.

recipes.title: Aunt Marie'S Unbeatables
instructions: Combine sugar, flour, baking powder and egg whites.
Add nuts and apricots.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 18 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.
Old German recipe.

recipes.title: Aunt Patsy'S Bell Peppers(Microwave)
instructions: Cut bell pepper in half, seed & clean.
Mix all ingredients together and stuff bell peppers.
Place in microwave glass dish 2-inches deep.
Cover with wax paper and cook 19-20 minutes. Uncover, spread ketchup on top of peppers, return to microwave and cook uncovered for 2-5 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Aunt Patsy'S Chili Beans(Crockpot Style)
instructions: Wash beans well, place in crockpot with water, salsa & onion. Cook overnight on low.
The next morning add meat in pot and cook on low until dinnertime.
Serve with cornbread.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Aunt Sally'S Olive Shells
instructions: Blend together the cheese, butter, paprika and salt.
Stir in flour.
Chill dough for easier handling.
Wrap a small piece of dough around each olive, sealing well.
Place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake in 400° oven for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve warm.
Makes 24.

recipes.title: Autumn Cheese Soup
instructions: Place vegetables in water and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients except parsley. Heat and stir for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Garnish with parsley.
Serves 5.

recipes.title: Autumn Squash-Tomato Casserole
instructions: Cook onion in butter 5 minutes.
In buttered 2-quart casserole, layer squash and onions.
Measure seasonings into tomatoes, then pour over.
Dot with butter.
Bake uncovered at 375°, until crisp done, 40 minutes for tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Bacon And Cheese Oven Omelet
instructions: Cook bacon; drain.
Curl 1 slice, chop 4 slices and leave others as whole slices.
Cut cheese slices into halves.
Arrange in the bottom of a lightly greased 9-inch pie pan.
Beat together the eggs and milk with fork.
Add chopped bacon.
Pour over cheese and bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Arrange whole bacon slices on top of omelet around bacon curl.
Bake 10 minutes longer.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Bacon Chive Rice
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp.
Add rice, chives and seasonings. Blend well and heat thoroughly.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Bacon Horseradish Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients; stir to mix well.
Cover; chill. Makes 2 cups.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Bacon Stuffed Burgers
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients and mix well.

Make 8 thin beef patties. Place an equal amount of mixture on 4 patties. Place remaining patties on top and pinch edges together. Grill or broil 6-inches from heat source, 6 or 8 minutes a side or as long as you prefer. Makes 4 burgers.

recipes.title: Bacon Water Chestnuts
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
Cook bacon in large skillet on medium heat until almost crisp; drain.
Wrap bacon around water chestnuts; secure with toothpicks.
Place in baking dish.
Mix remaining ingredients; pour over water chestnuts.
Bake 45 minutes.
Makes about 24.

recipes.title: Bailey Bones(Dog Biscuits)
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients until well blended.
Roll out on floured board.
Cut out treats with cookie cutter (bone shape).
Microwave at 50% for 5 to 10 minutes, turning every 2 minutes or bake in 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until dry. Yields about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Baked Almond Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken pieces with flour.
Blend celery salt, paprika, salt, curry powder, oregano and pepper with butter, coating all sides.
Arrange chicken in single layer in a baking dish (9 x 13-inches).
Sprinkle evenly with almonds.
Pour light cream between pieces.
Bake, uncovered, in a moderate 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Uncover.
Spoon 1/2 cup sauce from pan into sour cream and mix together.
Pour evenly over chicken.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake, uncovered, about 15 minutes longer or until chicken is tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Apple Pudding
instructions: Combine margarine, sugar and egg in mixer; beat until light. Gradually blend in combined flour, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon.
Stir in vanilla, apples and walnuts.
Turn mixture into an ungreased 8-inch square baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.
Serve warm or with Cool Whip.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Bean Trio
instructions: Saute bacon and onion until bacon is crisp.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Spoon mixture into a 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake at 325° for 1/2 hour.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Beans And Bacon
instructions: In a large frypan, cook cut up bacon 15 minutes. Cook onion and green pepper in bacon drippings 3 to 4 minutes.
Pour off drippings.
Add bacon and remaining ingredients.
Heat, covered, on low heat 1 hour. Remove cover, stir and continue heating, uncovered, 30 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Beans With Ham And Maple Syrup(Microwave)
instructions: Place ham in center of an ungreased 11 x 9 x 2 inch microwave dish.
Arrange carrots single layer around ham.
Combine maple syrup and Dijon mustard.
Pour over ham and carrots.
Cover with plastic wrap, venting one edge.
Microwave on high for
8 minutes (7 minutes if over 1000 watt), stirring once.
In a separate bowl, mix beans, ketchup, dry mustard and chili powder.
Combine with ham and carrots.
Microwave uncovered for 8 minutes, stirring midway.
Sprinkle bread crumbs and butter over casserole. Microwave 2 more minutes or place under broiler 4 inches from the top for 1 minute.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Baked Cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Butter a 12 x 8-inch shallow baking dish. Discard outer leaves from cabbage.
Wash head and cut into 12 wedges.
Put 1 cup water in large skillet. Bring to a boil. Add 1 teaspoon salt and the cabbage. Cook over medium heat, covered, 10 minutes. Drain well.
Arrange cabbage in prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with mixture of flour, sugar, 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper.
Dot with butter.
Pour hot milk over cabbage. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake, uncovered, 35 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Cauliflower
instructions: Cook whole cauliflower in boiling water until tender, 15 minutes.
Cook bacon, remove and crumble; set aside.
Add onion to 2 tablespoons bacon drippings.
Cook until tender.
Stir in soup and milk; add cheese.
Place drained, cooked cauliflower in 1-quart casserole.
Pour sauce on top.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Garnish with reserved bacon.
Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Cheese Potato Slices
instructions: Combine soup, pepper and paprika; then place potatoes in a greased baking dish.
Sprinkle with cheese and top with soup mixture.
Cover with foil and bake at 400° for 40 minutes. Uncover, and bake for 5 to 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken and pepper in water-soaked (remove skin from chicken) simmer; mix well.
Place chicken breast over top of mixture.
Sprinkle with pepper; cover with water-soaked lid.
Microwave for 15 minutes, soaked lid. Microwave for 15 minutes on High.
Rearrange chicken.
Microwave for 28 to 30 minutes on simmer or until rice and chicken are done. Let stand, covered, 5 minutes before serving.
Serves about 6. Cook in 2-quart dish.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a plastic bag; shake well.
Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces; dip chicken pieces in butter, and shake a few at a time in breadcrumb mixture.
Place on a lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until tender.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Combine crumbs and cheese.
Brush chicken with salad dressing and coat with crumb mixture.
Place in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Baked Chow Mein
instructions: Cover rice with hot water; let stand while preparing other ingredients.
Brown meat, breaking up large pieces.
When partially browned, add onion, celery and mushrooms.
Stir in brown sugar, soy sauce, water chestnuts and rice.
Turn into lightly greased casserole.
Cover and bake 1 hour in 350° oven.
This serves 8 generously.

recipes.title: Baked Corn(An Amish Recipe)
instructions: Melt butter and add the flour.
Add milk gradually and bring to boiling point.
Stirring constantly, add corn, sugar, salt and pepper.
Remove from heat and add beaten eggs.
Pour into a greased baking dish and sprinkle with buttered crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until corn is firm.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Baked Crab
instructions: Saute minced seasoning in butter until it becomes glazy but not brown.
Mix crab meat and crumbs and add cooked seasoning.
Add mustard, mayonnaise, eggs, garlic, salt and pepper; mix well.
Pack into well-greased shells.
Top lightly with crumbs.
Bake in 400° oven until lightly browned.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Baked Cup Custard
instructions: Beat eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla until blended, about 1 minute.
Add slowly while beating scalded milk.
Beat only until blended. Pour into custard cups.
Sprinkle with nutmeg, if desired.
Set cups in pan of hot water.
Bake in preheated oven (325°) about 45 minutes or until a silver knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Fish In Herb Sauce
instructions: Sprinkle fillets with salt and pepper.
Place in shallow baking pan.
In saucepan, combine remaining ingredients.
Bring to boiling and simmer 5 minutes.
Pour over fish.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, basting occasionally.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Baked Fish With Sour Cream
instructions: Cut fish in serving pieces.
Pat dry.
Cook onion in margarine for 3 minutes.
Place fish in 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Spread onion over top.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Mix sour cream and cheese.
Spread over fish.
Sprinkle crumbs over top. Bake uncovered 25 minutes at 350°.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and paprika before serving.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Baked Lentils
instructions: Cook lentils.
When tender, place in baking dish and add tomatoes.
Saute pepper and onion
in oil.
Add all ingredients to lentils, plus salt (if lentils were not salted during cooking). Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Baked Lentils With Cheese
instructions: In a shallow baking dish (about 9 x 3-inches), mix the lentils, water, bay leaf, salt, pepper, marjoram, sage, thyme, onions, garlic and tomatoes.
Then cover tightly with foil and bake in a 375° oven for 30 minutes.
Uncover; stir in carrots and celery.
Bake, covered, for 40 minutes more or until vegetables are tender.
Stir in green pepper and parsley.
Sprinkle cheese on top; bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes or until cheese melts.
Makes 6 servings.
This is an excellent meatless dish; high in protein and very tasty.

recipes.title: Baked Meatballs
instructions: Heat oven to 400°.
Mix all the ingredients thoroughly and shape the mixture into 1-inch balls.
(Use a small ice cream scoop if you have one.
It's a timesaver and it makes meatballs of uniform size.)
Place the meatballs in an ungreased jelly roll pan (15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inches).
Bake 10 minutes or until done. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease shallow baking dish.
Brown chops in greased frying pan.
Place in baking dish.
Sprinkle with celery, brown sugar, lemon juice and seasonings.
Pour tomato sauce and water over chops.
Cover and bake in moderate 350° oven for 1 1/4 hours until chops are done.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Baked Pork Chops And Apples
instructions: Brown pork chops on both sides and place in large casserole. After removing pork chops, add 1/3 cup sour cream to pan and stir until mixed with browning from chops.
Meanwhile, cut and core 1 apple.
Place each half (open side up) on a pork chop.
Fill each half apple with 1 tablespoon brown sugar.
Pour sour cream sauce over apples and pork chops.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1/2 hour. Serve with rice or egg noodles.
Quick, easy and delicious! Serves 2.

recipes.title: Baked Sausage And Rice
instructions: Crumble sausage and fry until brown; then mix with other ingredients.
Pour into large casserole, cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Baked Steak With Mushrooms And Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine flour, salt and pepper; coat steak. Brown steak in butter over medium heat and remove.
Saute onion until soft. Add mushrooms and cook 1 minute.
Add beef stock and bring to a boil. Season with salt and pepper. Place meat in shallow baking pan in a single layer.
Pour liquid over and cover with aluminum foil. Bake 20 minutes, then add potatoes. Bake another 40 minutes or until done. Remove from pan; add half and half to liquid.
Heat, but do not boil. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Baked Tomatoes With Spinach
instructions: Place tomatoes in shallow baking dish, cut side down.
Mix rest of ingredients, except crumbs.
Divide and spread evenly over tomatoes.
Top with crumbs.
Bake in preheated 375° oven for 15 minutes or until crumbs are toasted and tomato heated.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Vegetable Dish
instructions: Shred cabbage; peel and shred carrots.
Put all vegetables in a bowl and mix in salt, sugar, lemon juice and melted butter. Stir well.
Pack mixture into a 2-quart greased casserole.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Baked Western Omelet
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Lightly spray a 10-inch glass pie pan with nonstick cooking spray.
In medium bowl with wire whisk, beat eggs with 1/4 cup of water until well blended.
Stir in remaining ingredients with rubber spatula.
Scrape into prepared pie pan. Bake 20 to 30 minutes until omelet is set, slightly puffed and browned.
Cut into 4 servings and serve at once.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Orange Frost
instructions: Mix orange juice, milk, banana and half the sherbet in a blender on high speed until smooth.
Pour into tall glasses; top each with a scoop of remaining sherbet.
Makes 3 servings (1 cup each).

recipes.title: Banana Pops
instructions: In a blender, combine the yogurt, orange juice and banana; cover and process until smooth.
Pour into popsicle trays or pour into small plastic disposable cups and insert popsicle sticks. Freeze until firm, about 5 hours or overnight.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except ginger ale and freeze.
Partially thaw for 2 to 3 hours before using.
Mixture should be slushy. Break up and add the ginger ale to this.
Makes 2 gallons.

recipes.title: Banana Split Banana Bread
instructions: In large bowl cream sugar, egg and butter with electric mixer until fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Set aside.
In small bowl, mix bananas and milk (to which I add 1 tablespoon vinegar); set aside. Sift together flour, baking powder and baking soda onto paper plate or bowl.
Add dry ingredients to creamed butter mixture alternately with banana mixture, stirring with spatula until all dry ingredients are blended, about 1 minute.
Stir in chocolate chips and pecans.
Spoon into greased and floured bread pan.
Drop pan twice from 6-inch height to countertop to remove air bubbles or let rest 20 minutes before putting into oven.
Preheat oven to 350°. Bake 1 hour.
Cool in pan 10 minutes before removing to rack to cool.
Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Banana Walnut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly coat a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray.
In a large bowl, combine first six ingredients; set aside.
In another large bowl, beat egg whites until foamy.
Add bananas, buttermilk, applesauce and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just blended.
Add nuts.
Pour into prepared pan and bake for 45 to 55 minutes or until golden.
Serves 12.
Calories per serving 215, grams of fat 3.6, 0 mg cholesterol.

recipes.title: Banana-Lemon Shake
instructions: In blender, mix first 3 ingredients until smooth.
Add ice cream.
Blend again until smooth.
Makes 3 (8 ounce) servings.

recipes.title: Barbecue Bean Bake
instructions: Brown beef, bacon and onion; drain.
Add all other ingredients, except beans; stir well.
Add beans and mix well. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 20 to 24 servings.

recipes.title: Barbecue Cups
instructions: Brown ground beef and chopped onion in skillet.
Add barbecue sauce.
Place biscuits in an ungreased muffin pan; shape like a cup.
Add beef mixture in biscuits.
Sprinkle with shredded cheese.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 10 to 12 biscuit cups.

recipes.title: Barbecue Ham Sandwiches
instructions: Cut meat in bite-size pieces.
Fry in a little butter. Sprinkle some flour over meat, then add the rest of ingredients. Simmer 1 hour.
Makes 15 to 20 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Barbecue Meatballs
instructions: Combine meat, salt, milk, bread crumbs and onion; mix well. Shape into balls; place meat balls (uncovered) in baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat balls.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Barbecue Pork Chops
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pork chops, simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cool, pour over pork chops in bowl.
Refrigerate for several hours.
Arrange chops in shallow baking pan; pour sauce over.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Baste with sauce occasionally.
Yields 2 servings.

recipes.title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Parboil chicken in water with vinegar (approximately 1/2 hour). Combine all ingredients.
Coat chicken.
Barbecue on grill.
Recoat as necessary.
Grill until golden brown.
Serves approximately 2 to 3 people.

recipes.title: Barbecued Stuffed Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in skillet; saute onions, celery and green pepper, using medium heat.
Stir in flour and milk, stirring constantly, until thick.
Add bread crumbs, crab meat, Worcestershire sauce, chopped parsley, salt and pepper.
Mix well.
Remove shells and veins from shrimp, leaving tails on.
Slit backs of shrimp.
Put two shrimp together with crab stuffing.
Hold together with toothpicks.
Chill in refrigerator until ready to cook.
Place shrimp in broiler pan, 5 inches from broiler unit.
Baste occasionally with sauce until shrimp are done, about 5 minutes on each side.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Barley Pilaf
instructions: Saute onions in 3 tablespoons butter 4 to 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms; saute a few more minutes and remove from pan.
Brown barley in remainder of butter, stirring often.
Put in casserole; add onions and mushrooms, salt and 2 cups chicken stock.
Bake, covered, in 350° oven for 1/2 hour.
Add remaining stock; stir and bake 1/2 hour longer.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Basic Holiday Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Stir into creamed mixture (dough should be stiff).
Refrigerate overnight in covered bowl.
Roll dough very thin, using flour on board and rolling pan.
Cut out in shapes.
Place 1 to 1 1/2-inches apart on greased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until crisp and straw colored.
Remove cookies and cool on racks. Yields 16 dozen.

recipes.title: Basil Salad Dressing
instructions: Measure all ingredients into a jar.
Shake thoroughly.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes 1 1/3 cups dressing.

recipes.title: Bean Fondue Dip
instructions: Keep in reserve 1 cup cheese.
Mix rest of cheese and all other ingredients.
Spread in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle with reserved cheese.
Wrap and refrigerate at this point if making ahead.
If not, bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.
Serve hot with tortilla chips for dipping.
Serves 18.

recipes.title: Beanie Weenies
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Place in a microwavable dish.
Microwave on High for 6 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Beef - O - Matic Juice
instructions: Combine; chill.
Makes 3 1/2 cups.
Contains 9 calories/4 ounces.

recipes.title: Beef And Kraut Casserole
instructions: Combine beef, rice, onion, salt and pepper; mix thoroughly. Alternate mixture in casserole with sauerkraut.
Add water until it comes to top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.
Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Beef And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cook noodles according to package; drain.
In large skillet, brown meat and stir in tomatoes and salt.
Heat through.
Combine with noodles; put into a 3-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Beef And Peppers In Crock-Pot
instructions: Cut the steak into serving size pieces.
If desired you can brown the meat in a little hot oil before adding to crock-pot. Place the peppers in bottom of crockpot, reserving a few to place on top of meat, if desired.
Add vegetables and then meat.
Mix all other ingredients and pour over meat and peppers.
Cover and cook on low heat for 8 to 10 hours.
Yield: 8 servings. Carbohydrate 3 g, protein 34 g, fat 14 g, calories 237.

recipes.title: Beef Burgers Provencale
instructions: Mix ground beef, shredded zucchini and bread crumbs into 8 (1/2-inch) thick patties.
Brown on both sides in a large nonstick skillet for 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in sliced zucchini and tomatoes. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 7 to 9 minutes. Turn patties and stir 2 to 3 times or until zucchini is crisp-tender.
Add potatoes and simmer 3 minutes longer or until patties are no longer pink in center.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Beef Goulash With Vegetables
instructions: Heat oil in large heavy kettle.
Add onion and green pepper and cook, stirring often, until onion is golden.
Add paprika, beef and salt and cook, stirring until meat loses its red color. Add tomatoes and 3/4 cup water.
Bring to a boil, cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add potatoes and carrots and cook until all is tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Beef Noodle Casserole
instructions: In saucepan, brown beef and cook onion.
Stir to separate meat.
Pour off fat.
Stir in 3/4 cup cheese and remaining ingredients.
Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Beef Porcupines
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients.
Roll into balls and brown in oil; pour tomato sauce over balls and add 1 can water.
Simmer, covered, 5 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Beef Taco Bake
instructions: In skillet, over medium heat, cook meat until brown. Drain. Add soup, salsa, milk, tortillas and half of the cheese.
Spoon into 2 quart shallow baking dish.
Cover.
Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes or until hot.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Beef Vegetable Soup
instructions: Put beef broth, beef, salt, peppercorns and bay leaf in 2 quarts of water.
Bring to boil, cover and simmer for 1 hour.
Add vegetables, bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer until vegetables and meat are tender. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Beer Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine the first nine ingredients in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in onion and lemon.
Remove from heat.
This is the sauce for barbecue ribs! Yields 3 cups.

recipes.title: Best Ever Fried Rice
instructions: Arrange all ingredients for easy access.
Whisk eggs together in a small bowl.
Preheat wok or skillet on medium to medium-high heat.
Add peanut oil and heat 1 minute.
Then add eggs and let cook for 1 minute, without stirring, or until top is moist and bottom is cooked.
Add rice and toss with eggs, coating rice with moist egg while chopping in cooked egg.
Stir-fry for 2 minutes, then add scallions, carrots and ham.
Stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes more.
Add peas and soy sauce; toss until heated through.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Best In The West Barbecue Bean Bake
instructions: Brown ground beef, bacon and onion; drain excess fat.
Combine and add all other ingredients, except the beans; stir well.
Add beans; combine thoroughly.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Makes 20 to 24 servings.

recipes.title: Best Pear Preserves

ingredients.notes: thinly sliced, or can use real lemon juice

instructions: Crumble beef into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish; add onion. Microwave on High, uncovered, for 5 to 6 minutes or until meat is no longer pink; drain.
Add beans, rice, catsup, 3 tablespoons brown sugar, mustard and pepper.
Mix well.
Cut apple into 10 thin slices.
Arrange in clockwise pattern on top of the casserole.
Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon brown sugar.
Cover with lid.
Microwave at High for 8 to 9 minutes or until heated through (150°).
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Best-Ever Spareribs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Coat ribs with flour.
Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Add barbecue sauce, onion and green pepper.
Cut ribs into serving-size pieces; place in pan, baste ribs with sauce.
Bake ribs for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Beth'S Tangy Chicken
instructions: Place chicken breasts in baking dish.
Melt margarine. Add other ingredients and stir until well blended.
Pour over chicken breasts and sprinkle each with paprika.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Betty'S Boston Baked Beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Chop bacon and place in a heavy bottom skillet over medium heat.
Cook until partly crisp.
Add chopped onions.
Continue cooking, stirring occasionally until onions are limp and transparent.
Stir in brown sugar, ketchup and bourbon.
Add beans.
Mix well.
Put in beanpot.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Big Catch Casserole
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Blend well.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Bake in 1 1/2-quart casserole in 350° oven for 25 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Big-Wheel Burger Skillet
instructions: Mix together onion, ground beef, egg, rolled oats, salt, pepper and milk.
Mound in a 10-inch skillet.
With a wooden spoon handle, make 5 to 6 holes in mound.
Combine spaghetti sauce and kidney beans (with liquid).
Pour over and around meat mixture. Place over medium heat.
When hot, reduce heat and simmer 25 to 30 minutes.
Serves 5 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Biloxi Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in buttermilk a few minutes.
Shake chicken in a sack with mixture of dry ingredients.
Fry in hot oil until done, turning once.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Biscuit Mix
instructions: Mix flour, soda and lard.
Cover and store in the refrigerator. Keeps for 1 month.
Makes 10 cups.
When needed, mix a batch with 1/2 cup milk and 2 cups mix and bake at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Black Bean And Corn Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl, mix well.
Cover and chill several hours or overnight.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Black Beans
instructions: Heat olive oil.
Add onion, pepper and bay leaf.
Cook until translucent.
Add black beans and water.
Simmer 10 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Black Beans And Rice
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine broth, coconut and margarine. Bring to a boil.
Stir in rice.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in beans and onions.
Cover and cook an additional 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Makes 6 (2/3 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Black Bottom Cups
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients; set aside.
Stir in the chocolate chips.
Sift together the flour, sugar, cocoa, salt and soda.
Add the water, oil, vinegar and vanilla to sifted ingredients; beat until combined.
Fill paper muffin cups 1/3 full.
Top with 1 teaspoon of the cream cheese mixture.
Sprinkle with sugar and nuts.
Bake at 350° for about 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 24.

recipes.title: Black Forest Cherry Pie
instructions: Combine cherry pie filling, coconut and flavoring.
In a separate bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Add sugar to whipped cream and fold into whipped cream cheese.
Make sure cream cheese is well blended or it will be lumpy.
Fold into cherry mixture.
Pour into graham cracker crust and chill until firm. Freezes well.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Pea Relish
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Cover and chill at least 3 hours. Drain and serve.
Makes 7 cups.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Pea Soup

ingredients.notes: 4 slices cooked bacon, crumbled up, or a meaty ham bone

instructions: Sort and rinse peas.
In large skillet, saute onion in butter until tender, but not brown.
Add these both to a large pot. Cover with water.
Add bay leaf, thyme and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until peas are tender.
Add tomatoes and meats.
Cover and simmer 30 to 45 minutes more.
Serves 6 to 8 (high fiber).

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Chill before serving.
Yields 12 servings.

recipes.title: Black-Pepper Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a small bowl until thoroughly blended. Spoon into small, covered container and refrigerate.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.
Good on hot or cold meat or chicken or instead of sour cream on baked potatoes.
Keeps up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Blondies
instructions: Grease 12 x 9-inch pan.
Melt margarine.
Add sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Beat until smooth.
Stir in flour.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Makes 18 to 24 blondies.

recipes.title: Blt Bites
instructions: Cut a thin slice off of each tomato top.
Scoop out and discard pulp.
Invert the tomatoes on a paper towel to drain.
In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients; mix well.
Spoon into tomatoes.
Refrigerate for several hours.
Yield: 16 to 20 servings.

recipes.title: Blueberry Pound Cake

ingredients.notes: washed and drained well (frozen blueberries may be used)

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan.
Use mixer to cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Beat well after each egg is added.
Add vanilla and beat until fluffy. Dredge berries with 1/4 cup of flour and set aside.
Sift remaining flour with baking powder and salt.
Fold into cake batter until well blended.
Gently stir in berries.
Bake for approximately 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Place pan on rack and cool in pan for 10 minutes before removing from pan.
Serves 12 to 16.

recipes.title: Blueberry Torte
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs, sugar (1/2 cup) and margarine until crumbly.
Press mixture into a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Mix remaining 1/2 cup sugar, milk and cream cheese until smooth, then fold in Cool Whip.
Spread this mixture over crust.
Spread blueberry filling. Chill thoroughly.
Serve.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Bohemian Spareribs
instructions: Cut spareribs into individual servings.
Season with salt and pepper.
Mix caraway seed with sauerkraut and place in 12 x 8-inch baking dish.
Arrange onion on top of sauerkraut and pour tomatoes on top.
Place spareribs on top.
Bake at 350° for 2 hours.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Bombay Chicken Salad
instructions: Cut chicken into 1-inch cubes.
Mix together chicken, water chestnuts and celery.
Blend together yogurt, mayonnaise, curry powder, soy sauce and lemon juice.
Pour over chicken mixture. Stir in grapes.
Chill several hours.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Boston-Style Baked Corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine mustard, salt, sugar and catsup in medium bowl.
Add onion and corn; mix thoroughly.
Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with bacon.
Bake for 40 minutes, or until bacon is cooked.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Bourbon Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients, mixing well.
Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.
Remove from refrigerator; let stand 30 minutes.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 minutes.
Remove from oven; top with marshmallows.
Bake an additional 7 minutes or until marshmallows are golden.
Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Boursin Cheese
instructions: Just mix all together.
If using fresh herbs, double the amounts.
Makes 1 cup.
This is a very useful blend to have on hand and it keeps very well.
You can use it for cheese and crackers.
To spread on toasted bread with any kind of meats and cheeses makes a gourmet-style deli sandwich.
Spread on a precooked pizza shell, then load with your favorites; gourmet pizza.
Try pizza crust, Boursin cheese, sliced tomatoes and topped with smoked Swiss.

recipes.title: Braised Celery Bites(Serve With Poultry)
instructions: About 20 minutes before serving in a 10-inch skillet over high heat in boiling water, heat celery and next 3 ingredients to boiling.
Reduce heat to medium; cover and cook 8 to 10 minutes until celery is tender-crisp.
Drain celery.
Return to skillet. Stir in butter until melted.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Braised Green Beans
instructions: Heat oil in heavy saucepan.
Add onion and garlic.
Cook until golden.
Add remaining ingredients.
Juices should just cover beans in pan.
If not, add a little more water.
Cover. Cook over low heat for 45 minutes or until fork-tender.
Serve with pan juices.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Braised Spareribs
instructions: Wipe spareribs with a damp cloth; cut into serving portions. Dip in flour seasoned with salt and pepper.
Brown in hot bacon drippings.
Reduce heat.
Add water; cover and simmer until tender, about 1 hour.
If preferred, place browned spareribs in baking pan with water.
Cover and bake in a moderately slow oven (325°).
Serves 5.

recipes.title: Brandied Friendship Fruit
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 2-quart nonmetallic bowl, stirring gently.
Let stand, covered, at room temperature for 3 weeks, stirring twice a week.
Serve over ice cream or pound cake, reserving 1 cup of mixture for Starter.
Add 1 cup sugar and 1 of the fruits to Starter every 1 to 3 weeks, alternating before serving.
Serve with ice cream or pound cake.
Yields 6 cups.

recipes.title: Brazilian Rice
instructions: Mix sauce; stir in rice.
Pour into 2-quart baking dish.
Bake in a pan of water in a 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles(Dietetic)
instructions: Combine cucumbers, onions and garlic in large bowl.
Sprinkle with salt.
Cover with ice cubes.
Let stand overnight.
Drain well.
Combine remaining ingredients, except liquid artificial sweetener.
Add cucumber mixture.
Bring to a boil.
Cover and boil gently for 2 minutes.
Stir in sweetener.
Remove garlic clove.
Spoon into sterile jars.
Seal.
Yield: 5 cups. Exchanges: 1/2 cup = 1 vegetable and contains 28 calories.

recipes.title: Breakfast Bake
instructions: Butter bread and place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Top with bacon (can substitute sausage or a vegetable) and cheese. Mix eggs, milk, salt and mustard.
Pour into dish.
Cover and let set in refrigerator overnight.
In the morning, mix cornflakes and melted butter.
Pour on top of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 8 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Brown sausage and onions in skillet.
Drain.
Add diced potato and eggs and scramble all together.
Place generous amount of cooked mixture in a steamed tortilla.
Excellent served with picante sauce.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Breakfast Cookies
instructions: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.
Beat in egg.
Add flour and baking soda, mix well.
Stir in bacon, cornflakes and raisins.
Drop by rounded tablespoon 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 - 18 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool for 2 minutes before removing to wire racks. Store in the refrigerator.
Yield: 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Breakfast Take Alongs
instructions: Beat together butter, sugar, egg and vanilla until well blended.
Add combined flour, soda and salt.
Mix well.
Stir in oats, cheese, wheat germ and bacon. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.

Bake in preheated moderate oven at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire cooling rack. Store in loosely covered container in refrigerator or at room temperature. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Corn Scallop
instructions: Saute onion in 1 tablespoon of butter.
Blend in flour. Gradually add milk.
Stir constantly until thickened.
Add cheese. Stir until melted.
Stir in corn and 1/4 cup bread crumbs.
Arrange broccoli in an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch dish.
Pour cheese sauce over broccoli.
Toss remaining crumbs and butter over casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Broccoli Nut Salad
instructions: Mix the mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.
Toss with rest of ingredients and refrigerate.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Brocomole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions, but without salt.
Drain.
Place 3/4 of the broccoli (including all stalks) into your food processor or blender.
Add remaining ingredients and puree until smooth.
(Add reserved broccoli florets and process briefly for a slightly chunky texture.)
Makes 3 guilt-free servings.

recipes.title: Broiled Shrimp In Garlic Butter
instructions: Brown garlic in butter.
Remove garlic; mix other seasonings in butter.
Place peeled and deveined shrimp in baking dish.
Pour butter mixture over shrimp.
Broil 5 minutes, or until done.
Add lemon juice.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Brown Sauce
instructions: Melt butter; blend in flour.
Cook and stir over low heat until browned.
Stir in soup.
Bring to a boil and cook 3 to 5 minutes.
Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Makes about 1 1/3 cups.

recipes.title: Browned Rice
instructions: Melt oleo in large iron skillet (that has a lid) over low heat.
Add rice.
Cook, stirring frequently until rice is yellow. Dissolve bouillon cubes and salt in boiling water.
Slowly add rice.
Simmer with cover for 25 minutes.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Brownie Frosting
instructions: Cream
butter,	cocoa,	corn syrup and vanilla in small mixer bowl.
Add	powdered
sugar and milk.
Beat to spreading consistency.
Makes about 1 cup of frosting.

recipes.title: Brunch Bites
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix first 3 ingredients.
Add egg, milk and sour cream.
Mix well.
Add cheese, ham, garlic and parsley. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish for 40 minutes or bake in miniature muffin tins for 15 minutes.
Yield: 4 dozen muffins.

recipes.title: Brunch Cheese Dish
instructions: Layer the sausage, bread and cheese in greased (9 x 12-inch) casserole, ending with cheese on top.
Mix eggs, milk and pepper; beat well and pour over top of other ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour until bubbly and slightly browned.
Serves 12 to 15.

recipes.title: Brunch Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 9-inch pie plate.
Spread broccoli or spinach or asparagus in plate.
Beat sour cream, cottage cheese, baking mix, margarine and eggs until smooth.
Pour into plate.
Top with tomatoes; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean, about 30 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Buckaroo Beans
instructions: Boil beans in 6 cups boiling water for 2 minutes.
Let stand for 1 hour.
Rinse twice.
Add 3 1/2 cups fresh water and cook until tender.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 1 1/2 hours uncovered.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Bud'S Chili
instructions: Melt oil in large skillet and brown onion, green pepper and beef.
Add remaining ingredients.
Stir and cook over low heat 1 1/2 hours.
(Serves 4 to 6.)

recipes.title: Budget Shrimp Creole
instructions: Saute first 4 ingredients in oleo.
Remove from heat, stir in tomato sauce, water and seasonings.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in shrimp.
Heat to boiling.
Cover and cook 15 minutes.
Serve over hot rice.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Bulgarian Stew
instructions: Grease an oblong casserole dish, large size.
Cut in the vegetables and sprinkle with salt, pepper and a little sugar. Season the meat and mix into the vegetables.
Pour over the juice; stir and cover with foil.
Bake at 350° until done, about 2 1/2 hours.
The meat should be very tender.
This can also be baked at 300° for a longer time.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Burger Florentine
instructions: About 40 minutes before serving prepare spinach as label directs; drain well.
Toast English muffins; keep warm.
Preheat broiler if manufacturer directs.
Into bowl tear bread into small pieces; add spinach, ground beef, egg, salt and onion.
Mix well. Shape mixture into four 1-inch thick round patties.
Place patties on rack in broiling pan.
Broil patties about 5 minutes on each side for medium or until of desired doneness.
Just before patties are done, cut Mozzarella cheese into 4 slices.
Top each meat patty with a cheese slice; broil 1 minute longer or until cheese melts.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Burgundy Beef
instructions: Melt butter in heavy saucepan.
Brown beef and onions.
Blend in flour, salt and pepper.
Add thyme, wine and water, stirring constantly, until mixture reaches the boiling point.
Add parsley, carrots and bay leaf.
Cover and cook over low heat for at least 2 hours or until tender.
Add more water, if needed.
Serve with rice.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Busy Day Bake
instructions: Season liver with salt and pepper; coat with flour.
In large skillet, brown quickly in hot
oil,
about	1
minute on each side.
Place in greased
baking
dish.
Add seasoning and tomatoes; cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Remove cover and bake for 10 to 15 minutes
longer to thicken gravy.
Serve on rice.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Busy Day Casserole
instructions: Brown beef in skillet, stirring until crumbly.
Add remaining ingredients. Cover; cook for 25 minutes or until macaroni is tender.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Butter Cookies(From The Files Of Ola Dortch Williams)
instructions: Mix well all ingredients in one bowl.
Put into long rolls in Saran Wrap.
Chill in refrigerator.
Slice and bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Sprinkle with sugar while still warm or dip each cookie in sugar before baking.
Makes 4 dozen or more cookies.

recipes.title: Butter Crunch Carrots
instructions: Peel carrots and cut into 1/4-inch diagonal slices.
In small saucepan, bring 1/2 cup water to a boil.
Add carrots; cover and cook until tender-crisp, about 10 minutes.
Drain well.
Melt butter over medium heat.
Stir in almonds, brown sugar and lemon pepper.
Cook, stirring constantly for 3 minutes or until sugar dissolves.
Add cooked carrots; toss to coat.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Butter Dips(Quick Bread)
instructions: Heat oven to 450°.
Melt butter in pan in oven and remove. (You may find you need additional butter.)
Stir dry ingredients together.
Add milk; stir.
Knead lightly.
Roll out 1/2-inch thick into an 8-inch square.
With floured knife, cut into strips 4 inches wide, then cut crosswise to make 18 sticks.
Dip sticks in butter; place in 2 rows in pan.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot.
Makes 18 Butter Dips.
Delicious!

recipes.title: Butter Like Grandma'S
instructions: Soften margarine to room temperature in a large bowl.
Add oil and buttermilk and beat on high speed with electric mixer until light and fluffy.
Makes about 2 pounds.
To keep cholesterol low use corn oil and corn oil margarine.

recipes.title: Butter Wafers
instructions: Cream butter or margarine until soft; gradually add 1 cup of sugar.
Blend together until light and creamy.
Beat in egg and vanilla.
Sift flour.
Stir the flour gradually into the butter mixture.
Shape dough into 1/2-inch balls.
Place on greased baking sheet.
Bake in 375° oven until the edges are light brown (about 8 minutes).
Makes 5 to 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Butter-Me-Nots
instructions: Soften in microwave the butter and margarine.
Do not completely melt.
Add sour cream and stir well.
Add flour and mix well.
Spoon into 1 3/4-inch muffin tins and bake at 350° for about 20 minutes until golden.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Buttered Carrots And Corn
instructions: Cover carrots with
water
and
cook until tender.
Add the corn, salt, sugar
and butter; cook over a slow fire for 5 to 10 minutes.
Serve hot.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Buttered Green Beans
instructions: Wash green beans; trim ends and remove strings.
Bring water to a boil in a Dutch oven.
Add beans; cover, reduce heat to medium and cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain and toss beans with butter.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken into 1/4 cup buttermilk, then roll in seasoned flour (salt and pepper).
Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Put chicken in pan, skin side down.
Bake, uncovered, in a 375° oven for 30 minutes.
Turn chicken and bake for 15 minutes.
Blend 1 cup buttermilk and soup; pour around chicken.
Bake 15 minutes more, or until done.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
instructions: Place chicken into bowl.
Pour buttermilk over; marinate 1 hour.
In another bowl, mix flour, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper.
Remove the chicken from buttermilk; roll chicken pieces in seasoning mixture.
Reserve the buttermilk and pour into buttered casserole.
Heat shortening and margarine in heavy skillet; fry chicken just until brown.
Remove, scrape up brownings, and add chicken broth.
Cook for 2 minutes.
Place chicken on top of buttermilk in casserole.
Pour all your scraped up brownings over the chicken.
Bake, uncovered, in a 375° oven until tender, about 1 hour.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pecan Chicken Fingers
instructions: Cut each chicken breast in 3 or 4 strips.
Combine next 6 ingredients and set aside.
Combine egg and buttermilk.
Dip chicken into buttermilk mixture and dredge into flour mixture.
(It works well, good to put flour mixture in a Ziploc bag.)
Pour butter into jelly roll pan.
Add chicken, turning to coat.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Serves 24.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Delights
instructions: Cream the shortening in a large bowl.
Gradually add sugars, beating well.
Add eggs, milk and vanilla.
Beat well.
Sift together flour, soda, baking powder and salt.
Add to creamed mixture, stirring well.
Stir in oats and butterscotch chips.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes until light brown.
Makes 10 to 12 dozen.

recipes.title: Buttery Almond Cookies
instructions: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and confectioners sugar.
Add flour and vanilla; mix well.
Stir in almonds.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake at 350° for 13 to 16 minutes or until bottoms are golden brown and cookies are set.
Cool for 1 to 2 minutes before removing to wire racks to cool completely.
Roll in confectioners sugar.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: C. B. Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook onions and celery in butter until tender, but not brown. Stir in mushrooms, pimentos, chicken and cooked rice.
Blend broth and soup.
Stir into chicken mixture.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Turn into a greased 8 x 12 x 2-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cabbage And Carrot Slaw
instructions: Combine vegetables in non-metallic container with cover.
To make dressing, mix remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables. Mix well.
Cover; refrigerate 4 to 24 hours.
Keeps well.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cabbage Bean Soup
instructions: In a 5 quart pot, brown beef, sausage, onion and bell pepper. Drain if necessary.
Add about 4 cups of water, beans, potatoes and seasonings.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce to low and simmer 30 to 35 minutes.
Add cabbage and continue to cook until potatoes are tender and cabbage is done.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in large soup kettle and cook cabbage and onions for about 15 minutes, stirring to keep from sticking. Sprinkle with flour and mix well.
Gradually add water, while stirring; heat until mixture reaches boiling point.
Add all other ingredients and simmer over low heat for about one hour.
Serves 8.
Easy to prepare and simply delicious on a cold day.
Best served with a pan of corn bread.

recipes.title: Cacahuetes Endadiablados(Deviled Peanuts)
instructions: In mixing bowl combine peanuts, oil, chili powder, salt and cayenne.
Spread in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake in a
350° oven
for	30
minutes
or
until peanuts are lightly browned, shaking pan occasionally.
Makes about 3 cups.

recipes.title: Cacciatore Sauce
instructions: Melt margarine in large skillet.
Saute onions and mushrooms with garlic powder in margarine until onions are transparent. Add the remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Cajun Nuggets
instructions: Combine soup, bread crumbs and spices.
Dip chicken in crumb mixture coating well.
Place in lightly greased large shallow pan and drizzle with butter.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until chicken is tender.
Turn once during baking.
Makes about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Cake Style Cornbread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl.
Add other ingredients and stir until just mixed.
Cook in 9 x 13-inch pan at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Can be made in cupcake pans using liners.
Makes 24.

recipes.title: Calico Baked Beans
instructions: Saute beef, onion, celery, green pepper.
Add to remaining ingredients in a 2 quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours (or microwave on High 10 to 12 minutes) until heated through. Makes 8 servings, approximately 300 calories each.

recipes.title: Camp Style Eggs And Corn
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet; pour off fat.
Add corn.
Add beaten eggs to corn-sausage mixture and cook as scrambled eggs.
Makes 6 servings.
One-fourth cup of minced onions or scallions and 3 tablespoons finely chopped green peppers may be added to browning sausage for added flavor, if desired.

recipes.title: Caribbean Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all in saucepan.
Boil 1 minute.
Use to brush chicken during broiling or grilling.
Makes 1 1/2 cups or enough for 2 broilers.

recipes.title: Caribbean Rum Custard
instructions: Scald first 3 ingredients and cool to lukewarm.
Whip other ingredients together until thick and lemony in color.
Add warm cream mixture.
Pour into ramekins.
Cover each with foil.
Place in baking pans.
Fill baking pans halfway with water.
Bake at 325° until custards test done, about 25 minutes.
Serves 8.
Great with Expresso.

recipes.title: Carolina Peach Pie
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the peaches with flour, nutmeg and salt. Turn the mixture into pie shell.
Pour cream over the top.
Bake in a 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Carrot Cream Soup
instructions: In 4 quart saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until soft.
Add carrots and stir in flour, mixing well. Cook, stirring constantly, about 2 minutes.
Stil stirring, add chicken stock and bring to a boil.
Lower heat, cover and cook 1/2 hour, stirring occasionally.
Blend in cream, add salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately.
Makes 12 cups.

recipes.title: Carrot-Potato Scallops
instructions: Pare carrots and cut into 1/8-inch diagonal slices. Pare potatoes and cut into 1/8-inch crosswise slices. Place in alternating layers in lightly greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish or casserole. Melt butter in saucepan. Blend in flour and salt; stir in milk and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Add chives and caraway seed. Pour over carrots and potatoes in casserole.
Cover and bake in 350° oven 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake 30 minutes longer until carrots and potatoes are tender. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Carrots And Celery
instructions: Cut celery and carrots into 1/2-inch pieces.
Simmer until tender-crisp with water, horseradish and salt.
Drain and toss with butter.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Carrots Elegante
instructions: Cook carrots in 1/2-inch boiling water for 8 minutes.
Drain. Turn carrots into a 1-quart baking dish.
Stir in raisins, oleo, honey, lemon juice and ginger.
Bake, uncovered, in a 375° oven for 35 minutes.
Stir occasionally; spoon into serving bowl. Sprinkle with almonds.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Casserole Of Peas
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Stir breadcrumbs with butter and sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Cathy'S Noodle Kugel
instructions: Boil and drain noodles.
Add other ingredients and stir.
Place into well-greased, shallow, heavy casserole or baking dish.
Bake at 350° for about 3/4 to one hour, until cooked.
Let stand for 5 minutes.
Serves 8 to 12 as side dish.
It's a holiday favorite.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
instructions: Place cauliflower upside down in a 2-quart microproof casserole dish.
Add water.
Cover with lid and cook on High for 4 minutes; turn cauliflower over.
Cover and cook on High for 4 to 5 minutes or until tender; drain and reserve liquid.
Mix liquid with cheese and bread crumbs.
Pat mixture gently onto cauliflower.
Cover and cook on High for 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese begins to melt. Let stand, still covered, 3 minutes before serving.
Serves 5 to 6.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Dilly
instructions: Cook flowerets in boiling water until tender (or steam). Don't overcook.
Pour into casserole.
(I put minced garlic into melted butter and pour over cauliflower.)
Shake on dill weed; salt and pepper.
Sprinkle Cheez Whiz over all.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Cauliflower-Broccoli Medley
instructions: Wash cauliflower and separate into flowerets, slicing larger ones into bite size pieces.
Wash broccoli; trim large leaves from stalk.
Cut flowerets into bite size pieces.
Cut skin and tough end section from stalks; slice remainder into bite size pieces. In a large bowl, combine broccoli and cauliflower with onion rings and mushrooms.
Combine mayonnaise, oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper to make dressing.
Pour over vegetables and toss lightly. Chill several hours or overnight.
Garnish with crumbled bacon. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Celery And Peas(Makes 6 Servings)
instructions: Dissolve bouillon cubes in water in skillet, add celery, thyme and salt.
Cook until almost tender but still crisp.
Add peas and cook until all is just tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Celery Casserole
instructions: Boil the celery in just enough water to cover it for 8 to 10 minutes.
Drain.
Add to the drained celery the cream of mushroom soup and the melted butter; mix.
Pour in a casserole pan. Sprinkle the bread crumbs and the almonds and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chantilly Potatoes
instructions: Put mashed potatoes in a baking dish.
Top with cream and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake in hot oven until cheese is melted and topping is golden brown and bubbling.
This can be prepared in advance and frozen.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chapattis
instructions: Mix thoroughly, the flour, salt and oil.
Add enough water to make a soft bread-like dough.
Divide into 8 balls and roll out thin; it will be about 8 inches in diameter.
Bake on a hot griddle or skillet a few minutes on each side.
May be spread with margarine and filled with rice, beans or any desired filling and rolled up, or eaten as is.
Makes 8 Chapattis.

recipes.title: Charlotte'S No-Fault 100 Percent Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Place whole wheat flour in a large mixing bowl and set it in the oven at the lowest temperature for 20 minutes.
While the flour is warming, dissolve the 2 yeast packages in 1 cup warm water.
Add the honey to mix and set aside while the flour is being warmed. When the flour has been warmed, combine yeast, molasses and salt; add to flour.
Stir, don't knead, slowly adding 2 1/2 cups of remaining water to produce a sticky dough.
Oil your pans, filling them between 1/3 and 1/2 full.
Let dough rise for 1 hour.
Bake in preheated 375° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
Yields 2 large loaves.

recipes.title: Cheddar Bacon Soup
instructions: In large skillet, cook bacon until crisp.
Drain bacon, reserving 1/2 cup of the drippings.
Crumble bacon and set aside. In large saucepan, cook carrots, celery and onion in reserved bacon drippings until vegetables are crisp and tender.
Stir in flour and pepper.
Add milk and chicken broth.
Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly.
Reduce heat to low.
Add cheese, stirring until melted.
Stir in bacon, reserving 1/2 cup for garnish.
Soup can be made up to 2 days ahead.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Cheddar Cheese Chowder
instructions: In large pot, bring chicken stock to boil.
Add vegetables. Cover and simmer 10 minutes, or until they are tender.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Blend in flour; cook 1 minute.
Gradually add milk.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add cheese; stir until melted.
Stir cheese sauce into vegetables.
Cook over low heat until thoroughly heated.
Do not boil.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Cheddar Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes and 1/2 cup melted butter.
Stir soup, sour cream, onion, cheese, salt and pepper.
Place in greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Combine cornflake crumbs and 1/2 cup melted butter.
Sprinkle over top.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 20 minutes more (until browned). Serves 12.

recipes.title: Cheese 'N Chili Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Lightly grease a 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Saute onion in butter and remove from heat.
Stir in hot rice, sour cream, cottage cheese, salt and pepper.
Toss lightly to mix well.
Layer half the rice mixture in bottom; then spread chilies over that layer, then 1/2 the grated cheese.
Layer other half of rice and top with remaining cheese.
Bake 25 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Cheese Baked Chicken
instructions: Mix cheese, onion, garlic powder, salt, basil, oregano and pepper.
Roll chicken pieces in the mixture to coat well.
Place in large casserole.
Cover tightly.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) about 1 1/2 hours, until chicken is tender and lightly browned. Serve warm or cold.
Makes 4 servings, 290 calories each.

recipes.title: Cheese Balls(Baked)
instructions: Blend until smooth.
Make into balls.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Makes 1 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Cheese Bites
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed until creamy; gradually add cheese.
Combine flour, salt, red pepper; gradually add to cheese mixture, mixing well.
Cover and chill 1 hour.
Roll dough into 3/4-inch balls and place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Yields 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Cheese Broccoli
instructions: In boiling, salted water, cook broccoli; drain.
In a saucepan over low heat, combine mayonnaise, cheese and milk.
Heat, stirring frequently, until cheese melts.
Serve over cooked broccoli.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Chili Cubes
instructions: In a large mixer bowl beat eggs with electric mixer until light, 4 to 5 minutes.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Add to eggs and mix well.
Fold in Jack cheese, cottage cheese and chilies.
Turn into greased 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes.
Cut in small squares.
Makes 3 to 4 dozen appetizers.

recipes.title: Cheese Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl until well blended. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.
Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Cheese Logs
instructions: With electric mixer, beat cream cheese, mayonnaise and milk until smooth.
Add Worcestershire sauce, onion and garlic powder; blend well.
Slowly add cheeses; combine thoroughly.
Shape into 2 logs 2-inches in diameter.
Combine parsley and wheat germ.
Roll cheese logs in parsley mixture to cover completely.
Wrap logs tightly in foil and chill thoroughly before serving with crackers. Makes 2 (1/2 pound) logs.

recipes.title: Cheese Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.
Shape in loaf pan.
Bake at 350° about 1 hour until browned.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Stuffed Chicken
instructions: In thickest side of each chicken piece, cut a pocket large enough for cheese.
Place a cheese slice in each pocket.
Beat together egg, Parmesan cheese, parsley, bouillon and dash of pepper.
Coat chicken with flour and dip in egg mixture.
Brown in hot oil 2 to 3 minutes on each side.
Transfer to 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Cheesy Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Layer asparagus, egg and cheese 1/2 at a time in well-greased casserole.
Top with mushroom soup and cashews.
Toss crumbs with butter.
Sprinkle over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cheesy Beef-Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Place peppers in 2-quart (12 x 7-inch) glass baking dish; set aside.
Combine remaining ingredients, except shredded cheese, in medium bowl; mix well.
Spoon meat mixture into green pepper halves.
Cover with wax paper.
Microwave for 24 to 26 minutes on Roast, or until meat is well done (about 140°).
Top with shredded cheese and continue cooking on Roast until cheese is melted. Makes about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cut broccoli spears into bite size pieces and place in bottom of greased crock-pot.
In saucepan, blend milk, cream cheese, salt, garlic salt and Parmesan cheese over low heat until melted and smooth.
Pour one cup over broccoli; top with sliced chicken. Pour remaining sauce over chicken.
Cover and cook on low 4 to 6 hours.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a large covered pan, cook zucchini, carrots and onion with butter until tender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Heat through, stirring often.
Makes 7 cups.

recipes.title: Cheesy Crab-Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes thoroughly.
Rub skins with oil.
Bake at 400° for 1 hour, or until done.
Allow potatoes to cool to touch.
Cut potatoes in half lengthwise.
Carefully scoop out pulp, leaving shells intact.
Spoon pulp into a mixing bowl.
Add remaining ingredients, except paprika.
Mash with a potato masher.
Stuff shells with potato mixture; sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cheesy Ham Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Place half of the ham in a 2-quart casserole which has been sprayed with Pam.
Cover with half of the potatoes and half of the onion.
Sift half of the flour over and sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper.
Repeat layering ham, potatoes, onion, flour, salt and pepper.
Pour milk over all.
Bake, covered, at 350° in oven for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until potatoes are tender.
Uncover.
Combine bread crumbs and melted oleo.
Sprinkle atop casserole.
Add shredded cheese on top and sprinkle with parsley.
Bake 15 minutes longer.
Serves approximately 6 people.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
Thaw potatoes.
Combine them with rest of ingredients.
Use a 3-quart casserole or long flat dish.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes.
Yields 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Cheesy-Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package, omitting salt; drain well. Saute onion in butter in a medium saucepan.
Add broccoli and remaining ingredients to saucepan; cook over medium heat until cheese melts, stirring often.
Serve immediately.
Yields 5 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Cheezy Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Mix baking mix, milk and cheese until soft dough forms.
Beat vigorously for 30 seconds.
Drop dough by spoonfuls on ungreased sheet.
Bake in a 450° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.
Mix butter and garlic powder together.
Brush over warm biscuits before serving.
Makes 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Cheezy Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 375°.
Mix all ingredients.
Spoon into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serves about 8.

recipes.title: Cherry Angel Delight
instructions: Cut cake into small cubes; place half of cubes in 9 x 12-inch casserole dish.
Spoon pie filling over cake, reserving half cup for garnish.
Cover with remaining cake cubes.
Mix pudding, milk and sour cream together until smooth and pour over cake.
Garnish with reserved pie filling.
Refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Cherry Balls
instructions: Drain cherries from juice (save juice).
Set aside.
Mix oleo, powdered sugar, flour, salt and vanilla together.
Add enough water to get the mixture the texture of a pie crust.
Make little balls and flatten in hand.
Roll 1/2 of a cherry inside dough. Bake at 350° until light brown (approx 10-12 minutes). After they cool, roll into icing mixture (recipe follows) completely covering the balls.
Place on wax paper to dry.
Makes 5 dozen, depending on size.

recipes.title: Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour over 1 can of cherry pie filling (or blueberry pie filling).
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Serve warm, topped with vanilla ice cream.
Serves 2.

recipes.title: Cherry Date Skillet Cookies
instructions: In a 10-inch Teflon skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Stir in sugar and dates; remove from heat.
Stir in egg.
Return to heat and continue cooking over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a full boil (4 to 6 minutes). Boil, stirring constantly, for 1 minute; remove from heat.
Stir in rice cereal, 1 cup flaked coconut, cherries and vanilla until moistened.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Shape rounded teaspoonfuls of dough into 1-inch balls.
