Roll each ball in remaining 2 1/2 cups flaked coconut.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Cherry Pudding Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Stir in milk, flour and baking powder; mix well.
Spread batter in 6 1/2 x 10 x 2-inch baking dish.
Cover with pie filling.
Combine lemon juice with boiling water and carefully pour over top.
Bake in moderate (350°) oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until crusty top or toothpick comes out clean.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter.
Add eggs and milk and beat well.
Add the flour, cornmeal, lemon juice and grated rind.
Pour mixture into two pastry-lined pie plates and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until crust and filling are done.
This makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Chewy Brownie Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, cream shortening, sugar, water and vanilla.
Beat in the eggs.
Combine flour, cocoa, salt and baking soda.
Gradually add to creamed mixture and beat just until blended.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake at 375° for 7 to 9 minutes.
Do not overbake.
Yield: 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Chewy Crisps
instructions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Flatten with fork dipped in water.
Bake in moderate oven at 325° for 15 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Cool 1 minute before removing from baking sheet.
Yields 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicago Shrimp
instructions: Cook, peel and devein shrimp.
Cut each in half lengthwise. Overlap the cut shrimp in an au gratin dish.
Mix butter, onion, garlic, parsley, salt, tarragon and sherry in a saucepan and heat thoroughly.
Pour over the shrimp; top with crumbs and broil until browned.
Serves 3 or 4.

recipes.title: Chick-N-Q Basting Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute.
Use as a basting sauce for chicken.
Yields 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Chicken And Crumbs Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix garlic, basil, oregano and salt with bread crumbs.
Melt margarine and brush each chicken breast with it.
Roll each piece in bread crumb mixture.
Place them in shallow baking pan.
Bake for 60 minutes.
Mix wine and onions and pour over chicken.
Return chicken to oven for 3 to 5 minutes, or until sauce is hot.
Serve over rice.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken until cooked through.
Take chicken out of pan; set aside broth.
Debone chicken and place meat back into broth. Heat broth and chicken to boiling.
While broth is heating, cut shortening into flour until mixture resembles fine crumbs.
Stir in milk.
After broth starts boiling, drop dough by spoonfuls onto chicken.
Cook uncovered 10 minutes.
Cover and cook about 10 minutes longer.
Makes 8 to 10 dumplings.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Blend cream of chicken soup and milk together.
Mix all ingredients together and put in a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole dish.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Artichoke Soup
instructions: Saute garlic, onion, thyme and artichoke hearts in butter for 15 minutes over medium heat.
Add water, chicken and bouillon cubes.
Simmer covered over medium heat for 45 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Balls
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients, mixing well; shape into 1-inch balls.
Fry in a small amount of hot oil over medium heat until brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Tie whole cloves in cheesecloth and set aside.
Combine 1/3 cup brown sugar and cornstarch in a large saucepan.
Gradually add water, stirring until smooth.
Add pineapple juice and lemon juice; cook, stirring constantly, until smooth and thick.
Add meatballs and whole cloves.
Simmer on low 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove cheesecloth bag.
Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Beat egg.
Add cooking oil and beat thoroughly.
Add vinegar, salt and other seasonings.
Baste chickens about every 5 minutes. Makes 10 halves.

recipes.title: Chicken Best
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces.
Heat butter in a heavy skillet and quickly saute chicken pieces until tender.
Add pineapple chunks and green pepper.
Combine 3/4 cup pineapple juice, honey, soy sauce and cornstarch; mix until smooth.
Add to chicken mixture and cook, stirring until thickened (over medium heat).
Serve over rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken Breast Scampi
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cut chicken breast into bite size pieces and place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat.
Add the garlic, scallions, parsley, dill, oregano, salt and pepper.
Cook for 2 minutes.
Pour the mixture over the chicken pieces.
Bake 10 minutes.
Turn over chicken pieces and bake another 10 minutes.
Turn over to broil and put chicken under broiler for 3 to 4 minutes or until lightly brown. Serve over rice or spaghetti to sop up garlic sauce.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts Piquant
instructions: Combine soy sauce, oil, water, garlic, oregano and brown sugar.
Arrange chicken breasts in baking dish.
Pour wine mixture over breasts. Cover. Bake at 375° for
1 hour and 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli

ingredients.notes: skinned, boned, cooked and cut in pieces

instructions: Cook broccoli.
Arrange in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Place chicken on top.
Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, curry powder and soup.
Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine bread crumbs and margarine.
Sprinkle on top.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Capri
instructions: Rub the breast with the cut lemon.
Squeeze the juice out as you rub.
Sprinkle salt and pepper over the chicken; coat with flour.
Heat butter in skillet; brown chicken breasts in butter. Mix the soup, sherry and cheese; pour over browned chicken. Simmer for about 1 hour.
Remove chicken to warm serving platter; spoon gravy over chicken.
Garnish with parsley.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix first nine ingredients.
Saute 5 minutes butter, almonds and corn flakes.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Consomme With Avocado
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat the chicken broth; do not let it boil.
Place slices of avocado in the bottom of each soup plate. Top with 2 slices of lemon.
Pour the chicken broth over the avocado and lemon.
Add 1 1/2 tablespoons of sherry to each bowl. Sprinkle chopped parsley on top.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Crunch Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs and margarine.
Place mixture in buttered 9 x 12-inch pan.
Brown bread crumbs lightly in margarine; sprinkle over casserole and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator for 1 hour before baking.
Bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry Casserole

ingredients.notes: cooked and cut in bite-size pieces

instructions: Cook rice according to directions; spread in bottom of large baking dish. Cover with frozen peas.
In separate bowl, combine soups, mayonnaise and curry powder; then spread 1/2 this mixture over peas.
Next, place chicken pieces in dish.
Spread remaining mixture over top.
Sprinkle cheese and bake in 375° oven until heated through, about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Great dish to make ahead of time and freeze.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry With Almond-Raisin Rice
instructions: Saute apples, onions and garlic in butter until tender.
Stir in flour, seasonings and chicken broth.
Cook over low heat until slightly thickened.
Add chicken and heat until hot.
Serve over Almond-Raisin Rice.
Serves 4 to 6.
"Most delicious."

recipes.title: Chicken D'Artichoke
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Drain artichokes and arrange in a 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Spread chicken on top.
Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese.
Toss bread cubes in melted butter and pour over cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Serve over rice.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Dumplings
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder and salt.
Combine milk and oil; add to dry ingredients.
Stir just to moisten.
Drop by tablespoons directly onto chicken in boiling broth.
Cover tightly and return to boiling.
Reduce heat (do not lift lid).
Simmer 12 to 15 minutes.
I boil 12 minutes.
Makes 10 dumplings.

recipes.title: Chicken Egg Drop Soup
instructions: Cook onion and celery in broth until tender.
Slowly pour beaten egg into boiling broth, stirring so egg separates into shreds.
Yields 4 cups (4 servings).

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Round Steak
instructions: Pound steak thoroughly.
Cut in serving pieces.
Blend egg and milk.
Dip meat in egg mixture, then in crumbs.
Slowly brown meat in hot oil (iron skillet works well), turning once.
Season with salt and pepper; cover.
Cook over low heat for 30 to 45 minutes or until tender.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Gumbo Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients, cover and cook about two hours.
It can be made in a slow cooker on low setting for two hours.
Yields 1 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Chicken In Almond Sauce
instructions: Cut the chicken in 4 or 6 parts.
In the pot, mix chicken, water, vinegar, garlic and salt.
Cook for 45 minutes or until chicken is soft.
In a separate pan, fry the almonds in oil. Remove from the oil, chop with a clove of garlic.
Pour over the meat.
Cover the pot for 10 minutes, the juices must thicken. Serve over white rice or with French fries.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken International
instructions: Cook chicken and debone it.
Cut into pieces.
Melt butter in skillet over medium heat.
Add chicken and salt, stirring constantly for 3 minutes.
Add the rest of ingredients.
Cook until vegetables are almost soft.
Serve over rice.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Chicken Log
instructions: Mix cheese, mayo, lemon juice, salt, ginger, pepper and pepper sauce.
Stir in chicken, eggs and green pepper.
Shape into log, 8 x 12 inches.
Wrap in plastic wrap; refrigerate about 4 hours. Top with toasted sesame seed.
Serve with crackers and/or bread rounds.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Chicken Luncheon Casserole
instructions: Mix together and spread in greased 9x12-inch (or 13-inch) pan. Cover and put in the refrigerator overnight.
Bake at 300 degrees for 2 hours or 350 degrees for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Cut in serving pieces.
This can be baked, cooled and frozen and then reheated if there are leftovers.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Chicken Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan over medium heat, melt butter or margarine. Add green pepper and celery. Cook until tender, stirring occasionally. Stir in flour, salt and pepper until blended.
Gradually stir in milk. Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens slightly. Stir in chicken and shredded cheese just until cheese is melted.
Remove from heat. Stir cooked, hot macaroni into cheese mixture until well blended. Serve with salad and crackers or hot bread.
Kids will love this.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Mushroom Soup
instructions: Melt butter and cook mushrooms.
Sprinkle in flour and salt; cook until thick, stirring constantly.
Gradually whisk in cream, then broth.
Add chicken.
When hot add sherry and serve immediately.
Makes about 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Or Turkey, Ham Bake
instructions: Saute onions and mushrooms. Blend in flour, salt, pepper, milk and sherry. Cook until thick. Add turkey, ham and water chestnuts. Pour into casserole dish and top with cheese.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 400°.
Serves 4.
Good to use up leftovers.

recipes.title: Chicken Orange Mandarin
instructions: In large skillet heat oil, then add chicken, stirring well for about 2 minutes.
Add celery and cook until bright green.
Add garlic powder, green pepper and green onion, stirring until done. In bowl mix teriyaki sauce, cornstarch, then add to skillet.
Then add orange slices and pineapple chunks.
Stir until thickened. Serve over white steamed rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken Oregano
instructions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces.

Mix egg and milk together in small bowl. Dip chicken into egg/milk mixture, then coat with bread crumbs. Fry chicken in butter and oil just until brown. Remove chicken from pan. Saute onion until clear.
Add garlic. Fry for 5 minutes. Remove garlic.
Add 1/4 cup cooking wine to hot oil.
Let it steam for 30 seconds. Add 1/2 cup water and oregano. Stir and simmer 5 minutes. Add mushrooms and chicken. Serve over egg noodles or rice. Serves 5.

recipes.title: Chicken Oriental
instructions: Rinse, dry and slice fresh mushrooms (5 cups) or drain canned mushrooms, reserving liquid.
In large skillet, heat 3 tablespoons oil.
Add mushrooms; saute 5 minutes.
Remove and set aside.
Heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil.
Add chicken; brown.
Remove and set aside.
To skillet, add celery, onion, green pepper and garlic; saute until tender, about 5 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with water or reserved mushroom liquid (makes 2 cups).
Stir in skillet along with soy sauce, salt, ginger and red pepper.
Return chicken, uncovered, until tender, 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms, heat and serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Paprikas
instructions: Brown onion in shortening.
Add seasonings and chicken; brown 10 minutes.
Add water, cover and simmer until tender. Remove chicken.
Add sour cream to drippings and mix well.
Add cooked noodles.
Arrange chicken on top.
Heat through and serve.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Pepper Pasta
instructions: In 12-inch skillet melt margarine.
Stir in onion, peppers and garlic.
Cook over medium-high heat until peppers are crispy-tender (2 to 3 minutes).
Remove vegetables from skillet with slotted spoon and set aside.
Reserve juices in pan.
Add chicken, tarragon, salt and pepper.
Continue cooking, stirring occasionally until chicken is lightly browned and fork-tender (7 to 9 minutes). Prepare vermicelli as directed, drain.
Add vegetables, half and half, Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses.
Reduce heat, cook until cheese melts (3 to 5 minutes).
Add vermicelli.
Toss gently to coat.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Picado
instructions: Brown chicken slices in ovenproof pan.
Remove with slotted spoon.
Saute green peppers over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes.
Add chicken back, cook until just done, remove from heat.
Preheat broiler to high.
Top chicken mixture with butter, garlic and cheese.
Place under broiler 6 to 7 minutes, until well browned. Garnish with sliced green onion.
Serve with warm tortillas and Spanish rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.
In medium bowl, combine soup, milk, soup mix and mushrooms.
Stir until blended.
Reserve 1/2 cup of the mixture.
Stir rice and thawed vegetables into remaining mixture.
Spoon vegetable mixture into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Arrange chicken pieces on top.
Pour reserved 1/2 cup soup mixture over chicken.
Sprinkle paprika over all.
Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until rice is tender and chicken is cooked through. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad With Almonds
instructions: Toss chicken and celery together.
Mix onion, lemon juice, mayonnaise and cream.
Add to chicken and toss until chicken and celery are coated.
Season with salt and pepper and stir in almonds.
Chill.
Serves 5.

recipes.title: Chicken Scallopini
instructions: Pound chicken breasts very thin between 2 sheets of waxed paper (use flat side of mallet).
Dip chicken breasts first into beaten egg, then into bread crumbs.
Heat oil with clove of garlic; remove garlic.
Brown chicken for 3 minutes each side over medium heat.
Add basil and sherry.
Top with lemon slices and capers.
Simmer 5 to 6 minutes or until cooked through.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Skillet Dinner
instructions: Brown chicken in oil until lightly browned; remove from pan. Add vegetables and stir for 2 or 3 minutes.
Add chicken broth mixed with cornstarch to pan.
Return chicken to pan.
Cover and cook slowly for 20 minutes.
Serves 2.

recipes.title: Chicken Stuffed Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs in half lengthwise; remove the yolks and mash. Combine chicken, egg yolks, celery, mustard, salt and mayonnaise; mix well.
Stuff the whites with mixture; sprinkle with paprika. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Chicken Superb(Diabetic)
instructions: Mix together flour, salt and half the pepper.
Lightly coat chicken with flour mixture.
Cook chicken in margarine until golden, using a tightly covered pan.
Turn breasts meat side down; add remaining ingredients and cover.
Stirring occasionally, simmer gently until tender (about 30 minutes).
Serve over noodles or rice.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Taco Bake
instructions: Blend enchilada sauce and soup.
Stir in chicken and onion. Grease a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with half of the corn chips.
Pour chicken mixture over.
Sprinkle with cheese, then remaining chips.
Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Tasty And Tangy

ingredients.notes: cut up or pieces of your choice

instructions: Mix all ingredients except chicken in small saucepan.
Heat on low until butter is melted and ingredients are blended.
Dip each piece of chicken in sauce and place skin side down in a shallow baking pan.
Pour remaining sauce over chicken.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 25 minutes.
Then turn pieces skin side up.
Bake 35 minutes.
Makes about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Vegetable Salad
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the first 6 ingredients.
In a large bowl, put the remaining ingredients.
Add mayonnaise mixture to the large bowl.
Toss to coat well.
Chill at least 2 hours to blend flavors.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Chicken Waldorf Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients until blended.
Garnish with shredded carrots, if desired.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken With 40 Cloves Of Garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large Dutch oven, melt margarine in oil.
Add cut-up chicken, turning until golden (5 to 10 minutes). Tilt pan and spoon off all but 2 tablespoons fat.
Add garlic and stir.
Sprinkle with lemon, thyme, salt, pepper and water.
Cover tightly and bake 1 1/2 hours.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken With Buttermilk Dumplings
instructions: Combine chicken, onion and enough water to cover in a large pan; cook until tender.
Remove chicken from broth, reserving broth.
Debone chicken.
Sift flour, soda and salt together into mixing bowl.
Cut in shortening.
Blend egg and buttermilk.
Stir enough buttermilk mixture to form dough.
Roll thin on lightly floured board.
Cut into short strips.
Combine chicken, soup and broth; bring to a rolling boil, stirring.
Drop in dumplings and cook until tender.
Add milk and bring to a boil.
Serve immediately.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken With Mustard Cream
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to 1/4-inch thickness and season with salt and pepper.
Spread both sides of chicken with 2 tablespoons mustard and coat with flour.
Melt the butter in a 10-inch skillet over moderately high heat.
Brown the chicken in the butter. Remove chicken to a warm platter.
Pour the cream into skillet and boil rapidly, about 2 minutes, scraping brown bits stuck to the skillet.
Remove skillet from heat and add 1 tablespoon mustard. Add additional mustard and seasoning to taste.
Return chicken to skillet and reheat, basting with sauce.
Serves 4.
Recipe can be halved.

recipes.title: Chicken-N-Rice Bake
instructions: Combine process cheese spread and rice; mix well.
Add chicken, peas and half of onions; mix lightly.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Top with remaining onions.
Continue baking 5 minutes or until onions are lightly browned.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Chickpeas And Macaroni
instructions: Saute onion (cut in slivers) in olive oil.
Add tomato sauce and chickpeas.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Cook linguine and drain. Spoon chickpeas and sauce onto linguine.
Add Parmesan cheese. Serves 6 to 8 people.

recipes.title: Chili Lentils
instructions: Bring water to boil and add lentils, cover and simmer 30 minutes or until tender and drain.
Cook ground chuck, onion and garlic until browned.
Combine meat mixture, lentils, tomatoes, chili powder, oregano and salt in Dutch oven and cook over high heat until mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chili Mac
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water with 1 tablespoon cooking oil. Drain off liquid.
Meanwhile, brown beef and onion.
Add tomato juice, brown sugar, salt, pepper, chili powder and cooked macaroni.
Simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
Pour into dish and serve. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Chili Strata
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix egg and water.
Crush 4 cups corn chips.
Add egg mixture to crushed chips.
Spread in lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Combine chili, 1 cup enchilada sauce, green pepper and onion.
Spread over corn chips in baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Top with cheese and remaining whole corn chips.
Bake 5 minutes more.
Top with lettuce and tomatoes.
Serve with remaining sauce.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Chili-Cheese Corn Bread
instructions: Chop pepperoni.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
In large bowl, measure flour, corn meal, sugar, baking powder and salt.
With wire whisk, beat eggs, milk, oil and sour cream until smooth.
Stir egg mixture into flour mixture.
Stir in pepperoni, cheese, onion and green chilies.
Spoon batter into pan. Bake for 45 minutes, or until golden brown and toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Makes 14 servings.

recipes.title: Chili-Mac Skillet
instructions: In large skillet, brown meat with onions.
Drain off fat.
Stir in kidney beans, tomato sauce, undrained tomatoes, uncooked macaroni, green pepper, water, chili powder and garlic salt.
Bring to boil; reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring often.
Remove skillet from heat.
Sprinkle meat mixture with Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese (both can be used).
Cover and let stand for 2 minutes or until cheese melts.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chinese Pepper Steak With Rice
instructions: Melt Crisco or drippings.
Add beef and brown slowly over a low flame.
Add onion, green peppers, celery and 1/2 cup liquid. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Thicken with cornstarch blended with water and soy sauce.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Serve hot with boiled rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chinese-Style Cabbage
instructions: Heat shortening in skillet.
Drop in vegetables; stir well. Cover tightly; steam 5 minutes on medium heat, stirring several times.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chippy Blond Brownies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, cream margarine and brown sugar.
Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Beat in vanilla.
Combine the flour, baking powder and salt; gradually add to the creamed mixture. Stir in the chocolate chips and pecans.
Spread into a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.
Cool on a wire rack.
Yield: 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Billionaires
instructions: Microwave caramels and water in 2-quart glass measure on 100% power for 3 minutes, stirring after 1 1/2 minutes.
Stir well; mix in pecans and cereal.
Drop mixture by teaspoonful onto greased waxed paper-lined baking sheets.
Insert a toothpick in center of each candy; chill until firm.
Microwave chocolate chips in 1-quart glass measure on 100% power for 2 minutes.
Stir in vegetable shortening.
Dip candies into chocolate.
Place onto waxed paper.
Chill.
Store in an airtight container.
Makes 4 dozen candies.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies(Eggless)
instructions: Mix ingredients, adding chips last.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet.
Bake in 350° oven.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Coated Popcorn
instructions: Boil sugar, water, corn syrup and chocolate together until it reaches hard ball stage (about 254°).
Pour slowly over popped corn in a large bowl.
Mix quickly. Butter hands and quickly shape into balls. Makes about 12 balls.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cookies(No Bake)
instructions: Bring to a boil over medium heat for 1 minute only the oleo, sugar and milk.
Add dry mixture to cooked wet mixture.
Mix well. Drop onto foil sheets with a tablespoon.
Let cool completely. Makes 3 dozen or more cookies.

recipes.title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: In a mixing bowl, beat margarine and cocoa powder until margarine is softened.
Gradually add 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar, beating well.
Slowly beat in 3 tablespoons skim milk and vanilla. Slowly beat in 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar and additional skim milk, if needed, to make of spreading consistency.
Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge Meringues
instructions: Beat egg whites, cream of tartar and salt to soft peaks in medium bowl.
Beat to stiff peaks, adding sugar gradually.
Fold in cocoa, then fold in chopped chocolate.
Drop mixture by tablespoons onto aluminum foil-lined cookie sheets.
Bake at 300° until cookies feel crisp when touched (20 to 25 minutes).
Cool on pans on wire racks.
Makes 24 cookies.

recipes.title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Heat milk in saucepan, but do not boil.
In a bowl, mix the sugar, cocoa, flour and salt and stir in enough milk to make a smooth paste.
Pour this into the warm milk.
Stir continuously over moderate heat until the sauce thickens.
Add butter and vanilla.
Serve over hot, buttered biscuits.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal Drops
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix sugar, margarine, shortening, water, egg and vanilla.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Drop by rounded teaspoonful about 1 inch apart onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake until almost no indentation remains when touched, 10 to 12 minutes.
Immediately remove from cookie sheet.
Makes about 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Puffs(A Macaroon-Type Cookie)
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add sugar gradually and continue beating until blended.
Add salt and vanilla.
Fold in melted chocolate, coconut and nuts.
Drop by teaspoon onto baking sheet. Bake in slow oven (300°) for 10 to 15 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Ripple Divinity
instructions: Combine sugar, water, syrup and salt in a heavy saucepan. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugar is dissolved. Cook to a hard ball stage without stirring.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Pour hot syrup slowly over egg whites, beating constantly.
Add vanilla.
Continue beating until mixture loses gloss and will hold shape.
Fold in chocolate bits quickly and drop from teaspoon onto buttered waxed paper.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sugar Cookies
instructions: In bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt.
In another bowl, combine 1 cup of sugar and oil; mix well.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Gradually add flour mixture.
Stir in chips; drop by tablespoon.
Shape into balls.
Roll into remaining sugar.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 325°.
Makes 5 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Chocolate Tea Bread
instructions: Cream butter or margarine, sugar and egg in large mixer bowl until light and fluffy.
Combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt in small mixing bowl.
Add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture.
Beat on low speed just until blended; stir in nuts and raisins.
Pour into greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Remove from pan.
Cool completely on wire rack.
Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Chocolate Yummies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter in saucepan over low heat; cool. Combine biscuit mix and sugar.
Stir in egg, milk, chocolate mixture and vanilla.
Blend well.
Fold in coconut and drop from a teaspoon onto an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 14 minutes.
Cool on rack.
Spread tops with buttercream frosting or chocolate frosting.
Decorate if desired.
Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate, Oatmeal, Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine in a saucepan the sugar and cocoa.
When thoroughly mixed, add the milk or cream and margarine.
Place over low heat and let margarine melt, stirring constantly. When it starts to boil, let boil hard for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in the oatmeal, peanut butter and vanilla.
Drop by spoon on buttered plate or wax paper.
Place in refrigerator for 1 hour or until cool and hard.
Makes approximately 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Dipped Coconut Balls
instructions: In large bowl combine coconut, sweetened condensed milk and melted butter.
Set aside in a cool dry area for 2 to 3 hours. Then add confectioners sugar and knead mixture to well mixed. Shape into 1 inch balls and place on baking sheets lined with wax paper.
Freeze until firm.
Once frozen these can be dropped into Ziploc storage bags to dip at a later time.
When ready to dip, melt together chocolate pieces and Crisco in top of double boiler. Dip tops of frozen balls in warm chocolate mixture (chocolate will set immediately.)
Store in cool place.
Makes 8 dozen pieces.

recipes.title: Chow Mein Cookies
instructions: Melt chips in double boiler or microwave.
Add noodles and peanuts; stir.
Spoon out on waxed paper to cool.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Christiana Campbell'S Tavern Sweet Potato Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease muffin tins that are 1 1/2-inches in diameter.
Puree sweet potatoes in blender.
Cream butter and sugar.
Beat egg into the potatoes.
Sift flour with baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add the dry ingredients alternating by hand with milk, chopped nuts and raisins, mixing just until blended.
Do not overmix.
Spoon into greased muffin tins, filling each tin completely full.
A little sugar and cinnamon may be sprinkled on top of each muffin.
Bake at 400° for 25 minutes. Yields 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Christmas Eggs
instructions: Spray casserole with Pam.
Mix all ingredients together.
Chill in refrigerator overnight.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Great for brunches!
Serves 10 people.

recipes.title: Christmas Figure Cookies
instructions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Set aside.
Cream shortening; add sugar gradually and continue to beat until light. Add well beaten eggs and blend thoroughly.
Add vanilla.
Combine dry ingredients and creamed; mix thoroughly.
Chill.
Roll thin to 1/8-inch on lightly floured board and cut with cookie cutter or form drop cookies.
Bake at 400° for 6 to 10 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except ginger ale.
Add ginger ale to punch mixture when ready to serve.
Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Christmas Snack Crunch
instructions: Combine butter, sugar and preserves in a 3-quart saucepan. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until well blended and smooth.
Remove from heat.
Add remaining ingredients mixing until dry ingredients are coated.
Spread mixture evenly into ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Bake in preheated oven at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown, stirring occasionally. Spread mixture onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Cool.
Break into bite sized pieces.
Store in tightly covered container in cool dry place. Yields 6 cups.

recipes.title: Chuck-Wagon Cabbage And Apples

ingredients.notes: unpeeled, cored and cut into 2-inch pieces

instructions: Heat the bacon drippings in a 12-inch cast-iron Dutch oven over medium heat on the stove top (or a fire or hot coals).
Add the onion and cabbage.
Cook, covered, over just enough heat to steam the cabbage for 25 to 30 minutes, or until tender.
Stir occasionally to keep the onion from browning too much.
Stir in the apples, lemon juice, sugar and salt.
Cover and continue to cook over low heat for another 25 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the apples are soft and cooked down.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Chunky Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in a Dutch oven; bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 45 minutes.
Remove chicken from broth, and cool.
Strain broth; discard celery leaves and solidified fat.
Return broth to Dutch oven; add green onions and next 8 ingredients.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Bone and chop chicken; add to broth.
Cook 5 more minutes.
Discard bay leaf.
Sprinkle soup with pepper, if desired.
Yield 7 cups.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Apple Waffles
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together.
Combine eggs, milk, Wesson oil and apples; add to dry ingredients.
Beat until smooth.
Use about 1/2 cup batter for each waffle.
Bake in hot waffle iron until golden brown.
Yield: 8 waffles.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Flan(Spanish)
instructions: Combine sugar and 2 teaspoons water in heavy small skillet. Cook, stirring constantly, until caramelized and syrup. Immediately pour into warm 4-cup buttered mold.
Tilt to coat bottom and sides of container while sugar is still hot.
Beat eggs well.
Add milk, 1 cup water, cinnamon and lemon peel.
Mix well. Pour into prepared mold.
Place casserole in longer pan containing hot water to level of custard.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cool completely. Loosen custard with knife.
Put on serving platter and spoon caramel over top.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
Preparation time: 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cinnamon French Toast
instructions: Combine eggs, cinnamon and vanilla in a large shallow pan/bowl.
Add bread, turning over so it absorbs the egg.
Fry with butter or margarine until brown on all sides.
Serve with fruit jam or syrup.
Makes 4 slices.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine butter, sugar and eggs.
Beat until mixture is light and fluffy.
Blend in sour cream.
Sift flour with soda and baking powder into the creamed mixture.
Add vanilla and blend.
Spoon 1/2 batter in 9-inch tube pan which has been buttered and floured. Sprinkle in cinnamon-nut mixture over batter.
Spoon the remaining batter in and top with the rest of nut mixture.
Place in cold oven; set overn to moderate (350°) and bake about 55 minutes.
Serve warm or cool.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Twists
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Scald cream. Add sugar, salt and oil. Cool to lukewarm.
Add beaten eggs and yeast dissolved in warm water.
Beat and add flour gradually until of kneading consistency. Knead on floured board for 5 minutes.
Let rise in warm place. Divide dough. Roll out as a rectangle and spread half with 1/4 of the butter and cinnamon mixture. Fold other half over and repeat process.
Roll to 1-inch thick and cut in strips, 1 x 5 x 6-inch.
Twist and place on cookie sheet. Let rise.
Bake at 400° for 12 or 15 minutes. When cool, frost with powdered sugar icing.
Makes 4 dozen rolls.

recipes.title: Clam Fritter
instructions: Drain Clams and chop.
Sift all dry ingredients together. Combine Eggs, Milk, Onion, Butter and Clams, pour into dry ingredients.
Stir until smooth.
Drop batter by teaspoonfuls into hot fat (350 degrees).
Fry about three minutes or until golden brown.
Drain.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Clara'S Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars.
Add eggs, vanilla and oatmeal.
Mix dry ingredients (flour, salt and soda), then add to creamed mixture.
Add nuts, raisins and chocolate chips.
(These can be worked in by hand.)
Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 7 to 10 minutes.
Makes approximately 7 dozen.

recipes.title: Classic Alfredo
instructions: Cook fettucine according to package directions; drain. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, melt butter or margarine over medium heat.
Stir in heavy cream and milk.
Gradually stir in cream cheese, then Parmesan cheese until well blended.
Stir in parsley.
In small pan, cook scallops and add to sauce.
Pour over hot fettucine.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Classic Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan.
Add sugar, cocoa and milk, half at a time, stirring constantly.
Add salt.
Stir until mixture just begins to boil.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.
Makes 3 to 4 cups.

recipes.title: Classic Meat Loaf
instructions: Reserve 1/4 cup tomato sauce.
Combine ground beef, remaining tomato sauce, bread crumbs, egg, onion, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, salt and pepper, mixing thoroughly.
Shape beef mixture into an 8 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Place on rack in an open roasting pan. Combine brown sugar and mustard and blend with reserved tomato sauce.
Spread over top of loaf.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Classic Turkey Salad
instructions: In medium bowl, stir together mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt and pepper until smooth.
Add rest of ingredients; toss to coat well.
Cover and chill.
Makes about 5 cups.

recipes.title: Coating For Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 425°.
Line 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with foil.
Heat margarine in pan in oven until melted.
Mix baking mix, paprika, salt and pepper; coat chicken.
Place, skin side down, in pan. Bake uncovered 35 minutes.
Turn.
Bake until done, about 15 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cocoa Fudge Sauce
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in saucepan.
Add corn syrup and milk and blend thoroughly; bring to a boil.
Boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in butter and vanilla.
Cool, without stirring, until pan feels warm to hand.
Serve.
Yields 1 1/2 cupfuls sauce. Very good!

recipes.title: Coconut Fudge
instructions: Put sugar, milk and butter in saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat.
Add rest of the ingredients and beat well. Drop on a greased cookie sheet or wax paper.
Makes 3 dozen candies.

recipes.title: Coffee Breeze
instructions: In heavy saucepan, combine sugar and milk.
Bring to a boil, stirring, until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat.
Let stand until cool. Combine milk mixture, coffee, vanilla and 1 cup whipping cream. Pour mixture into loaf pan. Freeze until slush, about 1 to 2 hours.
Beat cream until stiff. Stir slush mixture. Spoon into dessert dishes. Top with whipped cream.
Makes 12 (1/2 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Cold Bean Salad
instructions: In large bowl, combine all beans, pimiento and onion.
Combine remaining ingredients in small bowl.
Stir well and pour over bean mixture, tossing gently.
Cover; refrigerate to chill and blend flavors.
Stir gently several times before serving (if you remember).
Can be made day before.
Makes 10 servings.
Has appeared at potlucks at campgrounds across the country on our RV travels.

recipes.title: Cold Macaroni Salad(Summer Salad)
instructions: In large boiling pot, cook and drain noodles as directed. Rinse noodles under cold water to stop cooking.
In large bowl, blend the rest of ingredients, then add noodles.
Blend and refrigerate.
Serve cold.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Coleslaw Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup boiling water.
Stir in mayonnaise, 1/2 cup cold water, vinegar and salt.
Chill until partially set. Beat until light and fluffy.
Stir in vegetables.
Pour into 4 cup mold.
Chill until firm.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Combination Vegetable Dish
instructions: Cook green beans according to package directions.
Add broccoli when beans are partially cooked.
Cook until beans and broccoli are tender.
Drain.
Saute water chestnuts in butter for 5 minutes.
Add to vegetables and toss lightly.
Serve.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Company Baked Beans
instructions: Chop bacon into small pieces; lightly brown in skillet.
Add green pepper and onion; continue to cook until tender.
Add all other ingredients; stir to blend.
Pour bean mixture into lightly greased 2-quart casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Company Cabbage
instructions: In large saucepan, heat bouillon in 1/4 cup water until dissolved.
Add cabbage, carrots, onion, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper; toss to mix.
Cook, covered, 5 to 10 minutes or until tender.
Combine butter, mustard and pecans and pour over vegetables; toss to mix.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Company Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place thawed potatoes in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Place chicken and mushrooms over potatoes.
Stir together remaining ingredients except almonds and pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with almonds.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Company Ham Dish
instructions: Drain pineapple; reserve liquid.
Cut chunks in half.
Blend mayonnaise, mustard, seasoning and pineapple juice.
Stir in pineapple and remaining ingredients.
Serve cold as a salad or bake in casserole dish at 350° for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with paprika or almonds.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Company Meat Loaf
instructions: Add green pepper, garlic, onion, celery and oatmeal to ground chuck.
Work in eggs, milk, 1/4 can cream of mushroom soup, salt and pepper.
Shape and put in loaf pan.
Mix remaining soup, ketchup and Worcestershire sauce and spread on top of loaf.
Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Confetti Coleslaw Parfait
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water.
Stir in cold water and vinegar. Gradually add gelatin to Miracle Whip, mixing until well blended. Chill until slightly thickened.
Fold in cabbage, carrots, celery and raisins.
Pour into 1-quart mold. Chill until firm.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Continental Zucchini
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet.
Saute zucchini and garlic for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add pimiento, corn, salt (if desired) and lemon pepper; cook and stir for 2 to 3 minutes or until zucchini is tender.
Sprinkle with cheese and heat until cheese melts.
Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cookie Raisin Puffs
instructions: Cream shortening, 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs until fluffy.
Add flour, soda and salt to creamed mixture.
Add cooked raisins. Shape dough into small balls.
Roll each in sugar and place on greased sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Yields 6 to 8 dozen.

recipes.title: Cool Rise Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add warm milk, brown sugar, salt and margarine to yeast and water mixture.
Add 2 cups flour and oats.
Blend together.
Let rest for 20 minutes.
Add remaining flour; mix and knead until smooth.
Form loaves.
Brush with oil. Refrigerate 2 to 24 hours.
Bake in 400° oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Coq-Au-Vin
instructions: Combine flour, salt and pepper in a bag.
Add chicken; shake to coat.
Set aside.
Meanwhile, cut bacon into 1-inch pieces; put bacon in skillet.
Fry lightly; do not drain.
Stir in flour from bag.
Add remaining ingredients; let simmer on low until done or bake in oven at 350° for about 1 hour and 10 minutes or 1 hour and 20 minutes or until tender.
Remove bay leaf.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Corn And Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix together and pour into casserole dish.
Melt 1 stick margarine in a pan; add 1 1/2 cups of herb seasoned stuffing mix. Stir enough to mix.
Sprinkle on top of vegetables.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Corn Curry
instructions: Combine margarine, vegetables and curry powder in a skillet. Cook over low heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Stir in sour cream and pepper.
Heat thoroughly, stirring often; do not allow to boil.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Corn Flake Chews
instructions: Heat sugar and syrup to boiling stage, stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add peanut butter.
Mix well.
Add corn flakes, stirring with wooden spoon until all are coated with syrup.
Drop by small rounds onto waxed paper.
Makes about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Corn Sausage Chowder(Soup)
instructions: In Dutch oven or kettle, cook sausage and onion until sausage is brown and onion is tender; drain on paper towel.
Return sausage and onion to Dutch oven with potato, salt, marjoram, pepper and water.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer just until potato is tender, about 15 minutes.
Add cream-style corn, whole kernel corn and evaporated milk.
Heat through.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Corn Soup
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp.
Add onion and saute until soft.
Put corn through food processor and add to bacon and onion.
Cook until brown.
Add oleo and flour.
Combine well and cook slowly for 3 minutes.
Add milk, salt and pepper.
Cook until thickened. Add 2 cups of light cream and stir until smooth.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Corn Spoon Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except whole kernel corn.
Fold in corn.
Bake in a greased 11 x 7-inch baking dish at 350° for 35 minutes or until knife tests clean.
Yield: 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Sandwiches
instructions: Cook onion in butter until soft.
Stir in corned beef and ketchup. Cook over low heat, stirring frequently, approximately 15 minutes. Serve in hot, split buns. Makes 8 sandwiches.
Serve these with hot vegetable soup.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Baked Chicken
instructions: Combine cornmeal and spices; dip chicken in milk, then coat in cornmeal mixture.
Place on rack in shallow baking pan.
Drizzle margarine over chicken.
Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Cereal
instructions: Toast almonds
in oven until light brown.
Boil 1 quart of water.
Mix
pint
plus 1 1/4 cups cold water with cornmeal. Slowly
add cornmeal to boiling water.
Stir constantly for 15 minutes.
Add other ingredients and simmer 15 minutes. Makes approximately 1 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Muffins
instructions: Cream shortening.
Add sugar and eggs.
Beat until thick and light colored.
Stir in alternately flour, cornmeal, baking powder and salt with the milk.
Mix thoroughly and bake about 20 minutes at 400° in well-buttered muffin pans.
Yields 14 to 16 muffins.

recipes.title: Country Captain Chicken
instructions: Flour and salt chicken.
Brown in oil.
Remove.
Add onion, green pepper and garlic.
Cook 3 minutes. Blend in tomato sauce, water, seasonings and currants. Mix well.
Replace chicken.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Garnish with almonds.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Country Chicken And Potato Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Cut unpeeled potatoes into 1 1/2-inch chunks.
Finely chop onion.
In large roasting pan, toss potatoes and onion with chicken, salt, pepper and rosemary.
Arrange the chicken pieces skin side up.
Bake uncovered one hour or until potatoes are tender and browned and juices run clear when chicken is pierced, basting with pan drippings occasionally.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Country Chicken Casserole(Great Over Hot Cooked Rice)
instructions: In 3-quart casserole, cook garlic, onion and green pepper, covered, on High for 4 to 6 minutes, until tender, stirring halfway through cooking.
Stir in flour until blended, then tomatoes with their liquid, raisins, half of curry powder (1 1/2 teaspoons) and salt, stirring to break up tomatoes.
Add chicken pieces, arranging meatier portions toward edge of casserole.
Sprinkle chicken with remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder.
Cook, covered, on High 20 to 24 minutes, until chicken juices run clear, stirring mixture and rearranging chicken halfway through cooking.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Country Chicken Stew
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp.
In hot drippings, cook onion and oregano until tender.
Stir in soup, water, potatoes and carrots. Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally.
Stir in beans; cover. Simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in crumbled bacon, chicken and parsley. Heat through.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Country Corn Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.
In large bowl, combine corn, soup, milk, celery, pimiento, seasoned salt, 1/4 cup cheese and 1/2 can French fried onions.
Crumble 3 slices bacon; stir into corn mixture.
Spoon corn mixture into 8-inch square baking dish. Bake, covered, at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Top with remaining bacon slices, cheese and onions; bake, uncovered, 3 minutes or until onions are golden brown.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Country Style Chicken Kiev
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients.
Dip chicken pieces in butter. Set remaining butter aside.
Roll in crumbs.
Place in shallow casserole.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.
To leftover butter, add remaining ingredients.
Pour over baked chicken.
Bake 20 minutes more or until done.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cowboy Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in fat.
Thinly slice garlic; sprinkle with salt and mash thoroughly to pulp.
Add to beef with onion, green pepper and chili powder.
Cook 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and add tomatoes.
Combine rice and beans in 2-quart casserole dish. Add hot beef mixture.
Bake, covered, 1 hour at 350°.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Cowboy Caviar
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except cream cheese, eggs, green onions and fresh red pepper.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Spread cream cheese on serving dish.
Spoon bean mixture evenly over cream cheese.
Arrange egg on bean mixture.
Sprinkle with green onions and red pepper.
Serve with tortilla chips.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Crab And Cheese Bites(Appetizer)
instructions: Mix oleo, cream cheese, crabmeat and Cheez Whiz.
Spread on English muffin halves.
Put in freezer until firm enough to cut into wedges, approximately 1 hour.
Remove from freezer and cut into wedges, about 4 per half.
Refreeze in plastic bag.
When ready to use, remove amount to be used and broil until golden brown.
Cheese Bites can be kept in freezer for a few months.
Add horseradish or use jalapeno Cheez Whiz for a spicier taste or serve with shrimp cocktail sauce on top of each wedge.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Crab And Shrimp Au Gratin
instructions: Cook the shrimp in salted water 3 minutes. Drain.
Saute mushrooms, garlic and onion in butter for 5 minutes. Stir in flour, pepper and dill, then stir in milk.
Bring to a boil. Remove from heat.
Add half of the cheese. Stir until melted.
Add white wine.
Mix lightly the crab and artichokes with the other mixture and the rest of the cheese.
Pour into a 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with crumbs.
Bake at 350° until bubbly. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Crab And Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Saute onions, mushrooms and garlic in large pan in melted butter until tender.
Do not brown.
Combine with all remaining ingredients.
Pour mixture into a 3-quart baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 35 to 45 minutes.
Can make ahead and refrigerate.
Bake approximately 1 hour from refrigerator.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Crab And Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in medium bowl.
For creamier dip, add more sour cream.
Yield: 2 cups.

recipes.title: Crab Meat Florentine
instructions: Pick over crab meat.
Drain spinach.
Saute mushrooms over medium heat in large skillet until golden.
Blend in flour, garlic salt, pepper, sherry and milk.
Stir in sour cream, spinach and crab meat.
Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens. Place in bowl and sprinkle with cheese.
Place under broiler about 5 inches from heat until melted and nicely browned (about 7 to 10 minutes).
Serves 4.
Good served with herbed rice.

recipes.title: Crab Soup
instructions: Melt butter in top of double boiler; blend in flour until smooth.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly.
Add crab meat and seasonings.
Cook slowly over hot water for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley or paprika.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Crab Stuffed Avocado
instructions: Mix the crab meat, celery, mayonnaise, chili sauce and lemon juice.
Split the avocados; remove the pits and sprinkle avocado halves with lemon juice and stuff with the crab meat mixture. Serve on lettuce-lined plates with crackers and fresh fruit. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Crab Stuffed Potatoes

ingredients.notes: drained and flaked or 1 (8 oz.) pkg. imitation crabmeat

instructions: Bake potatoes at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until tender. When cool enough to handle, halve potatoes lengthwise.
Carefully scoop out pulp into a bowl, leaving a thin shell.
Set shells aside.
Beat or mash potato pulp with butter, cream, salt and pepper until smooth.
Using a fork, stir in onions or chives and cheese.
Gently mix in crab.
Stuff potatoes shells; sprinkle with paprika.
Return to oven for 15 minutes or until heated through. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Crab-Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Slice stem end from tomatoes; scoop out pulp.
Combine crab meat, green onions, parsley flakes, vinegar, bread crumbs and dill weed in bowl; mix well.
Stuff tomatoes with crab meat mixture. Arrange on paper towel-lined plate.
Microwave on High for 2 to 4 minutes or until heated through, turning plate once or twice. Garnish with paprika.
Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Crab-Stuffed Snow Peas
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except snow peas, mixing well. Chill.
Trim ends from snow peas. Using a sharp knife, carefully slit one side of each pod.
Spoon crab mixture into a decorating bag fitted with a tip with a large opening.
Pipe crab mixture into each snow pea.
Cover and chill.
Yield: 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Imperial
instructions: Saute butter and onions.
Cool.
Add all ingredients together, trying not to break up crabmeat lumps.
Place in casserole and bake for 25 minutes at 350°.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Crabmeat In Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: Blend butter, flour and milk.
Add beaten egg yolks.
Stir constantly until thick over heat.
Remove from heat.
Add lemon juice, salt and chopped shallots.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Mornay
instructions: Melt oleo in heavy pot and saute onions, bell pepper, celery and parsley.
I often substitute 1/2 carrot, finely chopped and sauteed for pimento.
Blend in flour, mushrooms, salt and pepper. Add evaporated milk or cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Gently fold in crabmeat, picked over.
Add sherry just before serving. Yields 5 1/2 cups, 75 pattie shells or 1 1/2 to 2 boxes Melba rounds.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Nippies
instructions: Flake crabmeat and toss with mayonnaise and onion.
Spoon onto Melba toast.
Sprinkle generously with cheese.
Broil 3 inches from heat 1 to 2 minutes until cheese is melted and slightly browned.
Serve hot.
Makes 20 to 24 canapes.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Omelet(Virginia Seafood Council)
instructions: Sure!
Crabmeat for breakfast!
Drain and flake about 6 ounces.
Slice green onions with tops very thin.
Cook 2 or 3 minutes in 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet.
Beat eggs. Add skim milk, salt, pepper and paprika.
Pour over onions and cook slowly until firm and browned on the bottom.
When done, sprinkle with crabmeat, fold over and turn out on a hot platter. Makes 4 servings and each portion contains only about 215 calories.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake pastry shell 5 minutes.
Mix ingredients; pour into pastry shell.
Bake 45 minutes.
Let stand 10 to 12 minutes until firm before cutting into wedges.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Souffle
instructions: In a buttered 2-quart shallow casserole, layer the bread cubes, cheese and then the crabmeat.
Repeat layers.
Combine beaten eggs, milk and salt and pour over layers.
Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight.
Pour melted butter over top and sprinkle with chopped pimento, if desired.
Set casserole in a pan of water and bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cracked Sugar Cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°.
Lightly grease a cookie sheet. Cream the sugar and butter until fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in the yolks and vanilla.
Sift the dry ingredients together, then add to the batter in 4 parts, mixing well after each addition.
Form dough into balls the size of a walnut and place balls on cookie sheet about 2 inches apart.
Do not flatten.
Bake for approximately 11 minutes.
Cool on a wire rack.
Repeat with remaining dough until used up.
Makes approximately 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Cranberry Glazed Chicken

ingredients.notes: cut up or 4 whole chicken breasts

instructions: Combine 1/2 cup flour, salt and pepper.
Skin chicken, if desired.
Dredge chicken in flour mixture.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chicken and cook 30 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove chicken and drain on paper towels; keep warm. Add cranberries, brown sugar and water to pan drippings in skillet; cook for 5 minutes or until cranberry skins pop.
Blend together 1 tablespoon flour, cinnamon, cloves, allspice and vinegar.
Add vinegar mixture to cranberry mixture and cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Return chicken to mixture in skillet and baste with cranberry mixture; cover and simmer 30 minutes, turning chicken occasionally.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cranberry Muffins
instructions: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda into a large bowl.
Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly.
Add egg, orange peel and orange juice all at once.
Stir until mixture is evenly moist.
Fold in cranberries.
Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups, 2/3 cup full.
Bake at 350° for about 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 15 muffins.

recipes.title: Cranberry Sweet Tart
instructions: Place washed cranberries in a 9-inch glass, non-greased pie dish.
Pour 1/3 cup white sugar and 1 tablespoon of butter over top.
Cover with a moist paper towel.
Microwave 3 to 5 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients, except the walnuts.
Sprinkle walnuts over cooked berries and pour sugar mixture over top.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until top looks dry.
Serves 8 (or 1 if it's a hit).

recipes.title: Cranberry-Orange Relish(No Cooking)
instructions: Put berries and orange through food processor until evenly chopped.
Stir in sugar to desired sweetness.
Mix well and refrigerate several hours before serving.
May be frozen.
Makes about 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat together all ingredients, except egg whites.
Beat whites until stiff
and
mix in batter.
Makes 3 layers.
Bake at 350° until firm to touch.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Glaze
instructions: In food processor (with blade in) combine lemon juice and soft butter or margarine.
Drop through chute the cream cheese, with motor running.
Add powdered sugar and process until smooth. Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Cream Of Mushroom Soup
instructions: Clean and slice mushrooms.
Fry in butter 5 minutes.
Add flour and blend.
Add stock.
Cool slightly; add cream and seasonings. Heat through and serve.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Cream Of Spinach Soup
instructions: Drain spinach thoroughly; set aside.
Saute onion in butter in a large saucepan until tender and add flour, stirring until smooth.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add milk and stir in spinach, salt and pepper.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and bubbly.
Makes about 1 quart.

recipes.title: Creamed Cheese Crescents
instructions: Mix ingredients until smooth and creamy.
Place dough in refrigerator overnight.
Divide dough and roll in powdered sugar. Cut into 2-inch squares.
Fill with prune, walnut or apricot butter.
Roll into crescents.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, or until brown.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cool.
Makes 10 dozen.

recipes.title: Creamed Cucumbers
instructions: Combine cucumbers and green onions in a large bowl.
Cover and let stand for 1 hour.
Combine all remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers and mix well.
Refrigerate for several hours. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Creamed Green Beans
instructions: Cook green beans following label directions.
Soften cream cheese.
Add other ingredients.
Add to beans and heat.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Creamed Ham
instructions: Melt oleo, add flour and blend well.
Slowly add milk, stirring constantly.
Add remaining ingredients; cook until slightly thickened and cheese is melted.
Serve on toast, rice or potatoes.
Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Creamed Peas
instructions: Cook peas according to package directions; drain.
In medium saucepan, melt butter; remove from heat.
Stir in flour, salt, pepper and nutmeg until smooth.
Gradually stir in milk and cream. Bring to boiling, stirring constantly.
Boil gently for 1 minute. Add peas; simmer 2 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Creamed Spinach
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large saucepan.
Saute onion in butter until brown.
Add washed, drained spinach to onion and cook, covered, for 3 to 5 minutes.
Drain and chop.
Return spinach to a saucepan.
While spinach is cooking, work remaining butter and flour together with a fork.
When spinach is cooked, lower heat and add butter-flour mixture a little at a time until all is smoothly incorporated.
Add milk and seasonings.
Reheat.
Use as a garnish with other vegetables.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Creamette Summer Salad
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions for salad use.
Drain.
Add tuna and next 6 ingredients.
Blend Italian dressing, sour cream and seasoned salt thoroughly.
Add to salad and toss well.
Chill.
Garnish with additional slices of cheese, if desired.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Creamless Celery Bisque
instructions: In large saucepan, bring broth to boil.
Add celery, onion, potatoes, salt, seasoning and pepper.
Simmer about 15 minutes, until tender.
Place 1/3 in blender or food processor.
Whirl until smooth.
Repeat until remaining mixture is smooth.
Return to saucepan; add milk.
Heat until hot.
Serve with croutons. Makes 10 cups.

recipes.title: Creamy Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Halve large fresh Brussels sprouts.
In a medium saucepan cook fresh sprouts, covered, in a small amount of boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes, or until crisp-tender.
Drain and remove from pan (or cook frozen sprouts according to package directions; drain and remove from pan; halve any large sprouts).
In the same saucepan, cook onion in butter or margarine until tender.
In a bowl combine milk, sour cream, flour, mustard and salt.
Add to saucepan.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in Brussels sprouts; heat through.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Creamy Cabbage Slaw
instructions: In serving dish, combine shredded cabbage and sliced onion. In small bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, celery seed and salt; stir until sugar is dissolved and ingredients are well blended.
Drizzle mayonnaise mixture over cabbage mixture in bowl. Toss lightly to mix well.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Creamy Cranberry Shake
instructions: Place 1/2 of milk and 1/2 of cream cheese in blender.
Blend until smooth.
Add 1/2 of ice cream and 1/2 of cranberry sauce. Blend until combined.
Scrape down sides of blender container if needed.
Pour into large pitcher.
Repeat with remaining ingredients.
Pour into pitcher and stir.
Serve immediately. Makes 7 (8 oz.) servings.

recipes.title: Creamy Cucumber Salad(This Is A Tasty Salad!)
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add vinegar and chill until partly thickened.
Fold in the remaining ingredients. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Creamy Italian-Style Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients, stirring well.
Cover and chill. Yields 1 cup.

recipes.title: Creamy No Cook Sauce(For Fresh Fruit)
instructions: Beat all ingredients together until blended; cover and chill. At serving time, fill dessert glasses with fresh fruit and top with chilled sauce.
Makes 1 3/4 cups.

recipes.title: Creamy Orange Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix fruits in large bowl and set aside.
In a small bowl mix pudding, milk and orange juice for 2 minutes.
Add sour cream, mix well.
Spoon over fruit.
Toss to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Makes 8-10 servings.

recipes.title: Creamy Oriental Chicken
instructions: In skillet over medium heat, heat 1 tablespoon oil.
Stir-fry half of the chicken until brown. Remove.
Repeat with remaining chicken.
Remove.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat. Stir-fry carrots and garlic until tender.
Do not remove.
Add soup, onions, soy sauce and chicken. Over low heat, heat through and stir often. Serve over rice.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Creamy Relish Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Cover and chill. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuna Rice
instructions: Bring water, milk, dill and salt to boil in medium saucepan on medium heat.
Add cheese; cook and stir until cheese is melted. Stir in Minute rice, tuna and parsley.
Cover.
Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Stir and serve. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Creates Its Own Crust(Coconut Pie)
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Add milk and flour, blending well; add coconut.
Pour into a lightly greased 9-inch pie plate; bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until set.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Creole Scalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Heat the margarine in a skillet and lightly saute peppers, onions and mushrooms.
Grease a 2-quart casserole.
Put a layer of half the bread cubes in the bottom, then a layer of tomatoes and a layer of sauteed mixture.
Sprinkle tomatoes with sugar, salt, paprika and dot with margarine.
Repeat layer.
Top with bread cubes and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake in a 400° oven for 30 minutes or until well browned.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Crisco Pastry For Double Crust
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a mixing bowl.
Cut Crisco with pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture is fairly coarse. Sprinkle with water.
When it forms a firm ball, pull into 2 parts and roll out on a floured board.
Roll into a circle.
Makes 2 (9-inch) pie crusts.

recipes.title: Crisp Corn Sticks
instructions: Sift corn meal.
Add salt and soda; mix.
Add oil; stir.
Add buttermilk and syrup; stir well.
Fill thoroughly greased iron corn stick pans; bake at 400° for 1/2 hour.
Makes 9 sticks.
Easy to add to for large family.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix first 9 ingredients together in a greased 2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle cornflakes and butter on top.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Mix Bisquick and
pepper
in a bowl.
Stir chicken into eggs and then
place
in Bisquick mixture.
Coat chicken well. Heat oil in
skillet over medium-high heat.
Stir-fry chicken until golden brown
and
done.	Add
vegetables
and stir-fry until vegetables are slightly limp.	Serves 4.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut chicken wings in two pieces, discarding the tips.
In a small shallow bowl, combine butter and garlic powder.
In another bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
Dip chicken wings into butter, then crumb mixture.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until done.
Yields about 20 appetizers.

recipes.title: Crispy Confections
instructions: Combine caramels and water in a 4-cup glass measuring cup. Microwave at High 1 to 2 minutes; stir well to combine.
Combine the cereals and coconut in a large bowl; pour caramel mixture on top.
Toss well until coated.
Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Crispy Corncakes
instructions: In a medium bowl, pour boiling water over cornmeal; cool.
In a medium bowl, combine flour, baking powder, chili powder, cumin and salt.
Mix egg, milk and butter with cornmeal mixture; stir into flour mixture until blended.
Mixture will be runny.
On a heated griddle or skillet sprayed with non-stick cooking spray, drop mixture by tablespoonfuls.
Cook over medium heat until bottom is crispy brown and top looks dry; turn and brown other side.
Makes about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Crispy Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine flour, egg white and milk to make batter.
Dip chicken into batter; then coat with corn flake crumbs (seasoned to taste). Bake for 1 hour at 350° in uncovered baking dish, coated with vegetable oil spray.
Makes 4 servings.
Low in fat!

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Cheese Soup
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients in crock-pot.
Cook 3 to 4 hours or until potatoes and carrots are tender. Add the mushrooms and corn.
Make a paste with reserved liquid and flour. Add to soup. Cook on high until slightly thickened.
Add cheese.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot French Onion Soup
instructions: Cook onions in butter until tender (about 20 minutes).
Put into crock-pot; add remaining ingredients.
Cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 hours.
Top individual bowls with Swiss or Mozzarella cheese and broil until cheese is melted or Parmesan cheese may be sprinkled on soup before serving.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Crumb Chicken

ingredients.notes: made into fresh bread crumbs (use food processor)

instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
Coat a 13 x 9-inch pan with vegetable cooking spray.
Put milk in a shallow dish.
Mix remaining ingredients except chicken in a medium size bowl.
Dip each piece of chicken in milk, then in crumbs, pressing so crumbs adhere to form a thick, even coating.
Arrange meaty sides up in a single layer in prepared pan.
Bake 1 hour or until browned and juices run clear.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Crunchy Baked Chicken
instructions: Mix crumbs, cheese, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper.
Dip chicken in melted butter and then in crumb mixture.
Arrange pieces in single layer in large shallow dish.
Pour remaining margarine over chicken.
Bake for 1 1/4 hours at 350°.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Crunchy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except onion rings and cheese.
Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle onion rings and cheese over the top.
You can also add 1/2 cup onions (chopped) and 1 cup tuna (rinsed and drained).
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings. Top with slivered almonds the last 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Crunchy Oriental Casserole
instructions: Brown meat.
Drain and slice water chestnuts.
Saute with onion and celery in butter.
Blend together with remaining ingredients.
Place in buttered casserole.
Top with noodles. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Crunchy Potato Chip Salad
instructions: In medium bowl, combine mayonnaise and vinegar.
Stir in cabbage, tuna, carrots, green pepper and onion.
Cover and chill. Just before serving, add potato chips; toss lightly.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Crustless Bacon Quiche
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp, then drain on paper towels.
Combine eggs, milk, dash of pepper, baking mix and melted margarine in blender.
Cover and blend 15 seconds.
Pour mixture in greased 9-inch pie plate.
Sprinkle with bacon and cheese well into mixture.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cuban Black Beans
instructions: Sort and wash beans.
Place in a large Dutch oven or regular soup kettle.
Cover with water 2 inches above beans.
Let soak 8 hours; drain.
Saute onion, green pepper, garlic and pimento in olive oil until tender.
Combine beans, vegetables, 5 cups of water and next 4 ingredients; bring to a boil.
Cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until beans are tender, stirring occasionally.
Serve over hot rice.
Garnish with grated cheese, chopped tomatoes, chopped green onions and a dollop of sour cream. Yields about 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cucumber Sauce
instructions: Drain
excess juice from cucumbers.
Place in a bowl and add dill
weed,
sugar, salt, pepper and lemon juice; mix well. Fold in sour cream and chill thoroughly.
Great on boiled fish, baked potatoes or as
dip for your favorite crackers.
Yield: 2 cups.

recipes.title: Currant Scones
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Cut in butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Stir in currants.
Gradually add enough milk to the mixture to form a soft dough, stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead lightly, 4 or 5 times.
Roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness; cut with a 2-inch biscuit cutter.
Place on lightly greased baking sheets.
Bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Serve warm. Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Curried Chicken
instructions: Heat oil. Add onion, garlic and curry powder.
Cook 5 minutes, stir gently.
Add chicken, brown and remove (keep warm).
Add tomatoes to oil mixture, stirring constantly (3 minutes).
Add hot water and salt; mix.
Add chicken and simmer until tender (50 minutes).
Remove chicken to serving platter.
Blend evaporated milk into flour; stir constantly.
Stir and cook until thickens. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Curried Potatoes And Peas
instructions: Cook potatoes in salted water to cover over medium heat until tender (about 15 minutes).
Heat margarine in skillet; add onion and cook until softened (about 5 minutes).
Stir in curry powder and honey; cook about 1 minute.
Drain potatoes; toss with peas to coat with onion mixture.
Serve hot.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Curried Sauce For Turkey Or Chicken
instructions: In a saucepan, melt butter.
Saute garlic, onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Stir in curry powder and saute for 1 minute more. Stir in flour and gradually add chicken broth and cream.
Stir over low heat until sauce bubbles and thickens.
Season to taste and add salt and pepper.
Serve with cooked, sliced turkey or chicken.
Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Curried Shrimp
instructions: About 35 minutes before serving, shell and devein shrimp.
In small bowl, combine shrimp, salt, cornstarch, ginger, pepper and sugar.
In a 10-inch skillet over medium heat in hot salad oil, cook onion until tender, but not brown.
Stir in curry powder. Cook 1 minute.
Turn heat to high and add shrimp mixture.
Cook just until shrimp turn pink and are tender.
Serve with cocktail picks.
Makes 8 appetizer servings.
Each serving has about 120 calories.

recipes.title: Curry Chicken Salad
instructions: Toss together chicken, rice and celery in large bowl.
Blend remaining ingredients.
Stir into chicken mixture.
Serve on shredded lettuce and garnish with black olives.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Danish Goulash
instructions: Cut meat into 1/4-inch cubes.
Brown well in hot oil with pepper.
Add onions and stir until light brown.
Add salt, 2 1/2 cups water, sugar and bay leaves.
Simmer, covered, for 1 1/4 hours or until fork-tender.
Remove bay leaves.
Stir in flour that has been mixed with 5 tablespoons water.
Stir until mixture is smooth.
Cook until mixture thickens.
Serve over noodles, rice or mashed potatoes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Danish Meat Loaf
instructions: Have pork and beef ground together.
Combine meat, egg, onion and seasonings.
Add flour and beat using electric mixer, until thoroughly blended and fluffy.
Add milk slowly, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating well.
Shape into a long loaf in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Refrigerate until cold. Makes about 24 thin slices.
Serve on light rye, pumpernickel or egg bread.

recipes.title: Danish Pastry Apple Bars
instructions: Combine flour and salt; cut in shortening.
Beat egg yolk in measuring cup; add enough milk to make 2/3 cup liquid.
Mix well; stir into flour mixture.
On floured surface, roll half the dough to 17 x 12-inch rectangle; fit into and up sides of 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch baking pan.
Sprinkle with cornflakes; top with apples.
Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle atop.
Roll remaining dough to 15 1/2-inch rectangle; place over apples.
Seal edges; cut slits in top.
Beat egg white until frothy; brush on crust.
Bake in 375° oven for 50 minutes.
Combine 1 cup sifted powdered sugar and 3 to 4 teaspoons milk; drizzle on warm cookies. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Danish Puff
instructions: Blend and mix to a paste the first two ingredients.
Round into a ball and divide in two.
Put into two long strips on ungreased baking sheet.
Then mix the butter, water and almond.
Bring to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Add flour and sugar.
When smooth, add eggs, one at a time, beating well.
Divide in two and spread evenly over pastry.
Bake 1 hour in 350° oven.
Do not underbake.
Makes 2.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate chips with condensed milk.
Remove from heat; stir in walnuts and vanilla. Spread into waxed paper-lined 8-inch square pan.
Chill for 2 hours.
Turn fudge onto cutting board.
Peel off waxed paper and cut into squares.
Makes 2 pounds.

recipes.title: Dave'S Chicken Gumbo
instructions: In large pot, saute onions and pepper in oil until tender. Stir in water, tomatoes and tomato paste.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Simmer 10 minutes longer.
Makes about 8 cups.

recipes.title: Deannie'S Peanut Butter Cookies

ingredients.notes: 1/2 c. coconut and 1/2 c. nuts or 2 c. oats, 1 c. flaked cereal (corn flakes or Total)

instructions: Put butter, sugar, chocolate and milk in a 1 1/2-quart saucepan on stove.
Boil one minute on medium heat.
Takes about 5 minutes to come to a rolling boil.
Remove from heat and add vanilla, peanut butter and oats.
Mix thoroughly and drop by teaspoon onto wax paper.
Makes about 4 dozen large cookies.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Peach Pie
instructions: Place peaches in 8 inch square baking dish.
Mix flour sugar and cinnamon well.
Stir into peaches.
Dot top with small pieces of butter.
Roll out biscuit dough on floured surface and cut into lattice strips and place over peaches.
Sprinkle top with cinnamon sugar if desired.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Deion'S Special Fruit Dish
instructions: Mix low-fat Cool Whip with all the fresh or canned fruit.
Add 1 to 3 drops of lemon juice and stir well.
Let mixture set in refrigerator 15 to 25 minutes.
Yields 4 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Delicious Green Beans
instructions: Combine green beans and artichoke hearts in a bowl.
Pour salad dressing over top; toss.
Chill at least 2 hours; drain. Spoon green bean mixture into 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle top with mixture of bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Delicious Pecan Oat Cakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Pour boiling water over oatmeal and let stand.
Mix sifted flour and baking powder and set aside.
Cream butter, brown sugar and flavoring well.
Add eggs, one at a time and beat well.
Add dry ingredients, alternating with oatmeal. Add nuts.
Spoon in paper baking cups in muffin tins.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 22 minutes.
Makes 20 to 24.

recipes.title: Delicious Southern Fried Chicken
instructions: Cut up and sprinkle salt and pepper over chicken pieces.
In separate container, mix eggs with milk and Worcestershire sauce. Dip chicken in this mixture, then flour it well.
Then place it in the frying pan that has been preheated to 350°.
Cook about 20 minutes until golden brown.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Denver Omelet Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs, onion powder, thyme, salt and pepper.
Stir in the potatoes, cheese, ham and green pepper.
Pour into a greased 9-inch pie plate.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.
Garnish with tomato slices.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Deviled Crabs
instructions: Flake crab meat.
Combine all ingredients.
Put in greased individual baking dishes.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Dot with butter.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) until well browned.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Halve hard-cooked eggs lengthwise; remove yolks and mash with a fork.
Stir in mayonnaise, vinegar, mustard and the salt.
Stuff egg whites with yolk mixture.
Garnish with paprika.
Makes 12 servings.
