recipes.title: Dijon Potato Salad
instructions: Combine first four ingredients and pepper.
Stir in remaining ingredients, cover and chill.
Makes 4 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Dill Onion Vinaigrette
instructions: Combine ingredients in a jar.
Cover; shake vigorously.
Chill to blend flavors.
Shake again before serving with mixed garden salad.
Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Dilled Chicken Salad

ingredients.notes: chopped or 1/2 tsp. dried dill weed

instructions: Combine chicken, celery, pickles, dill and apples.
Moisten with mayonnaise or salad dressing.
Serve on lettuce; garnish with almonds, olives and cranberry cubes (if used).
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Dilled Vegetable Sticks
instructions: Combine the first 7 ingredients in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil; cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.
Add beans, carrots and celery.
Return mixture to a boil; cover, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Place vegetables in a shallow container; pour vinegar mixture over vegetables.
Cover and chill at least 8 hours.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Dilly Salmon Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well.
Shape into loaf.
Place in greased, shallow baking dish.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with Lemony Dill Sauce.
Garnish as desired.
Refrigerate leftovers.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Dishpan Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients well in large bowl.
Mix together flour, salt, baking soda and baking powder and add to sugar mixture.
Mix in remaining ingredients.
Dip out by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.
Bake in 350° oven until almost brown.
Makes 10 to 11 dozen.

recipes.title: Dixie Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops in hot grease; sprinkle with salt and sage. Place in baking dish; top with apples.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Add flour to grease in skillet; blend.
Add water and vinegar; cook until thick.
Add raisins; pour over chops.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Dorothy'S Apple Pie Filling
instructions: In large saucepan blend first 4 ingredients and 1 teaspoon salt.
Stir in 10 cups water; cook and stir until thick and bubbly.
Add lemon juice, pack apples into hot jars, leaving 1 inch headspace to help distribute syrup.
Process in cold packer 15 minutes for pints and 20 minutes for quarts.
Makes 6 quarts. Bake pie at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Double-Corn Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Grease 12 muffin pan cups.
In large bowl, combine flour, corn meal, sugar, baking powder, salt and red pepper.
In medium bowl, whisk milk, butter and egg.
Stir into dry ingredients just until combined.
Stir in corn.
Spoon into prepared pans.
Bake 20 minutes.
Unmold and serve warm.
Makes 1 dozen.

recipes.title: Dressing For Fruit Salad
instructions: Blend flour into sugar.
Add water, butter, egg and vinegar. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Cool and use as needed over a desired combination of diced apples, celery, pecans, grapes, pineapple tidbits and marshmallows.
Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Dried Beef With Rice
instructions: Saute onions and peppers in butter until soft but not brown. Add dried beef; cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Add rice and continue cooking until thoroughly heated.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Drive 'Em Wild Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes in half lengthwise.
Scoop out potatoes, leaving 1/8-inch shell.
Add sour cream and butter to potato mixture; mash well.
Stir in bacon and 2 tablespoons chives.
Add Mozzarella cheese; mix well.
Fill shells with mixture.
Sprinkle with Swiss cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Top with remaining chives. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Dutch Oven Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter in Dutch oven until crisp-tender.
Arrange chicken in layer over vegetables; add spaghetti in a layer.
Combine soup, broth, lemon juice and pepper.
Pour over spaghetti, making certain all of spaghetti is moistened.
Sprinkle mushrooms over top.
Cover; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, 15 to 20 minutes or until spaghetti is tender.
Garnish with Parmesan cheese and paprika.
Makes 4 generous servings.
Can be frozen or reheated.

recipes.title: Dutch Potato Salad
instructions: Cut bacon fine and dry.
Brown onions in fat.
Add vinegar, water, sugar, salt and pepper.
Heat to boiling, then add potatoes and parsley.
Heat thoroughly and serve.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Early Morning Casserole
instructions: Scramble and cook until brown the sausage.
Drain on paper towel and put in ovenproof baking dish. Melt in skillet the butter.
Scramble until slightly soft the eggs.
Pour over sausage and add soup and chilies.
Cover top with grated cheese.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for approximately 15 minutes, or until heated through and through.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Easiest Souffle
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan.
Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.
Bring mixture to room temperature before baking.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until is firmly set.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Easy Bake Meat Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine ground beef, onion, egg and cracker crumbs and shape into meatballs.
Pour cream of celery soup and half a can of water over top of meatballs.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, add baked potatoes and have a quick, delicious meal.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Easy Baked Chicken(Microwave)
instructions: Remove giblets; wash chicken and pat dry.
Sprinkle inside of body cavity with salt and pepper.
Place onion and celery inside chicken.
Tie legs together and tie wings to body.
Place chicken, breast up, on a microwave roasting rack in a 12 x 7 x 2-inch microproof dish.
Spread with softened margarine; sprinkle with thyme.
Cook on High for 15 to 17 minutes, or until done (juices will run clear).
Cover with aluminum foil; let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Roll the meat in flour and brown in butter; place in casserole. Add mushrooms and liquid, soup mix and water.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Before serving, stir in sour cream.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute onion in margarine or butter until tender.
Add flour, stirring well.
Gradually stir in broth and broccoli; reduce heat. Stir in milk, cheese and pepper.
Heat until cheese melts.
Serve immediately.
Yields 4 cups.

recipes.title: Easy Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a greased casserole dish.
Mix well.
Refrigerate 4 to 5 hours or overnight.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 50 minutes.
Uncover and bake 10 minutes or until brown. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Easy Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Toss cheese with flour, salt and pepper, combine with potatoes. Place in a 2-quart casserole; add cream.
Bake uncovered 1 hour and 15 minutes until lightly browned (350°).
Makes 8 servings. Casserole may be assembled up to 24 hours before baking.
Cover and refrigerate.
One 24 ounce package of defrosted hash brown potatoes may be substituted with excellent results.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken in shallow baking dish so pieces don't overlap. Cover with mushrooms.
Combine soup with sour cream and sherry. Pour over chicken completely covering.
Dust with paprika.
Cover and bake at 350° for about 2 hours.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken And Rice
instructions: Sprinkle rice in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Combine soup and water; pour over rice.
Place chicken pieces, skin side up, in baking dish.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Place a piece of butter on each piece of chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Deep Dish Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Lightly grease jelly roll pan (15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch) or cookie sheet.
Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms.
Gently smooth dough into ball on floured surface.
Knead 20 times.
Pat dough on bottom and sides of pan with floured hands.
Cook and stir beef, onion, salt and garlic until the beef is brown; drain.
Mix the tomato sauce and Italian seasoning.
Spread evenly over dough.
Spoon beef mixture evenly over sauce.
Top with mushrooms, green peppers and cheese.
Bake until crust is golden brown, about 20 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Filled Date Drop Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix shortening, brown sugar and eggs. Stir in water and vanilla.
Sift together and stir in flour, soda, salt and cinnamon.
Drop with a teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Place 1/2 teaspoon of date or raisin filling on each cookie after making a depression with a teaspoon or knife.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 5 or 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Easy French Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter in medium size saucepan.
Add onion and sugar. Cook and stir 5 to 10 minutes until lightly browned.
Add bouillon, water and Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Garden Vegetable Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400°.
Lightly grease deep 10-inch pie plate. Cook broccoli and/or cauliflower to tender crisp in salt water, about 5 minutes.
Drain thoroughly.
Mix with onion, green pepper and cheese in pie plate.
Beat remaining ingredients until smooth, 15 seconds in blender on high speed, or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour over contents in pie plate.
Bake until golden brown and knife inserted comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes.
Let stand about 5 minutes before cutting.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Hamburg Casserole
instructions: Put hamburg in bottom of 2-quart casserole; layer the potatoes on top of hamburg.
Add carrots, onions and chopped peppers.
Put the tomatoes and seasonings in next.
Top with shredded cheese.
Bake 2 hours at 300°.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Italian Chicken
instructions: Fry chicken in a medium-sized frying pan until cooked all the way through.
Cut each breast in half to make sure chicken is cooked thoroughly.
Cover with can of spaghetti sauce and simmer a few minutes before serving.
Top with cheese, cover and let cheese melt.
Serve with Italian bread and tossed salad.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Easy Italian Lasagna
instructions: Cook lasagna according to package directions; drain.
In skillet, cook ground chuck until brown; drain off excess fat. Stir in tomato sauce, sugar, salt, garlic salt and pepper.
Remove from heat.
Combine cottage cheese, Mozzarella cheese, sour cream, green onion and green pepper.
Put half of the lasagna noodles in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch buttered baking dish.
Moisten lasagna with some meat sauce.
Cover with cheese mixture; top with remaining lasagna, then meat sauce.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Cover with aluminum foil.
Bake in a preheated 375° oven for 40 minutes. Allow to stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Easy Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place margarine in a 2-quart casserole and place in oven to melt margarine.
Pour macaroni into casserole with melted margarine.
Stir to coat macaroni with margarine. Sprinkle salt and pepper and shredded cheese through macaroni, toss lightly.
Pour milk over all.
Do not stir.
Do not cover while baking.
Cooking time:
1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6.
Casserole size:
2 quarts.

recipes.title: Easy Macaroni Meal
instructions: Brown ground beef in a pan sprayed with Pam.
Add tomato juice and seasonings.
Cook over low heat.
When mixture is boiling about 5 minutes, gradually add the macaroni so that the tomato juice mixture continues to boil.
Add green peppers and onion.
Cover and cook until macaroni is tender, about 25 to 30 minutes.
Stir occasionally during cooking.
Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Easy Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup well in 1 1/2-quart casserole or bowl and nuke 4 minutes on High.
Add peanuts; stir and nuke 2:45 to 3 minutes.
Add butter and vanilla; blend well and nuke 1 to 2 minutes.
Peanuts will be light brown and syrup hot.
Add baking soda.
Stir gently until light and foamy and quickly pour onto greased cookie sheet.
Cool 1/2 to 1 hour and break into pieces. Makes about 1 pound.
Work fast after adding soda because it hardens fast.
Delicious.

recipes.title: Easy Microwave Pecan Brittle
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart glass bowl, stir together pecans, sugar, syrup and salt.
Cook for 8 minutes on High (stir after 4 minutes).
Stir in butter and vanilla extract.
Cook on High for 2 minutes.
Add soda and stir until light and foamy.
Pour onto greased cookie sheet.
Break into pieces when cool.
Yields 1 pound.

recipes.title: Easy Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook meat and onion in a large skillet until onion is tender. Stir in noodles, tomato paste, tomatoes, 1 cup shredded cheese, seasonings and olives.
Turn into 2-quart casserole dish.
Top with remaining 1/2 cup shredded cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until hot.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Oven Baked Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes and onions into 1/4-inch slices.
Alternate slices, slightly overlapping, in a single layer in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine the next 5 ingredients; drizzle over potato and onion slices.
Cover and bake at 400° for 40 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika and bake, uncovered, for an additional 20 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Oven Beef Stew
instructions: Place raw meat in a 7 x 11-inch pan.
Add vegetables.
Blend salt, sugar and tapioca.
Sprinkle over meat and vegies.
Add tomato juice.
Cover pan with foil, sealing tight around edges. Bake at 250° for 4 hours.
If it gets too thick, add water.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar, light corn syrup, peanuts and salt in large, covered microwave safe dish and stir well.

Microwave on high for 8 minutes, stirring halfway through cooking time. Add vanilla and butter, mix well and microwave on high again for 2 more minutes. Keep in mind that cooking times might vary, depending on the wattage of your microwave.
After cooking, remove and add baking soda.

Stir well until mixture becomes foamy and light in color. Immediately pour onto wax paper and use a metal knife to spread the mixture to about 1/4 inch thick. Plastic knives will melt. Wear oven mitts when cooking and handling this mixture.
It is very hot.
Let sit until completely cooled.
Remove wax paper and break into pieces.
Store in an airtight container.
Makes about 1 pound.

recipes.title: Easy Pigs In A Blanket
instructions: Brown hamburger with onion and cut up cabbage in quarters.
Add soup and rice.
Cook on medium heat 30 minutes.
Season to taste. Serve with rolls and salad.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Potato Cheese Soup
instructions: Melt oleo in medium pan, add flour to oleo.
Add water, bouillon cubes and pepper.
Cook and stir over medium heat 10 minutes.
Stir in potato soup and soup can of milk.
Lower heat and cook 10 more minutes.
Right before serving, add 3/4 cup grated Cheddar cheese.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Easy Rice And Peas
instructions: In medium saucepan, bring water, butter and salt to a boil. Add rice and peas; cover and remove from heat.
Let stand 5 to 7 minutes or until all water is absorbed.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Roll Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour, salt and shortening until it looks like meal.
Add water, vinegar and egg all at once.
Mix lightly.
Roll on floured board.
Makes 4 (9-inch) pie shells.

recipes.title: Easy Sausage Quiche
instructions: Trim bread crust to fit bread in bottom of greased 9x13 inch pan.
Brown sausage in pan and drain.
Stir in mustard.
Spoon mixture over bread and sprinkle on the shredded cheese.
Combine rest of ingredients and pour over the bread and sausage.
This can be made ahead and refrigerated.
Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until puffed and stiff.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Sausage-Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes until just tender; drain.
Saute smoked sausage and onion; drain.
Mix together potatoes, sausage, onion, Cheez Whiz and sour cream.
Pour mixture into a casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Combine milk and soup in a 2-quart, microwave-safe casserole dish.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover and microwave on High for 10 minutes.
Stir.
Microwave another 12 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Easy Taco Dinner
instructions: Cook
and
stir
ground beef and onion in skillet until done; drain.
Stir
in
taco
mix and water.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat
and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
Spoon beef mixture onto chips.
Top with remaining ingredients.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Turkey Oven Meatballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease 13 x 9-inch metal pan.
Chop bread into fine crumbs (approximately 1 cup).
Grate onion to measure 1 tablespoon.
Add to bread crumbs, along with turkey, spinach, salt, pepper and egg.
Shape into 16 meatballs.
Bake for 25 minutes, turning as they brown.
When meatballs are done, add to your own favorite tomato sauce recipe or any favorite ready made tomato sauce.
Simmer for 10 minutes or more to blend flavors. Serve over spaghetti or rice.
Makes 4 main dish servings.

recipes.title: Edible Play Dough
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients.
Chill.
Shape into faces, letters, etc., or cut out with cookie cutters.
If mixture is too sticky, roll in additional powdered milk.
Decorate with raisins or candy, if desired.
Yields 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Egg And Sausage Souffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.
Refrigerate for 12 hours or overnight.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Serves 6 to 10.

recipes.title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Combine sugar, flour and salt.
Beat eggs well; add dry ingredients.
Add butter and milk; mix well.
Pour into a pastry shell; bake in a 375° oven for 30 minutes.
Allow to set before serving.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Egg Mcmuffin
instructions: Scramble eggs in skillet.
Place eggs and cheese on English muffin.
Heat in microwave or toaster oven.
Makes 24 servings.

recipes.title: Egg Rice Bake
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in butter until tender.
Add mushroom soup and milk; reserve 1/2 cup of mixture.
Stir rice into remaining mixture.
Put in a greased 9 x 12-inch dish.
Cut eggs in half lengthwise; press the halves into rice mixture. Drizzle reserved soup mixture over eggs and cover.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Egg Sausage Bake
instructions: Brown and drain sausage; cool.
Beat eggs and milk; add bread cubes.
Fold in sausage and cheese.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate overnight.
Remove from refrigerator one hour before baking.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cool slightly before cutting. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Egg Strata(Quiche)
instructions: Butter bread and cube; set aside.
Beat eggs and milk.
Add all the rest of the ingredients.
Add bread; stir well.
Bake in buttered 9-inch pie pan or 8-inch square pan.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Egg'S Annapolis
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp.
Crumble and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt butter and saute onion.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring.
Slowly stir in milk and cook 5 minutes until thick.
Add crab, sherry and cheese, stirring to combine.
Split and toast English muffins.
Poach eggs.
Arrange eggs on muffins and cover with crab sauce.
Sprinkle with bacon and serve.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Eggs Portugal
instructions: Brown sausage (Deans or Owens); drain.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan, cover bottom with 8 slices of bread, cut in cubes.
Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese.
Add drained sausage.
Mix eggs (beaten) in milk and mustard and pour over sausage.
Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight.
In morning, top with can of mushrooms (drained) and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 6 to 8 people. Serve with fruit and pastries.

recipes.title: Elaina'S Favorite Strawberry Muffins
instructions: Thaw strawberries.
Mix all ingredients except pecans with an electric mixer.
Fold in nuts.
Line muffin pans with paper baking cups.
Bake at 350° for 22 to 25 minutes.
Use toothpick test for doneness.
Makes approximately 15 average sized muffins.

recipes.title: Elegant Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts.
Chill overnight. Sprinkle nuts on top of salad, just before serving.
Makes 12 main dish servings.
Serve on lettuce garnished with melon wedges, if desired.

recipes.title: Elegant Green Beans
instructions: Combine soup, onion, oregano, garlic salt and sour cream. Toss with beans.
Place in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with cheese.
Bake in moderate 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Elegant Hash Browns
instructions: Grease a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Mix sour cream, cheese, onion and soup.
Stir in potatoes.
Top with cornflake mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 8 to 10 people.

recipes.title: Elegant Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into greased casserole.
Bake in a 350° oven about an hour.
Sprinkle paprika on top, also, before baking, if desired.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole Chicken
instructions: Lightly grease or use Pam on casserole dish.
Layer corn/flour tortilla, enchilada sauce, cheese, onions and chicken and sauce. Layer until dish is filled.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Garnish with shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes and sour cream.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
instructions: In a saucepan, combine tomato paste, water, garlic and chili powder; simmer 20 minutes.
In skillet, brown ground beef with half of the onions; drain fat.
Stir in 1 1/2 cups of cheese and 1 cup tomato paste mixture.
Spoon 1/4 cup tomato paste mixture in 3-quart shallow baking dish.
Soften tortillas, one at a time, by dipping in and out of remaining mixture.
Spoon beef mixture down center of each tortilla; roll up.
Place seam side down in baking dish.
Pour remaining tomato paste mixture over top.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and onions.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Energy-Packed Granola
instructions: In large bowl, combine oats, coconut, almonds, sunflower seeds and wheat germ.
Combine honey and oil; stir into oat mixture. Spread in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Cook oat mixture at High for 10 minutes, stirring 3 times.
Stir in fruits.
Remove to another pan to cool.
Stir occasionally during cooling to prevent lumping.
Store in tightly covered jars or plastic bags.
Makes 6 cups.

recipes.title: Escalloped Corn And Tomatoes
instructions: Combine tomatoes, corn, eggs, flour, sugar and pepper.
Turn into 17 x 7 1/2 x 2 inch baking dish.
Melt butter, add onion and garlic.
Cook until tender but not brown.
Combine bread crumbs and Parmesan; add to butter mixture and toss to combine.
Sprinkle over baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, or until a knife inserted comes out clean.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Escalloped Corn(Corn Is Good With Any Meal.)
instructions: Place corn, salt, butter, green pepper and sugar in a greased baking dish and stir.
Spread crumbs on top.
Pour milk over mixture and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Exotic Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken, water chestnuts, celery, grapes and almonds. Mix mayonnaise, curry powder, soy sauce and lemon juice; add to chicken mixture.
Chill for several hours.
Serve on lettuce leaf and top with pineapple chunks.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Extra Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening and peanut butter until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Blend in syrup and milk.
Shape in 2-inch roll; chill.
Slice about 1/4-inch thick. Place half the slices on ungreased cookie sheet.
Spread each with 1/2 teaspoon peanut butter and seal edges with a fork.
Bake at 350° for about 12 minutes.
Cool slightly; remove from cookie sheet.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Family Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Cut chickens in half.
Clean and dry well.
Combine salad oil (or margarine), vinegar, water, salt, pepper and poultry seasoning.
Heat just to boiling and set aside.
Place chicken on grill over gray coals.
Brush with sauce mixture every 5 minutes or as often as necessary to prevent burning.
Cook until tender. When leg bone turns easily in the socket, chicken is done.
Yield: 10 servings.

recipes.title: Fancy Chicken A La King
instructions: In a hot skillet cook green pepper and onion until tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in soup and milk and blend well. Stir in meat, cheese and pimentos.
Cook for 5 minutes until thoroughly heated.
Pour over split biscuits.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fancy Chicken Salad
instructions: Blend curry and soy sauce with mayonnaise.
Toss together chicken, water chestnuts, grapes, pineapple and celery.
Stir in dressing, then nuts.
For attractive presentation, garnish with additional grapes and nuts.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fancy Rice Dish
instructions: Saute celery, onion and garlic in butter, using Dutch oven. Add chicken broth, rice, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook over low heat for 40 minutes.
Stir in carrots and cook additional 10 minutes.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Chocolate Therapy Cake
instructions: In a medium bowl, add ingredients, one at a time, stirring well after each addition.
After adding Marshmallow Creme, mix until the marshmallow lumps are gone.
Pour into a 9 x 9-inch pan that has been lightly coated with cooking spray.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Makes 10 servings at less than 1/2 gram of fat each.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Vegie Stir-Fry

ingredients.notes: sliced thin and separated into rings

instructions: Coat large skillet or wok with cooking spray, heat (skillet or wok) on medium heat until hot.
Add all ingredients; stir-fry about 5 minutes or until zucchini is crisp-tender.
Yields 4 servings (about 38 calories per serving, no fat).
Any vegetable can be added for variety.

recipes.title: Faye'S Number 7 Pancakes
instructions: Beat eggs, then add oil and buttermilk, mixing well.
Add the dry ingredients and just stir until mixed, but do not beat.
Have non-stick skillet heated to pancake temperature; pour about 1/4 cup batter onto skillet.
Let pancakes begin to bubble on top, and then turn over.
Serve with favorite syrup or preserves.
Makes 12 pancakes.
(Seven ingredients, thus the name.)

recipes.title: Fiesta Salad
instructions: Separate onion slices into rings.
Place in salad bowl with green pepper and tomato.
Fry bacon until crisp; remove and drain. Pour off bacon drippings.
Reserve 2 tablespoons in skillet. Stir vinegar, chili powder, salt and red pepper sauce into drippings; heat to boiling.
Pour over vegetables and toss lightly.
Crumble bacon; sprinkle on top.
Serve with a slotted spoon.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Filled Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and then slowly add flour.
Divide dough and roll.
Cut into pieces.
Add 1 teaspoon of filling per cookie. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes approximately 14 dozen.

recipes.title: Fire And Ice Tomatoes
instructions: Mix vinegar, celery salt, mustard seed, salt, sugar, red and black pepper and cold water.
Bring to boil; boil hard for 1 minute.
Pour hot mixture over tomatoes, green pepper and onion. Cover and place in refrigerator to chill.
Before serving, add cucumber.
Serve very cold as a salad on lettuce or as a relish. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Firemen Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Mix all ingredients.
Bake in greased pie plate at 350° for 30 minutes until golden brown.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Fish Creole
instructions: Arrange fish in greased shallow baking pan or casserole. Saute onion and green pepper in margarine.
Add seasonings and tomatoes.
Pour over fish.
Bake at 375°
for 30 minutes.
Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Fish Dijon
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish.
Mix butter, mustard, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce. Spread over fish.
Sprinkle bread crumbs over top.
Bake about 10 minutes.
Serves 2 to 3.

recipes.title: Fish Fillets Au Gratin
instructions: Heat oven to 400°.
In small bowl, combine all ingredients except fish.
Place fish on individual squares of greased foil. Spoon crumb mixture over fish.
Seal securely and bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until fish flakes easily.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fish Fillets With Mushrooms(Microwave)
instructions: Arrange fish fillets in 12 x 7 x 2-inch microproof baking dish.
Dot with butter.
Stir lemon juice into wine and sprinkle with remaining ingredients over top.
Cover with wax paper.
Cook on High 5 minutes.
Let stand covered 5 minutes.
(Makes 3 to 4 servings.)

recipes.title: Five Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple chunks, reserve 1 tablespoon syrup.
Combine pineapple chunks, reserve syrup, mandarin oranges, coconut, marshmallows and sour cream.
Chill for 2 hours to 24 hours. Before serving sprinkle with pecans.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Flank Steak Stir-Fry
instructions: Cut steak diagonally into thin strips.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in wok over high flame; stir-fry steak 5 minutes or until brown.
Push up sides; add remaining oil.
Stir-fry pepper for 2 minutes.
Add onion.
Stir-fry until crisp-tender, then mix with steak.
Combine soy sauce, cornstarch and water; add to wok, cooking until thickened.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Flank Steak Teriyaki
instructions: Marinate steak for several hours in the mixture of remaining ingredients.
Broil for 4 minutes on a side for rare or to desired doneness.
Slice thinly diagonally and arrange on a platter. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Flannel Pancakes
instructions: Measure and sift dry ingredients together.
Beat egg yolks and add milk.
Pour milk mixture slowly into dry ingredients; beat thoroughly.
Add melted butter, then fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Bake on hot griddle.
Makes about 12 medium sized cakes.

recipes.title: Florentine Potatoes
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in butter until soft.
Add potatoes; saute 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes; cook over high heat until slightly thickened.
Add spinach; heat through.
Sprinkle with cheese. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Fluffy Frozen P-Nut Butter Pie
instructions: Whip cream cheese, beat in sugar and peanut butter. Slowly add milk and blend thoroughly.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour in shells. Sprinkle nuts on top.
Freeze.
Remove from freezer a few minutes before serving.
Makes 3 pies.

recipes.title: Fluffy Fruit Salad
instructions: Put reserved pineapple juice in small saucepan.
To this, add the next 6 ingredients.
Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute. Remove from heat and cool.
Combine in a salad bowl the pineapple, fruit cocktail, oranges and bananas.
Mix the whipped cream with cooled sauce.
Fold into fruit.
Chill for several hours.
Serves 12 to 16 people.

recipes.title: Fluffy Salmon Loaf
instructions: Remove bone from salmon, flake.
Mix salmon, salt, paprika, pepper, onion, cracker crumbs, butter and tomato juice.
Stir in beaten egg yolks, fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour into well-greased loaf pan or Pyrex dish.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Foil-Grilled Peppers
instructions: Cut thin slice from stem end of green peppers.
Remove all seeds and membranes.
Wash inside and outside.
Mix chili beans, corn and catsup; lightly stuff each pepper.
Wrap each pepper securely in double thickness, heavy-duty aluminum foil.
Cook on medium coals 15 to 20 minutes or grill 3 to 4 inches from hot coals 30 to 40 minutes, turning once.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fork Cookies
instructions: Sift flour, soda and cream of tartar.
Combine other ingredients and mix with flour.
Add extra flour if too soft. Form into balls, press down on greased cookie sheet with fork. Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Four-Bean Beef Bake

ingredients.notes: wax beans (drained), kidney beans and garbanzo beans (rinsed and drained)

instructions: Brown ground beef with bacon in skillet, stirring until crumbly; drain.
Combine with remaining ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Mix well.
Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes or until heated through.
Yield: 8 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Frankfurter And Peas Casserole
instructions: Cut hot dogs into 1/4 slices; brown lightly in margarine. Remove hot dogs and set aside.
Add flour to margarine in skillet and stir until smooth; add milk, stirring constantly, until thick. Season with salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce and mustard.
Mix hot dogs, cheese and peas and pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Pour sauce over mixture.
Sprinkle with crumbs.
Bake in 375° oven for 30 or 40 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Franks In Hot Sauce
instructions: Cook ingredients 10 minutes.
Cut franks in 1-inch long pieces.
Add to sauce.
Simmer 5 to 10 minutes.
Makes 1 cup. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Freddie'S Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter.
Add beef, salt and pepper.
Heat; do not brown.
Spread part of cabbage in 2-quart baking dish.
Cover with meat mixture.
Top with more cabbage.
Alternate until all is used.
Pour tomato soup over top.
Bake covered at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Freeda Midkiff'S Clam Chowder

ingredients.notes: cut in small pieces or 2 cans clam bits

instructions: Place salt pork or bacon and onion in a pan and cook until onion is a golden brown.
Add 2 cups of water (clam liquid and enough water to make 2 cups) and potatoes.
Simmer until potatoes are tender.
Melt butter; stir in flour, milk and seasonings. Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Combine mixture; add clams. Heat; do not boil.
Add broken crackers.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Freezer Pickles
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate 24 hours in a glass bowl.
Do not use a plastic bowl.
Put in containers and freeze.
Makes about 3 pints.

recipes.title: French Bread
instructions: Mix water, yeast and sugar in electric mixer at low speed. Add some flour to dough before adding salt.
Gradually add flour until sides of mixer are clean.
Add a little oil! The dough should be stiff.
Mix for 10 minutes.
Let dough rise.
Make loaves.
Line pans with cornmeal.
Let rise.
Make diagonal slits across loaves halfway through rising.
Bake at 375° until light brown.
Makes 3 or 4 loaves.

recipes.title: French Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling, salted water 25 to 30 minutes. Drain and mash.
Add milk, butter, seasonings and baking powder. Beat until fluffy.
Add onion.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: French Muffin Donuts
instructions: Sift flour with 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, salt and nutmeg. Combine milk, egg, melted butter and vanilla.
Add liquid ingredients to flour mixture, stirring only until all ingredients are moistened.
Fill greased muffin pans 1/2 full.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
Remove from pan immediately.
Brush with melted butter and roll in mixture of remaining 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon.
Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Cook minced onions and peppercorns in butter or margarine over medium heat, stirring frequently, until onions are light brown. Sprinkle onions with flour.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add beef broth, water and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes.
Discard bay leaf.
Put soup in ovenproof soup tureen or large casserole.
Place toast slices on top.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Place under broiler or in a 400° oven until cheese melts.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: French Peas
instructions: In a saucepan, cook green onions and lettuce in oil over low heat for 5 minutes.
Combine flour with broth.
Add to lettuce mixture and stir until thickened.
Put in the cooked peas, sliced water chestnuts and seasoning.
Heat through and serve.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: French Rice
instructions: Combine

soup and butter. Drain mushrooms and water chestnuts; reserve liquid. Add water to liquid reserve to equal 1 1/3 cups. Add all ingredients together. Pour into lightly greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350°. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening, adding eggs and apple.
Mix in sifted dry ingredients to which pecans have been added.
Stir in buttermilk and vanilla.
Pour into greased loaf pan.
Sprinkle top with a mixture of sugar.
Bake 1 hour in preheated 350° oven. Yields 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Fresh Broccoli And Bacon Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli into small flowerets and wash thoroughly.
Combine broccoli, onion, and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl.
Combine mayonnaise and remaining ingredients.
Add to the broccoli mixture, stirring until well coated.
Cover and chill.
Yields 5 cups.

recipes.title: Fresh Corn Pudding
instructions: Cut corn from cob, scraping cob well.
Place corn and scrapings in a large saucepan.
Add 2 tablespoons water.
Bring to boiling.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and cool slightly.
Do not drain.
Place corn in a large bowl.
Add sugar, salt and eggs.
Stir in milk.
Pour into a 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole.
Bake in a 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Peel and slice peaches.
Mix peaches and sugar together in blender.
Add peaches and sugar mixture to other ingredients; churn in ice cream freezer according to machine instructions. Makes 4 quarts.

recipes.title: Fresh Pineapple Dip
instructions: Mix juice, egg, flour and sugar together.
Heat to boil and thicken.
Cool.
Fold into whipped cream.
Keep cold.
Makes 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Fresh Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
In a bowl, process a small amount at a time in food processor at low speed.
Pour into serving bowl. Yields 3 cups.

recipes.title: Friday Seashell Salad
instructions: Combine shell macaroni with onion, French dressing, salt, basil, garlic powder, pepper and lemon juice; mix well.
Chill at least 1 hour.
Add shrimp, celery, green pepper and mayonnaise. Toss lightly.
Serve well chilled.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes into 1/4-inch slices.
Combine cornmeal, flour, salt and pepper.
Dip tomato slices into cornmeal mixture.
Heat bacon drippings until melted.
Add tomato slices; cook, turning once, until golden brown.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Fried Mozzarella
instructions: Cut cheeses into 4-inch squares 2-inches thick.
Roll in flour, dip into egg, roll in crumbs, again into egg, again into bread crumbs.
Fry in oil just long enough for bread crumbs to turn golden in color.
Serve immediately (with tomato sauce, if desired).
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
instructions: In large skillet, cook and stir onion and green pepper in oil until onion is tender.
Stir in rice, water chestnuts, mushrooms and soy sauce.
Cook over low heat 10 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in beaten eggs.
Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes longer.
Makes 4 to 5 servings (about 1/2 cup each).

recipes.title: Frittata Lorraine
instructions: Beat together eggs, 3/4 cup cheese, water, bacon, onion, salt, nutmeg and pepper.
Melt butter in an iron 10-inch skillet over medium heat.
Pour egg mixture in and cook, without stirring, over low to medium heat until set, 7 to 9 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Broil about 5 to 6 inches from heat for 2 to 3 minutes.
Cut into wedges to serve.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Frosted Cauliflower
instructions: Cook large pieces or whole cauliflower for 12 to 15 minutes in boiling, salted water; drain well.
Place in shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with salt.
Mix mayonnaise and mustard; spread over. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 10 minutes at 375°.
Serves 6. (Could cut it up as well.)

recipes.title: Frosted Pecans
instructions: Combine sour cream, sugar and vanilla in heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil and cook to soft ball stage (243° on a candy thermometer). Stir frequently to prevent scorching.
Add pecan halves and stir to coat.
Turn onto buttered baking sheet and quickly separate pecans with two forks.
Makes about 1 1/4 pounds. Also good with peanuts.
May be packaged and frozen in airtight container.
Fill coffee mug full and give to friends for gifts!

recipes.title: Frosty Fruit Loaf
instructions: Drain fruit cocktail, reserving 1/2 cup juice/syrup.
In saucepan, sprinkle gelatin over juice.
Stir in strawberries and corn syrup.
Chill until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from spoon.
Fold in fruit cocktail and yogurt.
Spoon into 9-inch loaf pan.
Cover.
Freeze until firm.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Cup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in plastic container.
Freeze until solid.
Take out of freezer at least 1/2 hour before serving. Return any unused portion to freezer.
It can be kept for at least 2 weeks.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Frozen Orange Salad
instructions: Let orange juice soften a little before combining with other ingredients.
Freeze in a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Slice and serve. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Fruit Drop Cookies
instructions: Combine shortening, sugar and eggs and mix well.
Stir in buttermilk.
Combine flour, soda and salt and stir in.
Stir in pecans, cherries and dates.
Chill at least 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Place a pecan half on each cookie. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until almost no imprint remains when touched lightly with finger.
Makes 8 dozen.

recipes.title: Fruit Kabobs With Yogurt Dip
instructions: On 6-inch wooden skewers, alternate pineapple, strawberries, bananas and kiwi fruit.
Combine yogurt and orange juice to make dip.
Cover and chill for 2 hours or longer.
Garnish with rind. Yields 1 1/2 cups dip.

recipes.title: Fruit-Yogurt Delight
instructions: In food processor or blender, combine all ingredients.
Cover and blend on high speed about 1 minute or until smooth.
Yields 3 servings.
Per serving about 155 calories, 0.3 g fat.

recipes.title: Fruited Cabbage Salad
instructions: Place oranges, apples, cabbage and grapes in bowl.
Beat whipping cream in a chilled bowl until stiff.
Fold whipped cream, sugar, lemon juice and salt into mayonnaise.
Stir into fruited cabbage mixture.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Fruited Chicken Salad
instructions: Cut cranberry sauce into cubes.
Drain pineapple.
Beat together
sour cream, cheese and dash of salt.
Fold in chicken, pineapple, celery, nuts and green pepper.
Refrigerate up to
24 hours.
Before serving, top chicken mixture with cranberry cubes. Makes 4 or 5 servings.

recipes.title: Fruitful Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400°.
Line 12 medium muffin cups with paper baking cups. Combine oats, flour, baking powder and cinnamon.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix just until dry ingredients are moistened.
Fill cup 3/4 full.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 1 dozen.

recipes.title: Fruity French Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients in screw-top jar or small bowl.
Shake well or whip with wire whisk until ingredients are well blended and of a thick and creamy consistency.
Chill.
Refrigerate in tightly covered container.
Shake well before using.
Makes 1 cup dressing.

recipes.title: Fry Bread
instructions: Combine eggs and milk in medium bowl.
Stir in flour, baking powder and salt.
Mix well.
Turn dough out onto a floured surface.
Roll dough to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut into 3-inch squares. Gently place squares a few at a time in deep hot oil (375°).
Fry until golden brown, turning once.
Drain on paper towels. Serve warm with butter and honey.
Yields 2 to 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Garden Patch Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 5-quart Dutch oven. Bring to boiling over medium heat.
Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, stir occasionally.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Garden Stir-Fry
instructions: Cut chicken breasts diagonally into thin strips.
Heat one tablespoon oil in large skillet or wok.
Stir-fry chicken strips and garlic until chicken loses its pink color.
Remove from pan and set aside.
Heat the remaining tablespoon of oil.
Stir-fry the onion, zucchini and green pepper for 3 minutes.
Add mushrooms and tomatoes.
Continue to stir-fry an additional 3 minutes.
Return chicken to skillet.
Add spaghetti.
Stir-fry until heated through. Serves 3 to 4.

recipes.title: Garlic Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss with oil and add 2 cloves of garlic that have been minced.
Bake in shallow baking dish for 20 minutes at 400° until dark golden brown and fork-tender.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Gary'S Tomato Salad
instructions: Set bacon aside.
Toss all ingredients except bacon.
Sprinkle bacon on top of each serving.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Gazpacho(A Good Cold Vegetable Soup)
instructions: Peel tomatoes and coarsely chop.
Peel, slice and finely chop onion.
Seed and coarsely chop bell pepper.
Peel and coarsely chop cucumber.
Combine vegetables in 2-quart pitcher or bowl. Add finely minced garlic if using fresh clove.
Combine tomato juice, vinegar, olive oil, salt, pepper and garlic powder (if used) in small bowl.
Pour over vegetables.
Chill several hours. Serve 1-cup portions.
Makes about 6 to 8 cups.
Contains 64 calories per serving.

recipes.title: German Pizza
instructions: In a 12-inch skillet over medium heat, brown beef with onion, green pepper and half of salt and pepper.
Remove meat mixture from skillet; drain fat.
Reduce heat to low and melt margarine in skillet, spread potatoes over margarine and sprinkle with remaining salt.
Top with beef mixture, combine eggs and milk and pour over all.
Cook, covered, about 30 minutes.
Top with cheese, cover, and bake until cheese melts.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Ginger-Bake Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Arrange the potato slices in an overlapping pattern in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
In a small bowl, combine the apple juice, ginger root and honey or brown sugar; and pour the mixture over the potatoes.
Bake at 425° until potatoes have a golden tinge and the liquid has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Gingered Lime Gelatin
instructions: Drain pineapple, reserving juice; set the pineapple aside. In a bowl, dissolve the gelatin in water.
Stir in ginger ale, ginger and the reserved juice.
Chill until syrupy, about 45 minutes.
Fold in pineapple.
Transfer to a 6-cup mold coated with nonstick cooking spray.
Refrigerate until firm.
Unmold onto a serving platter.
Yield: 12 servings.

recipes.title: Ginny'S Gingerbread
instructions: Line a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with wax paper that has been greased.

Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg, then molasses. Combine thoroughly and add dry ingredients and water alternately until all have been added. Continue to beat until thoroughly mixed. Pour into pan and bake 35 minutes. Oven: 325°. Yield 15-24 servings.

recipes.title: Glazed Ham Loaf
instructions: Combine ham, pork, bread crumbs, onion, eggs, milk and catsup; mix well.
Shape into a loaf in a lightly greased baking pan. Combine brown sugar, vinegar and mustard in saucepan; bring to a rolling boil.
Spoon 1/3 of glaze over ham and return to oven. Bake 30 minutes longer and glaze every 10 minutes.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Glazed Onions
instructions: Put the onions in a saucepan; add the other ingredients and mix well.
Cook over low heat 20 minutes or until the onions are tender and the sauce is almost absorbed, stirring a few times. Serves 6.
Each serving contains 40 calories.

recipes.title: Gobbler'S Chili
instructions: In large saucepan, cook ground turkey, onion, green pepper and garlic until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender. Drain.
Stir undrained beans, undrained tomatoes, brown sugar, salt and pepper; bring to boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Ladle into bowls.
Top with shredded cheese, if desired.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Golden Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook eggplant in boiling salted water for 10 minutes; drain. Combine with remaining ingredients.
Turn into 1-quart casserole. Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Golden Fried Fish
instructions: Combine flour, salt, oil and water; blend well.
Beat egg white until soft peak forms.
Fold into flour mixture.
Dip both sides of fish in batter.
Fry fish in 1/2 inch of oil heated to 370° until golden brown.
Drain on paper towel.
Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Goober Haystacks
instructions: Place chips in microwave dish and cook on High for 1 minute; stir.
Microwave on High for 1 minute more.
Stir until smooth. Add peanut butter and stir.
Add peanuts and noodles.
Stir until well coated.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper to cool. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Good Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Combine onions, celery, green pepper, French dressing and caraway seed.
Dip cauliflower tidbits into dressing.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Good Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together until all milk is absorbed completely into meat. Form into loaf.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Good Old Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook frozen beans according to package directions; drain. Combine beans, milk, soup and pepper.
Add 1/2 can onions; pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes or microwave, covered, 8 to 10 minutes.
Top with 1/2 can onions and pimiento; bake 5 minutes longer or microwave, uncovered, on High 1 minute, then let stand 5 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Good Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour, salt and lard.
Mix egg, water and vinegar.
Add to flour mixture.
Makes 3 crusts.

recipes.title: Goulash
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet, drain off grease.
Put in large kettle and add all other ingredients, except macaroni.
Cook about 30 minutes.
Add macaroni and boil for 10 minutes on medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 more minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Gourmet Coffee
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Brew as desired at 1 1/2 times normal strength.
Mixture may be stored in airtight container in refrigerator for 2 weeks.
Makes 14 servings.

recipes.title: Gourmet Potato Soup
instructions: Combine potatoes, celery, onion, salt, water and bouillon cubes in a large saucepan.
Simmer about 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Add 1 cup milk to hot mixture.
In large bowl or measuring pitcher, blend sour cream with chives, flour and remaining milk.
Pour sour cream mixture into potato mixture and stir over low heat until thickened.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Gourmet Sauce-In A Stick Mix
instructions: Microwave butter in glass bowl 1/2 to 1 minute or until softened.
Mix in dry milk, flour, bouillon, garlic salt, thyme and pepper.
Stir in sherry until mix is moistened and can be formed into a ball.
Shape dough into an 8-inch roll on waxed paper or plastic wrap.
Make indentations at 1-inch intervals, dividing roll into eighths.
Wrap tightly and store in refrigerator.
Yields 4 cups (8 recipes).

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Crisps
instructions: Mix butter, margarine and sugar in a double boiler; place over heat and bring to a boil.
Let boil slowly for 3 to 6 minutes. Line cookie sheet with foil; place graham crackers (broken at dividing lines) on cookie sheet and sprinkle with pecans.
Pour the cooked mixture over the crackers and nuts.
Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes at 325°.
Yields 5 to 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Crust
instructions: Combine ingredients and press into 8-inch or 9-inch pan. Refrigerate 1 hour before filling.
Carbohydrate 11 g, protein 1.5 g, fat 3.7 g, calories 84.
Each serving 1/8 pie crust, exchange per serving: 1/8 crust = 1 fruit, 1 fat.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Log
instructions: Combine marshmallows, dates and walnuts; mix thoroughly with 1 3/4 cups cracker crumbs.
Add unwhipped cream; mix well.
Shape into roll; coat in remaining crumbs.
Wrap well in waxed paper; refrigerate for at least 6 hours.
Slice; serve with whipped cream.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Gramma Martin'S Casserole(Pastor Martin'S Favorite)
instructions: Brown meat, onion and celery. Add rice, chicken broth, etc. Put in large casserole.
Bake, covered, for 1 hour in a 350° oven. Remove cover and bake 1/2 hour longer.
(If too dry, add 1 cup boiling water with 1 tablespoon butter.)
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Grandma Alice Kline'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter.
Add egg and flavorings.
Mix thoroughly.
Add flour and dry ingredients.
Blend together into creamed mixture.
Chill 2 hours.
Roll half of dough at a time to 3/16-inch thick on lightly floured pastry cloth. Cut with cookie cutters.
Sprinkle with sugar if they will not be iced and decorated.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes or until delicately golden.
Makes 5 dozen (2 to 2 1/2-inch) cookies.

recipes.title: Grandma Dew'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar, flour and cocoa.
Beat egg yolks with milk and pour into sugar mixture.
Bring to a boil and then cook for 15 minutes. Pour into a baked pie crust.
Top with meringue and brown in oven.
Makes 1 pie.
Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Grandma Sally'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar, butter and eggs.
Stir in sour cream, then add dry ingredients that have been premixed and the vanilla.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Roll out a small amount at a time on a floured board to which some sugar has also been added.
Sprinkle top of dough with sugar also as roll out.
Cut out with 3-inch round open cookie cutter.
Keep dough cold.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes or until very slightly browned.
Cool on racks covered with waxed paper.
Store in airtight containers with waxed paper between layers.
Freezes well.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Homemade Relish
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all the vegetables and salt and let stand overnight.
Then rinse and drain the vegetable mixture. Next, combine the remaining ingredients together and pour over the vegetable mixture.
Place on stove and bring to a boil.
Let boil for 5 minutes.
Then pour into hot pint size canning jars and seal.
Makes about 8 pint jars.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Slaw
instructions: In a large bowl, put layers of cabbage and onions.
Pour sugar over the top.
Then mix the rest of ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Pour over slaw.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Grandpa Chico'S Cornbread
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients in bowl.
Add milk and egg to the dry ingredients and mix the batter.
Then add melted shortening. Stir gently to mix.
Bake immediately in a piping hot heavy skillet (about 10-inches) and bake in hot oven at 425° to 450° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serve at once.
Makes about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Great Texas Hash
instructions: Brown onions in shortening.
Add ground beef and stir constantly until browned.
Add green peppers, tomatoes, washed rice and seasonings.
Cook until rice is tender, about 30 to 45 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Greek Butter Crescents
instructions: With electric mixer, cream together butter and Crisco.
Add 10x sugar and eggs.
Gradually add flour.
Form into crescents. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Cool.
Sift 10x sugar over cookies. Makes approximately 10 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Green And Red Coleslaw
instructions: Mix dressing and sugar in a large bowl.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix thoroughly but lightly.
Refrigerate.
Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Green Bean And Tomato Salad With Mozzarella
instructions: Cook beans until crisp-tender. Drain well. Toss with remaining ingredients and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
May be served chilled or at room temperature.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Green Bean Bake

ingredients.notes: cooked and drained or 4 cans canned green beans, drained

instructions: In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper.
Stir in green beans and one can onions.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until hot through.
Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes more.
Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine beans (drained), milk, soup, pepper and 1/2 can French fried onions.
Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole(Low-Fat Recipe)
instructions: In an 8 or 9-inch glass pie plate, microwave liquid Butter Buds or chicken broth, wheat germ, oatmeal, Italian seasoning and garlic powder on High for 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir after each minute. Remove mixture from pie plate; set aside.
In the same plate, combine beans, mushrooms and onion.
Microwave on High 3 to 4 minutes, stirring after 2 minutes.
Stir in combined sour cream and cornstarch, coating vegetables thoroughly.
Microwave on High 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened; stir. Sprinkle reserved wheat germ mixture over the top before serving. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Green Beans And Almonds
instructions: Cook beans in salt water 5 to 7 minutes; drain.
Melt 2 tablespoons of margarine or butter in skillet; add nuts.
Use low heat.
Stir occasionally 5 to 7 minutes until browned.
Stir in remaining salt and pepper.
Pour over beans.
Toss to mix.
Yields 12 servings.

recipes.title: Green Beans And Sour Cream
instructions: Layer beans, onion rings, mushrooms and sour cream in greased casserole dish.
Sprinkle with cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Green Beans Italiano
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole, combine beans and water.
Cover. Microwave on High for 15 minutes, stirring once.
Drain well.
Add garbanzo beans, pimento, olives, olive oil, oregano and garlic powder; mix well.
Cover and cook again for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring once.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Green Beans With Basil
instructions: Place beans and water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil; cook, uncovered, for 7 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Drain; add the remaining ingredients.
Cover and cook for 4 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Green Beans With Garlic Saute
instructions: Bring water to boil.
Add beans and cover.
Cook until tender. Mix remainder of ingredients in small bowl.
Pour over hot beans and toss to coat.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Green Beans With Shallot-Thyme Butter
instructions: In a small bowl, combine butter, shallots and thyme; set aside.
Bring water to rapid boil in large saucepan; add green beans.
Cook for 7 min. or until tender, drain.
Add shallot butter to hot beans; gently toss until butter melts.
Serve immediately.
Makes 6-8 servings.

recipes.title: Green Beans With Walnut Dressing
instructions: Wash beans; trim ends.
Bring water to a boil in a pan; add beans.
Cook for 10 minutes or until tender; drain.
Combine green onions and next 6 ingredients; pour over green beans and toss gently.
Sprinkle with walnuts; serve hot or cold.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Green Beans, Cream Style
instructions: Cook beans according to package directions.
Drain.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Blend thoroughly.
Add to beans and heat through.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Green Mountain Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream shortening in bowl.
Add sugar, molasses and egg.
Mix thoroughly.
Sift remaining ingredients together.
Stir into creamed mixture.
Roll into small balls; dip in additional sugar. Place 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° (preheated) for 10 minutes.
They will still be soft when you take them out.
They firm as they cool.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Green Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients.
Top with the soup.
Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Green Pea Soup
instructions: Cover the green peas with hot water to which the sliced onion has been added and cook until the peas can be mashed.
Mash the peas and add the one pint of hot water.
Blend the margarine and flour and cook a minute or so with constant stirring, but do not brown.
Add the peas, then the milk and cream.
Season to taste with salt and white pepper and allow to boil up once.
Strain and serve.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Chow-Chow
instructions: Chop vegetables fine.
Sprinkle with salt; let stand overnight.
Drain.
Mix turmeric, flour and mustard with enough water to make smooth paste.
Let vinegar come to a boil; add mixture.
Add all other ingredients, including vegetables.
Boil for 10 minutes.
Seal in jars while hot.
Yields 12 pints.

recipes.title: Grilled Basil Burgers
instructions: Mix all together.
Makes 8 (3/4-inch) patties.
Grill on Webber kettle.
Low calorie.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Steaks
instructions: Spread mustard on both sides of chicken; sprinkle with pepper. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 4 hours.
Melt butter; stir in lemon juice, garlic salt and tarragon.
Cook over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Place chicken on grill.
Baste with sauce.
Grill 50 to 55 minutes, until done, turning and basting every 10 minutes.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Grilled Pork
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pork in large bowl.
Place pork in bowl; cover and let stand at room temperature 1 hour or in refrigerator overnight, turning occasionally.
Drain and grill pork.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Grilled Potatoes In Foil
instructions: Mix salad dressing and seasonings in large bowl until well blended.
Stir in potatoes and onions to coat.
Divide potat mixture evenly among six 12-inch square pieces of heavy-duty foil. Seal each to form packet.
Place foil packets on grill over medium-hot coals (coals will have slight glow).
Grill, covered, 25 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Grits-Sausage Casserole
instructions: Bring salted water to a boil.
Stir in grits.
Reduce heat and cook for 4 minutes.
Add cheese to grits, stirring until cheese is melted.
Combine eggs, milk, thyme and garlic.
Add some of the hot grits to egg mixture, stirring to blend.
Stir egg mixture into remaining grits.
Add cooked sausage.
Pour into a buttered 8 x 12-inch dish.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Remove 20 minutes before baking.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Ground Beef And Hot Sausage Casserole
instructions: Saute meat in skillet.
Place in well-greased casserole dish. Arrange the remaining ingredients in layers in order given. Season each layer to taste.
Cover with juice or soup; add water to cover.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Serves 5.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Grand Style
instructions: Brown ground beef with onions in skillet, stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain.
Combine cream cheese, soup, milk, catsup and salt in bowl; mix well.
Add to ground beef; mix well. Spoon into 2-quart baking dish and bake at 375° for 10 minutes. Arrange biscuits around edge of casserole.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until biscuits are golden brown.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Gypsy'S Delight
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Add tomato paste, salt, sugar, Worcestershire sauce and oregano.
Mix well. Add corn and put in small, buttered casserole dish.
Sprinkle crushed potato chips on top. Place in oven at 350° for 20 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Half Hour Apple Butter
instructions: Combine ingredients in heavy 1 1/2-quart saucepan.
Bring to a boil; cook 30 minutes.
Makes 1 1/4 cups.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Dice ham.

In a large bowl, combine flour, baking powder and brown sugar. With pastry blender or two knives used scissor-fashion, cut in margarine or butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in diced ham and shredded cheese. Stir in milk just until mixture forms soft dough that leaves side of bowl.
Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead 6 to 8 strokes to mix thoroughly.
With floured rolling pin, roll dough into a 9 x 7-inch rectangle. With floured knife, cut dough lengthwise into 3 strips, then cut each strip crosswise into 4 pieces.
With pancake turner, place biscuits on ungreased cookie sheet, about 1-inch apart. Bake 12 to 15 minutes until golden. Makes 12.

recipes.title: Ham And Egg Bake
instructions: Grease a square baking dish, 8 x 8 x 2-inch. Mix biscuit mix, milk, salt, mustard, parsley and eggs in the dish with a fork until batter is of uniform color. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bake uncovered until a knife inserted in center comes out clean, about 45 minutes in a 350° oven.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Ham And Eggs Au Gratin
instructions: Cook onion in butter until tender, but not browned.
Blend in flour and salt; cook until bubbly.
Add milk; cook, stirring constantly, until melted.
Add eggs, potatoes, ham and parsley. Pour into 1 1/2 or 2-quart baking dish; top with remaining cheese. Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until top is lightly browned.
Garnish with additional egg slices. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles.
Rinse.
Combine ham and 3/4 cup cheese. Combine soup, milk and onion.
Place 1/2 noodles in bottom of 2-quart dish.
Sprinkle 1/2 ham and cheese mixture over noodles. Pour 1/2 soup mixture over ham mixture.
Repeat 1, 2, 3.
Sprinkle top with rest of cheese.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Ham And Potato Bake
instructions: Combine onion and butter in 2-quart baking dish.
Cover and cook on High 10 minutes, stirring once.
Remove onion from dish and set aside.
Layer half of potatoes and half of ham in bottom of dish.
Combine flour, salt and pepper and sprinkle half of mixture over potatoes.
Top with half of onion and half of cheese. Sprinkle with paprika.
Repeat layering.
Scald milk and pour over casserole; cover and cook until potatoes in center of dish are tender.
Makes about 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Ham Barbecue
instructions: Melt butter and cook onion until clear.
Add the rest of the ingredients.
This makes 1 pint of sauce.
Put ham and sauce in crock-pot or roaster.
Add water to cover.
Heat, stirring often.

recipes.title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients well.
Makes 2 loaves.
Put sauce on top of loaves before baking.

recipes.title: Ham Potato Casserole
instructions: Make a thin white sauce using the margarine, flour and milk. In a slightly greased 2-quart casserole, alternate layers of potatoes, ham and cheese in that order.
Pour white sauce over the mixture.
Cover and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Ham Raisin Sauce
instructions: Boil raisins and water 5 minutes.
Mix dry ingredients and add to raisins and water.
Continue cooking on medium heat until thickened.
Add vinegar.
Stir well.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.
Serve hot on ham.

recipes.title: Ham Tetrazzini
instructions: In saucepan, brown ham and onion in butter until onion is tender.
Blend in soup, water, cheese and sherry (if used).
Cook over low heat until cheese melts, stirring often.
Add spaghetti (cooked and drained), chopped pimiento and parsley.
Heat.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Ham Tortillas With Picante Mayonnaise
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a cup, combine mayonnaise and picante sauce.
Spread 1/2 mixture evenly over each tortilla.
Top each with two slices of ham.
Spread remaining sauce evenly over the ham.
Pile the lettuce and tomato evenly on the sauce.
Fold and bake for 5 minutes or until sauce bubbles.
Cool for 1 minute. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Ham-Aghetti Casserole
instructions: Place 1-inch pieces of bacon into a 2-quart casserole. Microwave on High 4 to 5 minutes. Remove half the fat.
Add ham, tomatoes, spaghetti, onions, green pepper, salt and pepper. Stir well.
Cover.
Microwave on High 18 to 20 minutes until spaghetti is tender, stirring after 8 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheese. Microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes, uncovered, until cheese is melted.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Combine cream cheese and sour cream; set aside.
Brown hamburger.
Add salt and tomato juice.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Cook noodles according to directions.
Place in greased 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Spread hamburger over noodles.
Top with cream cheese and sour cream cheese mixture.
Cover with sharp cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Hamburger Hot Pot
instructions: In skillet, lightly brown ground beef and drain well.
Add garlic powder, salt and pepper; set aside.
Place half the potatoes and half the onions in greased crock-pot.
Add browned beef.
Top with remaining potatoes and onions.
Combine mushroom soup and water; spread over top, being sure to moisten and cover evenly. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours (on high setting for 3 to 4 hours).
Makes 4 to 6 servings (about 2 1/2 quarts).

recipes.title: Hamburger Patties With Gravy
instructions: Shape beef into 7 patties (1/2-inch thick).
Salt and pepper and dip in flour.
Brown in skillet.
Add water and chipped onion. Simmer for 15 minutes with top on skillet.
Makes 7 servings.

recipes.title: Hamburger Quiche
instructions: Brown beef and onions; drain fat.
Mix other ingredients in. Add beef and onions.
Put in uncooked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
You can freeze it or you can warm it and eat.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Hamburger Spanish Rice
instructions: In a skillet, brown ground beef, onion, green pepper and rice. Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until rice is tender. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Cook onion in butter until transparent.
Add ground beef. Cook, stirring until beef is light brown.
Add the flour, salt, pepper, mushrooms and soup.
Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the sour cream and simmer for 15 minutes longer.
Serve over cooked rice or cooked egg noodles.
Garnish with paprika.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Hamburger Supreme By Danish
instructions: Combine ground beef, onions, salt, pepper and eggs.
Mix well and shape into patties about 3/4-inch thick.
Roll in flour and brown on both sides in hot vegetable oil.
Remove patties when brown and pour off all but 3 to 4 tablespoons of fat.
Add flour to fat (may add some salt and pepper, if desired).
Mix well.
Add milk and mushroom soup; stir until thick.
Return patties to pan and cook 15 minutes longer, or place in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Hamburger Surprise
instructions: Cook noodles with bouillon cubes.
Drain and spread in buttered 9 x 13 pan.
Cook ground beef with onion, drain.
Mix with tomato paste, garlic salt, pepper, and water.
Cook 3 minutes then spoon over noodles.
Beat cream cheese.
Add cream of mushroom soup and sour cream until blended.
Pour over mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes until heated through.
Top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Bake 5 minutes until cheese is melted. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Hamburger Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown meat in kettle, stirring to break up meat.
Add onion and garlic.
Cook until yellow.
Add remaining vegetables and cook, stirring often, 3 minutes. Stir in flour. Add 6 cups boiling water, salt and pepper. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until tender.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Hamburger-Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter.
Add meat and cook until all the pink has disappeared.
Add celery, carrots, green pepper, beef bouillon cube, hot water and seasonings.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Mix flour and cold water until smooth and add to mixture.
Turn into a 1-quart casserole.
Spoon fluffy mashed potatoes around edge of the casserole.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until the top has become a golden brown.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Hamburger-Vegetable Chowder
instructions: Brown hamburger in oil over medium heat. Add all other ingredients except rice.
Cook on low for 1 hour, then add rice. Cook until rice is done. Add more water or tomato juice, if it is too thick.
V-8 juice may be substituted for liquid.
Makes 6 servings.
Can be frozen.
I make mine thick.

recipes.title: Harlequin Casserole
instructions: Shred Cheddar cheese (makes 1 1/4 cups).
Save 1/4 cup for biscuits.
Melt butter in saucepan; blend in flour.
Gradually add tomato juice and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick.

recipes.title: Harvard Beets, Heart Cookbook
instructions: Combine cornstarch, sugar, pepper, cloves and orange rind in a 1-quart saucepan.
Stir in vinegar and beet juice.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens.
Add beets; simmer until they are heated through.
Just before serving, stir in margarine.
Yields 4 servings.
Contains approximately 115 calories.

recipes.title: Harvest Soup
instructions: Add all ingredients except tomatoes to boiling water.
Cover and boil gently for 15 minutes.
Break up large pieces of tomato and add to vegetable mixture.
Continue cooking until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
Remove bay leaf and serve with grated Parmesan cheese.
Makes 4 servings, 1 cup each.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes.
Mix with soup, sour cream, onion, oleo, 1 cup cheese and salt and pepper to taste.
Pour into a well-greased baking dish (9 x 13 x 2-inch).
Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven. Makes 8 servings.
Each has 243 calories, 14 gr fat and 33 mg cholesterol.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl (potatoes should be thawed). Pour into oiled casserole and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
If topping is desired, mix 2 cups crushed corn flakes and 1/4 cup margarine and sprinkle on top before baking.
Serves 16.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Pour cooled dressing (amount according to personal preference) over all and stir well. Makes about 8 servings.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken Salad
instructions: Place the first 5 ingredients in mixing bowl.
In smaller bowl, make dressing with mayo, sour cream, curry powder, lemon juice and salt; pour over chicken mixture and toss.
Chill 30 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix the last 9 ingredients together; stir until there are no lumps in the batter.
Put thawed wings in batter and marinate overnight.
Stir several times.
Before deep frying, stir again, then fry until golden brown.
Serve hot or cold.
Serves 15 to 20 people.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Coleslaw
instructions: Combine cabbage, oranges and pineapple; toss gently, and set aside.
Combine mayonnaise and remaining ingredients; stir well. Pour dressing over cabbage mixture, toss gently.
Cover and chill at least 6 hours.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Rice
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions.
Combine remaining ingredients, salt to taste.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
(Serve with sour cream, optional.)
This is great with fruit salad.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Rice Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/4 cup juice.
Cut chunks in half. Combine rice, pineapple, coconut, almonds and cherries in a mixing bowl.
Blend sour cream, sugar, salt and reserved pineapple juice.
Pour over rice mixture.
Toss lightly.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hazel'S Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine
chicken,
water
chestnuts, pimentos, almonds, mushrooms,	lemon juice and mayonnaise.
Place in a buttered 2 quart
casserole.
Top
with
cheese and onions.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until golden.
Freezes well. Serves 6.

recipes.title: He Man Dish
instructions: Cook onions in oleo for a few minutes.
Take out.
Cook ground beef in pan where onions were cooked.
Cook until red is gone.
In 9 x 13-inch pan, put layer of noodles, layer of onions, and sprinkle thyme, Accent, pepper and salt over meat.
Mix milk with mushroom soup.
Pour over meat and noodle mixture.
Before baking, add cheese to top and pour beaten egg over top.
Bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Heart Smart Berry Frost
instructions: In covered blender at low speed, blend all ingredients until smooth and frothy.
Pour into glass.
Makes 1 serving.

recipes.title: Heart Smart Carrot Pineapple Juice
instructions: In blender at medium speed, blend carrots and water about 1 minute.
Strain; return liquid to blender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Blend at low speed until smooth.
Pour into 2 glasses.
Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Hearty Chili
instructions: In large skillet, cook beef and onions until brown.
Drain off fat.
Combine tomatoes and bean liquid.
Add water to make 1 cup. Add tomatoes, kidney beans, liquid mixture, chili powder and macaroni to skillet.
Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes.
Add water as necessary.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Hearty Clam Chowder
instructions: Saute bacon until crisp in large kettle.
Remove and chop. Add onions, potatoes, green pepper, celery and garlic.
Add 2 cups chicken broth and seasonings.
Cover kettle and simmer 20 minutes. Add clams and juice and half and half; heat until hot.
Do not boil.
Add chopped bacon.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hearty Healthy Hotcakes
instructions: In a bowl, combine all dry ingredients.
In another bowl, whisk egg yokes, oil, buttermilk and vanilla.
Pour into dry ingredients, stirring until moistened.
Beat egg whites on high speed until soft peaks form.
Fold dry ingredients into batter. Fry on hot griddle (will take longer to cook than normal pancakes).
Yields about 12 hotcakes.

recipes.title: Hearty Herbed Lentils And Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan.
Bring to a boil; then cover.
Let simmer one hour.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking, as nearly all the liquid will be absorbed by lentils and rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Hearty Potato Ham Chowder
instructions: In large kettle, melt margarine or butter; add onion and green pepper and cook until tender.
Add potatoes, 2 cups water and seasonings.
Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender.
Make paste of flour and 1/3 cup of water and stir into the potato mixture.
Add milk and cook until slightly thickened.
Stir in corn and ham.
Heat thoroughly.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Hedda'S Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar, shortening, egg and extract.
Add flour and salt and blend well.
Fold in coconut.
Shape into one-inch balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten with fork.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 18 minutes until slightly golden around edges. Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Helen'S Honey Baked Chicken
instructions: Wash and dry chicken parts; remove skin, if desired.
Melt butter in shallow baking pan.
Add remaining ingredients, except chicken.
Mix well.
Roll chicken in mixture and arrange in a single layer in same pan.
Bake at 375°, basting occasionally, for 40 minutes (30 minutes if boneless chicken is used).
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Helen'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar, margarine, eggs and flavorings thoroughly.
Measure flour and sift.
Stir flour, baking powder and salt together. Blend well and chill at least 1 hour.
Heat oven to 400°.
Roll dough 1/8-inch thick on a lightly floured board.
Cut with a 3-inch cookie cutter.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 6 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Hellmann'S Seven Layer Salad

ingredients.notes: drained or 1 pkg. frozen green peas, cooked and drained

instructions: In a large bowl, layer lettuce, celery, onion, pepper and peas.
Sprinkle cheese over peas.
Sprinkle bacon over cheese. Spread mayonnaise on salad, completely sealing salad.
Chill.
Can be tossed before serving.
