Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Herb Garlic Grilled Chicken
instructions: Combine parsley, garlic, lemon peel and mint.
Loosen skin from breast and thigh portion of chicken quarters by running fingers between skin and meat.
Rub some of the seasoning mixture over meat and under skin, then replace skin and rub remaining seasonings over outside of chicken.
Arrange medium-hot charcoal briquettes on one side of covered grill.
Place chicken on grill opposite coals.
Cover grill and cook chicken 45 to 55 minutes, turning once or twice.
Chicken is done when juices run clear. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Herb Mushrooms
instructions: Put mushrooms in casserole.
Combine remaining ingredients and add to casserole.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes and serve with steak or roast beef.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Herbed Chicken
instructions: Mix dressing, wine, garlic, onions and seasonings.
Pour salad dressing mixture over chicken; cover.
Refrigerate for several hours.
Drain.
Place chicken on grill over medium hot coals or on rack of broiler pan.
Grill or broil for 8 to 10 minutes on each side or until tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Herbed Meat Loaves
instructions: In a medium-size mixing bowl, combine egg, stuffing mix, milk, onion soup mix and the 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce.
Add the ground beef and mix well.
Shape into 5 loaves.
Arrange the loaves around the edge of a 1 3/4-quart casserole.
Cover with waxed paper and cook on High in microwave for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove and let stand for 5 minutes.
Heat the 1/4 cup sauce and spoon over loaves before serving.
Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Herbed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes.
Put potatoes in bowl. Add melted margarine, herbs, salt and pepper.
Stir to coat slices.
Wrap securely in heavy aluminum foil, making as flat as possible.
Cook on barbecue grill, turning regularly, for 20 minutes or until done.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Holiday Scallop
instructions: Saute mushrooms and onions separately in butter.
Next, combine cottage cheese and sour cream.
Then layer ingredients in 2 good-sized casserole dishes in this order:
potatoes, onions, mushrooms and cottage cheese mixture.
Sprinkle each layer lightly with seasonings and grated cheese.
Keep layering until all ingredients are used up, ending with grated cheese on top.
Cover and bake for 45 minutes at 350°; remove cover for last 15 minutes of baking.
If you don't want to bake both casseroles at once, deliver one to a friend.
It will keep nicely in the refrigerator for a day or two before baking.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Home Style Dressing From Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl until evenly distributed.
Put mixture in a foil packet or 1-pint glass jar. Store in cool, dry place.
Use within 6 months.
Makes about 2 tablespoons of dressing mix, enough for 2 cups home style dressing.

recipes.title: Home-Style Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a large saucepan, saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in flour, salt and pepper until blended. Gradually add milk. Bring to boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until sauce thickens. Place half of potatoes in a greased 3-quart baking dish. Pour half of sauce over potatoes. Repeat layers. Bake uncovered at 350° for 70 minutes or until potatoes are tender and top is lightly browned.
Serve immediately. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Homemade Condensed Milk
instructions: Mix well in blender.
Makes 1 1/4 cups condensed milk.

recipes.title: Homemade Egg Substitute(Cholesterol Free)
instructions: Beat egg whites lightly with a fork.
Add remaining ingredients and beat until blended.
Makes 6 tablespoons, equivalent to 2 whole eggs or 1/2 egg substitute.

recipes.title: Homemade Soup
instructions: Add beans, peas, carrots and potatoes to 1 quart of water and boil until tender.
Add to other ingredients in large pot and cook for 30 minutes. While boiling hot, put in jars and seal.
Makes 12 quarts.

recipes.title: Honey Coconut Balls
instructions: Sift powdered sugar into a bowl and set aside.
Mix other ingredients into separate bowl.
Roll into balls and dip in powdered sugar.
Makes about 24.

recipes.title: Honey Crunch Cookies
instructions: Sift together first 3 ingredients; set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, cream butter.
Add honey, a little at a time; mix well.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Mixture will appear to separate.
Gradually add dry ingredients; mix until moistened.
Fold in coconut, chips and cereal.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for about 12 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove cookies to cooling rack. Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Honey Dressing For Fruit
instructions: Combine sugar, mustard, paprika, celery seed and salt.
Stir in honey, vinegar, lemon juice and onion.
Very slowly pour salad oil into mixture, beating constantly with rotary beater.
Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Honey Fruit Glaze
instructions: Combine all together; mix well.
Brush on chicken or ham during last 10 minutes or roasting.
Makes 1/2 cup.

recipes.title: Honey Glorified Rice
instructions: Whip the cream; beat in honey gradually.
Stir in vanilla. Fold in remaining ingredients.
Chill.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Honey Herb Chicken
instructions: Grill or preheat oven to 350°.
In small bowl, combine all ingredients except chicken.
Brush sauce over chicken.
Grill or bake until well done and tender, basting every 5 minutes with sauce.
If baking, the chicken pieces may be placed in a baking dish and the sauce may be poured into the baking dish.
Basting is then done with a spoon at 10 minute intervals.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Honey Puffs
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and roll into small balls.
Makes 24.

recipes.title: Honey Roasted Apples
instructions: Pare top 1/3 of the apples and remove core, leaving 1/2-inch of core on bottom.
Place apples in oiled baking dish. Combine honey, orange juice, lemon juice, orange peel and ginger.
Mix well.
Spoon over apples, allowing mixture to fill centers and coat entire surface.
Pour water into baking dish. Bake, covered, at 400° for 15 minutes.
Remove cover and bake 30 minutes longer or until apples are glazed and tender.
Baste with liquid from baking dish every 15 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Honey-Dijon Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of electric blender. Process until smooth.
Cover and chill thoroughly.
Makes 1 1/4 cups.

recipes.title: Honey-Glazed New Potatoes
instructions: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, cover potatoes with salted water.
Bring water to a boil and cook until potatoes are tender; drain.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Stir in water, honey, salt and pepper.
Stirring occasionally, cook 1 layer of potatoes 10 to 12 minutes or until brown.
Transfer to serving dish and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
Repeat for remaining potatoes.
Serve warm.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Hoosier Pork Chop Supper
instructions: In a large skillet, saute onion in oil until tender.
Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside.
Reserve drippings in pan. Combine flour, salt and pepper; coat the pork chops.
Brown on both sides in the drippings.
Add potatoes, carrot, tomatoes and onion.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, adding the peas during the last 10 minutes.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Hoppin' John(Will Bring Good Luck If Served On New Year'S Eve.)
instructions: Finely chop and cook in margarine the pepper and onion.
Cook until bubbly flour and milk.
Add 1 1/2 cups cheese, peas, rice, ham and egg to milk mixture.
Turn into greased casserole. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Horseradish Ring
instructions: Beat eggs and mix with vinegar, sugar and horseradish.
Soak and melt gelatine over hot water.
Add gelatine to egg mixture in double boiler and cook until creamy.
Cool over cold water.
Fold in stiffly beaten whipped cream.
Pour into ring mold.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Horseradish Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly; refrigerate until serving time.
Yields 1 cup.

recipes.title: Horseradish Sauce For Ham
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the first 6 ingredients.
Mix well. Chill.
Serve over ham.
Yields 2 cups.

recipes.title: Hot And Spicy Seasoning
instructions: Mix together all ingredients.
Store in airtight container. Makes about 1/3 cup.

recipes.title: Hot Apple 'N Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Cook cabbage and onion in margarine for about 10 minutes.
Add the rest of the ingredients.
Cover and cook for about 5 to 10 minutes; serve hot.
Serves 6. Contains 160 calories.

recipes.title: Hot Cakes
instructions: Place oats and buttermilk in a mixing bowl; let stand 5 to 10 minutes.
Stir in brown sugar.
Beat eggs; add butter and stir into oat mixture.
Sift flour with baking soda and salt; add all at once to oat mixture.
Stir lightly with wooden spoon only until combined; do not beat.
Spoon batter onto hot, lightly greased griddle.
Yield: 16 (4-inch) pancakes.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken And Cheese Canapes
instructions: Combine ingredients.
Spread on crackers or toast squares. Broil 4 inches from heat until cheese melts.
Makes about 1 cup.

recipes.title: Hot Corned Beef Sandwiches
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put on hamburger buns.
Wrap each sandwich in foil and put in oven for 15 to 20 minutes at 375°.
Makes 12 sandwiches and you can double the recipe.
(Use cookie sheet.)

recipes.title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients except grated cheese in small casserole dish.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes, until bubbly.
Serve hot with crackers.
Makes about 15 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Crab Salad
instructions: Chop green pepper, onion and celery fine.
Combine crab and shrimp; add to vegetables.
Blend with other ingredients.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Hot Curried Fruits
instructions: Drain all fruits and turn out into 1 1/2-quart casserole and mix together lightly.
Blend together the soft butter, brown sugar, curry, cornstarch and lemon peel.
Sprinkle over fruit mixture.
Let mixture stand for several hours to draw out juices. Bake uncovered about 1 hour at 325°.
Spoon some of the juices over fruit several times during baking.
Serve while hot. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Hot Diggity Hot Dish
instructions: Prepare macaroni and drain.
Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients.
Mix well; turn into greased 2-quart baking dish.
Cover and bake 30 to 35 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Dutch Dressing
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp, drain and crumble.
Beat sugar into egg.
Stir in vinegar and water.
Add to bacon drippings in skillet.
Cook until slightly thickened, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add bacon.
Cool slightly before serving. Great for spinach salad.
Yields 1/2 to 3/4 cup.

recipes.title: Hot Fruit Brunch Casserole(Quick And Easy, A Family Favorite!)
instructions: In a casserole dish, put pie filling in first.
Next, add drained peaches and pears.
Sprinkle brown sugar over the top and then pour rum over it.
Bake at 450° for 20 minutes.
Serves 6. Can easily be doubled for a larger crowd.

recipes.title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes; drain, peel and dice while hot.
Cook bacon in frying pan until crisp.
Remove bacon from pan.
Cook onion in bacon grease until golden brown.
Blend in flour, salt and sugar. Stir in the water.
Boil 2 minutes.
Add vinegar and heat through. Pour the hot dressing over the hot potatoes.
Mix in the chopped bacon.
Makes about 4 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Ham And Cauliflower
instructions: Cook cauliflower and/or broccoli in a small amount of boiling salted water.
Cover until crisp-tender. Drain well. Remove from pan.
Melt 1/4 cup margarine in the same pan.
Stir in flour. Add milk all at once.
Cook and stir until mixture is very thick and begins to bubble.
Add cheese and sour cream.
Cook and stir over low heat until cheese is melted. Stir in ham, mushrooms and cooked vegetables.
Turn in a 2-quart casserole pan. Combine bread crumbs and 1 tablespoon melted margarine or butter.
Sprinkle atop casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Mexican Dip
instructions: Cook and stir beef and onions in a 10-inch skillet until brown; drain.
Stir in taco sauce, beans and 1 cup of the cheese. Heat, stirring occasionally until cheese is melted.
Pour into serving dish and sprinkle remaining cheese on top in a ring. Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Hot Mustard Relish
instructions: Chop vegetables, then measure.
Mix all together with salt. Let stand 2 1/2 hours.
Do not drain.
Boil for 10 minutes, or until done.
Combine vinegar, sugar, flour, mustard and turmeric; let come to a boil.
Pour over vegetable mixture; mix well.
Pour into sterilized jars and seal.
Yields 15 pints.
Eat with meats.

recipes.title: Hot Or Cold Baked Potato Salad
instructions: Bake potatoes on greased cookie sheet at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Stir occasionally while baking so they don't stick.
Add all other ingredients in bowl and stir together.
Serve warm or cold.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Pecan Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Top with potato chips and 1/4 cup pecans.
Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve hot.
Garnish with green pepper rings.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Hot Sour Cream Potatoes

ingredients.notes: pepper, cayenne, garlic salt and paprika to taste

instructions: Peel and dice potatoes while still warm.
Add butter, pimento, onion and seasoning.
Mix well.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Stir in sour cream.
Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Hot Tomatorie Chile
instructions: Melt the butter in a Dutch oven, then add the onions, green peppers and celery.
Cook until onion is tender, but not brown. Add the ground beef and cook until beef loses red color, breaking up with a fork.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, salt, monosodium, hot sauce and chili powder.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes longer.
Serve with crisp, salted crackers.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Huguenot Torte
instructions: In a bowl, beat eggs until frothy and lemon-colored.
Add sugar, flour, baking powder and salt.
Mix until smooth.
Stir in apples, pecans and vanilla.
Mix well.
Put mixture in a buttered 12 x 8-inch baking pan.
Bake at 325° for about 45 minutes or until crusty and brown on top.
Serve with vanilla ice cream. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients, then mix other ingredients.
Next, mix together gently.
Do not beat!!
Makes 3 layers.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hunt'S Hamburger Skillet Stew
instructions: Combine beef, bread crumbs, chopped onion, egg, 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce and 1/2 cup tomato sauce.
Shape into 16 balls.
Brown in oil in skillet.
Add vegetables, water and 1 teaspoon salt.
Pour over remaining tomato sauce.
Cover and simmer one hour, stirring occasionally.
Remove 1/2 cup stew sauce and mix with flour.
Gradually pour into stew and stir over low heat until gravy thickens.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Icebox Slaw
instructions: Place cabbage and onion in layers.
Boil vinegar, sugar, salt and celery seed for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat; add salad oil. Pour over cabbage and onion while hot.
Cover tightly. Refrigerate overnight.
Keeps for 2 weeks.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Icebox Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine all vegetables in a large glass bowl.
Set aside.
In a saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Cool slightly and pour over vegetables.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Iced Fresh Tomato Soup
instructions: Cut tomatoes into eighths.
Force tomatoes, basil and onion through food mill, or whirl in blender and pour through a wire strainer.
Add chicken broth, sugar, salt, pepper and white wine; whip to blend.
Chill thoroughly.
Stir before serving.
Float peeled, cooked shrimp on top, or garnish with salted whipped cream.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Ida'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown until onions are done.
Add hamburger.
Cook well done; then add stewed tomatoes, tomato paste and water.
Simmer for 1 hour over low heat.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Imperial Sugar'S Canefest Pralines
instructions: Combine sugar, soda, buttermilk and salt in a 3 1/2-quart heavy saucepan.
Cook for about 5 minutes over high heat or to 210° on a candy thermometer.
Stir often, scraping the bottom of the pan.
The mixture will foam up.
Add margarine and pecans. Continue cooking over medium heat, stirring constantly, and scraping the sides and bottom of pan until the candy reaches the soft-ball stage (234° on the candy thermometer).
Remove from the heat and cool slightly for about 2 minutes.
Beat with a spoon until thick and creamy.
Next, drop a tablespoon of the mixture onto a sheet of waxed paper or aluminum foil.
Let the pralines cool completely.
Makes 20 (2-inch) pralines.

recipes.title: Incredible Peach Pie(A Peach Custard Pie That Makes Its Own Crust)
instructions: In a large bowl, beat 2 eggs and add milk, corn syrup, butter, sugar, vanilla and flour.
Mix until smooth.
Stir in coconut and peaches.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch pie plate.
Top peach mixture with chopped pecans and sprinkle generously with nutmeg or cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until the custard is set.
Allow to stand 15 to 30 minutes for easy serving.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Indian Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix egg, flour and sugar.
Add cheese and corn.
Cook bacon; drain and crumble.
Stir 2 slices of bacon into mixture.
Turn mixture into a baking dish.
Sprinkle with remaining bacon.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Serves 3 to 4.

recipes.title: Insalata Agro-Dolce(Sweet And Sour Italian Salad)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Stir lightly. Marinate overnight in refrigerator.
Serves 20.

recipes.title: Instant Boiled Custard
instructions: Blend all ingredients well with electric mixer.
Store in glass container.
Three recipes yields 2 gallons.

recipes.title: Instant Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Put all ingredients in a pan, except cucumbers.
Bring to a boil and drop in 4 cups cucumbers.
Boil 3 to 5 minutes.
Put into sterile jars and seal.
Makes about 2 pints.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Sift flour, sugar, salt and baking powder into mixing bowl. Stir in caraway seed.
Cut in margarine until mixture looks like coarse meal.
Add raisins.
Combine buttermilk, 1 egg and baking soda; stir into flour mixture to moisten dry ingredients.
Turn onto floured board; knead lightly for 3 minutes.
Shape into ball; place in greased 2-quart casserole.
With a sharp knife, cut a 4-inch cross about 1/2-inch deep in center of bread.
Brush with beaten egg yolk.
Bake in a 375° oven for 1 hour, or until done. (Cake tester inserted in center comes out clean.)
Cool in casserole for 10 minutes before removing to wire rack.
Yields 1 bread.

recipes.title: Island Chicken
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients; stir well.
Place chicken in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Brush on half of marmalade mixture.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 50 minutes, basting occasionally with the remaining marmalade mixture.
Spoon pineapple chunks and orange sections over chicken; bake an additional 10 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Italian Lemon Chicken
instructions: In a large broiling pan, place chicken, garlic, cut-up wedges of potatoes and olive oil and bake until brown.
Add lemon juice, water, parsley, then salt and pepper to taste.
Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Italian Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a tightly covered jar.
Shake well until dressing is thoroughly mixed.
Refrigerate for 2 hours. Shake well before serving.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Italian Sauce
instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Discard the garlic.
Add to this the carrot, green pepper, bay leaf, oregano, thyme, basil, chives and parsley.
Mix well.
Add fresh tomatoes and tomato paste to this mixture as well as the remaining ingredients and mix well.
Simmer until thickened; remove bay leaf.
Better if made one day ahead.
Great canned!
Great on pizza or any Italian type dish.
Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: J B'S Mighty Fine Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet; drain off grease.
In large pot, stir all ingredients except kidney beans.
Add liquid from beans and bring to boil.
Reduce heat; cover, simmer about 50 minutes. Spoon off any fat.
Add kidney beans.
Cover and simmer another 50 minutes.
Can serve with grated Cheddar cheese.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Jackie Kennedy'S Cucumber Salad
instructions: Make a marinade of all ingredients, except oil.
Pour over cucumber slices.
Cover and store in refrigerator; stir occasionally.
Before serving, add salad oil and stir well. Serves 2.
Each serving contains 30 calories.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine cornmeal, salt and pepper.
Stir in the onion, jalapeno pepper and buttermilk just until combined.
Let stand for a few minutes to thicken.
Drop hush puppies, using two spoons, a few at a time, into the hot (365°) oil.
Fry for 3 to 4 minutes or until golden, turning once.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve hush puppies warm with catfish.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Janah'S Surprise
instructions: Cream together first 4 ingredients until fluffy.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Stir into molasses mixture, form in small balls.
Roll in granulated sugar; place 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet.
Bake in moderate oven (325°) about 15 minutes.
Cool slightly and remove from pan.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Jane'S Chili(Good!)
instructions: Put beans in 9 cups of water with 1 teaspoon of salt.
Bring to a boil; reduce to simmer and cook for 1 3/4 hours.
Save 1 1/2 cups of liquid.
Cook meat with vegetables until they are tender. Drain.
Combine remaining ingredients; simmer for 3 hours.
You can use a crock-pot, if desired.
Serves 15 to 20 people.

recipes.title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add other ingredients. Bake at 300° for 50 to 55 minutes.
Yields 2 pies.

recipes.title: Jellied Green Bean Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water.
Add vinegar and ice and stir until jello begins to thicken (about 3 to 5 minutes). Remove unmelted ice.
Fold in vegetables and pour into 4 cup mold or individual molds.
Chill until firm, about 3 hours.
Unmold and garnish with crisp salad greens and mayonnaise.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Jesse'S Easy Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef with onions.
Drain fat.
Stir in remaining ingredients except kidney beans.
Add 1 cup of water.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in kidney beans.
Heat.
Serve with oyster crackers.
Makes 8 servings (1 cup each).

recipes.title: Jiffy Hollandaise
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Cook and stir over low heat until heated through.
Makes 1/2 cup.

recipes.title: Jill'S Favorite Chicken Skillet
instructions: Combine flour, salt, paprika, sage and pepper in a paper bag. Add chicken, a few pieces at a time, and shake to coat.
Reserve excess flour mixture.
In skillet, brown chicken on all sides in hot Crisco.
Remove chicken. Stir reserved flour mixture and sugar into pan drippings. Add chicken broth.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in lemon juice, carrots, onion and parsley.
Return chicken to skillet. Cover and cook until vegetables and chicken are tender, 40 to 50 minutes. Stir occasionally.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Jo'S Favorite Company Chicken
instructions: Crush garlic clove into butter as it is melting.
Add salt. Dip washed and dried chicken into melted butter, then into crumb mixture.
Bake in shallow pan or dish, uncovered, at 375° for 30 minutes, then at 350° for 30 minutes or until it tests done. Serves 10 elegantly!

recipes.title: Joan'S Spicy Hot Black-Eyed Peas
instructions: Cook bacon in large skillet until crisp.
Remove bacon; crumble and set aside or substitute oil.
Stir next 11 ingredients into bacon drippings or oil in skillet.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat; simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour mixture into serving dish. Sprinkle bacon and parsley over top.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Joann'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except cheese and paprika.
Place in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes at 350°. Put cheese and paprika on during the last 10 minutes of baking time.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Joanne'S Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Melt butter in shallow roasting pan.
Roll chicken pieces in butter until well coated.
Arrange the pieces in single layer in pan.
Reserve 2 slices of the pineapple for garnishing the platter.
Dice remaining slices.
Mix the pineapple juice with remaining ingredients.
Cook until thickened, stirring constantly. Add drained pineapple pieces.
Spoon one-half of the sauce over chicken.
Cover and bake in moderate oven at 350° for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 30 to 45 minutes longer or until chicken is tender.
Baste chicken occasionally with remaining sauce.
Arrange chicken on hot platter.
Cut reserved pineapple slices in half. Twist each half to make an "S".
Place on chicken platter. Garnish with parsley, if desired.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: John'S Maple Candy
instructions: In large bowl, mix all ingredients.
Roll into little balls the size of walnuts.
Refrigerate one to two hours.
(Best if made a day ahead of serving time.)
Also may be rolled in finely shredded coconut or chopped pecans and placed on waxed paper lined cookie sheets until chilled.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Josephine'S Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes in 1-quart sauce dish, oven tested.
One bowl recipe, makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: K.C.'S Broccoli Salad

ingredients.notes: cooked and crumbled, drain off all grease

instructions: Wash broccoli well; pick off leaves and peel outer skin.
Cut florets and chop well.
Cut and chop stem of broccoli and mix with florets.
Wash cauliflower well; pick off leaves.
Use only florets of cauliflower; chop florets and add to broccoli.
Mix in onion and bacon.
Add mayonnaise to broccoli and cauliflower.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Kappa Alpha Theta Casserole
instructions: Cut crusts off of bread and cut into cubes.
Cook celery until tender. Put 1/2 of bread cubes in bottom of 3-quart casserole. Mix shrimp, crabmeat, green pepper, diced celery, salt and mayonnaise and spread over bread.
Mix egg, milk and mustard and pour over mixture in casserole.
Cover with rest of bread.
Spread over the top one can of undiluted cream of mushroom soup.
Spread cheese over top and bake 1 hour at 325°.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Karen'S Creative Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain.
Add onion, sour cream, mushroom soup, chicken soup, Worcestershire sauce and milk.
Bring to a simmer; stir in flour, if desired.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle chopped onions or chives on top.
Good when served over hot rice. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Katherine Hepburn'S Brownies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°.
Butter and flour an 8-inch square baking pan.
Melt the chocolate with the butter in saucepan over low heat.
Remove from the heat and stir in the sugar.
Stir in the eggs and vanilla and mix until smooth.
Add the flour, salt and nuts and stir until smooth.
Pour into the prepared pan.
Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center of the brownies comes out clean, 40 minutes.
Makes 16 brownies.

recipes.title: Kelly'S No Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil together sugar, milk and margarine for 3 minutes.
Add remainder of ingredients.
Mix together; drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper.
Cool to hard stage.
Makes 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Kids' Krunchy Krazy Korn
instructions: Heat oven to 250°.
Place popcorn on 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan.
In large saucepan, combine sugar, margarine and corn syrup. Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly; simmer for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in baking soda and vanilla. Pour mixture evenly over popcorn; mix well.
Bake at 250° for 30 minutes, stirring twice during baking.
Remove from pan immediately.
Cool on waxed paper.
Store in tightly covered container.
Makes 8 cups.

recipes.title: Kids' Tropical Treat
instructions: Wrap banana in foil and place it in the freezer for 1/2 hour. Remove and place all ingredients in a blender and puree for 30 seconds or until it is smooth.
Pour in small paper cups.
Makes 5 servings.
Children love these.

recipes.title: Killer Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar, milk and butter in a heavy 2 quart saucepan. Bring to a full rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Continue boiling over medium heat until mixture reaches 234° or soft ball stage.
Stir constantly to prevent scorching.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter, marshmallow cream and vanilla.
Stir until well blended and creamy.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Makes about 3 pounds of fudge.

recipes.title: Kings Arms Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Grease a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Mash cooked or canned sweet potatoes.
Stir in remaining ingredients except turn mixture into prepared casserole and sprinkle with reserved brown sugar.
Bake at 400° in preheated oven for 30 minutes or may freeze and bake at a later date.
Serves 8 to 10 people.

recipes.title: Korean Salad
instructions: Mix the dressing and onion and add to the chopped up spinach in a bowl.
Add water chestnuts and also add bean sprouts.
Then crumble cooked bacon on
top.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Krum-Kaka
instructions: Melt butter and cool.
Beat eggs; add sugar and mix.
Whip the cream.
Add melted butter to eggs and sugar; add whipped cream. Add vanilla and flour.
Use 1 scant teaspoon for each one on Krum-KaKa iron.
Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Krystal'S Vegetable Chili
instructions: Melt butter; saute vegetables until tender.
Add tomatoes and tomato sauce.
Add seasonings and simmer slowly for 1/2 hour.
Add beans and salt to taste; continue to simmer for another 1/2 hour. Serve hot.
May be topped with grated cheese, if desired.
Serves 6 hearty appetites.

recipes.title: La. Pecan Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs and add sugars and cornstarch.
Add scalded milk and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture coats the spoon heavily. Allow to cool and add the rest of the milk and cream.
Mix.
Stir in chopped pecans.
Pour into ice cream freezer.
Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

recipes.title: Lady Baltimore Cake
instructions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.
Cream shortening with sugar until fluffy.
Combine milk, water and vanilla.
Add sifted dry ingredients and liquid alternately in small amounts, beating well after each addition.
Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry and fold into batter.
Pour into greased pans and bake in moderate 350° oven for 25 minutes.
Cool.
Spread filling between layers and cover top and sides with divinity icing.
Makes 3 (9-inch) layers.

recipes.title: Lady Bird'S Lima Beans
instructions: Saute mushrooms in margarine.
Sprinkle in flour.
Add slowly and cook until thickened the milk.
Blend cheese, salt, pepper and chili powder.
Stir beans in gently.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Ladyfingers
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll in powdered sugar.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Serves 5.

recipes.title: Lane Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar well.
Sift flour and baking powder together.
Add milk alternately with creamed mixture.
Beat egg whites until stiff; fold in the mixture.
Bake at 325° for approximately 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 4 layers.

recipes.title: Lard Pie Crust
instructions: Combine flour, lard (softened) and water.
Mix until thick. Knead to desired consistency.
Makes 6 crusts.
Roll dough out and place in pan.

recipes.title: Lasagne(Made With Uncooked Noodles)
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef and onion.
Mix meat with stewed tomatoes, tomato paste, water, sugar, parsley flakes and basil. Mix together cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, parsley flakes and oregano.
Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan:
1/2 sauce mixture, 1/2 noodles, all cottage cheese mixture, 1/2 noodles, remaining sauce and top all with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, covered, then 15 minutes, uncovered.
Let stand a few minutes before cutting.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Layered Bean Dip
instructions: Spread refried beans in casserole dish or platter.
Brown ground beef and drain.
Add taco seasoning mix and water.
Cook and stir on medium heat, 10 to 15 minutes.

Spread over refried beans. Arrange layers of lettuce, salsa and cheese on top of meat. Garnish with desired toppings: sour cream, guacamole, black olive slices and jalapeno slices. Serve with tortilla chips.
Makes 14 to 16 appetizer servings.

recipes.title: Layered Fruit Salad
instructions: Layer apples, apricots, pears, peaches and pineapple in a large bowl. Combine orange juice and lemon juice.
Pour over fruit. Spread cherry pie filling on top, then cover and chill 2 hours.
Arrange bananas over pie filling.
Sprinkle with coconut. Serve immediately.
Yields 14 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Layered Supper
instructions: Divide potatoes between 2 (12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch) baking dishes. Season with salt and pepper.
Arrange corn and green pepper over potatoes in each casserole.
Layer the onion then the carrots in each.
Crumble beef evenly over the vegetables.
Sprinkle with more salt and pepper.
Pat gently to smooth.
Top each casserole with tomato sauce.
Bake covered at 350° for 2 hours.
Uncover; sprinkle with cheese.
Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving. Makes 2 casseroles, 8 to 9 servings each.

recipes.title: Leek And Potato Soup
instructions: Put leeks, celery and butter in a pan.
Cook 10 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add water.
Cover and cook 10 more minutes. Add potatoes and add more water to cover.
Cover and cook 10 additional minutes.
Add milk.
Simmer until potatoes are tender. Season to taste with salt, pepper and cayenne.
Serve hot.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Leicester Kid'S Place Pancakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together, then add vegetable oil, egg and milk.
Mix all together.
May add more milk to desired thickness. Makes 6 to 8 medium size pancakes.

recipes.title: Lemon Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Heat all ingredients to boiling in 3-quart pan.
Reduce heat; simmer uncovered.
Stir occasionally for 10 minutes.
Serve hot over your favorite cooked meats or baste whatever you like to grill.
Can be used on all meats and seafood.
Cover and store in refrigerator for up to 1 week.
For longer storage, remove lemon slices and store in fridge up to 1 month.
Makes 6 cups.

recipes.title: Lemon Broiled Scallops
instructions: Preheat broiler.
Place scallops in a shallow baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients.
Baste scallops with one-half of this mixture.
Broil 3 inches from heat for 5 minutes.
Turn scallops and baste with remaining sauce.
Broil 5 minutes more. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Lemon Caper Chicken
instructions: Combine flour, paprika and pepper on a plate.
Press chicken into mixture, coating evenly and then shake off excess.
In a heavy 10-inch skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat for 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook for 3 minutes on each side.
Do not overcook.
Place on heated platter.
Add chicken broth to skillet, scraping up any browned bits on the bottom. Stir in the lemon juice and capers and heat through.
Pour sauce over chicken breasts and serve.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Combine flour, salt and paprika in paper or plastic bag.
Brush chicken with lemon juice.
Add 2 or 3 pieces of chicken at a time to bag and shake well to coat chicken with flour mixture.
In 12-inch skillet, brown the chicken slowly in hot shortening. Dissolve bouillon granules in the boiling water.
Stir in green onion, brown sugar, lemon peel and any remaining lemon juice.
Pour over chicken.
Cover; reduce heat and cook over low heat for 40 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.
Sprinkle with snipped parsley, if desired.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken For The Grill
instructions: Place chicken in a large mixing bowl.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
Marinate overnight in refrigerator.
Cook chicken over medium heat on outdoor grill for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Baste with marinade every 15 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Lemon Cream Cooler
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients; mix well.
Add lemonade concentrate; chill until thick and syrupy.
Gently fold in whipped cream.
Pour into individual serving cups and chill until firm.
Garnish, if desired, with fresh mint leaves or fruit.
Serves 8.
Can be made a day ahead.

recipes.title: Lemon Crisps
instructions: Form cookies with cookie press.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Yields 7 dozen.

recipes.title: Lemon Dill Fish
instructions: Stir Miracle Whip, lemon juice, grated peel and dill weed together.
Place fish on greased grill or rack of broiler pan. Brush with half of the sauce. Grill or broil 5 to 8 minutes.
Turn and brush with remaining sauce.
Continue to grill or broil another 5 to 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Lemon Green Beans
instructions: Wash beans and remove strings.
Cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces if desired.
Cook, covered, for 12 to 15 minutes in small amount of water.
Drain and set aside, but keep warm.
Saute onion in butter until tender.
Stir in lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Add beans and cook 1 minute or until thoroughly heated, stirring constantly. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Lemon Pecan Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour, soda and salt in a bowl.
Add butter, sugar, egg and lemon rind.
Beat until smooth (about 2 minutes). Fold in pecans and rolled oats.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Lemon Sauce
instructions: Mix cornstarch, sugar and salt in a saucepan.
Blend with 1/4 cup water until smooth.
Then add remaining water.
Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture boils.
Remove from heat, add remaining ingredients.
Makes 1 1/3 cups of sauce.
Serve on plain sheet cake or spice or etc.

recipes.title: Lemon Sorbet
instructions: Combine boiling water and sugar, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Let cool.
Add lemon rind and juice.
Pour mixture into a 9-inch square pan; freeze until firm.
To serve, let mixture stand at room temperature 10 minutes.
Yields 4 cups.

recipes.title: Lemon Sponge Pie
instructions: Combine sugar, flour, melted butter, salt and egg yolks.
Beat until smooth.
Beat in lemon juice and peel.
Add milk, beating slowly.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Fold in.
Bake pie shell in a 350° oven for 5 minutes.
Pour in filling.
Bake 40 minutes at 350° or until filling is firm.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Lemon Sponge Pudding
instructions: Mix sugar, flour and salt.
Add butter, juice, lemon peel and egg yolks, then scalded milk.
Fold in egg whites.
Set in a 1 1/2-quart buttered pan in hot water.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Lemon-Baked Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in casserole dish.
Combine oil, lemon juice, oregano or tarragon and garlic powder and brush on chicken.
Cover and bake in 350° oven for 35 minutes.
Remove cover.
Brush again with oil-lemon mixture.
Continue baking, uncovered, 20 minutes longer or until tender.
Sprinkle with parsley and paprika before serving.
Contains 225 calories per serving.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Lemon-Butter Sauce
instructions: In small saucepan, over medium heat, melt margarine.
Add lemon peel, lemon juice and cornstarch.
Stir to blend.
Slowly add half and half, stirring constantly.
Add cornstarch and simmer until thickened.
Makes approximately 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Lemon-Grape Shimmer
instructions: In a 2-quart non-metal pitcher, mix together all ingredients. Serve over ice in tall glasses.
Makes 7 (1-cup) servings.

recipes.title: Lemon-Orange Butter
instructions: Mix all ingredients in small bowl.
Cover and chill if not ready to use.
Let butter soften before serving.
Makes 1/4 cup.

recipes.title: Lemonade Syrup For Homemade Lemonade
instructions: Combine sugar and water in saucepan.
Bring to boil and boil for 5 minutes.
Cool and add lemon juice.
Strain the syrup to remove unwanted pulp and seeds.
Store in covered glass jar in refrigerator.
When ready to serve, add 2 Tbsp. of syrup to 1 glass of cold water, stir to mix, add ice and enjoy.
Makes 2 1/2 cups of syrup.
Will keep in refrigerator for 3 to 4 weeks.

recipes.title: Lemony Lemonade Syrup Base
instructions: In covered jar, combine lemon peel, sugar and boiling water; cover and shake until sugar dissolves.
Add lemon juice, store tightly covered in refrigerator until ready to use.
Makes 2 2/3 cups syrup base, enough for 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Lentil Burgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and chill.
Form into 8 patties. Grill or fry in olive oil.
Serve on hamburger rolls spread with butter or ghee.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Light And Easy Biscuits
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients.
Use pastry blender to blend in Crisco.
Add milk.
Mix well.
Roll on floured board about 1/2-inch thick.
Cut out and bake at 350° until lightly browned. Makes 10 to 12, according to cutter size.

recipes.title: Light Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water.
Add other ingredients.
Knead. Roll, cut and place in greased dish.
Rise until doubled.
Bake at 375° until done.
Makes 20 rolls.

recipes.title: Likker Pudding(Very Good With Turkey And Pork)
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°.
Pour milk in a quart casserole.
Grate coarsely sweet potatoes and put them into the milk as you grate. This will prevent them from turning dark.
Beat eggs well, adding sugar gradually.
Add cinnamon and almonds.
Mix thoroughly with the sweet potatoes.
Dot generously with butter.
Bake in a 300° oven about 1 1/2 hours or until the potatoes are cooked and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and pour bourbon over the top of the sweet potatoes.
This freezes well.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Lillian Hellman'S Pot Roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients in a good pot in order given.
Cover and bake about 3 1/2 hours.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Linda'S Goulash(Quick 'N Easy)
instructions: Cook meat and onions in a large frying pan (drain if necessary).
Add tomato soup.
Pull tomatoes into small pieces and add with juice to pan.
Add macaroni and pepper; simmer 15 minutes.
Add pork and beans; simmer an additional 15 minutes. After beans are added, mixture will thicken.
Serves about 6.

recipes.title: Linguine With Sweet Pepper Sauce
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet.
Add the peppers, onions, shallots, garlic and basil or oregano.
Cook on medium-low until vegetables are soft and wilted, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the vinegar and honey.
Toss 1/4 of the pepper sauce with the linguine.
Divide the linguine between 4 plates.
Top each serving with the remaining sauce.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Liz'S Tuna Casserole
instructions: Saute onion, celery and green pepper.
Cook noodles.
Heat soup and milk.
Add cheese.
Stir until cheese melts and add to rest of casserole.
Bake at 425° for about 20 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Sliced Potato Casserole
instructions: Place all ingredients, except parsley, in a covered casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until tender.
Sprinkle with parsley flakes.
Makes 6 servings.
One serving equals 75 calories.

recipes.title: Louisiana Pralines
instructions: Combine powdered sugar and cream and boil to soft ball stage, 236°.
Then beat until mixture begins to sugar.
Add nuts and drop on greased waxed paper into 2-inch patties.
Wrap individually in plastic wrap.
Makes about 24.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Cupcakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Coat a muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray.
Mix first eight ingredients in a large bowl.
In a two-cup measure, mix milk, applesauce and egg.
Combine liquid and dry ingredients, mixing just to combine.
Batter will be lumpy.
Fill muffin cups three-quarters full.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Yield: 10 muffins.

recipes.title: Luau Beans
instructions: Cook pepper, onion and garlic in butter until tender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Heat.
Stir.
Makes 2 to 3 servings.

recipes.title: Lunch Box Peanut Oatmeal Candies
instructions: In a medium saucepan, over low heat, melt butter or margarine. In a small bowl, stir together sugar and cocoa.
Add to melted butter or margarine in saucepan; stir to blend.
Stir in milk. Bring mixture to a full boil.
Let boil 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and add vanilla and peanut butter, stirring until mixture is smooth.
Stir in oats.
Beat with a wooden spoon until mixture begins to harden, about 10 minutes.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.
Let cool completely.
Wrap and pack for lunch.
Be sure to beat for 10 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Macadamia Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg and vanilla; mix well.
Sift flour, baking soda and salt together; add to creamed mixture and mix thoroughly.
Add chopped nuts.
Drop by teaspoon 1 1/2 inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for about 12 to 15 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Tomatoes
instructions: Saute onions and celery in margarine just until tender.
Add tomatoes and sauce and all seasonings.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Add macaroni.
Simmer another 10 to 15 minutes.
Mixture should be fairly thick.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Macaroni Pizza
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain.
Beat together milk, 1 teaspoon Parmesan cheese and salt.
Blend into macaroni and spread into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add bits of raw hamburger.
Sprinkle green pepper, onions and mushrooms.
Top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Magic Brew
instructions: Combine juices, lemonade, cherries and orange slices.
Mix well; chill.
Just before serving, add sherbet and ginger ale. Serve over ice cubes.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Make-Ahead Breakfast
instructions: Crumble sausage in a medium skillet; cook over medium heat until browned, stirring occasionally.
Drain well.
Spread bread crumbs in a buttered 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish; top with sausage and cheese.
Combine eggs, milk and seasonings; beat well and pour over cheese.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until set.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Mama Gay'S Eagle Brand Milk
instructions: Combine boiling water and margarine and put in blender; process on low speed.
Add sugar and blend on low; add dry milk and blend until well mixed.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes 1 1/2 cups, which tastes the same as commercial Eagle Brand milk.

recipes.title: Mama Mary'S Potato Rolls
instructions: Combine milk, sugar, margarine, salt and pepper in a small bowl. Cool to lukewarm.
In a large bowl, sprinkle yeast over warm water; set aside 5 minutes.
With whisk, beat milk mixture into mashed potato until smooth. Stir in 1 1/2 cups flour until smooth. Add additional flour to make a soft dough.
Turn dough onto a lightly floured board.
Knead about 10 minutes or until smooth and elastic. Add more flour as needed.
Place dough in greased bowl. Turn to expose greased portion. Cover with towel. Set aside in warm place, about 1 hour or until doubled.
Grease muffin tin. Punch down dough; divide into 12 pieces.
Shape into 2-inch balls. Cut into quarters, cutting almost through to bottom of rolls. Place each cut roll into muffin tin.
Cover and set aside in warm place to rise, 45 minutes until doubled.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes in preheated oven.
Makes 12 rolls.

recipes.title: Mama'S Cornmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar.
Add egg and beat well.
Add rest of ingredients and mix well.
Drop by teaspoon on greased sheet. Bake in 350° oven about 15 minutes or until lightly brown on top. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Mama'S Garlic Fried Chicken
instructions: Wipe chicken with damp cloth.
Place in large bowl.
Mix remaining ingredients, except flour; pour over chicken, covering all pieces well.
Cover bowl tightly, refrigerate overnight. Drain, dredge with flour.
Fry until done.
Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Mamma'S Cooked Salad Dressing
instructions: Cook first 7 ingredients and add margarine.
Shake in some pepper and celery seed.
This makes 1 quart and will keep a long time.

recipes.title: Mamma'S Peach Pickle Recipe
instructions: Prepare fruit; let stand in lightly salted water while syrup is cooking.

Boil vinegar, sugar and spices together (spices in a loosely tied cotton bag) until mixture becomes a thick syrup. Drain salt water from peaches; add to syrup, cooking very fast until syrup covers peaches.

The syrup will not at first cover peaches, but after cooking a while, the juice comes out of the peaches and makes more syrup and also thins the first thick syrup. Keep peaches pressed down in syrup occasionally with a wooden spoon.
When done, place in hot jars and seal.
Makes about 3 to 4 jars (quarts).

recipes.title: Man-Style Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients together in large bowl.
Pack into greased loaf pan.
Bake, uncovered, in 375° oven 50 to 60 minutes or until crisp on top.
Let cool 15 to 20 minutes before slicing.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Fluff
instructions: Drain juice from oranges.
Add water to make 2 cups liquid. Add sugar.
Bring to a boil.
Add and dissolve jello.
Cool and allow to partially set.
Whip the whipping cream.
Whip jello until fluffy.
Beat in sherbet.
Fold in whipped cream.
Add oranges.
Turn into mold and refrigerate.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Mandarin Shrimp Dip
instructions: Heat curry powder and butter on medium for 1 minute.

Turn stove element to low and stir in flour, instant minced onion, dried parsley, garlic salt, sugar and instant liquid chicken broth (dissolve instant chicken broth in 1 cup hot water before adding to pot).
Cook, stirring constantly, until bubbly, then boil (the gentle, rolling kind) for 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Stir in lemon juice, mandarin oranges and shrimp.
Serves 10 to 12 people.

recipes.title: Mandie'S Eggs Ole
instructions: Beat eggs in bowl.
Add flour, baking powder, cottage cheese, butter, chilies and shredded cheese; mix well.
Spoon into buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Maple Chicken
instructions: In a large saucepan put chicken and all other ingredients except the rice.
Cover.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add rice.
Cook for 20 minutes or until rice is done. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Maple Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly with sugar.
Add vanilla and salt.
Mix well.
Pour in syrup and melted butter.
Blend thoroughly.
Spread coconut in 9-inch pie shell (unbaked).
Bake at 425° for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350°.
Bake until pie puffs in the middle and a silver knife inserted in the center comes out clean.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Marci'S Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook yams and sweet potatoes until tender when poked with fork; drain.
Partially cool and peel, removing any discolored portions.
Mash; add softened margarine and brown sugar while still warm.
Place in bowl, using electric mixer or blender until nice and smooth.
Grease large casserole dish.
Place half mixture in dish, placing part of marshmallows on top.
Add remainder of mixture and smooth top.
Place in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until nice and hot.
Poke remaining marshmallows uniformly on top. Return to oven just until marshmallows are lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Marinated Chicken Breasts
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a deep plastic bowl with a lid.
Pour pineapple juice over the chicken breasts.
Add chopped garlic and 1/2 bottle of soy sauce.
Refrigerate for 24 hours.
Delicious when grilled!
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Marinated Green Bean Salad
instructions: Beat oil, vinegar, sugar and pepper together with a fork. Toss beans, onion rings and dressing together.
Cover tightly and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Marinated Green Olive Salad(Insalata Di Olvia Verdi)
instructions: Place olive on cutting board
and
lay a spatula on top of each olive.
Smash down to crack skin.
Put olives, carrots and celery in a large bowl
with lid.
Combine the rest of the ingredients and pour mixture on top of olives.
Cover container and toss occasionally.
Serve
after
24 hours.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
Store in refrigerator but serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Marinated Slaw Pressley
instructions: Shred cabbage.
Grate onion and pepper on top.
Top with sugar.
Bring to a boil the salad oil, vinegar, dry mustard, celery seed and salt.
Pour mixture over cabbage.
Let sit overnight.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Marinated Sliced Tomato Salad
instructions: Peel and slice 4 large tomatoes.
Arrange in a shallow dish. Combine salad oil, lemon juice, minced garlic salt and oregano. Pour over tomatoes.
Chill covered for 1 hour.
Must do ahead of time.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Banana Pudding
instructions: Soak gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water for 5 minutes.
Add 1/4 cup boiling water; stir until dissolved.
Cool, stirring occasionally, until congealing starts.
Add egg whites; beat until very light. Add bananas; stir lightly.
Chill until set.
Serve with whipped cream.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Marshy Muffins
instructions: Mix together as normal muffins, except mash 1/2 cup blueberries and add to ingredients.
Add the rest of blueberries by hand and mix in.
Sprinkle muffins with granulated sugar before baking.
Pour into greased muffin cups and bake in 375° oven for 30 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Mary'S Meatless Lasagna
instructions: Rinse the cooked noodles in cold water.
Set aside.
Saute the onions and garlic in skillet sprayed with Pam.
Stir in the tomato spices, parsley and salt.
Cook sauce about 1/2 hour, simmering and stirring often until thickened.
Stir in sauteed mushrooms and cooked beans.
To assemble lasagna, place a layer of noodles on the bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Spread 1/2 of tomato mix over noodles, then layer cheeses.
Repeat 2 times and end with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Makes 15 servings.

recipes.title: Mary'S Rice
instructions: Mix all together and bake covered in large roaster for 20 to 30 minutes.
Yield:
9 cups of rice.
Serves 20.

recipes.title: Maureen'S Pork Chops 'N Stuffing
instructions: Brown chops on both sides.
Place into shallow baking dish. (Sometimes I do mine in electric skillet.)
Lightly mix together bread cubes, onion, butter, 1/4 cup water and poultry seasoning. Place a mound of stuffing on each chop.
Blend soup and 1/3 cup water.
Pour over chops.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour or until tender.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Maureen'S Weight Watcher Chili
instructions: In a saucepan, cook turkey and onion until brown.
Drain off any fat.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer approximately 35 minutes.
Serves 4 people.

recipes.title: Maurice Salad
instructions: Put lettuce in a salad bowl and then add ham, turkey or chicken and the cheese.
Mix together the remaining ingredients and pour over the salad.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Maxwell'S Spinach Salad

ingredients.notes: fried crisp and broken into bite sizes

instructions: Arrange spinach in a large bowl.
Top with remaining ingredients.
Serve accompanied by Maxwell's Spinach Salad Dressing.
Serves 1 large salad.

recipes.title: Meat And Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine meat or tuna fish, celery, macaroni, salt, pepper and chopped, cooked eggs.
Add salad dressing and mix well.
Cover and refrigerate a few hours before serving.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf On A Stick
instructions: Crush the cornflakes and then mix in a large bowl with the other ingredients.
Wrap a small quantity of the mixture around the end of a stick, making it long instead of into a round ball.
Wrap foil around the meat and part of the stick to prevent the meat from falling into the coals.
Place it over a bed of coals, turning it slowly to cook it evenly.
Makes about 7 drumsticks.
Serves 3 to 4.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf Parmesan
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs and milk.
Add meat, egg, Worcestershire sauce, salt, cheese, green pepper, onion and garlic salt.
Mix thoroughly.
Pack into 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake in a slow oven (325°) for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf Supreme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients. In large baking pan, shape into loaf.
Bake 1 hour or until done. Makes about 8 servings.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf With Cheese
instructions: Combine meat with next	8
ingredients.
Place	half of this mixture in a loaf pan.
Cover with half of cheese and top with half of the
parsley.
Repeat
with
the
remaining meat, cheese and parsley.
Bake at 350°	for
1	hour or until done. Sprinkle with paprika and let stand 10 minutes before slicing. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Meat Smoke Seasoning
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and store in airtight container. Rub a small amount of mixture over entire outer surface of brisket, turkey, etc., before smoking in standard or water smoker.
One tablespoon is plenty for average size Thanksgiving turkey.
Makes about 1 pound of seasoning.

recipes.title: Meatball Minestrone Soup
instructions: In mixing bowl, combine meat, egg, onions, crumbs, salt and pepper.
Shape into 30 one-inch balls.
In a large saucepan, brown meatballs on all sides.
Drain excess fat.
Add remaining ingredients, except macaroni and parsley.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Add macaroni; simmer for 10 minutes or until tender. Stir in parsley.
Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Meatballs And Gravy
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients lightly but thoroughly.
Shape in 2-inch balls and roll in flour.
Brown on all sides in margarine. Add 1 1/2 cups bouillon and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil, cover and simmer 1/2 hour.
Mix 1/4 cup flour with remaining bouillon until smooth.
Stir into mixture and cook, stirring gently until thickened.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Meatballs In Cocktail Sauce
instructions: Shape meatballs into 1 inch balls.
Place on a jelly roll pan. Bake in preheated oven at 400° for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, in large saucepan, combine brown sugar, cornstarch, basil and salt; stir in remaining ingredients.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened.
Add meatballs.
Remove from heat, pour into storage container; cool.
Cover and refrigerate.
Just before serving, heat meatballs about 10 minutes in sauce.
Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Meatless Chili
instructions: In a 5-quart saucepot, heat oil over medium heat.
Add next 6 ingredients.
Cook, stirring 5 minutes, or until onion is tender. Add zucchini and carrots.
Cook, stirring for 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 30 to 35 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
Freezes well.

recipes.title: Meatless Chili(Diet)
instructions: Spray pot with cooking spray.
Place over medium heat until hot.
Add onion and garlic; saute 5 minutes.
Add water and next 7 ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, 30 minutes.
Serve with some sour cream on top.
Serves 5 to 6.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Scallops
instructions: Cut pepper in julienne strips. In hot oil, cook garlic briefly.
Add pepper, tomatoes, olives, capers and thyme.
Cook 5 minutes.
Melt butter; add scallops and cook about 3 minutes. Sprinkle lemon juice and basil over and stir briefly.
Spoon tomato mixture on heated plates with scallops over mixture.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Meemee'S Maple Peanut Butter Yummies
instructions: Sift flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Cream the shortening and peanut butter together.
Add brown sugar; cream well.
Add maple syrup and egg yolk; beat well.
Blend in dry ingredients gradually.
Mix thoroughly.
Shape dough into balls.
Place on ungreased pan and flatten with fork.
Bake in a 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Melted Onion Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes.
Place them in the middle of 16-inch square of aluminum foil.
Dice onion and put over potatoes.
Cover with butter.
Fold foil over top and sides.
Carefully seal all openings and bake at 450° for 45 minutes or until potatoes are golden brown.
Top with sprinkling of Parmesan cheese or garnish with parsley if desired.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Memorial House Chicken

ingredients.notes: drained and chopped or 1 c. celery

instructions: Combine soups with mayonnaise. Add onion, water chestnuts or celery and chicken.
If very thick, add 1/4 to 1/2 cup chicken broth. Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes. About 10 minutes before it is done, spread bread cubes over mixture and then sprinkle cheese on top. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Meringues
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Beat egg whites with salt until stiff, then beat in sugar gradually.
Add vanilla.
Remove from beater and add chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet.
Place in oven and turn off heat.
Leave in oven overnight (do not peak!).
Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Mexi-Chile Dip
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl.
Combine remaining ingredients and add to vegetable mixture.
Chill at least 2 hours before serving.
Serve with corn chips.
Makes 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Mexican Beef Skillet
instructions: Prepare macaroni as on package; drain.
In large skillet, combine green pepper, garlic and beef; cook until beef is brown and vegetables tender.
Drain.
Stir in tomatoes, sauce, corn, olives and salt.
Add macaroni; mix well.
Stir in cheese.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken Wings
instructions: Heat oven to 425°.
Separate chicken wings at joints; discard tips.
Mix baking mix, cornmeal, chili powder, salt and pepper. Dip chicken into buttermilk; coat with cornmeal mixture.
Arrange close together in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch rectangular pan. Drizzle with margarine.
Bake, uncovered, for 35 to 40 minutes or until light brown and crisp.
Makes 20 chicken wings.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn And Zucchini
instructions: Cut corn from cobs.
Cook and stir onion and garlic in margarine in 10-inch skillet until onion is tender.
Stir in corn and remaining ingredients.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat, cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Mexican Hot Chocolate
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine 1 cup milk, sugar, chocolate and cinnamon.
Cook and stir over medium-low heat until chocolate is melted. Gradually stir in remaining milk. Cook and stir until milk is very hot, almost boiling, but do not boil.
Gradually stir 1 cup of hot mix into eggs, then return all to saucepan. Cook and stir for 2 minutes over low heat.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Beat with beater until frothy.
Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream.
Makes 6 (8 ounce) servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Meat Loaf Pie
instructions: In large bowl, mix ground beef, egg, bread crumbs, Worcestershire sauce and 1/2 of the salsa.
When thoroughly mixed together, press into 10-inch ungreased pie pan.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 40 minutes.
Remove from oven, leaving oven on. Drain excess grease.
Sprinkle cheese over top of pie and return to oven for 5 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.
Serve by cutting in pie wedges and spooning remaining salsa over top. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl.
Mix well to combine all flavors.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad Bowl
instructions: Mix the first 7 ingredients.
Cover; chill.
Drain and combine corn, beans and olives; spoon into lettuce lined bowl.
Serve with dressing.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Salsa Salad
instructions: Combine macaroni, salsa, vinegar, cumin and chili powder. Stir in red beans, cheese and olives.
Cover and refrigerate 1 hour.
Toss before serving.
Makes 4 servings.
Each serving counts 1/2 fat, 1 1/2 pro., 1/2 vegetable and 1 bread.

recipes.title: Mexican Skillet Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar, butter, cinnamon, salt and milk in an electric skillet.
Set thermostat at 280°.
Bring to boil.
Boil 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Turn off skillet.
Add marshmallows, chocolate chips, pecans and vanilla.
Stir until marshmallows and chocolate chips are melted and smoothly blended.
Pour into an 8 x 8-inch square buttered dish.
Cool before cutting into squares. Yields 2 pounds.

recipes.title: Mexican-Style Beans
instructions: Soak beans in cold water overnight.
Drain and cook them, covered, with the diced onions, in about 6 cups of fresh cold water.
Simmer slowly for about 2 hours.
Add butter or bacon drippings and salt.
Simmer one more hour, but remove from heat when they are soft.
More salt may be added, and the bean broth should be thick.
Serve hot.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Microwave Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium glass bowl.
Cook at High for 5 minutes and at Medium-low for 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir occasionally.
Sauce should be slightly thickened.
Use as basting sauce on chicken, ribs, hamburgers, etc.
Yields 2 cups.

recipes.title: Microwave Broccoli Chowder
instructions: In 2-quart microwave bowl, combine broccoli, onion and water. Cook, covered, on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until veggies are tender.
Stir twice, breaking broccoli.
Stir in soup, milk, cheese and pepper.
Cook, uncovered, on High for 7 to 9 minutes, until well heated, stirring twice.
Top each serving with chopped peanuts.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Microwave Chili
instructions: Crumble ground beef in a 2-quart glass casserole.
Stir in onion and green pepper.
Cover.
Microwave 6 to 8 minutes on High or until beef is browned.
Drain and stir in remaining ingredients.
Re-cover and microwave 20 to 25 minutes on medium or until hot. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Yields 5 to 7 servings.

recipes.title: Microwave Family Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine sugar, tomato sauce and mustard.
Set aside.
Combine beef, onion, cracker crumbs, eggs, salt and pepper.
Add 1/2 cup of the tomato sauce mixture and stir until mixed good.
Place mixture in 8 cup micro-proof mold ring.
Pour rest of tomato sauce over meat.
Cook on High 18 to 20 minutes or until done.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Microwave French Onion Soup

ingredients.notes: thinly sliced and separated into rings (1 1/2 c.)

instructions: In a 3-quart casserole combine onion and butter or margarine. Cook, covered, on High (100%) for 8 to 11 minutes or until onions are tender, stirring after half the cooking time.
Stir in beef broth and hot water.
Cover, cook on High (100%) for 4 to 6 minutes or until heated through, stirring once.
Ladle soup into 4 large individual bowls or casseroles.
Top with bread slices. Sprinkle evenly with cheeses.
Cook on Medium-high (70%) for 3 to 5 minutes, or until cheese melts, rearranging bowls once or twice. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Microwave Glazed Carrots
instructions: Cut carrots into long, thin strips.
Set aside.
Combine brown sugar, margarine, water, salt and cinnamon in a 1-quart casserole dish.
Microwave at High until margarine is melted (1 1/2 minutes). Stir to blend.
Stir in carrots until coated.
Cover.
Microwave at High until carrots are tender (8 minutes), stirring once.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Microwave Islander Chicken
instructions: Cut
larger pieces of chicken in half for uniform size. Arrange, skin side up, in 2 quart baking dish.
Combine juice, cornstarch, salt, cinnamon and lime juice.
Pour over chicken. Cook,
covered
with wax paper, 28 minutes or until chicken is done,
spooning sauce over chicken during last half of cooking time.
Add bananas and nuts.
Cook, uncovered, 1 minute and 30 seconds.
Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Microwave Mexican Bean Dip
instructions: Place sausage in a large glass bowl.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Stir several times.
Add beans, cheese, peppers, pimento, parsley and remaining seasonings.
Mix well.
Microwave on Medium-high for 8 minutes.
Stir after 4 minutes.
Serve with corn chips.
Dip may be frozen.
Makes 16 servings.

recipes.title: Microwave Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions.
Drain and set aside.
Combine ground beef, green pepper and onion in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch casserole, cover tightly with heavy-duty plastic wrap. Fold back a corner of wrap to allow steam to escape.
Microwave at High 5 minutes or until done, stirring at 2 minute intervals; drain.
Add noodles, pizza sauce and next 4 ingredients, mixing well.
Cover and microwave at High 17 to 19 minutes, stirring at 6 minute intervals.
Sprinkle with cheese; cover and let stand 5 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Microwave Pumpkin Cups
instructions: Mix all together with rotary beater.
Pour into custard cups. Microwave on High until pumpkin starts to bubble.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Microwave Salmon Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine soup, salmon liquid and cheese in a microwave-safe casserole.
Stir well.
Cover and microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir at 1 minute.
Add salmon, broccoli and rice.
Cover and microwave on High for 8 minutes.
Stir at 2 minutes and at 6 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Microwave Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In large bowl, gradually stir soup into milk.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Cover tightly and microwave on High 10 minutes.
Stir; cover and microwave on High 10 to 15 minutes.
Let set 10 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Microwave Sunday Glazed Carrots
instructions: Wash and cut carrots into 1/2-inch diagonal slices.
Place in 1-quart casserole with butter and brown sugar.
Cover and microwave on High for 9 to 11 minutes, stirring after 5 minutes. Mix water and cornstarch until smooth.
Stir into carrot mixture. Add pecans. Cover and microwave on High for 2 to 4 minutes, until thickened. Stir before serving.
Makes 3 to 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mildred Lovett'S Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix the first 9 ingredients, plus mushrooms; put in a 9 x 13-inch greased casserole dish.
Top with corn flakes or potato chips, nuts and butter.
Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.
Serves 15.

recipes.title: Millionaire Pies
instructions: Cream sugar and cream cheese.
Add pineapple, Cool Whip and nuts.
Pour into pie shells and refrigerate until chilled.
Makes 3 pies.

recipes.title: Mini Carrot Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place 1/3 of potatoes and carrots into an 8-inch casserole.
Sprinkle with 1/3 of cheese and nutmeg, pepper to taste.
Alternate for 2 more layers in the same fashion.
Bring broth to a boil.
Pour over vegetables.
Bake casserole for 45 minutes or until top is brown.
If vegetables begin to dry out, add more broth.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Minute Meat Loaves(295 Calories Per Serving)
instructions: About 30 minutes before serving:
Preheat oven to 400°. Combine all ingredients, but olives.
Spoon mixture into 12 ungreased 3-inch cupcake cups.
Lightly press to shape.
Top each with olive half.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until well done.
Makes 12 individual loaves or 6 servings.

recipes.title: Miracle Cookie(No Flour Required)
instructions: Combine peanut butter and sugar; mix thoroughly.
Add beaten egg and vanilla; mix well.
(Optional:
stir in chopped pecans.) Roll into 3/4-inch balls; flatten with floured fork on greased cookie sheet, 1 1/2-inches apart.
Bake at 350° about 10 to 13 minutes.
Allow to cool on cookie sheet before removing.
Yields about 4 dozen.
Keeps well in airtight container.

recipes.title: Mississippi Potatoes
instructions: Toss potatoes with mayo, salt, pepper, diced cheese and onion. Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with crumbled bacon.
Bake at 325° uncovered for 1 hour.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
Can be made ahead and frozen.

recipes.title: Mitzi'S Special Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles as directed.
Melt margarine over low heat.
Add bread crumbs.
Drain noodles.
Add to browned bread crumbs, stirring constantly until all noodles are coated.
Remove from heat.
Cover.
Let stand several minutes, then serve.
Serves 3.

recipes.title: Mix Ahead Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni, drain and add remaining ingredients to macaroni; mix well.
Spoon into lightly greased 3-quart baking dish.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or several hours.
Remove from refrigerator and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Mixed Peas And Rice
instructions: Cook rice according to package.
In a pot, combine peas and rice.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Soup
instructions: Combine broth, potato and carrots in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil and simmer 30 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cook 5 minutes or until cabbage is crisp/tender.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mock Guacamole
instructions: Position knife blade in food processor bowl.
Add asparagus. Process until smooth.
Transfer to a mixing bowl.
Stir in tomato and remaining.
Place mixture in a paper towel-lined wire-mesh strainer or colander and let drain 1 hour.
Cover and chill at least 3 hours.
Yields 2 cups.

recipes.title: Moist 'N Crispy Chicken
instructions: Put cereal, paprika, salt and pepper in a large plastic bag and shake to blend well. Brush chicken on both sides with mayonnaise and put 1 piece of chicken at a time in bag; shake to coat well.
Place on rack in broiler pan and bake at 425° for 10 to 45 minutes or until golden brown and tender. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Moist Cornbread Muffins
instructions: Beat sugar and eggs.
Add flour, baking powder, salt and soda. Add yogurt and melted butter.
Stir until batter is evenly moistened.
Makes 12 muffins.
Bake at 400° until tops are light brown, 18 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Molded Beet Aspic
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water.
Mix in all ingredients, except beets and celery.
Chill until partially set.
Add vegetables; chill until firm.
Serves 6 (makes 1 quart).

recipes.title: Molded Chicken Salad
instructions: Prepare the Jell-O with water, including the vinegar and onion salt.
Cool.
Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice and sour cream.
Pour Jell-O mixture slowly into mayonnaise mix.
Chill until it begins to set, then add remaining ingredients.
Refrigerate in 7 3/4 x 12-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Molded Tuna Salad
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over cold water.
Drain and flake tuna. Dissolve bouillon cube in hot water; stir in softened gelatin. Add salt and cool.
Mix lemon juice, mayonnaise, tuna, celery, cucumber and pimento and add to gelatin mixture.
Pour into mold and chill until firm.
Makes 6 deliciously cool salads.

recipes.title: Mom'S Biscuits
instructions: Combine flours, sugar and baking powder in bowl. Cut in margarine. Add milk and stir lightly. Knead 10 times.
Shape into balls or roll out and cut.
Use greased pan.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

recipes.title: Mom'S Italian Zucchini
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Slice zucchini thinly.
Place a layer of zucchini in a shallow baking dish.
Cover with 1/3 of the onion, 1/3 of the cheese, sprinkle with salt and oregano.
Make 3 layers.
Pour tomato sauce over the vegetables.
Bake 45 minutes, covered with foil.
Remove the foil; sprinkle with the Parmesan cheese and bake 10 minutes longer.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Mom'S Potato Pancakes
instructions: Shred potatoes.
Mix all ingredients well.
In skillet, heat 1/4-inch oil over medium heat.
Drop batter by 1/3 cup in hot oil. Flatten to form pancake.
Fry until golden brown on both sides; drain on paper towel.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Mom'S Prize Winning Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly.
Pack firmly into ungreased loaf pan (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inches).
Bake in a preheated oven (350°) for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting slices.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Monica'S Chili
instructions: Cook ground beef until brown.
Drain grease.
Add all ingredients and simmer approximately 3 hours.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mother'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix well.
Shape into loaf pan and top with catsup or chili sauce.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Muggsy'S Favorite Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine eggs, oil, sugar & vanilla.
Beat together until thickens.
Add remaining ingredients.
Put into a greased and floured bread tin.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Mushroom Barley Soup
instructions: Over medium heat, saute onion in oil until soft. Add mushrooms; cook about 4 minutes until tender. Add remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low. Simmer, covered, about 1 hour or until barley is tender.
Remove bay leaf. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Mushroom London Broil
instructions: Cut both sides of steak into a diamond pattern 1/8-inch deep. Cook and stir onions and 1/4 teaspoon of salt in margarine until onions are tender.
Keep warm.
Mix remaining ingredients, except mushrooms.
Brush half of mixture on the steak.
Set oven to broil or 550°.
Broil beef with top 2 to 3 inches from heat until brown, about 5 minutes.
Turn meat over, brush on remaining mixture and top with mushrooms.
Broil 5 minutes longer.
Remove from oven and add onions.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mushroom-Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and drain; add butter.
Cover bottom of deep dish with buttered noodles.
Alternate layers of chicken, chopped onion, peas, asparagus and soup.
Add milk.
Cover with cracker crumbs; sprinkle with paprika.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Mushroom-Lemon Filets
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
Pam 12 x 8-inch or 8 x 8-inch baking dish. In large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons margarine or use Pam.
Saute the mushrooms and onions until tender.
Reduce heat to low.
Stir in flour, parsley, salt and pepper.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly until smooth and bubbly.
Gradually stir in the milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in lemon peel.
Place fish fillets or pan fish in baking dish.
Spoon sauce over fish.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until fish flakes with a fork.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Mustard Honey Bake Chicken
instructions: Stir together mustard and honey.
Dip chicken pieces in mustard mixture, then roll in crumbs.
Arrange on greased baking sheet. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 375°.
Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Mustard Pickles
instructions: Chop vegetables into 3/4-inch pieces.
Cook in 1 cup pickling salt with water to cover until tender.
Drain.
Using the same kettle in which vegetables were cooked, cook remaining ingredients until thickened.
Stir constantly.
Add drained vegetables and bring to a boil again.
Immediately put in hot jars and process accordingly.
Makes 5 quarts.

recipes.title: Mustard Vinaigrette
instructions: Place mustard in a small bowl.
Add vinegar, tarragon, salt and pepper; whisk well.
Slowly drizzle in the olive oil, whisking constantly, until dressing is creamy.
Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: My Favorite Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef, green pepper and onion until meat is browned.
Add next 11 ingredients and mix well.
