Then add noodles and stir well.
Pour into a large baking dish, cover and bake in a 350° oven for 50 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven for 10 minutes more.
Serves 14 to 16 people.

recipes.title: My Favorite Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese and paprika until well blended.
Place in a 2-quart casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.
Garnish with cheese and/or paprika during the last 10 minutes of baking time.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Natalya'S Chicken
instructions: Combine oregano, sage and basil thoroughly.
Wash and pat dry the chicken breasts.
Pat chicken breasts with combined spices on both sides.
Place in a glass casserole dish 2 to 3 inches deep. Squeeze 1/2 of fresh lemon on chicken.
Scatter over the chicken the carrots, celery, mushrooms, tomatoes and lemon slices.
Pour 1/3 cup of water over the vegetables and chicken.
Distribute butter over top of vegetables and cover tightly with casserole lid or aluminum foil.
Bake at 300° until vegetables are tender, about 1 hour.
Serve chicken with vegetables over buttered rice with spinach salad.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Native American Cranberry Sauce
instructions: Bring syrup, water and ginger to a boil in heavy 2 1/2-quart saucepan over medium heat.
Stir in cranberries.
Simmer until berries begin to pop, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Turn into bowl and let cool.
Refrigerate.
(Can be prepared 3 days ahead.)
Makes about 4 cups.

recipes.title: Neapolitan Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients in cooker.
Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or high for 3 to 4 hours.
Good with hot garlic bread. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Neapolitan Pork Chops
instructions: Heat oil in a large heavy skillet.
Add garlic and cook until lightly browned.
Season chops with salt and pepper.
Put chops in skillet and brown on both sides.
Add mushrooms, green pepper, sieved tomatoes and wine.
Cover and cook over low heat about 1 hour or until tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Never Fail Fluffy Biscuits
instructions: Sift together into a bowl:
flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and cream of tartar.
Add shortening.
Cut in with pastry blender until the mixture looks like coarse cornmeal.
Add milk all at once.
Stir just enough to make a soft dough.
Turn out onto a lightly floured board.
Knead lightly for 30 seconds.
Roll out to a thickness of 1/2-inch.
Cut with a floured 2-inch round cutter. Place on an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes about 16 biscuits.

recipes.title: Never Fail Oil Crust
instructions: Stir together with fork the flour, wheat germ and salt. Combine oil and water in separate container.
Stir oil and water mixture all at once into flour.
Stir until flour is all dampened. Divide into 2 balls.
Roll out each ball between 2 sheets of waxed paper until size for crust.
(To keep paper from shifting, dampen area where paper is placed.)
Bake shells in a 425° oven for 10 minutes.
Yields 2 large crusts.

recipes.title: Never Fail Yellow Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar until fluffy. Add one egg at a time, beating after each is added.
Mix in flour and milk.
Pour into greased cake pans and bake at 350° until sides leave pans. Makes 5 or 6 (12-inch) layers.

recipes.title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: In an 8-quart kettle over medium heat, cook bacon until lightly browned.
Add onions and fry until tender, about 10 minutes.
Gradually stir in flour until mixed well.
Add enough water to clam liquid to make 4 cups.
Slowly stir it into flour mixture.
Cook, stirring constantly, until slightly thickened. Dump in potatoes, pepper and garlic.
Cover and cook until potatoes are tender, 10 to 15 minutes.
Add clams, milk, cream and butter.
Simmer until thoroughly heated, about 5 minutes, stirring often.
Makes 14 cups.

recipes.title: New England Clam Chowder Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes, onion and celery in 1 1/2 cups water until tender.
Drain vegetables, saving 1 cup water.
In saucepan, melt 1/2 stick butter.
Add flour and stir until smooth.
Add 2 cups milk; stir until creamy.
Add 4 slices of cheese.
Stir until cheese is melted over medium heat.
Add vegetables to sauce; stir, then add clams.
Do not drain juice.
Pour clams and juice into sauce.
Add 1 cup water that you saved from vegetables, stirring constantly until mixture is blended to a smooth consistency. Serves 4.

recipes.title: New Mexico Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into lightly greased shallow pan (9-inch square or larger).
Bake, uncovered, at 400° for about 45 minutes or until firm.
Yield: 1 large loaf.

recipes.title: New Year'S Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Mix well.
Place in a greased casserole.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Nine-Day Cole Slaw
instructions: Stir together cabbage, onion, green pepper and 1 cup sugar. Bring to a boil salad oil, vinegar, celery seed, salt and 2 more tablespoons sugar.
Pour hot mixture over cabbage; toss well and chill overnight before serving.
Recipe makes about 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Ninth Street House Tea
instructions: Mix tea, sugar, grape juice and lemon juice together in a 1 gallon jug.
Finish filling jug with water.
Makes 1 gallon tea.

recipes.title: No Bake Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package.
Brown beef with onion in skillet.
Add tomato paste, sauce, mushrooms, garlic, basil, parsley, salt, pepper, oregano and water.
Simmer for 1 hour.
Let Mozzarella melt over sauce.
Serve like spaghetti.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: No Bake Oatmeal Turtle Cookies
instructions: Bring butter, sugar, evaporated milk and cocoa to a boil in a small, heavy saucepan.
Boil 1 minute, stirring and being careful not to allow mixture to burn.
Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter, vanilla and oats.
Work quickly and drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.
Let cool.
Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: No Crust Pizza
instructions: Drain mushrooms; reserve liquid.
Add water to equal 1/3 cup liquid.
Combine the liquid, egg, crumbs, oregano, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper; let stand 5 minutes.
Add beef; mix well. Pat beef mixture into 9-inch pie plate to form crust.
Cut cheese into 8 triangles; layer half atop beef mixture.
Top with pizza sauce, mushrooms, onions and green pepper.
Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese; bake 5 minutes.
Remove to serving platter, using 2 spatulas.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: No Fail Crust
instructions: Combine dry ingredients together.
Cut in the Crisco.
Add enough water (ice cold) to egg yolks to make 1 cup.
Pour over flour.
Makes 6 crusts.

recipes.title: No Sugar Cookies(Applesauce)
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients. Mix well.
Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet.
Bake.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: No-Bake Peanut Oatmeal Drops
instructions: Mix sugar, butter and evaporated milk in a saucepan.
Bring to a rolling boil; boil 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Remove from heat.
Stir in last 4 ingredients.
Drop by tablespoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Let stand until set.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: No-Cook Barbecue Sauce
instructions: In small bowl stir all ingredients until blended.
Brush on meats or poultry, turning frequently, during last 20 minutes of grilling.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: No-Fat Applesauce Bran Muffins
instructions: Stir together flour, sugar and baking powder.
Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cereal and milk.
Let stand about 5 minutes.
Add egg and applesauce.
Beat well.
Add flour mixture, stirring only until combined.
Put batter into muffin pans that have been coated with cooking spray.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Yield: 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Non-Butter Crust
instructions: Sift flour and salt together into mixing bowl.
Mix the oil with the cold milk, and pour all at once into the flour.
Stir lightly with a fork until blended, adding more liquid if necessary to make dough hold together.
Divide the dough into 2 portions. Refrigerate until ready to prepare pie.
Yields 1 (9-inch), 2 crust pie, 8 servings.

recipes.title: Nonfat Yogurt
instructions: Heat water and milk to 115°.
Stir in yogurt.
Preheat thermos with 115° water.
Pour water out and fill with yogurt.
Let set 4 hours or until starts to thicken.
Remove from thermos.
Put in cups and store in refrigerator.
Makes approximately 4 cups.

recipes.title: Noodle Rice Pilaf
instructions: In saucepan, over medium-high heat, saute vermicelli until browned, stirring constantly.
Stir in rice.
Stir in broth. Bring to boil.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover.
Simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender and broth is absorbed.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Not-So-Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions.
Add ketchup, garlic powder and mustard.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Spoon onto your hamburger buns. Serves.
Makes 4.

recipes.title: Nutty Muffins
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl.
Fill greased muffin pan cups 1/2 full with batter.
Bake in a preheated 300° oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 6.

recipes.title: Nutty Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine evaporated milk, margarine, sugar and Marshmallow Creme in a heavy saucepan (3-quart size).
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly.
After it comes to a boil, continue stirring for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Immediately add peanut butter chips and vanilla, stirring until chips are melted.
Add nuts. Pour into a buttered 7 x 11-inch pan.
Cool.
Makes about 3 pounds.

recipes.title: Nutty Waffle Cookies
instructions: In mixing bowl, beat margarine and brown sugar.
Beat until fluffy.
Add egg and milk.
Beat well.
Mix flour and baking powder; add to mixture.
Drop by rounded teaspoon on waffle iron. Cook same as waffles.
Cool on rack.
Frost, if desired.
Makes 20 to 24.

recipes.title: Nutty-Noodly Clusters
instructions: Melt chocolate and butterscotch chips in heavy pan over low heat, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and quickly stir in noodles and nuts so they are evenly coated.
Dip out by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Chill and refrigerate.
Yields about 24 clusters.

recipes.title: Oat & Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add beaten egg and mix well.
Sift flour, salt and baking powder into creamed mixture.
Add oats, raisins and sesame seeds.
Mix well.
Place by spoonfuls on cookie sheet.
Flatten slightly with back of spoon. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Let cool on cookie sheet slightly. Then move to rack.
Makes 10.

recipes.title: Oat-Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Mix oatmeal and buttermilk in a small covered bowl. Refrigerate overnight.
Add beaten egg and sifted dry ingredients in morning.
Mix all.
Add vegetable oil and more liquid if needed.
Bake on lightly greased griddle.
Makes about 12 pancakes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Banana Muffins
instructions: In a bowl, mix butter, eggs, bananas and honey.
Mix together yogurt and baking soda. Add to mixture and cream.
Add flour to creamed mixture and stir just until blended.
Stir in oatmeal. Fill muffin cup 2/3 full of filling. Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes.
Makes 18 muffins.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cinnamon Cookies
instructions: Mix together butter, sugar, eggs, molasses and vanilla.
In another bowl, mix flour, cinnamon and baking powder.
Add to butter/sugar mixture.
Add oats, raisins and chocolate chips. Bake at 350°
for 12 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cocoa Chippers
instructions: In small bowl, combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt; set aside.
In large bowl, combine margarine, brown sugar, sugar and vanilla; beat until creamy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Gradually beat in flour mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips, oatmeal and walnuts.
Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for approximately 10 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookie
instructions: Mix flour with baking soda.
Combine butter, sugar and pudding mix in a large bowl.
Beat until smooth and creamy.
Beat in eggs.
Gradually add flour mixture, then stir in oats and raisins. Batter will be stiff.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Jumbos
instructions: Pour enough boiling water over raisins to cover; let stand 10 minutes.
Drain.
Sift together flour, salt, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves into bowl.
Add shortening, sugar, egg and water.
Beat until smooth, about 2 minutes.
Stir in raisins and oatmeal.
Roll dough out on lightly floured board or canvas to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut with floured 3-inch round cutter.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Sprinkle with granulated sugar.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Pancakes
instructions: Beat all ingredients with hand mixer until smooth.
(For thinner pancakes, stir in 2 to 4 tablespoons additional milk.) Grease heated griddle with shortening.
(Pastry brush can be used for this.)
To check if griddle or pan is hot enough, sprinkle few drops of water.
If it bubbles and skittles around, it's ready. Use 1/4 cup batter for each pancake.
Cook until golden on both sides.
Makes 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Snacks
instructions: Beat egg; add other liquid ingredients.
Blend thoroughly. Add dry ingredients and mix well.
Stir in oats.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Waffles
instructions: In large mixing bowl, stir together flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt; set aside.
In small bowl, mix eggs, milk, butter and brown sugar together.
Add to flour mixture.
Stir to blend.
Pour batter onto preheated grids of greased waffle iron. (Amount of batter will vary with size of waffle iron.)
Close lid quickly.
Do not open during baking.
Use fork to remove baked waffle.
Top with fresh fruit, yogurt or syrup.
Yields 12 (4-inch) square waffles.

recipes.title: Octoberfest Sausage Brunch
instructions: Combine
eggs,	cream,	mustard,
salt and pepper until well blended.
Add
cheese,
sausage
and pepper.	Pour mixture into
8-inch square baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake until cheese melts. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Oil French Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bottle.
Cover tightly and shake well.
Chill and remove the garlic.
Shake thoroughly before serving.
Makes 1 1/3 to 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Okra Goulash
instructions: Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp.
Remove bacon; reserve 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet.
Crumble bacon and set aside.
Cook onion in drippings over medium heat, stirring constantly, until tender.
Add okra and cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add corn and remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle with crumbled bacon. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Okra Pilau
instructions: Saute bacon until crisp and set aside.
Add the boiling water to the bacon drippings.
Add okra and tomatoes; let come to a brisk boil.
Add rice, salt, pepper and basil.
Cover and cook over low heat about 30 minutes or until rice is tender and fluffy. Add more water during cooking, if needed.
When ready to serve, garnish with the bacon crumbled on top.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Okra Stew(Liberian Dish)
instructions: Boil beef for 20 to 25 minutes.
Combine okra and chopped onion and fry for 8 minutes.
Add 3/4 cup warm water, seasoned salt and tomato paste.
Add cooked beef to the sauce and allow to cook on medium heat for 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve on cooked rice.
Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Old Fashion Lace Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Sift together flour, baking powder and sugar. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Drop 1/4 teaspoonful of batter 4-inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden.
Let cool before removing. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Simmer chicken until tender enough to bone and skin in salt water.
Put chicken back into broth and bring to boil.
Cut butter into flour and add eggs.
Mix well and roll thin as for pastry.
Cut into narrow strips and drop into boiling broth with chicken.
Cook for 10 minutes or until done.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Cream Of Tomato Soup
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the first six ingredients.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour.
Heat cream in the top of double boiler over simmering water; add to the tomato mixture just before serving. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Honey Wheat Loaf
instructions: Heat water, cottage cheese, honey and butter until warm. Combine liquid, 2 cups flour and remaining ingredients.
Beat well.
Gradually add remaining flour and knead well.
Let rise to double size.
Makes 2 loaves.
Let rise again.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
Brush with butter.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Spicy Chili
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large Dutch oven.
Cook over medium heat, stirring to crumble meat, until meat is browned and onion is tender.
Drain off pan drippings.
Stir in chili powder, flour and sugar.
Add remaining ingredients; stir well (mixture will be very thick).
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes over low heat.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Gingersnaps
instructions: Beat the butter in large bowl until light.
Slowly add sugar. Beat in molasses, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking soda and salt. Add flour, 1/4 cup at a time.
Mix thoroughly.
Chill 4 hours. Heat oven to 325°.
Divide cookie dough in half.
Shape each half into 1 1/2-inch thick rolls.
Cut dough crosswise with sharp knife into 1/2-inch thick slices.
Place on lightly buttered baking sheet.
Bake cookies until golden, about 8 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Soft Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar together.
Add eggs and lemon juice. Continue beating until light and fluffy.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream; blend well.
Drop by tablespoons onto greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar or nuts, if desired.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°. Makes 2 dozen and Praise the Lord!

recipes.title: Omelette With Ricotta Cheese
instructions: Beat eggs lightly with water.
Melt butter in large saucepan. Saute onions until golden brown.
Mix Ricotta cheese and Parmesan cheese.
Pour eggs into frypan.
Sprinkle cheese mixture and parsley over eggs and onions.
Salt and pepper.
Cover and cook in oven at 250°.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Omi'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute chopped onion in margarine.
Add flour to make paste. Add water and tomato paste.
Stir and add additional water until you have a sauce the consistency you like.
Serve over rigatoni or large macaroni shells.
Sauce serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: One Hour Italian Casserole
instructions: Brown ground turkey in skillet.
Drain off excess fat.
Add meat into spaghetti sauce and simmer over stove while preparing the rest of the recipe.
Prepare pasta according to directions on box.
Spray with nonstick oil; add pasta and pour meat sauce over. Arrange pepperoni on top.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let sit 10 minutes and sprinkle with grated cheese.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Onion And Potato Bake

ingredients.notes: thinly sliced and separated into rings

instructions: Scrub potatoes and slice 1/8 inch thick.
Coat.
Put in shallow 2-quart casserole with Pam.
Combine potatoes and salad dressing in casserole; toss gently.
Cover and microwave it on High for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring at 4-minute intervals.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover and microwave at High for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring at 4-minutes intervals.
Yields 6 servings (88 calories each).

recipes.title: Onion Sauce
instructions: In medium saucepan, saute onion rings in oil until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes.
Makes 1 cup.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Orange Buttermilk Muffins
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar together.
Add egg; mix well and set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, soda and salt.
Chop the orange half in a blender with the buttermilk or yogurt.
Add alternately the flour mixture to the sugar mixture, stirring only until the ingredients are moistened.
Pour into greased muffin cups.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 9 to 12 small muffins.

recipes.title: Orange Energy Booster
instructions: Whirl all ingredients in a blender until smooth and frothy. Garnish with orange slice or maraschino cherry.
Makes 1 serving.

recipes.title: Orange Glazed Beets
instructions: Heat beets in their own liquid.
In small saucepan, melt margarine.
Remove from heat; add flour, brown sugar and orange juice.
Return to heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. Drain beets; add sauce to beets.
Makes 4 to 5 servings.

recipes.title: Orange Rice Cream
instructions: Make early in day, or one hour before serving.
Cook rice as label directs; refrigerate.
Peel orange, cut into sections; reserve 10 sections for decoration; cut rest in half and sprinkle with sugar; refrigerate.
Just before serving, whip cream stiff and add vanilla.
Fold in rice and halved orange sections (if very juicy, drain off some juice).
Arrange in serving dish; decorate with 10 orange sections and chocolate pieces.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Orange Shake
instructions: Combine the ingredients in electric blender. Blend 30 to 45 seconds on liquefy or until ice is broken.
Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Orange Sugar Cookies
instructions: In small bowl, combine flour and baking soda; set aside.
In medium bowl, with electric mixer at medium speed, beat 1 sugar, margarine, orange peel and vanilla until creamy.
Add Egg Beaters; beat one minute.
Gradually stir in flour mixture until blended, mix in orange extract.
Chill dough 1 hour.
Shape dough into balls and roll in colored sugar, place 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet, press balls with fork.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes until light golden brown.
Makes about 3 1/2 dozen. 2 grams fat, 60 calories per cookie.

recipes.title: Orange Yogurt Shake
instructions: In blender container, combine all ingredients.
Cover and blend 30 seconds or until smooth.
Serve immediately.
Makes 4 (1 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Orange-Glazed Ribs
instructions: Place ribs, meaty side down, in shallow roasting pan.
Roast in 450° oven for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven; drain off excess fat.
Turn ribs, meaty side up.
Reduce oven temperature to 350°; continue roasting 30 minutes more.
Combine marmalade, soy sauce, lemon juice and ginger; spoon half of the sauce over the ribs. Roast 30 minutes more or until tender, spooning remaining sauce over occasionally.
Garnish ribs with orange slices, if desired. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Oriental Green Beans
instructions: Fry bacon in large skillet over medium-low heat.
Drain on paper towel.
Cook onion and garlic in bacon grease until tender. Stir in soy sauce and add green beans.
Cook and stir until hot. Crumble bacon just before serving.
Stir in bacon.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Oven Apple Butter
instructions: In a large covered kettle, simmer the apples and water until tender.
Press through a sieve or food mill.
Measure 1 gallon of pulp; place in a large roaster.
Add sugar, vinegar, cinnamon and cinnamon stick.
Cover and bake at 400° for 3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Uncover and bake 1 hour longer, stirring occasionally until very thick.
Remove the cinnamon stick.
Pour hot into hot jars, leaving 1/4 inch headspace.
Adjust the caps. Process for 10 minutes in a boiling water bath.
Yield: 8 pints.

recipes.title: Oven Baked Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a large heavy Dutch oven or soup pot.
Saute onions over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally until light brown.
Sprinkle flour over the onions; stir into onions.
Stir in beef broth, wine, salt and pepper.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes.
Place slice of toasted French bread in each of 6 small ovenproof soup dishes.
Ladle soup over bread.
Place one slice cheese in each soup dish; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 375° until cheese melts, about 5 minutes.
Serve hot.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Oven Baked Sausage Casserole
instructions: Crumble sausage; brown and drain.
Saute vegetables; drain. Set aside.
Beat the eggs, milk, garlic salt and pepper until frothy.
Layer sausage, vegetables and cheese in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with egg mixture; bake at 350° until set, about 35 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Oven Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Flatten each chicken breast half to 1/4-inch thickness between waxed paper.
Divide ham and Swiss cheese among chicken breasts. Roll each chicken breast up and secure with a wooden pick.
Mix corn flakes, parsley and paprika.
Dip chicken into buttermilk. Coat evenly with corn flake mixture.
Place chicken, seam sides down, in greased square pan (9 x 9 x 2-inch).
Bake, uncovered, in 425° oven for 35 minutes; remove wooden picks.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Oven Crisp Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a small bowl, mix together sour cream, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, paprika, celery salt, garlic powder and pepper.
Place stuffing mix in a blender or food processor; process until it resembles fine crumbs.
Coat the chicken pieces with the sour cream mixture, then roll in the crumbs.
Place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Drizzle with melted butter and bake for 1 hour.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Oven Made Caramel Corn
instructions: Combine popped corn, roasted peanuts and pecans in a large roasting pan.
Melt butter in a large saucepan; stir in sugars, corn syrup and salt.
Bring to a boil; boil 5 minutes, stir often (temperature will be about 244°).
Remove from heat; stir in soda. Pour sugar mixture over popped corn and nuts; stir well.
Bake at 250° for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.
Cool.
Store in an airtight container.
Yields 6 quarts.

recipes.title: Oven Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Combine crumbs, cheese, parsley and oregano.
Brush chicken with butter.
Roll in crumb mixture.
Place skin side up in an ungreased shallow baking pan.
Sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Bake in a 375° oven until tender, 50 to 60 minutes.
Do not turn. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Oven Porcupines
instructions: Mix meat, rice, water, onion, salt, garlic salt and celery salt in bowl.
Shape into balls.
Place into a 9 x 9-inch or larger baking dish.
Mix tomato sauce, 1 cup water and Worcestershire sauce.
Pour over meatballs.
Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Remove foil and cook 15 minutes longer.
Makes 12 to 15 meatballs.

recipes.title: Oven Roasted Chicken And Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease baking dish with 1 tablespoon of oil.
Toss chicken and potatoes with the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil.
Arrange in dish in an even layer.
Sprinkle with garlic, rosemary and 4 tablespoons lemon juice.
Cover loosely with foil. Bake 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer, turning chicken and potatoes.
Pour remaining lemon juice over chicken. Serve.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Oven Roasted Chicken And Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°.
In large plastic bag, add all ingredients. Close bag and shake until chicken and vegetables are evenly coated. Empty all into prepared baking dish.
Arrange chicken breast side up and bake, uncovered, basting half way through.
Bake 45 minutes or until chicken and vegetables are done.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Oven Scramble Strata
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients.
Put in oblong baking dish, 13 x 9 x 2-inches that has been sprayed with Pam.
Beat eggs and add rest of ingredients.
Pour over ham, bread, etc. mixture. Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Serve hot. Serves 12 or more.
Serve muffins with this and it makes a very nice combination.

recipes.title: Oven-Barbecued Round Steak
instructions: Cut meat into 6 to 8 serving pieces.
Brown meat in oil for about 15 to 20 minutes.
Transfer meat to an ungreased casserole. Mix remaining ingredients; pour over meat.
Cover and cook in a 325° oven until tender, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Overnight Breakfast
instructions: Beat eggs; add milk and salt.
Layer bread, sausage and cheese in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour egg mixture on top.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Overnight Sausage Egg Casserole
instructions: Place bread crumbs in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish, sprinkle with cheese and set aside.
Brown sausage over medium heat; drain fat.
Crumble sausage over bread and cheese.
Beat eggs, milk, mustard and soup together.
Pour over sausage.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 3 hours before baking.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until set.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: P. T.'S Beans
instructions: Combine all in a casserole dish.
Top with sliced bacon. Bake at 350° for 2 hours.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Pacific Coast Bake
instructions: Saute onions in margarine.
Stir in rice and salmon.
Add combined mayonnaise and egg; mix lightly.
Layer half the salmon mixture, Parmesan cheese and broccoli in 1-quart casserole.
Cover with 1 cup Cheddar cheese.
Repeat layers, ending with broccoli. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining Cheddar cheese; continue baking until cheese is melted.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Pan Toasted Fish
instructions: Place fish in shallow baking dish and cover with milk. Refrigerate 1 hour.
Drain and pat dry.
Combine egg white and lemon juice in a separate shallow dish and set aside.
Combine oat bran, paprika and black pepper.
Dip fillets in egg mixture then oat mixture.
Saut in oil in nonstick skillet 3 minutes on each side or until evenly browned.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pancakes
instructions: Beat egg until fluffy.
Beat in remaining ingredients until smooth.
For thinner pancakes, add 1/4 cup milk.
Cook on griddle or skillet until golden brown.
Makes about 9 pancakes.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken Bites
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Bone and skin chicken.
Cut each half into 6 to 8 pieces.
Combine stuffing mix, cheese and parsley. Dip chicken pieces into butter and roll in stuffing mixture. Place in a single layer on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Bake 10 minutes or until tender. Serve hot or cold with picks.
Yields 3 to 4 dozen bites.

recipes.title: Parmesan Curry Dressing
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender container or food processor; process until blended.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Party Eggnog
instructions: Beat eggs well.
Mix in syrup, ginger, cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Stir in orange juice and lemon juice.
Cut ice cream into chunks the size of small eggs.
Put into large punch bowl.
Pour ginger ale over ice cream.
Stir in egg mixture.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Makes 6 quarts.

recipes.title: Party Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except flour and oil.
Shape meat into small balls.
Roll in flour.
Brown meatballs on all sides in oil over medium heat.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 375°.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients, except potato chips or corn flakes.
Spread evenly in 9 x 13 x 7-inch baking dish.
Top with crushed chips or corn flakes.
Bake about 1 hour.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Party Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix all ingredients well and form into 1-inch balls. Bake 15 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet until golden brown.
Makes about 6 dozen balls.

recipes.title: Party Shrimp
instructions: Melt the butter in a pan, but do not let it brown.
Mix in the garlic salt.
Add the shrimp and cook, stirring, over medium heat for about 8 minutes, until the shrimp begin to turn pink.
Do not overcook.
Add the Worcestershire sauce.
Stir to mix.
Turn off the heat; cover and let sit for 4 to 5 minutes.
Sprinkle on the parsley.
Pierce each shrimp with a toothpick or place the shrimp in a serving dish with toothpicks alongside so guests can help themselves.
Serve warm or cold.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Pasta With Clam Sauce
instructions: In skillet, heat butter; add garlic and saute for 3 to 4 minutes or until garlic is golden.
Add clam juice and continue cooking until sauce is reduced in half.
Add clams and parsley. Continue cooking until heated through.
Toss pasta into sauce and continue to heat.
Remove from heat and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, if desired.
Serve immediately.
Serves 6 to 8 as a first course or 4 as a main course.

recipes.title: Pasta-Crab Salad
instructions: Break vermicelli into 2 inch lengths.
Cook according to directions.
Rinse with cold running water and drain well.
In a medium bowl, toss vermicelli with remaining ingredients.
Cover and chill 20 minutes.
Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Paw Paw'S Creamy Pralines
instructions: Mix sugar, salt, milk and butter in a 2 quart pan.
Cook, stirring constantly, over low heat until sugar is dissolved.
Add pecans and cook over medium heat to a soft ball stage (234°) stirring constantly.
Remove from heat, let cool 5 minutes.
Stir rapidly until mixture thickens and coats pecans.
Working quickly, drop teaspoonfuls on waxed paper, forming patties.
Let stand until cool and set.
Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Peach Bread
instructions: Puree peaches and 6 tablespoons of sugar in the blender (mixture should yield 2 1/4 cups). Combine dry ingredients.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Add 1/2 cup sugar to peaches and set aside.
Combine flour, salt and 2 cups sugar and add to milk.
In a large saucepan, heat milk on medium.
Beat eggs and gradually stir into milk.
Cook on medium until mixture coats a spoon.
Stir constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add whipping cream, peaches and flavorings.
Chill in refrigerator, then churn in ice cream freezer.
Makes 5 quarts.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Apple Crumble
instructions: Measure flour and 1 cup of sugar into mixing bowl.
Cut in margarine and peanut butter until crumbs resemble coarse meal. Pare and slice apples.
Arrange in 2-quart casserole or shallow baking dish.
Sprinkle with the remaining sugar, orange rind, orange juice and water.
Cover with crumb mixture.
Bake at 350° until apples are tender, about 45 minutes.
Serve warm, topped with ice cream.
Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Blossom
instructions: Cream shortening, peanut butter, egg, milk and vanilla.
Add flour, soda and salt.
Mix together.
Roll in 1-inch balls.
Roll balls in sugar.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Put Hershey's Kisses in center as soon as baking finished.
Put in fridge to harden up a little.
Makes 1 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Chews
instructions: Bring sugar and corn syrup to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter and mix thoroughly.
Add corn flakes and mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Cool.
This may be spread into a 9 x 13-inch pan and cut into squares.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies You Won'T Believe
instructions: Mix together all ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten with a fork which has been dipped in sugar. Bake at 325° for 15 to 18 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Crescents
instructions: Cream shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla; stir in peanut butter.
Sift dry ingredients.
Stir into creamed mixture.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake in moderate oven at 350° about 10 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Crisscrosses
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Stir in peanut butter; add sifted dry ingredients and stir in.
Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press with back of floured fork to make crisscrosses.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Delights
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a heavy saucepan; mix well. Bring to a boil; boil 1 minute, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter.
Add oats; mix well.
Quickly drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Cool.
Makes about 5 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Divinity
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup and water. Bring to boiling.
Cook to hard ball stage (260°), stirring only until sugar dissolves.
In large mixing bowl, beat egg whites to stiff peaks.
Gradually pour syrup over egg whites, beating at high speed on electric mixer.
Add peanut butter and beat until candy holds its shape, about 3 or 4 minutes.
Test candy by spooning a small amount onto waxed paper.
Mixture should mound rather than flatten out.
Quickly drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper.
Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Frickles
instructions: Mix all ingredients and with a teaspoon drop mixture on greased cookie sheet.
Bake 15 minutes at 350° or until cookies are puffed but still soft.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fruit Sauce
instructions: Combine sugar, corn syrup, water and salt.
Simmer 10 minutes. Cool.
In a large bowl, stir mixture into peanut butter and raisins.
Spoon over fresh fruit cup.
Yields 1 1/3 cups.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Milk Drink
instructions: Beat all ingredients together until smooth.
Refrigerate. Serve cold.
This is a very delicious and nutritional drink. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Oaties
instructions: Mix sugar, butter, cocoa and milk in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Add remaining ingredients and mix.
Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.
Allow to set for several hours.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Puffs
instructions: Beat egg whites with salt until soft peaks form.
Adding sugar very gradually, beat until stiff peaks form.
Beat peanut butter to soften; fold thoroughly into meringue.
Drop from teaspoon 1 inch apart on greased cookie sheet.
Bake in a slow oven at 325° about 20 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool slightly; remove from pan.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Ripple Ice Cream
instructions: Combine peanut butter, honey, extract and nutmeg.
Layer ice cream and peanut butter mixture into metal bowl or other 2-quart freezer container, beginning and ending with the ice cream. Freeze until firm.
Scoop or spoon into serving dishes.
Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Shortbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°.
In a bowl, mix all ingredients with fingers until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Press mixture into ungreased 8-inch round pan.
Use fork to prick decorative wedges in the dough.
Bake 1 hour or until brown.
Cut into wedges while still hot.
Makes 16 wedge-shaped cookies.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Supremes
instructions: Cream the shortening and peanut butter.
Add sugars and beat well.
Beat in eggs.
Sift flour, salt and soda into the peanut butter mixture.
Mix well.
Make small balls from rounded teaspoonfuls of dough.
Place 2-inches apart on cookie sheet and flatten with fork.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Treats
instructions: Combine butterscotch morsels and peanut butter in large saucepan.
Stir over low heat until smooth.
Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies cereal.
Stir until well coated.
Press mixture evenly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Chill until firm.
Cut into 2-inch squares.
Makes 24 squares.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter-Banana Shake
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender; process until smooth.
Makes about 2 cups.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter-Honey Dip
instructions: Combine peanut butter, honey and milk in a medium-sized mixing bowl; stir until smooth.
Stir in raisins and cinnamon; sprinkle with
toasted
almonds.
Serve
with apple and banana slices. Yields 3 cups.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter-Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt into a bowl.
Cut in peanut butter until crumbly.
Add oats, egg and milk; stir just until moistened.
Pour into a greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until loaf appears golden brown.
Cool on a wire rack.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Crinkles
instructions: Cream first 4 ingredients; add egg.
Beat well.
Sift dry ingredients.
Add to cream mixture.
Beat thoroughly.
Drop by teaspoon and press with fork.
Bake in moderate oven 12 minutes. Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Pear Amber
instructions: Wash oranges; cut up and remove seeds, then dice or grind coarsely, peeling and all.
Add drained pineapple and peeled and diced pears to orange mixture.
(The orange and pineapple mixture keeps the pears from getting dark.)
Measure this mixture into a large, broad kettle.
For each cup, add 3 cups of sugar.
Heat slowly to boiling, stirring constantly.
Boil, stirring frequently, 20 to 30 minutes longer, until pears are transparent and mixture is as thick as you like.
Add cherries.
Remove from heat; let stand overnight.
Stir occasionally while cooling.
Heat to boil; pack into jars.
Makes 3 1/2 pints.

recipes.title: Pearl'S Pecan Drops
instructions: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease baking sheet with butter flavor Crisco.
Combine sugar, Crisco and vanilla in a large bowl.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until blended and crumbly. Combine flour, baking soda and cream of tartar.
Add to creamed mixture alternating with buttermilk, mixing thoroughly after each addition at low speed. Stir in nuts with a spoon. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto baking sheet 2-inches apart.
Bake at 375° for 9 to 11 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet before removing to rack.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Peas And Cauliflower
instructions: Measure water and salt into 2-quart saucepan.
Place cauliflower in pan with peas on top.
Cook as directed on package. Stir in butter.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Pecan Chicken
instructions: Place each piece of chicken between 2 sheets of wax paper; flatten to 1/4-inch thickness using mallet or rolling pin.
Set aside.
Combine honey and mustard; spread on both sides of chicken, then dredge chicken in chopped pecans.
Arrange chicken in a lightly greased shallow baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until tender.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pecan Kisses
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°.
With an electric mixer, beat egg whites until stiff not dry.
Gradually beat in sugar, vinegar and vanilla; fold in pecans.
Drop teaspoonful of dough 2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until firm. Cookies should remain light.
Remove from sheet at once.
Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Pecan Orange Snowballs
instructions: Cream butter and sugar.
Stir in flour, pecans, orange rind and vanilla.
Shape into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 300° for 35 minutes.
Cool
slightly and roll in powdered sugar.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Peking Shrimp
instructions: Combine the first 7 ingredients.
Heat corn oil in skillet; add shrimp and cook for about 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add sauce and remaining ingredients.
Boil for 1 minute, stirring gently.
Serve over rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Peppery Pork Chops
instructions: In a small mixing bowl combine paprika, garlic salt and pepper.
Mix well.
Rub each chop with paprika mixture.
Place the pork chops on the unheated rack of a broiler pan.
Broil 4 to 5 inches from the heat for 8 minutes.
Turn chops and broil for 7 to 9 minutes more or until the meat is no longer pink.
Serve with sour cream.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Perfect Pastry
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening.
Combine all other ingredients.
Sprinkle 4 tablespoons mixture over flour mixture; mix with fork.
Add 4 more tablespoons and continue mixing until pastry holds together.
Gather dough with hands and press into ball.
Wrap in clear plastic.
Wrap; chill 15 minutes. Divide dough into 4 parts.
Roll out between clear plastic wrap. Makes 4 crusts.
Freezes well.

recipes.title: Philly 3 Step Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended.
Add eggs; mix well.
Pour into crust.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool.
Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.
Yields 8 servings.
Can be served with fruit sauce on top.

recipes.title: Picadillo
instructions: Heat olive oil and add finely chopped onions, garlic and green pepper.
Add ground beef, stirring every few minutes until brown; drain.
Add other ingredients and allow to simmer over medium heat for 20 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.
Can also be served over rice.

recipes.title: Pickled Crab Apples
instructions: Wash and remove blossom ends and prick.
Bring vinegar, water, sugar, ginger, cinnamon and cloves (cinnamon and cloves tied in a bag) to a boil and add apples, a little at a time.
Remove before adding next batch.
Pour syrup over apples; let stand overnight. Remove bag of spices.
Pack apples in hot jars.
Bring syrup to a boil.
Pour over fruit.
Process 30 minutes.
Makes 16 to 20 pints.

recipes.title: Picnic Slaw
instructions: In a bowl, combine cabbage, carrots, bacon and onions.
In a jar with tight fitting lid, mix vinegar, oil, sugar and salt; shake well.
Just before serving, pour dressing over cabbage mixture and toss.
Makes 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Pie Crust Supreme
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients.
Cut in Crisco until crumbly. Mix water, vinegar and egg together.
Add to flour mixture.
Mix until it forms a ball.
Wrap in wax paper and chill.
Will keep for 5 days and makes 3 full pies or 6 shells.
Flour hands when handling dough.

recipes.title: Pimento Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Cover and refrigerate.
Spread on rolls or crackers.
Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Pineapple Brunch Cakes(Taste Like Sweet Rolls From The Bakery)
instructions: In a small mixer bowl, combine cream cheese and sugar.
Beat in egg and vanilla; stir in crushed pineapple.
Split and toast English muffins; place on baking sheet.
Spoon pineapple mixture atop, using about 1 1/2 tablespoons mixture for each.
Sprinkle with chopped pecans.
Bake in a 375° oven for 6 to 8 minutes. Serve warm.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pineapple Burgers
instructions: Set oven at broil and/or 550°.
Shape meat into 8 thin patties; sprinkle with salt.
Place pineapple slice on each of 4 patties. Top with remaining patties and press edges together to seal.
Place patties on rack in broiler pan.
Broil with tops 4-inches from heat until brown, 3 to 5 minutes.
Mix brown sugar, ketchup and mustard. Turn patties.
Spoon mixture on patties and broil until desired doneness, 3 to 5 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cherry Cake
instructions: Evenly spread pineapple in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Carefully spread pie filling on top.
Sprinkle with dry cake mix.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until the top is browned.
Yield: 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Pineapple Orange Molded Salad
instructions: Melt jello in boiling water.
Add cream cheese and beat with beater until smooth.
Add pineapple and orange juice.
Mold until firm.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Pineapple Spread
instructions: Blend cheese and mayonnaise until smooth.
Stir in ginger and pineapple.
Chill.
Let set at room temperature 1/2 hour before serving.
Yields 3 cups.
(Best if made a day or two ahead of time.)
Serve with crackers or as a filling for small sandwiches.

recipes.title: Pittsburg Pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cook beef until brown; drain grease. Add onion, garlic salt, spaghetti sauce and undrained mushrooms. Mix well. Pour half of the cooked macaroni into deep casserole and cover with half of the tomato sauce. Spread half of the sour cream over the tomato sauce.
Top with all of the Provolone cheese. Repeat the layers. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Cover and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove cover and bake until cheese melts. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Pizza Mac

ingredients.notes: thinly sliced and separated into rings

instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions.
Drain.
In medium bowl, blend milk and egg.
Add macaroni and mix well. Spread evenly into greased 10 x 15-inch baking dish.
Spoon spaghetti sauce over macaroni mixture.
Top with remaining ingredients.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° until hot and macaroni is set, about 30 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Pizza Meat Loaf
instructions: Blend soup, water, oregano and garlic together. In a bowl, combine 1/4 cup soup mixture,

bread crumbs, onion, parsley, egg, salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly with beef. Shape firmly into a loaf; place in shallow baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour 15 minutes. Remove from oven, spoon off fat. Pour remaining soup over loaf. Top with cheese and bake until melted. Serves 4-6.

recipes.title: Pizza Meatballs
instructions: Cut part of cheese into 20 to 24 (1/2-inch) cubes.
Shred remaining cheese and set aside.
In a large bowl, with fork, mix well all remaining ingredients, except salad oil and spaghetti sauce. Shape some of the mixture around each cheese cube to make 1 1/2-inch meatballs.
In 12-inch skillet, over medium-high heat, in hot salad oil, cook meatballs until all sides are brown.
Spoon drippings from pan.
Add spaghetti sauce.
Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Sprinkle meatballs with reserved shredded cheese.
Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Pizza Pit Salad Dressing
instructions: Blend onion, sugar and vinegar well.
Add paprika, celery salt and salt and blend well.
Add oil.
Blend well until well mixed. Makes 1 pint.

recipes.title: Plain Roll Dough
instructions: Soften active dry yeast in warm water.

In a large bowl, combine sugar, shortening and salt. Stir in hot milk. Cool to lukewarm. Add softened yeast, egg and 2 cups of the flour; beat well. Gradually add remaining flour or enough to make a soft dough. Cover and let rise in a warm place until double (about 1 1/2 hours).
Punch down. Shape into rolls.
Makes about 24 hot rolls.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Plain Scotch Scones
instructions: Fold butter into dry ingredients.
Stir in buttermilk.
Mix well.
Put on a floured board; pat down until 1/2-inch thick, then cut into triangles.
Cook in electric frypan at 375°, until brown on both sides.
Makes 8 to 10.
Serve with butter, jams or jelly.

recipes.title: Plain Sugar Cookies(Cut Out Very Nice)
instructions: Measure flour; add baking powder and salt and sift again. Cream shortening; add sugar gradually.
Cream well.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each.
Add vanilla and flour alternately with milk, mixing well after each addition.
Chill overnight.
Roll 1/8-inch thick.
Cut into desired shapes.
Place on greased baking sheet.
Bake at 375° for 9 minutes or until done.
Yields 6 dozen medium size cookies.

recipes.title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture forms a ball.
Takes about 6 minutes.
Knead to form a ball after cools.
Put in airtight container.
You can divide ball and mix different food color in each.
Makes 2 pounds.

recipes.title: Please-The-Cook Cookies
instructions: Beat egg white until stiff.
Add brown sugar gradually, beating constantly.
Add nuts and stir.
Drop by spoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 250° for 30 minutes.
Remove from sheet and cool.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Polish Potato Pancakes
instructions: Combine ingredients and beat well.
Using large spoon, drop on hot frying pan and fry both sides in corn oil.
Makes 8 to 10 pancakes.

recipes.title: Polka Dot Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar, butter and cream cheese until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Blend in flour and salt. Stir in chocolate chips and raisins.
Bake in a 350° oven until lightly browned, about 12 minutes.
Makes 5 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Polynesian Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken, celery, grapes, carrots and almonds.
Blend mayonnaise with sour cream and seasonings; pour over chicken and toss lightly.
Chill thoroughly.
Makes 6 servings.
(I think it best if made the day before.)

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Dressing And Fruit
instructions: Mix first five (5) ingredients well in a mixer.
Slowly add 2 cups oil while beating.
Add poppy seed.
Makes 1 quart.
Pour about 5 to 6 tablespoons over fruit.
Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pork Broccoli Delight
instructions: Prepare cooked pork.
Measure and set aside.
Put broccoli into boiling salt water for 2 minutes.
Drain.
Sprinkle croutons in bottom of shallow buttered 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole dish. Top with broccoli.
Mix pork with mayonnaise and sour cream. Spread over broccoli.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 20 minutes or until lightly brown.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Pork Chops A La Vineyards
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in a saucepan and simmer 5 minutes. Add cornstarch mixture to thicken.
When thickened, add parsley and paprika.
Bake pork chops 30 minutes at 450°.
Remove chops to another dish.
Add sauce and bake 1 1/2 hours at 300°.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes and onions in 8 x 8-inch casserole.
Mix soup and milk.
Pour over potatoes and onions.
Top with pork chops. Cover and bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pork In Soy Sauce
instructions: Fry pork in hot oil until brown. Add onions, green onions and garlic.
Fry until brown. Add ginger, brown sugar, soy sauce, 1/2 cup water and salt. Be careful how much salt as soy sauce is salty. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Serve hot. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Pork Steak Vegetable Bake
instructions: Place potatoes and carrots in bottom of an 11 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch dish.
Trim fat from steaks.
In large skillet, cook trimmings until there are about 2 tablespoons oil; discard trimmings.
In hot oil, brown steaks well on both sides.
In a small pan, combine water, onion soup mix and soy sauce; bring to boiling.
Spoon half soup mix over potatoes and carrots; top with steaks.
Spoon remaining soup mixture over steaks.
Cover and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
Uncover and bake 10 minutes more. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pork Tortilla Soup
instructions: Brown pork and onion in oil.
Add remaining ingredients except tortillas and garnishes.
Simmer, covered, 45 to 60 minutes or until pork is tender.
Cut tortillas into wedges and carefully stir into soup.
Serve with garnishes of grated cheese, yogurt or sour cream, if desired.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pork-And-Beef Barbecue
instructions: In 3 1/2 to 5-quart slow cooker, place beef, pork, onions and peppers.
Thoroughly combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat.
Cover; cook on high (300°) for 8 hours.
With a wire whisk, stir mixture until meat is shredded.
Serve on hard rolls.
Makes 12 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Potato Buns
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.
Measure flour into large bowl.
Mix all other ingredients; add yeast mixture and pour over flour.
Mix good and knead.
Let rise.
Punch down in bowl, take approximately 1/4 cup portions rolling in your hands to form a ball and place on cookie sheet.
Bake on middle shelf at 350° for 10 minutes or until nicely browned.
Yields approximately 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Potato Cheese Chowder
instructions: Put water and chicken cubes in Dutch oven and boil.
Add vegetables, cover and simmer until tender.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Blend in flour and cook 1 minute.
Gradually add milk and cook over medium heat until thick, stirring constantly.
Add cheese and stir until melted.
Stir cheese sauce into vegetable mixture.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Potato Lovers' Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place frozen hash brown potatoes in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt 1/2 cup of butter and pour over potatoes.
Set aside.
In a 2-quart bowl, mix sour cream, onion, cheese, soup, salt and black pepper.
Pour over potatoes and mix well.
Combine 2 cups of crushed cornflakes and the other 1/2 cup melted butter.
Spread over potato mixture.
Bake for 1 hour. Yield:
9 cups.
Makes 18 servings (1/2 cup each).

recipes.title: Potato Salad(Italy)
instructions: Combine salad dressing mix with mayonnaise.
Blend in warm potatoes, celery and olives.
Chill.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Potato Soup With Ham
instructions: Cook potatoes, onion, salt and bouillon cube in boiling water until potatoes are tender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bring to a simmer.
Yields 3 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Potato-Cheese Scallop
instructions: Saute onion slices in butter.
Place 1/4 potatoes in bottom of greased 2-quart dish or casserole.
Add 1/2 each onion slices, cheese, flour, salt and pepper.
Repeat layers.
Pour milk over. Cover and bake for 1 hour.
Remove cover and bake 15 minutes longer.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Potato-Corn Fritters
instructions: Mix all ingredients well.
Add corn liquid with just enough mix to make moderately thick dough.
Shape into patties.
Dredge in additional flour.
Fry until crisp and golden.
Makes 4 to 6 fritters.

recipes.title: Potatoes Deluxe I
instructions: Melt 1/2 cup margarine in baking dish in slow oven.
Mix potatoes, onion, cheese, sour cream and soup and place in baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Mix corn flakes and 1/2 cup melted margarine.
Put on top and bake 15 minutes longer.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Prize Winning 4-H Corn Bread
instructions: Put Wesson oil in muffin tins and put in oven to get hot.
Mix all the ingredients well and fill muffin tins.
Put in oven at 450° to cook for about 10 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Puffy Popovers
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Beat milk, flour, salt and butter together.
Add eggs and beat again.
Pour batter into a greased muffin pan until they are 3/4 full.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes, then lower the heat to 350° and bake for 20 more minutes.
Serve fresh from oven while warm.
Makes 9 or 10 popovers.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Custard
instructions: Combine pumpkin, sugar, salt, spices and eggs.
Add milk slowly, stirring constantly.
Pour into well-greased custard cups. Set in pan of warm water.
Bake in preheated 375° oven until an inserted knife comes out clean.
Serve with whipped cream, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Stir together 2 eggs, slightly beaten, pumpkin, 1/3 cup sugar and spices.
Spread over bottom of pie shell.
Combine 2 eggs, corn syrup, 1/2 cup sugar, butter and vanilla.
Stir in nuts.
Spoon over pumpkin.
Bake in oven for 50 minutes or until set.
Makes 1 pie.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Streusel Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the first 5 ingredients; set aside. In a medium bowl, combine the eggs, pumpkin and oil.
Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients.
Stir just until moistened.
Spoon batter into greased muffin cups, filling 3/4 full.
Sprinkle streusel topping over batter.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 18 muffins.

recipes.title: Quiche - Impossible Vegetable Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400°.
Cook broccoli, slightly undercooked.
Mix broccoli, cheese, onion and green pepper in a greased 10-inch pie plate.
Beat remaining ingredients until smooth (1 minute on high). Pour into pie plate.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until clean knife comes out clean.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Macaroons
instructions: Mix coconut, milk and vanilla in large bowl.
Drop by teaspoonfuls, about 1-inch apart, onto well-greased cookie sheets, pressing down ends of coconut with back of spoon.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately remove from cookie sheets.
Top with almonds or maraschino cherries, if desired.
Cool on wire racks.
Yields 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Mock Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: In the top of a double boiler over medium heat, blend hot water with mayonnaise, stirring, until thoroughly heated.
Add lemon juice and stir to mix well.
This sauce may be served with broccoli, asparagus, cauliflower or other vegetables.
Makes 1/2 cup.
Serves 8 (1 tablespoon per serving).

recipes.title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Saute beef and onions in hot oil.
Place uncooked noodles on top of meat.
Mix remainder of ingredients and pour on top.
Press noodles down to moisten well.
Do not stir.
Bring to a boil, then turn heat on low.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Quick Cheddar Cheese Squares
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and milk in small saucepan.
Cook on low heat about 5 minutes or until mixture thickens slightly, stirring constantly.
Add Cheddar cheese; stir and heat until cheese is melted.
Serve over cooked chicken, vegetables or pasta.
Makes 1 cup sauce.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken Chasseur
instructions: Dredge chicken in cornstarch.
In large skillet, brown coated chicken in oil.
Stir in seasonings and scallions.
Cook 2 minutes longer.
Add broth and sherry (wine).
Cover; simmer 10 minutes. Gently stir in mushrooms and tomatoes.
Cover; simmer 5 minutes longer.
Serve over rice.
Sauce may be served separately.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Quick Corn Biscuits
instructions: Melt butter on a sided cookie sheet.
Mix Bisquick and corn. Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet.
Turn each biscuit so that it is coated with butter.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until golden. Yields 1 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Quick Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix thoroughly.
Pack firmly into loaf pan.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.
Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Quick Minestrone Soup(Low-Fat)
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine all ingredients, except cheese.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until very crisp-tender.
Stir occasionally.
Top each serving with 1 tablespoon of Parmesan cheese.
Yields 6 (1 1/3 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Quick Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix water, potatoes, onion and salt in a saucepan; cover and cook for 5 minutes over medium heat.
Lower heat and continue cooking for 20 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
Remove cover and stir gently over low heat until potatoes look dry.
Stir in the remainder of ingredients and heat until cheese melts, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Quick Swiss Pie
instructions: Press rolls into 12-inch pizza pan or 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Brown meat and onion; drain.
Mix in oregano and spread over crust.
Beat cottage cheese, eggs and seasonings.
Spoon over meat.
Top with green pepper, tomato and cheese.
Bake at 370° for 20 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Quick Vegetable Soup(Microwave)
instructions: Place bacon in single layer in a 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe casserole.
Cover with paper towel.
Microwave on High for 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp; set aside.
Preserve 1 tablespoon of drippings; discard remainder.
Add vegetables, tomatoes, cut into small pieces, onion, bouillon and garlic powder to drippings. Cover with casserole lid.
Microwave on High 9 to 11 minutes or until steaming hot and flavors are blended.
Crumble bacon and add to soup.
Sprinkle cheese over individual bowls of soup.
Makes about 4 servings (125 calories).

recipes.title: Quickie Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients and beat 30 seconds.
Drop on ungreased cookie sheet and bake in preheated 450° oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Melt 1/2 cup margarine or butter and add 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder; pour over hot biscuits and serve.
Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

recipes.title: R.J.'S Easy Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine the juice of 1 lemon with olive oil and thyme in shallow bowl.
Marinate chicken breasts in lemon mixture 10 minutes to 1 hour (depending on time available!).
Bake in nonstick pan for 20 to 25 minutes.
Lay 1 to 2 slices of tomato on each breast. Cover tomato with cheese. Bake for approximately 10 more minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Raised Meatballs
instructions: Soak bread in 1/2 cup milk.
Then add beaten eggs and mix. Add ground beef, salt and pepper, baking powder and onions; mix lightly but well.
Shape into balls the size of walnuts and brown in a small amount of fat.
Place into a greased baking dish.
Mix together soups and remaining milk.
Pour over meatballs and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 6 to 8 people.

recipes.title: Raisin Honey Drops
instructions: Cream honey, sugar, butter, peanut butter and egg.
Sift together flour, salt, cinnamon and soda.
Stir into creamed mixture.
Add rolled oats and raisins.
Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake on upper shelf of oven.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool on racks.
Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Raisin Tea Loaf
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Stir in raisins and lemon rind.
Mix and sift dry ingredients.
Combine lemon extract, vanilla and milk; add alternately with dry ingredients to raisin mixture.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Ranch Baked Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef.
Stir in remaining ingredients and pour into 2-quart casserole.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Ranch Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine
all ingredients in a small bowl.
Refrigerate. Yield: 2 cups.

recipes.title: Raspberry Parfaits
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Measure 3/4 cup gelatin; spoon in sherbet and stir until melted.
Chill until set.
Add cold water and ice cubes to remaining gelatin and stir constantly until gelatin starts to thicken, 3 to 5 minutes.
Remove any unmelted cubes.
Fold in fruit and spoon into 6 parfait glasses. Chill until set.
Spoon sherbet mixture into glasses.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Raspberry Swirl
instructions: Combine thoroughly the crumbs, melted butter and 2 tablespoons sugar.
Lightly press mixture into well-greased 7 x 11 x 1 1/2-inch pan.
Bake in moderate (375°) oven about 8 minutes.
Cool thoroughly.
Beat egg yolks until thick.
Add cream cheese, sugar and salt; beat until smooth and light.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Whip cream until stiff and thoroughly fold with egg whites into cheese mixture.
In a mixer or blender, crush raspberries to a pulp.
Gently swirl half of fruit pulp through cheese filling and spread mixture into crust.
Spoon remaining puree over top; swirl with a knife.
Freeze, then cover and return to freezer.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Raw Fries
instructions: Cook potatoes in microwave for 10 to 12 minutes, then thinly slice them.
Heat shortening in 10-inch skillet until melted. Layer 1/3 each of potatoes and onion in skillet; sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper.
Repeat twice.
Dot top layer with margarine.
Cover and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Uncover and cook turning once until potatoes are brown.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Raw Vegetable Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients well and allow to stand, covered, in refrigerator for 2 or 3 hours.
Yield: 2 1/4 cups.

recipes.title: Red Beans And Rice(Southern Dish)
instructions: Wash beans and soak overnight or from 4 to 5 hours in cold water. Drain water. Place in a pot and cover with cold water. Heat slowly.
Add seasonings with meat, onion and chopped garlic. Boil at least 2 hours or until beans are tender.
Add rice.
Mix well and let steam 10 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Red Cabbage With Apples
instructions: Melt margarine in large skillet.
Add onion; saute until tender.
Stir in cabbage, apple, salt, caraway seed, pepper, brown sugar, vinegar and water.
Cover and simmer 50 to 60 minutes, or until cabbage is tender and flavors are well blended.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Red Wine Biscotti(Serve With Cream Cheese Caviar Spread)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients in food processor and process only until combined.
Do not overmix. Remove dough and divide into thirds.
Divide each third into eighths.
Roll each piece into 3-inch lengths and form into a donut shape.
Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Cool.
Makes 24 biscotti.

recipes.title: Red-Hot Corn Relish
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Put in sterilized pint jars.
Makes about 9 pints.

recipes.title: Reduced Sodium Swiss Steak
instructions: Trim fat from steak and coat with flour and pepper.
Pound meat with edge of plate or wooden mallet to tenderize before meat is floured if desired.
Heat oil in skillet.
Brown steak on both sides; remove steak from skillet.
Saute onion in skillet.
Add tomatoes, beef broth, vegetable juice and meat.
Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add carrot pieces and simmer until carrots are tender. Makes 6 servings, 226 calories; 252 mg. sodium per serving.

recipes.title: Rhubarb-Strawberry Jam

ingredients.notes: washed, trimmed and cut into 1/4-inch diagonal slices

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2 1/2-quart souffle dish.
Cover tightly with microwave plastic wrap.
Place dish on platter that will fit in your oven.
Cook at 100% for 10 minutes.
Uncover and cook for 10 minutes longer.
If any liquid bubbles out, scrape off and put back in bowl.
Remove from oven, divide jam among sterilized jars.
Seal with 1/8-inch melted paraffin.
I freeze the jam and don't use paraffin.
Makes 4 cups.

recipes.title: Rice And Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Mix rice, sauteed celery, fish, eggs and lemon juice.
Fold in mayonnaise and soup and season to taste.
Turn into buttered casserole dish.
Top with onion rings or mix in as they tend to get too brown.
Can add them 5 minutes before finished.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Cookies
instructions: Melt together white chocolate and peanut butter.
Add peanuts and Rice Krispies.
Mix well but gently.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Let set an hour.
Makes approximately 7 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat.
Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted.
Remove from heat. Add Kellogg's Rice Krispies cereal.
Stir until well coated.
Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Cut into squares when cool.
Yields 24 treats.
Has 80 calories and 2 grams of fat.

recipes.title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Brown rice, onion, garlic, oil and butter.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding(Reduced Calorie)
instructions: Beat eggs in casserole dish.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 375° for 50 to 55 minutes until done.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Rice Sabrosa
instructions: In an ovenproof skillet, saute beef, onion and green pepper with seasonings until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender.
Stir frequently to crumble meat.
Add tomatoes and rice. Top with cheese and bake at 350° until cheese melts.
Makes 6 to 7 servings.

recipes.title: Rice Sausage Skillet Dinner
instructions: Cook onion and sausage balls in skillet until onion is tender and sausage is lightly browned.
Drain off excess fat.
Add next 3 ingredients.
Heat to boiling, cover, reduce heat.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add peas, cover, let simmer another 5 to 10 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Rice With Beans And Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix rice, beans, garlic, onion and chilies.
Layer this mixture alternately in a greased casserole with Jack and Ricotta cheese, ending with rice mixture.
Bake for 30 minutes.
During last few minutes of baking, sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese over top.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Rice With Black Beans
instructions: Cook and stir onion in hot oil in saucepan until tender, but not browned.
Add tomatoes, beans, oregano and garlic powder. Bring to boil.
Stir in rice.
Return to boil.
Reduce heat and cover; simmer 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes. Makes 8 servings.
One serving equals 170 calories, 7 g protein, 32 g carbohydrate, 3 g fat, 0 cholesterol, 340 mg sodium and 4 g dietary fiber.

recipes.title: Rice With Tomatoes(Risotto Con Pomodoro)
instructions: In large skillet saute
green pepper, onion, garlic and basil in heated olive oil.
Saute until all peppers are tender but not brown.
Stir
in
rice,
tomatoes, salt, pepper, water and bouillon cubes.
Cook covered over
low
heat for 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Rice-Crusted Ham 'N Swiss Pie
instructions: Thoroughly combine rice, butter and 1 slightly beaten egg. Press lightly against sides and bottom of an ungreased 9-inch pie plate.
In rice crust, layer ham, cheese and 1/2 cup fried onions. Combine milk, remaining 2 eggs and pepper.
Pour over ham-cheese-onion filling.
Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Rice-Nut Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients; pack into an oiled 9-inch loaf pan.
Bake for about 50 minutes, until firm. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes.
Unmold and slice.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Richard'S Ranger Cookies
instructions: Cream the margarine and sugars.
Add eggs.
Mix flour, soda, salt and baking powder together. Add to creamed mixture thoroughly. Add vanilla.
Add oatmeal and corn flakes until moist. Drop by tablespoons on slightly greased cookie sheet, about 12 cookies to each pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Yields 4 dozen total.

recipes.title: Ricky'S Hamburger Special
instructions: Make
four beef patties.
Place on individual pieces of aluminum
foil.
On
top of meat, place slices of potatoes and onions.
Wrap each patty securely and bake 25 minutes or until done at 300°.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Ring Of Plenty
instructions: Combine ingredients.
Pour into well-greased 10-inch ring molds.
Set in pan of water (1-inch deep).
Bake until set, in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.
Unmold on hot platter.
Fill center with creamed seafood, chicken or vegetable.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Roasted Asparagus With Thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Place asparagus in a roasting pan or baking pan lined with heavy-duty foil.
Drizzle with oil and toss to coat.
Sprinkle with the thyme, salt and pepper.
Bake uncovered for 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Roasted Carrots
instructions: Scrape carrots; cut large carrots into lengthwise slices. Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Combine oil and butter; drizzle over carrots.
Sprinkle in salt and pepper.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Turn carrots and bake an additional 30 minutes. Yields 12 servings.

recipes.title: Rohliky(Crescent Rolls)
instructions: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup water with teaspoon sugar.
Combine hot milk, shortening and salt and cool to lukewarm.
Add 1 cup flour. Add yeast and eggs.
Beat well.
Stir in remaining flour and knead lightly 5 to 8 minutes.
Cover and let rise until double, then divide dough into thirds.
Roll each into 9-inch circle.
Divide circle like pie and roll big end first so point is on outside. Arrange rolls point down on greased cookie sheet.
Curve slightly like a crescent.
Brush with melted butter.
Before baking, beat an egg with a little water and sprinkle poppy seed on them.
Cover and let rise until light.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Rolled Out Clusters
instructions: Combine sugar, milk, butter and salt in a saucepan.
Stir and bring to a boil, then boil one minute longer.
Remove from heat. Add vanilla and peanut butter; stir until smooth.
Add oats and mix well.
Cool slightly and drop by tablespoon onto waxed paper. Yield: 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Rolls
instructions: Let yeast dissolve in 1/4 cup warm water.
Mix flour and liquid to form soft dough.
Knead gently on floured board.
Form dough in 12 small balls and place in muffin pan.
Brush with oleo. Let double in size.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Roman Beef Stew
instructions: Cooking Time: About 1 1/2 hours.
Servings: 6.

recipes.title: Rose Pedal Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add sugar and Crisco.
Beat in other items.
Spoon into greased muffin tins only 1/3 to 1/2 full. Bake at 400° for 13 to 15 minutes.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen rolls.
This dough will keep 1 week in covered container in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Rosey Glow Cranberry Punch
instructions: In large saucepan, combine all ingredients and blend well. Simmer over low heat 10 to 15 minutes, or until warm.
If desired, remove cinnamon sticks and nutmeg.
Serve warm in mugs or cups. Garnish as desired.
Yields 24 (1/2 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Rosti Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes in skins.
Cool, peel and shred.
Melt shortening in skillet.
Add potatoes and salt; cook until heated and yellow. Stir in bacon, onion and cheese.
Press potatoes into a round flat cake pan and sprinkle with water.
Cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes or until crust forms on bottom.
Shake pan once or twice to prevent burning.
Place serving plate over potatoes and invert so crust side is up.
Makes 5 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Round Steak And Gravy
instructions: Cut steak into 5 or 6 serving-size pieces.
Place in crock-pot. Add dry onion soup mix, water and condensed mushroom soup.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.
Makes 5 or 6 servings.

recipes.title: Ruby Sauced Beets
instructions: Blend cornstarch, sugar and salt in a large saucepan. Stir in cranberry juice cocktail. Cook and stir over medium heat until thick and bubbly. Add drained beets and orange peel.
Heat and serve. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Rum Sauce
instructions: Beat butter in small bowl on medium speed until creamy.
Beat in egg yolk. Add powdered sugar until fluffy. Add rum.
Stir in orange peel.
Beat until well blended. Cover and refrigerate. Yields 1 cup.

recipes.title: Salmon Corn Chowder
instructions: In large saucepan, combine potatoes, onion, celery, broth, garlic and marjoram.
Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer, covered, about 10 minutes.
Stir in milk and oleo.
Combine flour and corn; stir into soup.
Heat, but do not boil, until slightly thickened.
Gently stir in salmon and heat through.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Salmon Dyonnaise
instructions: Whisk together mayonnaise, mustard and dill.
Mix in buttermilk.
Cover.
Chill 1 hour.
Serve over salmon or any fish or vegetable.
Makes 1 1/4 cups.
Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Salmon Puff
instructions: Mix flaked fish and potatoes.
Add onion and celery, then add butter and egg yolks and fold in beaten egg whites last.
Place in buttered casserole dish and bake at 350° until brown.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Salmon Rice Loaf(Microwaved)
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients (salmon juice, not salmon) in casserole (microwave-safe) and microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir after 1 minute.
Add salmon, broccoli and rice to casserole. Mix well.
Cover (vented).
Microwave on High for 8 minutes.
Stir at 2 and 6 minutes.
Serves 6.
Serve with a salad.

recipes.title: San Antonio Style Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut wings in half at joints; discard wing tops.
Combine 1/3 cup of picante sauce, catsup, honey and cumin.
Pour over chicken. Place in refrigerator; marinate at least 1 hour, turning once. Drain chicken, reserving marinade.
Place on rack or foil-lined broiler pan.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Brush chicken with reserved marinade.
