Turn and bake, brushing generously with marinade every 10 minutes, until tender, about 30 minutes.
Place 6 inches from heat in preheated broiler.
Broil 2 to 3 minutes or until sauce looks dry.
Spoon sour cream into small clear glass bowl.
Top with remaining 2/3 cup picante sauce.
Serve with chicken.
Makes 24 appetizers.

recipes.title: Sandra'S Taco Meat
instructions: Brown hamburger in a large pot.
Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 3 hours.
Makes 6 quarts.
May freeze in separate containers for future use.

recipes.title: Sarkis' Peach Butter
instructions: Wash peaches.
Peel, quarter and pit.
Place 3 cups at a time into blender.
Cover.
Blend until smooth.
Repeat process. Measure 11 cups.
Place in crock-pot.
Stir in lemon juice and cinnamon.
Cook uncovered on High for 9 hours, stirring twice. Stir in sugar.
Cook uncovered 2 more hours, stirring several times.
Pour into hot, sterilized 1/2-pint jars, leaving 1/2-inch headspace.
Wipe jar rims; adjust lids.
Process in boiling water bath 10 minutes.
(Start time when water returns to boiling.) Makes 8 one-half pints.

recipes.title: Saturday Night Casserole
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole, combine onion and ground meat. Microwave 4 minutes on High (100%).
In a separate bowl, combine the remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Add to meat and onion, stirring to blend.
Cover and microwave 8 minutes on High (100%) or simmer on stove.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Saturday Night Special
instructions: Brown beef lightly in skillet without any added fat, stirring frequently.
Add pork and beans, tomatoes and salt.
Grease a baking dish.
Pour half the mixture in.
Cover with slices of onion.
Add remaining meat-bean mixture.
Top with strips of bacon and sprinkle with brown sugar.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Saturday Special
instructions: Microwave Directions:
Crumble ground beef into 2-quart casserole.
Add onion.
Microwave on High for 5 minutes, stirring once halfway through cooking time.
Drain and return to casserole dish.
Add sour cream, soup, corn, pimiento, salt and pepper. Cover and microwave 5 minutes on High.
Top with tomato slices. Microwave for 3 minutes on High or until tomatoes are slightly softened.
Garnish with French fried onions.
Let stand 3 minutes, uncovered.
(If tomato is not used, cook an additional 3 minutes on High before adding French fried onions.)
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Saucepan Peanut Butter Crunchies
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa in large saucepan.
Add butter and milk and boil 2 minutes.
While stirring, remove from heat.
Add oats, peanut butter and vanilla.
Mix thoroughly.
Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.
Cool until set.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Dumplings(Hungarian Recipe)
instructions: Grate potatoes; add egg and salt with enough flour to make a thick dough.
Drop by tablespoon into a pot of boiling water. Cook about 10 minutes.
Drain.
Rinse with cold water.
Melt shortening in large frying pan.
Add drained sauerkraut.
Brown. Add dumplings.
Cook until dumplings are heated through, about 10 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Relish
instructions: One day or up to 1 week ahead, rinse sauerkraut by running under cold water. Drain well. Dice red and green peppers.
In a large bowl, stir sauerkraut, peppers, cider vinegar, brown sugar and caraway seed until mixed.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Store in refrigerator.
Makes about 8 cups.

recipes.title: Sausage (Ham) Souffle
instructions: Brown sausage and drain grease.
Mix and beat eggs.
Add milk, salt and dry mustard.
Add cubed bread and stir.
Add cheese and sausage (ham); put in greased baking dish (glass).
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.
Let stand.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Sausage And Eggs
instructions: Cook sausage in a large skillet over medium heat until browned, stirring to crumble; drain well.
Place sausage in a greased 8-inch square baking pan.
Set aside.
Combine eggs and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until foamy.
Remove crust from bread; cut bread into 1-inch cubes.
Stir bread cubes and cheese into egg mixture.
Pour egg mixture over sausage.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until set.
Yield 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sausage Appetizers
instructions: Combine biscuit mix, crumbled sausage, and shredded cheese. Mix well; roll in balls about the size of walnuts.
Flatten with fork or leave in balls.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet or freeze and bake when needed.
Yields 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Sausage Breakfast
instructions: Brown sausage and drain well.
Mix well and let set overnight in refrigerator.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Do not cover while baking.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Sausage Corn Bake
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cracker crumbs, mixing well. Spoon into a lightly greased 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking pan; sprinkle with cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until done.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sausage Primavera
instructions: Saute vegetables in butter until tender; set aside.
Brown sliced sausage and drain.
Combine sausage, vegetables and cream. Simmer 2 minutes.
Add cheese and serve over cooked fettucine. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Sausage, Zucchini, Skillet Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage, onion, zucchini and corn in skillet.
Lower heat; cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Remove from heat; cover with cheese and let set for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sausage-Egg Casserole
instructions: Mix and let set overnight.
Start baking in cold oven.
Bake for 20 minutes at 325°.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Sausage-Macaroni Skillet
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain, rinse and set aside.
In skillet, cook sausage and green pepper until sausage is browned and pepper tender; stir occasionally to break sausage into bits and to brown evenly.
Drain off fat.
Stir in undrained tomatoes, pizza sauce and salt.
Bring to boiling.
Stir in zucchini.
Cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in macaroni. Cook, uncovered, for about 5 minutes more.
Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sauteed Green Beans With Pecans And Fresh Tarragon
instructions: Clean green beans and cook in boiling, salted water until tender, about 2 to 5 minutes.
Rinse under cold water and drain. In a saucepan, heat olive oil and butter; add green beans, shallots and garlic.
Toss.
Add pecans, tarragon and salt and pepper to taste.
Serves 8 to 10 people.

recipes.title: Sauteed Squash And Tomatoes
instructions: Wash squash well, scrubbing with a brush.
Slice into 1/2-inch thick diagonal slices.
In butter in medium skillet with tight fitting cover, saute onion, stirring, until golden, about 3 minutes.
Add squash and remaining ingredients; toss lightly to combine.
Cook, covered, over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes, or until squash is tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sauteed Zucchini
instructions: Heat olive oil in skillet.
Add zucchini and saute over high heat for 3 minutes.
Stir in basil and remaining ingredients. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Savory Baked Beans
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake, covered, in greased casserole dish at 350° for 20 minutes.
Uncover and cook for 15 minutes longer. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Savory Sauerkraut Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into buttered casserole dish.
Bake for 2 hours at 300°.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Scalloped Cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
Cut off the crust of bread.
Butter bread on both sides and cut each into 4 quarters.
Place layer of bread on bottom of oiled casserole.
Layer cheese and bread alternately in casserole.
Mix well the milk, beaten eggs and salt.
Pour liquid mixture into the casserole over the bread.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes until brown.
Serves 4 as a main dish, 6 as a side dish.

recipes.title: Scalloped Cheese Potatoes
instructions: In a large bowl, combine potatoes and soup.

Layer half of the mixture in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Dot with half of the butter and sprinkle with half of the cheese. Repeat layers. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Yields 12 servings.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Cook onion and green pepper in 1 Tbsp. of the margarine till tender.
Combine egg, milk, 1/3 cup of the crushed crackers, and dash of pepper.
Stir in onion mixture and corn.
Pour into a greased 1-quart casserole.
Melt remaining margarine; toss with remaining crumbs.
Sprinkle crumb mixture atop corn mixture.
Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes or till a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine; add to beaten eggs and remaining ingredients and mix well.
Place in a greased pan (7 x 11-inch) and bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.
The casserole is ready to eat when brown on top and not soggy in the center.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn Supreme
instructions: Heat milk and corn gradually.
Stir in egg.
Add next four ingredients and dash of pepper.
Mix well.
Pour into greased 8-inch round baking dish.
Top with buttered crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Scalloped Green Beans And Celery
instructions: Cook cut-up celery in water to cover until almost tender. Drain, saving liquid.
Make a white sauce of 4 tablespoons butter, the flour, milk, celery liquid and salt.
When thickened, add shredded cheese to melt, but do not boil.
Butter the crumbs and brown in a greased baking dish, place half the cooked beans, celery and bread crumbs.
Then add the remainder of vegetables and all of the cheese sauce.
Top with buttered crumbs and place in oven at 375° for 25 minutes or until brown and hot.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Scalloped Oysters
instructions: Grease a baking dish.
Arrange a layer of the combined cracker and bread crumbs in the bottom of it, then a layer of oysters, butter in small pieces, salt and pepper.
Repeat, having a layer of crumbs on top with small pieces of butter dotted over them. Have only 2 layers of oysters.
Moisten with milk and oyster liquor combined.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until brown. Serve at once.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Scalloped Oysters Corn
instructions: Mix well and pour into greased casserole.
Sprinkle on top 2 tablespoons melted margarine and 1/2 cup crackers (11).
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potato Bake
instructions: Spread 4 cups sliced potatoes in bottom of greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish.
Combine remaining ingredients, 3/4 teaspoon of salt and dash of pepper.
Pour half of the mixture over the potatoes.
Repeat layers.
Cover; bake at 350° for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 30 to 45 minutes longer.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes And Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine potatoes and onions in a large saucepan and parboil until almost tender.
Drain and arrange in a shallow baking dish.
Distribute tomatoes and mushrooms over the potatoes; dot with butter and top with cheese and then crumbs. Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and juices have mostly evaporated.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes With Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops in hot oil.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Stir in flour, 1 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Add chicken broth; cook, stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil.
Place potatoes in bottom of 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish.
Top with onion rings. Pour chicken broth mixture evenly over top.
Top with pork chops. Cover with foil.
Bake in 350° oven 1 hour.
Remove cover and continue baking 30 minutes or until meat is tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Scalloped Sausage And Potatoes
instructions: In skillet, break sausage into small pieces; brown lightly and drain well.
Place half of the potatoes in 2-quart casserole; sift half the flour over and sprinkle with half the salt.
Top with half the sausage, then half the cheese.
Repeat with remaining potatoes, flour, salt, sausage and cheese.
Pour milk over all. Cover and bake in a moderate oven (350°) for 50 to 60 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
Uncover and bake 10 minutes more. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Scalloped Strawberries
instructions: Wash and hull strawberries and mix with sugar.
Put alternate layers and bread cubes into a buttered baking dish.
Dot with butter and bake in a hot oven.
Serve hot with cream.
Bake at 400° oven for 30 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Scalloped Yams And Apples
instructions: Arrange half the yams, cut side down, in shallow 2-quart baking dish.
Add half the apples.
Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle half on mixture.
Repeat layers.
Cover with lid or foil and bake at 350° until apples are tender, about an hour.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Scallopini Chicken
instructions: Season flour with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Dredge breasts in flour mixture, then in eggs, then bread crumbs and cheese, which have been combined.
Melt butter in a skillet and brown breasts on both sides.
Continue cooking for about 5 minutes or until done. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Scallops Maison
instructions: Combine scallops and mushrooms in a shallow casserole. Combine wine, soup, half and half and curry powder.
Pour over scallops and bake at
350° for 40 minutes.
Serve over rice. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Scampi(Microwave)
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart glass casserole dish, cook butter on Roast for 1 1/2 minutes.
Add garlic; cook on High for 1 1/2 minutes or until butter is bubbly.
Mix in Parmesan cheese, parsley, lemon juice and shrimp.
Cook on High for 2 minutes or until shrimp are cooked.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Scotch Scones
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together.
Blend in butter.
Add sour milk.
Turn out onto floured board.
Pat or roll gently to 1/2 to 1-inch thick in a rectangle about 4 x 8 inches.
Cut in 16 triangles.
Place on baking sheet.
Brush with egg wash.
Bake in hot oven (400°) about 15 minutes.
Makes 16 scones.

recipes.title: Scrambled Eggs, Bacon And Tortillas

ingredients.notes: fried and crumbled or 1/2 c. diced ham (optional)

instructions: In a medium sized pan, fry tortillas in cooking oil, stirring until browned. Add crumbled bacon or diced ham (if desired) and warm.
Add eggs and scramble entire mixture over medium heat until eggs are cooked through.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Seafood Fettuccine
instructions: In a large pan melt butter over medium heat.
Add garlic and carrot; saute.
Stir in flour and salt.
Blend in half and half and milk.
Stir in parsley and basil.
Cook 5 to 10 minutes or until thickened and bubbly, stirring constantly.
Stir in shrimp and scallops. Increase temperature to medium-high.
Cook about 8 minutes or until seafood is opaque, stirring frequently.
Stir in cooked fettuccine.
Toss to coat.
Heat through.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Seafood Mushroom Caps
instructions: Wash mushrooms and drain.
Remove stems; reserve for later use.
Drain fish and pat dry.
In food processor, place fish. Combine cream cheese, shallots, lemon juice and mustard.
Cover and process until smooth.
Add 3 tablespoons Parmesan cheese to fish.
Stir well; season to taste with salt and pepper.
Fill mushrooms with fish mixture including parsley.
Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese.
Bake in a 425° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until heated through.
Let stand a few minutes before serving.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Seafood Spread

ingredients.notes: tuna or shrimp, drained and flaked

instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients.
Mix well. Refrigerate.
Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Seafood Supreme
instructions: Gently combine all ingredients.
Turn into a glass casserole and bake 1 hour at 350°.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Seafood-Cucumber Filling

ingredients.notes: drained (press moisture out between paper towels)

instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill thoroughly.
Yields about 1 1/2 cups.
Double the recipe for a tea for 40 to 50.

recipes.title: Seashore Casserole(Kids Can Make This)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and chips; mix well. Place in a casserole.
Sprinkle cheese and chips evenly on top. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Self-Filling Cupcakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Spoon into paper lined muffin tins, filling 3/4 full. Mix the softened cheese, egg, salt and sugar together until light and fluffy. Add the chips.
Drop by teaspoon into each cupcake. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes; check for doneness.
Makes about 2 dozen cupcakes. Frost with favorite icing, if desired.

recipes.title: Semur Indonesian
instructions: Cut round steak into 1/2 inch squares.
Heat oil in skillet over medium heat; saute round steak.
Then add onion, garlic powder, sugar and pepper.
Cook, stirring until onion is golden. Add water and soy sauce. Simmer, covered one hour.
Serve over noodles, rice or mashed potatoes.
Serves 4.
(Canned mushrooms can be added at end of cooking time.)

recipes.title: Sesame Flank Steak
instructions: In a 8 to 10-inch heavy frying pan, stir sesame seed over low heat until golden, 2 to 3 minutes.
Crush in a mortar and pestle or food processor.
In a bowl, mix onion, soy sauce, oil, vinegar, brown sugar, ginger, garlic, mustard, Worcestershire and sesame seed.
Place steak in a 9 x 13-inch dish and pour sesame mixture over top.
Cover and chill, turning occasionally, at least 4 hours or overnight.
Cook steak over hot coals, turning once to your liking, 5 to 6 minutes a side for medium-rare.
Cut across the grain in thin slices to serve.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sesame Potato Spears
instructions: Pare and cut potatoes in strips.
Grease a cookie sheet and place potatoes on the sheet, arranging them so they do not touch. Brush with melted butter. Sprinkle salt, paprika and sesame seed over the top. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Turn, if you wish. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Banana Split Cake
instructions: Cut margarine into flour until crumbly.
Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 400°.
Beat powdered sugar, egg whites and softened margarine until smooth.
Spread on cooled layer.
Drain pineapple.
Spread over second layer.
Slice bananas and distribute over the pineapple.
Slice the strawberries and spread over the bananas.
Spread the whipped topping over the strawberries.
Sprinkle the nuts over the whipped topping layer. This serves 12 to 15.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to moderate (350°). Place above ingredients in a 2-quart baking dish with tight-fitting lid.

Layer ingredients in this order: rice, corn, sprinkle of salt and pepper, 1 can tomato sauce, 4 ounces water, chopped onion, chopped green pepper, ground beef, sprinkle of salt and pepper again, second can of tomato sauce, 2 ounces water and cover with bacon strips, cut in half. Bake, covered, one hour.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer, until bacon is crisp.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Dip
instructions: Mix beans and seasoning mix.
Spread on bottom of 9-in. pie plate.
Layer remaining ingredients over bean mixture. Refrigerate.
Serve with tortilla chips.
Serves 6-8.

recipes.title: Shortcake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients and cut in shortening.
Add beaten egg and milk and mix well.
Put in muffin tins and bake at 400° until browned.
Makes 12 and that depends on the size of the muffin tin. Good with any fresh fruit, especially strawberries.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Clam Bites
instructions: Combine eggs and bread crumbs.
Stir in cheese, clams, shrimp, onions and pimiento.
Spread mixture in greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Cut into bars.
Serve warm.
Makes 24.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Rice Casserole
instructions: Shell, devein and wash shrimp.
Cut in chunks.
Combine with remaining ingredients.
Turn into a greased casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until firm.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Bisque
instructions: In saucepan on low heat, heat all ingredients, stirring often, until hot and shrimp turn pink.
Yields approximately 5 servings of 1 cup each.

recipes.title: Shrimp Cocktail Sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients together in a jar and shake until blended.
Chill in refrigerator.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Curry With Rice
instructions: Cook onions, garlic and ginger in butter until lightly browned.
Add curry, flour, salt and pepper and blend.
Add chicken broth gradually and cook and stir until thick.
Add shrimp.
Serve
over rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except chili sauce.
When mixture is smooth, add chili sauce.
Serve with crackers or chips.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Fry shrimp in oil in deep frying pan for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add eggs, salt and pepper. Fry over medium for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the rice and soy sauce.
Fry 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Garnish with chopped scallions. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fritters
instructions: Bring water to a boil with butter, add flour all at once, stirring well until mixture leaves the side of saucepan.
Remove from heat and add well beaten eggs, stir until smooth and thick. Stir in shrimp and cheese.
Drop by small spoonfuls into shallow hot fat.
Brown on both sides.
Serves 6.
May double recipe.

recipes.title: Shrimp In Lemon Garlic Sauce
instructions: Clean, peel and devein shrimp and set aside.
Position knife blade in food processor bowl; add next 8 ingredients to bowl and top with cover.
Process for 30 seconds or until well mixed.
With processor running, add butter through food chute; process 1 minute or until sauce is thickened.
Set aside.
Heat oil in large skillet to 375°.
Combine flour, salt and pepper.
Drain shrimp and dredge in flour mixture.
Fry shrimp in hot oil until golden brown.
Turn once; drain.
Arrange shrimp in 4 or 5 individual baking dishes and top with sauce.
Broil shrimp 30 to 45 seconds. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Jambalaya
instructions: Spray saucepan with nonstick cooking oil.
Place onion over medium heat.
Saute onion until clear.
Add all ingredients, except shrimp.
Stir well.
Add shrimp; cover and cook on very low heat for 35 minutes.
Uncover and toss rice.
Cover again and cook very slowly until rice is done.
Yields 2 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Noodle Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients together, except 1/4 cup chow mein noodles.
Pour into greased, 2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup noodles on top.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Makes approximately 3 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Quiches
instructions: Separate rolls into 2 equal pieces.
Cut in half.
Press into small muffin tins.
Divide shrimp.
Blend all ingredients.
Divide among shells.
Sprinkle cheese over each.
Bake at 350°
for 20 minutes or until brown.
Cool and freeze.
When you want to serve them, place the frozen quiche on baking sheet and reheat for 15 minutes.
Makes 24 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Rice
instructions: Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp.
Crumble and set aside.
Drain and reserve 2 tablespoons of drippings.
Add onion and celery.
Cook until tender, but not brown.
Stir in flour. Stir in Worcestershire sauce and shrimp.
Cook and stir about 3 minutes or until shrimp turn pink.
Add margarine; stir until melted.
Combine shrimp mixture and hot rice.
Garnish with bacon. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Mix shrimp, celery, onion, and potato.	Mix other ingredients for sauce; pour desired amount of sauce over shrimp mixture and mix well.
Let set in refrigerator for 1 or 2 hours.
Serve on lettuce leaves.
Serves 2-4.

recipes.title: Shrimp Sauteed With Wine And Mushrooms
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in pan.
Add mushrooms, green onions and basil; saute about 5 minutes.
Dredge shrimp in flour, saute in mushroom pan until just cooked through (2 minutes).
Add wine, 4 tablespoons butter, lemon juice and parsley.
Mix and serve over cooked rice.
Serves 2.

recipes.title: Shrimp Stuffed In Bell Peppers
instructions: Cut off tops; remove seeds from peppers.
Cook pepper shells in boiling water for 5 minutes, then put at once into cold water.
Cut shrimp slightly.
Combine with eggs, crumbs and milk.
Saute chopped ingredients in butter for 3 minutes; add to shrimp mixture. Add seasonings; stuff into pepper shells, putting a few bread crumbs and a drop of butter on top of each.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in moderate oven (375°).
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Shrimp With Shallots And Cream Sauce
instructions: Shell, devein, rinse and dry shrimp.

Heat butter in a large skillet over high heat until brown. Add shrimp and saute 2 minutes on each side. Remove from skillet and keep warm. Add chopped shallots; saute for 1 minute over high heat. Combine wine, salt, pepper, parsley and tomato paste.
Add to skillet and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add cream and thyme; boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and strain.
Divide shrimp among 4 plates and spoon on sauce.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp, Spinach And Cheese Souffle
instructions: In a saucepan, melt butter or margarine.
Blend in flour.
Add milk.
Cook and stir until bubbly.
Remove from heat; stir in cheese.
Fold in spinach and shrimp.
Beat egg yolks 5 minutes or until thick and lemon colored.
Stir in shrimp mixture.
Wash beaters and in large mixer bowl beat egg whites to stiff peaks. Gradually fold egg whites into shrimp mixture.
Turn mixture into an ungreased 1 1/2-quart souffle dish.
Bake in 325° oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Serve immediately.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Shrimply Delicious Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl of food processor and process until smooth.
Makes about 3 cups. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Silver Creek Salmon Potato Strata
instructions: In large bowl, combine salmon, onion, celery, eggs, milk, 1/2 teaspoon salt, dill and pepper.
Mix well.
Pare potatoes and cut into thin slices.
Place half of potatoes in greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt and spread half of salmon mixture over potatoes.
Repeat with remaining potatoes, salt and salmon.
Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender when pierced with fork. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Simple Salisbury Steak
instructions: In bowl, mix thoroughly 1/4 cup soup, hamburger, bread crumbs, egg and onion.
Shape firmly into 6 oval patties.
In skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon hot fat, cook the patties until brown. Spoon off fat.
Stir in remaining soup and mushrooms.
Return patties to skillet.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until done, turning occasionally.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Simple Scalloped Potatoes(Cooking Time 30 Minutes)
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole, combine potatoes, flour, salt and onion.
Toss lightly.
Stir in milk and butter.
Cook, covered, 5 minutes, or until milk is just about to boil.
Stir mixture, then cook on Defrost 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Let stand, covered, for 3 to 5 minutes.
If desired, sprinkle with paprika or parsley.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Sinkhole Stew

ingredients.notes: picked over (can substitute 1 quart fresh oysters, undrained)

instructions: If using oysters, make sure any shell particles are removed. In large saucepan, cook onion and celery in margarine until tender.
Add mushrooms and cook for one minute.
Over low heat, stir flour, salt and pepper into vegetable mixture.
Add milk gradually until thickened, being careful not to boil.
Add cheese and stir until melted.
Add crab (or oysters), soup, pimento and hot pepper sauce.
Over low heat, cook for 5 to 10 minutes or until oysters begin to curl.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Six Layer Dinner
instructions: In order given, layer ingredients in greased 2-quart baking dish.
Season each layer with salt and pepper.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Six-Layer Sausage Casserole
instructions: Lightly brown sausage; drain on paper towel and cut into small pieces.
Into a 2-quart dish, place the vegetables in order given. Sprinkle with seasoning mixed together and top with sausage. Cover and bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350°.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Skillet Dinner
instructions: Brown beef, onion and green peppers.
Add tomatoes, sour cream, macaroni and seasoning.
Cover and bring to a boil; turn to simmer and steam for 25 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Skillet Festive Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken well.
In bag, combine flour, salt and chili powder.
Shake chicken, a few pieces at a time, in flour mixture to coat.
In large skillet, brown chicken in oil.
Meanwhile, in small bowl, combine remaining ingredients except hot cooked rice. Mix well.
Pour tomato mixture over chicken.
Simmer covered 40 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in center.
Serve over hot cooked rice.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Skillet Salad
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp.
Remove from skillet; pour off fat, except for 1 tablespoonful.
Combine onion, salt, brown sugar and vinegar in tablespoon of drippings left in skillet.
Toss parsley and cabbage in hot drippings.
Add crumbled bacon.
Heat thoroughly.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Skillet Sausage Peppers
instructions: In large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat.
Add peppers, onion and garlic; saute 5 to 8 minutes.
Remove.
Add sausage to skillet; saute 10 minutes or until browned.
Return peppers, garlic and onion to skillet.
Add tomatoes and oregano; bring to boil.
Reduce heat to medium; cook 12 to 14 minutes. Toss with egg noodles.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Skillet Twin Loaves
instructions: Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, chopped onion, parsley, eggs, 1/2 can tomato sauce, salt and pepper.
Form into 2 oval loaves, about 3 x 5-inches.
Brown on all sides in oil by turning loaves with large spoon and spatula or 2 spatulas.
When loaves are browned, add remaining ingredients, cover and simmer 1 hour, basting occasionally.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Skillet Zucchini Dinner
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion together.
Drain and add tomatoes, zucchini, corn, and spices.
Simmer 20 to 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Skinny Dips
instructions: Cut potatoes in half lengthwise.
Scoop out most of potato. Sprinkle cheese, bacon and green onion over skins.
Heat in oven at 350° for 4 to 5 minutes, until cheese is bubbly.
Serve with dressing.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sloppy Toms
instructions: Use your hands to break up ground turkey to put in skillet. Add onions.
Turn burner to medium-high.
Cook, stirring with a wooden spoon about 10 minutes, until all pink is out.
Drain fat (if any).
Stir tomato sauce, chili powder, mustard and Worcestershire sauce into meat mixture.
Cook on high until bubbly, stirring now and then, for 5 minutes.
Spoon meat mixture on bun and sprinkle with shredded cheese.
Makes 8.

recipes.title: Smokey Beef Ribs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Cut ribs into serving size pieces. Arrange in a single layer in a shallow baking pan.
Bake loosely covered for 45 minutes.
Stir together remaining ingredients. Reserve half of sauce.
Brush ribs lightly with sauce.
Broil for 10 minutes.
Turn ribs; brush with remaining sauce.
Broil for 5 minutes, basting frequently.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Smothered Okra
instructions: In a skillet, cook onion and green pepper in butter for about 5 minutes.
Stir in okra, tomatoes, salt, red pepper and black pepper.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 30 to 35 minutes for fresh okra, 15 minutes for frozen okra or until okra is tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Snappy Bean Bake
instructions: Drain beans; put half of them in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Blend soup, milk, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and ripe olives. Turn half of it over beans; sprinkle with half the potato chips. Repeat with beans, soup and chips.
Bake in moderately hot oven (375°) for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serves 4 or 5.

recipes.title: Snappy Tuna Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.
Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend.
Serve tuna salad on a bed of lettuce or between bread slices.
Makes 2 servings.
Recipe can be doubled or tripled.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well.
Sift the dry ingredients and stir in.
Roll into balls the size of small walnuts.
Roll into sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
(These cookies puff up at first, then flatten out.)
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Snowflake Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and cheese well.
Add sugar gradually and continue creaming.
Beat in egg yolk, vanilla and orange peel. Sift flour with salt and cinnamon.
Add to creamed mixture.
Fill cookie press; form fancy cookies on ungreased cookie sheet. Decorate with colored sugar.
Bake in 350° oven for 10 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Soft Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add the beaten egg and molasses. Add the flour, baking soda and spices.
Mix well.
The dough will be a little sticky.
Shape the dough into balls the size of a walnut.
Roll the ball in granulated sugar and bake for 7 to 8 minutes (no longer) at 350°.
Makes 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Soft Molasses Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs and vanilla and beat well.
Combine soda and molasses and add to creamed mixture.
Gradually stir in flour, then add raisins.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheets and bake at 350° for 8 minutes or until browned.
Makes 6 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Sonny'S Pizza Dough
instructions: Put yeast in water; add salt and oil.
Add flour; knead until smooth.
Put in greased bowl; raise 1 hour.
Punch down; let rest 10 minutes.
Divide in half; roll out.
Makes 2 (16 inch) pizzas.

recipes.title: Sopapillas
instructions: Mix dry ingredients well.
Beat liquid ingredients and pour into dry ingredients.
Knead well.
Dough may be sticky.
Cover and let set for 20 minutes.
Roll thinly on floured board.
Cut into 3 to 4-inch squares or triangles and fry in deep hot oil. Drain and serve hot with honey.
Yields 16 pieces.

recipes.title: Soul Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef, onions
and
pepper in skillet.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into baking dish and bake at 350° for about 20 minutes or
until mixture is bubbly.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Souper Tuna Noodle Bake
instructions: In pan, cook onion in butter until tender.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into 2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until hot.
Stir. Top with sliced cheese and croutons. Bake until cheese melts.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Sour Cream And Green Bean Soup
instructions: Saute onion and chunked potatoes in oleo.
Add 1 quart water. Cook until potatoes are tender.
Add green beans with juice and milk.
Do not boil from this point on.
With electric mixer, beat the sour cream and flour.
Introduce a little hot liquid at a time to sour cream mixture.
Add slowly to soup.
Stir for 5 minutes, until flour is cooked in.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Again, do not boil.
Makes approximately 2 quarts of soup.
A meatless delight!

recipes.title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Make filling by stirring together cheese, chicken and onion. Place spoonful of filling on each tortilla.
Add a spoonful of sauce made of soup, sour cream, green chilies and salt.
Roll tortillas and place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour remaining sauce on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: South-Of-The-Border Dip
instructions: Combine refried beans and taco seasoning mix; spoon mixture into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Spread sour cream over bean mixture and top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve hot with corn chips or tortilla chips.
Makes about 5 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Southern Biscuit Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease 12 (2 1/2-inch) muffin cups. (These muffins brown better on the sides and bottom when baked without paper liners.)
In large bowl, combine flour, sugar and baking powder.
Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in milk just until flour mixture is moistened. Spoon into muffin cups.
Bake 20 minutes or until golden.
Remove from pan.
Cool on wire rack. Serve with jelly, jam or honey. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Southern Chicken Casserole

ingredients.notes: cut up or use favorite pieces

instructions: In a skillet, fry bacon until crisp and remove.
Add chicken, browning well on all sides.
Remove to a 2-quart casserole dish as pieces brown.
Add vegetables, if desired, on top of chicken.
Cut potatoes into slices or chunks.
Add to bacon fat and brown. Remove.
Add as next layer in the casserole dish.
Top potatoes with onions.
Sprinkle with seasoning, salt, pepper, green onions and parsley.
Top with bacon.
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Apple Rings
instructions: Mix sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt.
Slice apples in 1/2-inch slices.
Heat butter in heavy frying pan.
Add apple rings and 1/2 of sugar mixture; cook about 3 minutes.
Turn. Sprinkle with remainder of sugar mixture.
Continue cooking until apples are almost transparent.
Serve hot.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Southern Pork Chop And Rice Casserole

ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced (I use canned tomatoes)

instructions: Brown pork chops.
Place in shallow baking dish.
Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water.
Pour over chops.
Add rice and salt. Add vegetables; top with pepper and paprika.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until chops are tender.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Southern Slaw
instructions: Combine cabbage, carrot, onion and salad oil.
Toss until cabbage is coated.
Chill.
Mix remaining ingredients; combine with cabbage mixture.
Serve cold.
Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Southern-Style Jambalaya
instructions: Cook and stir chicken in hot butter in large skillet until lightly browned.
Add sausage, green pepper, onion and celery; cook until vegetables are just tender, about 5 minutes.
Mix in tomatoes and water; bring to a full boil.
Stir in rice, salt and hot pepper sauce.
Cover; remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork; sprinkle with parsley.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Southwest Salsa Dressing
instructions: In small bowl, stir all ingredients together.
Makes 4 servings (2 tablespoons per serving).

recipes.title: Southwestern Rice And Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a large salad bowl.
Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Southwestern Style Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 375°.
Place chicken breasts in greased 12 x 8-inch baking pan.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover with foil; bake 20 minutes.
In medium bowl combine cheese and chilies.
Pat on top of each chicken breast; sprinkle with green onion and bacon.
Return to oven uncovered.
Continue baking 12 to 15 minutes or until chicken is fork tender.
Place on serving plate; top with sour cream and avocado.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Soy Vinaigrette(Nuoc Xi Dau Giam)
instructions: In a jar, combine all the ingredients and shake well. Dressing will keep in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
Makes about 3/4 cup.

recipes.title: Soyed Chicken Wings
instructions: Place chicken wings in stock pot; sprinkle with ginger and wine.
Cover and simmer over medium-high heat until wine is almost evaporated.
Add remaining ingredients, mixed well.
Simmer and cook, covered, for 1 hour, stirring wings often and keeping heat at medium to medium-high.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain and keep warm.
In large frying pan, cook bacon over high heat until golden.
Reduce heat to medium and add onions and garlic, cook 5 minutes.
In medium bowl, mix half and half, milk, whipping cream and egg until well blended.
Toss with spaghetti, add bacon mixture and cook over low heat until thoroughly heated.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and parsley.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Spanish Hamburger
instructions: Mix altogether and bake in oven at 350°.
Stir several times. Makes 24 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice - Microwave
instructions: In 2-quart microproof casserole combine all ingredients except rice.
Cook, covered, on High (max power) 5 minutes or until boiling.
Stir in rice, cook, covered, on 50 (Simmer) 30 to 35 minutes or until rice is tender.
Let stand, covered, 5 minutes before serving.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
Cooking time:
35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Spanish Skillet Rice
instructions: Cook meat, onion and garlic.
Drain.
Stir in rest of ingredients.
Cover and simmer 35 to 40 minutes.
Add more water, if it becomes dry before the rice is cooked.
Toss before serving. Use an electric frying pan to cook the Spanish rice in and you can control the simmering heat better.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Spanish Steak
instructions: Pound flour into meat.
In large skillet, brown meat in hot oil.
Drain off excess fat.
Combine remaining ingredients; pour over steak.
Cover and simmer 45 to 50 minutes or until meat is tender.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Special Cabbage
instructions: Place
cabbage in shallow 4 quart casserole.
Pour milk over; sprinkle with bread crumbs and dot with butter.
Cover; bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes or until crumbs are lightly browned and cabbage is tender.	Makes 6 generous servings.

recipes.title: Special Chocolate Icing
instructions: Combine corn syrup, water and butter in saucepan.
Bring to boil quickly, stirring until butter is melted.
Remove from heat; add chocolate.
Stir until completely melted.
Cool to room temperature before pouring over cake, petit fours or desired dessert to glaze; chill until set.
Yields about 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Speedy Cranberry Sauce

ingredients.notes: peeled, cored and chopped medium fine

instructions: In a saucepan, combine sugar, water, cranberries and chopped apples.
Boil rapidly until skins of berries pop open, about 5 minutes.
Cool.
Refrigerate until served.
Makes 1 1/4 quarts. Keeps well in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Spiced Apple And Raisin Sauce
instructions: In medium skillet, cook apple in margarine until tender.
Stir in brown sugar and cloves.
In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients; blend well.
Stir into apple mixture and cook until mixture boils and thickens, stirring constantly.
Serve warm sauce over turkey.
Makes 2 cups sauce.

recipes.title: Spiced Apple Syrup
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine juice, cloves, cinnamon stick and water.
Heat to boiling.
Simmer 5 minutes or until syrup measures 3/4 cup.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Spiced Baked Ham Slice
instructions: Slash outside fat about 1-inch apart to prevent curling. Stick whole cloves around edge of ham.
Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over ham slice in shallow pan or baking dish.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour. Serve with green peas and broiled grapefruit slices, bananas or peach halves sprinkled with cinnamon or nutmeg. Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Spicy Apple Chutney
instructions: Chop cored apples, tomatoes, onions, peppers and raisins. Combine with remaining ingredients.
Cook until thick.
Pour into sterilized jars and seal while hot.
This is an excellent meat relish and it makes about 4 quarts.

recipes.title: Spicy Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Cut ribs into serving size pieces.
Combine remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Pour into a large shallow dish.
Add ribs, cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, turning ribs occasionally.
Drain, reserving marinade.
Place ribs on grill, bone side down, over slow coals for 30 minutes.
Brush with sauce and cook another 30 minutes, basting and turning frequently. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Spicy Bean Dip
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine all ingredients.
Heat thoroughly over medium-high heat until cheese is melted and texture is smooth, stirring frequently, approximately 5 to 7 minutes.
Serve warm with nacho chips for dipping.
Makes 3 cups.

recipes.title: Spicy Cabbage Casserole
instructions: In a deep heavy skillet over moderately high heat, combine the beef, onion, garlic, bell pepper, oregano, salt and pepper, stirring constantly until brown.
Add the tomatoes, tomato sauce and rice and mix thoroughly.
In a buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole, arrange layers of the meat mixture, the cabbage and the cheese. Bake the casserole, covered, at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Spicy Nuts
instructions: Combine egg whites and water.
Add nuts and coat thoroughly. In a separate bowl, combine sugar, pumpkin pie spice, salt and pepper.
Add to nuts.
Toss until well coated.
Spread mixture on a lightly oiled baking dish.
Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.
Remove and break into clusters.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Spicy Peanut Dip
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together all ingredients until smooth. Chill for 1 hour.
For dipping, serve with assorted fresh or blanched vegetables and pickled baby corn.
Makes 1 1/4 cups.

recipes.title: Spicy Plantation Chicken
instructions: Combine egg, buttermilk and 1 tablespoon of oil.
Sift together the flour, curry powder, salt and pepper.
Blend flour mixture into the buttermilk mixture; beat until smooth.
Dip chicken pieces into batter; drain.
Cook batter chicken in deep 350° oil for about 12 minutes or until chicken is done.
Fried chicken recipe serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Spicy Roasted Peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a heavy skillet, cook oil, garlic and red pepper flakes over medium heat about 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Add peanuts and stir until well blended.
Pour peanut mixture onto a baking sheet.
Bake about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Bake to lightly browned.
Sprinkle paprika and chili powder over peanuts and stir.
Allow peanuts to cool completely. Yields 6 cups peanuts.

recipes.title: Spicy Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown beef.
Add onion, green pepper, salt, brown sugar, chili powder, bay leaf and rest of the ingredients.
Cook, covered, until rice and vegetables are done.
Stir often.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Spider Corncake
instructions: Sift cornmeal, flour and soda together; add sour milk, eggs, 1 c. sweet milk and sugar and mix.
In heavy, shallow baking dish melt 1 Tbsp. butter.
Pour in batter.
Over top pour 1 c. sweet milk.
Bake 50 minutes at 350°.
Cut in wedges.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Spinach Artichoke Dip
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients together.
Spoon into 9-inch pan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly brown. Serve with tortilla chips or crackers. Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Spinach Lasagna Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
In large saucepan, cook noodles; drain. Rinse with hot water; set aside.
Brown turkey and drain.
Stir in tomato sauce, paste, sugar, basil, garlic powder, oregano and pepper.
Stir in noodles.
In medium bowl combine cheese, sour cream, milk and onion; beat until smooth.
Spoon 1/2 of noodle mixture in a 2-quart baking dish or 12 x 8-inch dish.
Top evenly with cheese mixture.
Spoon spinach evenly over cheese mixture. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until heated through.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Cook spinach according to the directions on the box.
Drain spinach thoroughly.
Shred cheese, chop onion and bacon.
Mix together eggs and milk.
In a bowl combine cheese, onion, bacon (grease drained) and spinach.
Add egg/milk mixture.
Pour into pie pans.
Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 4 hungry people.

recipes.title: Spinach Spread
instructions: Wash and drain spinach; place on paper towels. Press until spinach is barely moist.
Combine spinach and cream cheese; mix well, stirring in remaining ingredients.
Spoon into a lightly greased 2-cup baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Spread on crackers or party rye bread. Yield: 2 cups.

recipes.title: Spring Garden Special
instructions: Saute onions and meat until thoroughly cooked.
Add tomatoes and seasonings and cook for a short time.
Add green beans and carrots.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Spring Pie
instructions: In medium bowl, stir boiling water into gelatin until completely dissolved.
Add sherbet; mix until melted.
Refrigerate about 25 minutes, or until mixture is slightly thickened.
Fold in whipped topping, marshmallows and pineapple.
Pour into crust. Freeze until firm.
Remove from freezer 20 to 30 minutes before serving.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Stan'S Hamburger Noodle Bake
instructions: Brown meat in butter.
Add tomato sauce, garlic, salt and sugar.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
While mixture is cooking mix cream cheese, sour cream, green onions and Cheddar cheese in a bowl. Combine cheese mixture with meat mixture and cooked noodles
and place in a 2-quart casserole.
Bake in a 350°
oven for 30 to 40 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Starburst Salad
instructions: Arrange lettuce wedges in salad bowl.
Combine carrots, zucchini, mushrooms and olives.
Toss lightly.
Place over lettuce wedges.
Chill. Combine sour cream and dressing, mixing until blended.
Serve with salad.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Steak Quesadillas
instructions: Pound steak with a tenderizing mallet.
Marinate 1 hour in soy sauce and water.
Grill until done and slice across the grain in very thin strips.
In a large skillet, lay down one tortilla and spread with half of the cheese, tomatoes, jalapenos and chopped cilantro.
Top with half of the steak and the other tortillas. Cook on stove top until bottom tortilla is toasted.
Flip quesadilla over and cook until other side is toasted and cheese is melted.
Remove from pan; cut into sixths and serve with salsa and sour cream.
Repeat for other quesadillas.
Serves 1 to 2.

recipes.title: Sticky Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°.
Brown chicken and place in baking pan. Mix tomatoes, soup mix and wine together and pour over chicken. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
When done, sprinkle cheese over top. Return to oven until cheese melts.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Stifado
instructions: Cut beef into small pieces.
Dice onion.
Saute beef in oil. Add onion and saute together for three minutes.
Add tomatoes, vinegar, wine, bay leaves, salt, pepper, nutmeg, cinnamon, paprika, parsley and 2 cups warm water.
Cook on low heat for 2 1/2 hours. Peel onions and carve them like cross.
In a pan melt butter; add 1 cup water.
Add onions, garlic and salt.
Cook on low heat until water is gone.
Add onions to the beef and cook for the last 30 minutes of cooking.
Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Stir And Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 400°.
Mix eggs, sugar, oil, lemon peel and vanilla thoroughly.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Drop by teaspoonfuls, about 2 inches apart, on an ungreased baking sheet. Flatten with a greased bottom of glass dipped in sugar.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Carrots And Mushrooms
instructions: Heat butter and oil in skillet until bubbly; add carrots, mushrooms and onions.
Cook and stir about 8 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Stir in lemon juice, salt and pepper. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Stir-Fry Medley
instructions: Heat electric wok or skillet at 325° for 2 to 3 minutes; add oil and heat 1 minute.
Add celery, onion and broccoli; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add cabbages and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Cover and cook vegetables over low heat 3 minutes.
Stir in salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce.
Serve immediately.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Stove-Top Baked Beans
instructions: Cook
bacon
until crisp;
drain.
Saute onion and bell pepper in
drippings
until
tender.
Add
beans and crumbled bacon with rest of ingredients.
Simmer in nonstick pan for 30 to 45 minutes. Time of preparation: 30 to 45 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Strata(Very Good)
instructions: Butter 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle bread cubes evenly over bottom.
Sprinkle cooked sausage over crumbs.
Place pepper and onions over sausage.
Mix eggs, milk, cheese, mustard, Worcestershire and paprika.
Pour over sausage.
Sprinkle bacon over top.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Serves 12 to 15.

recipes.title: Strawberry Ice Cream
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in saucepan.
Add egg yolk and 1/4 cup milk; mix well.
Stir in rest of milk and cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until thickened.
Cool.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour into freezer tray.
Freeze until almost firm.
Turn into mixing bowl and beat until creamy.
Add egg whites and beat until doubled in volume.
Fold in berries.
Refreeze.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Scones
instructions: In large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt.
Cut butter into flour mixture until coarse crumbs form. Stir in strawberries.
Add buttermilk and mix with fork just until dough is moistened.
Gather dough into a ball and roll or pat into a 3/4-inch thick circle.
Cut into hearts (approximately 12) and place on greased baking sheet 1 1/2-inches apart.
Brush tops of scones with cream.
Place on bottom rack of a 400° oven for 14 minutes.
Makes 1 dozen.

recipes.title: Strawberry Sodas
instructions: Mash strawberries and divide evenly among four glasses.
Add 2 tablespoons of cream to each glass and mix.
Add ice cream and fill glasses with ginger ale.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Lemon Pie
instructions: In a saucepan, combine granulated sugar and cornstarch.
Add water, egg yolk and butter.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly; cook 2 minutes more.
Remove from heat.
Stir in lemon juice.
Pour into baked crust.
Top with sliced berries.
In small mixer bowl, beat together cream cheese and powdered sugar.
Fold in the 1/3 cup coconut.
In another bowl, beat whipping cream to soft peaks; fold into cream cheese mixture until combined.
Spread on top of the berries.
Sprinkle with the toasted coconut.
Chill 4 hours or overnight.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: String Bean Casserole
instructions: Melt butter; add onion, flour, sugar and sour cream.
Melt 3 slices Swiss cheese, cut up, and mix all with green beans which have been cooked 5 minutes and drained.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour covered on until bubbles.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Stroganoff For A Crowd
instructions: Partially freeze meat for easier cutting.
Cut meat into 2 x 1/2-inch strips.
In large Dutch oven or kettle, brown the meat, one pound at a time, in hot shortening.
Return all meat to kettle or Dutch oven; sprinkle with pepper.
Add onion, garlic and mushrooms.
Combine soup, beef broth and tomato paste; blend until smooth.
Add to meat; cover, simmering until meat is tender, about 1 1/4 hours, stirring occasionally.
Stir some of the hot mixture into sour cream; return to meat mixture and heat thoroughly (do not boil).
Cook noodles according to package directions.
Serve meat over hot noodles.
Serves 24.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage Head
instructions: Trim off outside of cabbage.
Cook in boiling water 45 minutes, or until almost tender.
Remove cabbage from water and drain.
Reserve 1/4 cup cabbage water.
Core cabbage, making a cavity through cabbage.
Blend meat, onion and garlic powder; add 2 tablespoons tomato sauce.
Stuff mixture into cabbage.
Place in deep pot.
Pour remaining tomato sauce over cabbage.
Cover; cook about 1 hour at 350°.
Remove from heat and serve with sauce. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Flatten chicken breasts.
Place slice of ham and swiss cheese on each chicken breast.
Tuck in and roll up like a jelly roll. Combine crumbs, parmesan and parsley.
In baking dish, melt butter on high for 30 - 40 seconds.
Dip chicken in butter, then roll in crumbs.
Arrange chicken rolls seam side down.
Cook, covered at 70 percent power in microwave for 12 - 15 minutes until done. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Stuffed Double Burgers
instructions: Combine beef, Worcestershire sauce and salt; mix lightly. Shape into 12 patties.
Top 6 patties with cheese and pickle slices.
Place remaining patties over filling; seal edges.
Place on rack over hot charcoal.
Grill 5 minutes on each side.
Yields 6 burgers.

recipes.title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Cut tops off peppers; set aside.
In a bowl, combine the next six ingredients.
Spoon into peppers.
Place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Combine soup and basil; spoon over peppers. Cover and bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until the beef is no longer pink.
Sprinkle with cheese; return to the oven for 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted.
Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Stuffed Super Burgers
instructions: Cream together cream cheese, sour cream and dill weed.
Stir in toasted bread crumbs, mushrooms and olives.
Shape beef into 12 thin patties, 4 to 5-inches in diameter.
Place on equal amount of cheese stuffing in center of each of 6 patties; top with remaining patties, pressing edges together to seat.
Place burgers on grill, 3 to 4-inches, from heat and broil at moderate temperature, 8 to 12 minutes on each side or until done.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sue'S Peanut Butter Fudgies
instructions: Combine sugar and cocoa in large saucepan.
Add milk, stirring until smooth.
Add butter. Place over high heat and bring to boil; boil 2 minutes and remove from heat.
Add peanut butter and stir until melted.
Add oats, mixing well.
Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper and cool completely.
Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies(Rolled)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and almond.
Add flour and baking powder; mix well.
Do not chill.
Roll out and cut.
Bake in 400° oven 8 to 10 minutes.
Decorate with icing. Makes 6 to 8 dozen.

recipes.title: Sugar Jumbles
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Sift in all dry ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon.
Bake on lightly greased baking sheet until delicately browned.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen 2-inch cookies.

recipes.title: Sugar Pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 225°.
In a plastic bag, mix sugar, cinnamon and salt.
In a large mixing bowl, mix egg white and water.
Stir in pecans and mix until damp.
Pour pecans in bag to coat and shake well; spread on a baking sheet and bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until dry.
Stir every 20 minutes during baking.
Do not freeze.
Keep in cool, dry place.
Makes 1 pound.

recipes.title: Sugared Asparagus
instructions: In a skillet over medium-high heat, heat butter and brown sugar until sugar is dissolved.
Add asparagus; saute for 2 minutes. Stir in chicken broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes or until asparagus is crisp-tender.
Remove asparagus to serving dish and keep warm.
Cook sauce, uncovered, until reduced by half.
Pour over asparagus and serve immediately. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Summer Blt Spread
instructions: Reserve 1 teaspoon bacon for garnish.
Combine remaining bacon, sour cream, mayo and tomatoes in medium bowl.
Cover and refrigerate.
Serve with crackers.
Makes 3 cups.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Icebox Pickles
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl.
Mix well. Refrigerate overnight.
Pack the vegetables tightly into quart jars.
Cover with brine.
Refrigerate.
These pickles keep well in the refrigerator for up to 3 months.
Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Sunday Casserole
instructions: Place meat in 13 x 9-inch casserole dish; place onion on top of meat.
Mix soup and water and pour over all.
Cover and bake at 325° for 3 hours.
Serve with hot noodles, rice or boiled potatoes.
There will be plenty of flavorful, self made gravy. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Sunday Dinner Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Then add eggs and stir in sugar, cooking oil, salt and flour.
Stir until batter is well mixed.
Let set on countertop overnight, then the next morning, roll out dough on floured board about 1/2-inch thick and cut with a biscuit cutter.
Place rolls in greased pan; cover with a clean cloth and let rise while at church or about 3/4 hour.
Bake in 400° oven until golden brown.
This recipe makes about 18 rolls.

recipes.title: Sunday Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken and oil.
Place about 1 cup flour mixture in a paper or plastic bag.
Shake a few chicken pieces in the bag at a time, coating well.
On medium-high, heat 1/4 inch of oil in a large skillet.
Brown chicken on all sides; remove to a large, shallow baking pan.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until done.
Recipe makes enough coating for three chickens.
Store unused mixture in airtight container. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Sunday Supper Casserole
instructions: Melt vegetable oil, add onion and cook until tender.
Stir in flour and salt.
Add milk and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thickened and beginning to boil.
Remove from heat.
Stir in mustard and cheese.
Cut or dice ham.
Arrange alternate layers of potatoes, ham and cheese sauce in 2-quart casserole which has been rubbed with Crisco or sprayed with vegetable oil.
Top with cheese sauce.
Bake in slow oven, 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Serve hot.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Sunshine Shake
instructions: In a blender, combine orange juice, milk, water, vanilla and ice cubes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Super Amazing Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and peanut butter.
Gradually add sugars and blend until mixed.
Add eggs, one at a time, and beat until smooth.
Stir together flour and soda and add to creamed mixture. Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop from a teaspoon onto greased baking sheet.
Slightly flatten dough with back of spoon.
Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen 2-inch cookies.

recipes.title: Super Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook bacon; drain and crumble.
Separate rolls into 8 triangles.
Place in an ungreased pizza pan to form a crust. Sprinkle bacon over crust evenly, then sprinkle hash brown potatoes over bacon.
Sprinkle Cheddar cheese evenly over that. In a bowl, beat the eggs, milk, salt and pepper; pour over crust. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top.
Bake in a 375° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
Let set a few minutes.
Slice.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Super Peanut Butter Sandwich
instructions: Combine peanut butter, cream cheese and honey; mix well. Spread on bread slices.
Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Super Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Refrigerate for several hours. Serve with tortilla chips.
Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Surprise Date Bread
instructions: Pour water over dates; let stand 5 minutes.
Sift together flour, soda, salt and sugar.
Add date mixture, egg, cheese, vanilla and nuts.
Mix well.
Pour into greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350°
for 45 minutes to 50 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Cool on rack.
Makes 1 loaf.
Very good served with softened cream cheese.

recipes.title: Sweet 'N Spicy Popcorn
instructions: Spray a cold 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Add popcorn.
Stir together remaining ingredients and add to popcorn.
Toss until coated.
Bake in a 350° oven for 15 minutes, stirring once or twice.
Transfer to a large piece of foil and stir completely. Makes 6 (3/4 cup) servings.
Contains 76 calories, 16 grams carbohydrates, 1 gram fat and 0 cholesterol.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Beef Stew
instructions: Brown meat in oil.
Add
and cook until tender over low heat brown
sugar,
carrots,
vinegar,
onions, Worcestershire sauce, tomato sauce and 1/2 cup water.
Combine cornstarch and 1/4 cup water and add to thicken.
Serve over rice, noodles or baked potatoes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut tips from chicken wings.
Dip wings in egg and then in cornstarch to which the garlic salt has been added.
Pour cooking oil into electric fry pan and turn to 350°.
Brown wings.
Make a sauce of the next 7 ingredients.
Place the meat in 10 x 10-inch pan.
Cover with sauce and bake 40 minutes at 375°.
Serves 5 to 6.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken(Chinese)
instructions: In large skillet or wok, stir-fry onion in garlic and ginger in hot oil for 1 minute.
Add peppers and stir until crisp-tender.
Remove from pan and add chicken.
Stir-fry until cooked.
Return vegetables to pan.
Mix cornstarch with soy sauce, pineapple juice, vinegar and sugar.
Pour into pan.
Add pineapple chunks.
Bring to a full boil.
Serve with hot rice.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender.
Can make 4 days ahead of time.
Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Pork Loin
instructions: Cut meat lengthwise, but not in two.
Pound until meat is 1/2 inch thick.
Cook bacon until limp.
In bacon drippings, cook onion and green pepper until tender.
Stir in rest of ingredients. Cook until thoroughly heated.
Spoon mixture into center of tenderloin.
Wrap bacon around tenderloin and secure with a toothpick.
Bake in covered roaster for 1 hour.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Salad Dressing
instructions: In blender, mix onion, salt, garlic, garlic salt, dry mustard, paprika, sugar and vinegar.
Add salad oil.
Blend again.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes 1 pint.

recipes.title: Sweet And Tangy Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine onion, garlic and oil in 1-quart casserole; cover with lid.
Microwave on High for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover.
Microwave on High 5 to 6 minutes.
Sauce can be covered and refrigerated for up to 2 weeks. Makes 1
1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients.
Cut in butter until crumbly. Stir together sweet potato, sour cream and buttermilk; add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened.
Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead 3 or 4 times.
Pat or roll to 1/2 inch thickness.
Cut dough with a 3 inch round cutter, and place biscuits on a lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 14 biscuits.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Cole Slaw
instructions: Combine cabbage, sweet potato, onion and bell pepper in a bowl; toss gently.
Combine remaining ingredients; stir well.
Add cabbage mix; cover and chill.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sweet Potatoes And Apricots
instructions: Cut potatoes lengthwise; place in 10 x 6
x 2-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle lightly with a little salt.
Drain apricots, reserving syrup.
Add water if necessary to equal 1 cup liquid and set aside.
Arrange apricots over sweet potatoes.
In saucepan, combine brown sugar, cornstarch, salt and cinnamon.
Cook and stir until mixture comes to boiling.
Stir in sherry and orange peel. Pour mixture over potatoes and fruit.
Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven, basting occasionally, for 20 minutes or until well glazed. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sweet Tater Pone
instructions: Grease a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. In a mixing bowl, combine sweet potatoes, nutmeg, sugar and 1/2 cup pecans.
Add the milk and egg. Pour into the prepared baking dish and sprinkle with remaining pecans. Dot with butter. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 to 60 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Sweet-And-Sour Chinese Meatballs

ingredients.notes: dissolved into 1/2 c. cold chicken or beef broth

instructions: Blend together ground beef, salt, pepper and ginger.
Shape into 1-inch meatballs.
Heat oil in wok or skillet; brown meatballs on all sides, about 2 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cook over moderate heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens.
Cook 5 minutes.
Serve at once with rice. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Sweet-N-Sour Chicken
instructions: Saute onion in 2 tablespoons shortening.
Add carrots, water and bouillon cubes.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Combine next 6 ingredients.
Add to vegetable mixture and cook until clear.
Add pepper, pineapple and chicken.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until heated through.
Serve with rice or angel hair noodles. Serves 6 people.

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Chicken Or Pork
instructions: Combine brown sugar and cornstarch; stir in vinegar, pineapple juice, green pepper, soy sauce, pimento, garlic powder and ginger. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes more.
Makes 1 1/4 cups.
Serve over chicken, pork or spareribs.

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Cucumbers
instructions: About 1 hour before serving or up to 2 days before, in large bowl combine all ingredients.
Cover and refrigerate at least 45 minutes to blend flavors, stirring occasionally.
Makes 4 cups.

recipes.title: Sweet-Soy Marinade
instructions: In plastic bag or nonporous bowl, mix all ingredients and combine with 1 1/4 pounds of beef strips or pork strips or 2 pounds of chicken pieces.
Marinate beef or pork up to 24 hours; chicken 2 to 4 hours.
Thread beef or pork strips on bamboo skewers that have been soaked in water.
Grill or broil.
Yields 4 to 5 servings.

recipes.title: Swiss Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Beat until smooth and of a spreading consistency.
Chill.
Makes about 2 cups.

recipes.title: Swiss Corn Chowder
instructions: Add potatoes, carrots, celery, onion, salt and pepper to boiling water.
Cover.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Do not drain.
Make a white sauce with margarine, flour and milk.
Add cheese, stirring until melted.
Add corn and undrained vegetables.
Heat; do not boil.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak Deluxe
instructions: Add salt and pepper to the flour and pound into meat.
In large skillet, add the olive oil and brown the meat.
Add the onion, green pepper, boiling water and ketchup.
Cover closely; simmer slowly until done.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak For Six
instructions: Mix flour, salt and pepper.
Dredge meat in flour mixture; brown in oil.
Remove meat to a casserole.
Saute celery, onion and green pepper in the skillet from which the meat has been removed.
Make a gravy by adding flour, water and tomato juice to the vegetables.
Pour over meat; bake in a 375° oven for 1 1/2 hours.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Take It Easy Chicken
instructions: Mix rice with soups and water in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle 1/2 the onion soup on top.
Cover mixture with breasts.
Top with remaining onion soup.
Cover pan tightly with aluminum foil.
Bake at 250° for 2 1/2 hours.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Tangy Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a large shallow dish.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
Cover and refrigerate 4 hours. Grill chicken over medium coals for 55 to 60 minutes or until done, turning and basting with marinade every 10 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Tangy Salsa Shrimp And Rice
instructions: In bowl, mix shrimp and salsa.
Cover and chill 1 hour.
Cook rice and add chilies, scallions, salt and pepper. Mix well. Skewer salsa-coated shrimp; broil or grill.
Place on rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Tangy Shrimp Dip
instructions: Add mustard and Worcestershire sauce to softened cream cheese. Add onion, parsley and mayonnaise.
Mix until well blended.
Mash in shrimp.
May need to be thinned a little for right consistency; little more mayonnaise can be added.
Serve with potato chips. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Tangy Tomato Slices
instructions: In a small bowl or a jar with tight-fitting lid, mix the first 9 ingredients.
Layer onion and tomatoes in a shallow glass dish. Pour the marinade over; cover and refrigerate for several hours. Yields 12 servings.

recipes.title: Tarragon Peas
instructions: Cover peas with a little water and cook until crisp-tender and still a bright green.
Do not overcook.
Drain and add butter, salt, sugar and tarragon to the pan.
Toss gently.
Pour cream over the peas; heat through and serve.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Tasty Meat Loaf
instructions: Thoroughly mix ground chuck with soup mix.
Add bread crumbs softened with milk and eggs.
Mix well.
Put in loaf pan and shape.
Spread catsup over loaf.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Remove from oven and pour excess fat off.
Cool and slice. Makes 10 to 12 slices.

recipes.title: Taverns
instructions: Melt in large skillet margarine.
Add ground beef.
Cook until brown, stirring with fork.
Put through food mill.
Add kidney beans and stir well.
Add onion, green pepper, tomato soup, chili sauce, chili powder, salt and pepper.
Stir well and cover.
Cook over low heat for 1 hour.
Serve with toasted hamburger rolls. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Teahouse Punch
instructions: Combine hot water, nutmeg, allspice and cinnamon in saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat.
Boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add tea bags and steep 5 minutes.
Strain into pitcher. Add cold water, sugar, lemon juice and orange extract.
Mix well. Chill and serve over ice cubes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Tender Soda Pancakes
instructions: Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Beat eggs, milk and melted butter just until blended and add to flour mixture.
Beat until smooth.
Using a 1/4 or 1/2 measuring cup, drop batter on hot, lightly greased griddle.
Bake.
Brush with melted butter and serve immediately.
Makes 11 to 12 (5 1/2-inch) pancakes.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Bean Special
instructions: In a medium skillet, cook onion in butter or margarine until tender.
Add green beans, bean sprouts, chopped mushrooms and soy sauce; mix lightly.
Simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve with additional soy sauce.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Lasagna

ingredients.notes: cooked according to pkg. directions, rinsed and drained

instructions: In a large bowl combine first 4 ingredients.
In another bowl, combine cheeses.
Spread 1 cup of bean mixture in bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Layer 1/4 of noodles on top.
Top with 1 1/2 cups bean mixture and 1/4 cheese mixture.
Repeat 3 more times.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
Top with sour cream and chopped cilantro.

recipes.title: Texas Black-Eyed Peas And Rice
instructions: Place peas, onion, water and salt in a large saucepan.
Cover; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes.
Add rice and continue simmering until rice is tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Stir occasionally.
Cook bacon; remove from skillet.
Combine pea mixture, barbecue sauce, half of bacon, pepper and bacon drippings.
Place in greased 2-quart casserole.
Top with remaining bacon.
Bake in moderate oven approximately 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 8 large Texas servings.

recipes.title: Texas Flank Steak
instructions: Place flank steak in a shallow dish.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over steak.
Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours, turning steak often.
Drain steak, reserving marinade. Grill steak over hot coals 10 to 12 minutes on each side or to desired degree of doneness, basting occasionally, with reserved marinade.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Texas Meatballs And Rice

ingredients.notes: thinly sliced and separated into rings

instructions: Mix ground beef, egg, chili powder, salt and pepper; shape into 1 1/2 to 2-inch balls.
Place in 2-quart casserole.
Microwave at High (100%) until meatballs are set and lose pink color, 4 to 7 minutes, rearranging meatballs after half the cooking time.
Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover.
Microwave at High (100%) until mixture is bubbly and onion is tender, 4 to 7 minutes.
If using an oven without a carousel, stir after half the cooking time. Let stand until rice is tender, 2 to 3 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Texas Rice Delight
instructions: Cook sausage and onions until sausage is golden brown, stirring constantly.
Add sausage and onion mixture to rice and pour into well-greased casserole.
Make a layer of grated cheese. Top with tomatoes to which Tabasco sauce has been added.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Texas Style Chili
instructions: Combine ground chuck, sausage, onions, pepper and garlic in a Dutch oven; cook until meat is browned, stirring to crumble. Drain well.
Stir in next 6 ingredients.
Cover and simmer for one hour, stirring occasionally.
Add beans and simmer 20 to 30 minutes longer.
Makes about 5 quarts.

recipes.title: Texas Tortilla Soup
instructions: Cut tortillas in narrow strips with scissors and set aside to dry.
Heat oil in saute pan.

Cook garlic clove in oil and remove. Brown tortilla strips in oil and add tomato puree, onion, parsley, chili powder, bay leaf, chicken stock and chicken.	Simmer 15 minutes or until tortilla strips are soft.	Sprinkle grated cheese on top and garnish with tortilla strips and avocado slices.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: The Big Bad Wolf'S Brownies(From Walt Disney'S Mickey Mouse Cookbook)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Melt butter and chocolate in large pan over low heat.
Remove from heat.
Stir in sugar, flour, baking powder, vanilla and nuts. Add the eggs and beat well with an egg beater.
Pour the batter into the baking pan. Bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the pan from the oven and place it on a rack.
When the brownies are cool, cut them into squares.
Makes about 16 brownies.

recipes.title: The Crews Selection
instructions: Cut large shrimp in half.
Cook mushrooms, green pepper and onion in margarine until tender.
Stir in mushroom soup, cheese and pepper.
Heat, stirring constantly, until cheese melts.
Stir in shrimp.
Pour into a well-greased 1-quart casserole.
Combine crumbs and margarine.
Sprinkle over top of shrimp mixture.
Bake in hot oven at 400° for 10 minutes or until thoroughly heated and crumbs are brown.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Thin White Sauces
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan.
Blend in cornstarch, salt and pepper.
Gradually add milk.
Heat to boiling over direct heat and then boil gently 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Makes 1 cup sauce, then boil gently 2 minutes, stirring constantly.

recipes.title: Three Bean Chili
instructions: In 4-quart saucepan or Dutch oven, brown ground beef with onions and green pepper; drain.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato soup and taco seasoning mix; blend well.
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in beans; simmer an additional 15 minutes to blend flavors, stirring occasionally.
Makes 7 (1 1/2-cup) servings.

recipes.title: Three Cheese Tuna Casserole
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions; drain.
Heat soup, milk and cheeses together; stir until cheeses are melted. Combine macaroni, cheese sauce, vegetables, tuna, 1 cup French fried onions and seasonings.
Pour into a 2-quart baking dish. Bake, covered, in a 350° oven for 25 minutes or until heated thoroughly.
Top with remaining onions; bake uncovered for 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Three Pepper Stroganoff

ingredients.notes: cut in thin strips (green, red, yellow)

instructions: Cut meat into thin strips.
Sprinkle meat with salt, pepper and garlic.
Roll in flour.
Brown meat slightly in oil.
Remove meat and drain.
Add onions and mushroom soup and water.
Mix well.
Place meat, mushrooms and onions in mixture.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add bell pepper strips.
Cook 5 more minutes.
Serve over noodles.
Garnish with parsley, tomatoes and mushrooms. Serves 5 to 6.
