recipes.title: Thumper'S Tuna-Noodle Casserole
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°.
Strain tuna fish; put in small dish.
Break into little pieces.
Drain peas and set aside. Empty can of soup into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Add milk and stir in.
Add the tuna, peas and noodles to the casserole and stir everything together.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Tiger Butter
instructions: Combine white chocolate and peanut butter in the top of a double boiler.
Bring water to a boil and reduce heat to low.
Cook until chocolate and peanut butter melt, stirring constantly. Spread mixture onto a wax-paper-lined cookie sheet.
Pour semi-sweet chocolate over peanut butter mixture and swirl with a knife.
Chill until firm and cut into 1 to 1 1/2-inch pieces. Store in refrigerator.
Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Tiny Christmas Bites
instructions: Combine crumbs and margarine, add milk, vanilla and almond extract.
Stir in remaining ingredients until well blended. Spoon 1 tablespoon into each paper lined miniature muffin pan. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Remove from pan and cool on rack.
Yields 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Toasted Holiday Pecans
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in large saucepan.
Mix in next 3 ingredients.
Stir in pecans and spread in a glass baking dish. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes, stirring frequently.
Turn out onto paper towel and sprinkle with salt.
Let season one day before serving.
Yield: 4 cups.

recipes.title: Toasted Tuna Sandwiches
instructions: Combine tuna, celery, green pepper, relish, lemon juice, mayo and cheese.
Spread evenly on 6 slices bread and cover with remaining slices.
Combine eggs and milk.
Melt butter in skillet. Dip sandwiches in egg mixture.
Turn so both sides are coated. Cook sandwiches until golden brown on both sides.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Toffee Nut Bar
instructions: Mix together.
Press and flatten with hand to cover bottom ungreased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes in 350° oven. Remove from oven and spread with topping.
Return to oven 25 minutes.
Cool slightly. Cut into bars.
Yields 2 1/2 dozen 1 x 3-inch bars.

recipes.title: Toffee Topped Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease 9 x 13-inch baking pan. In large mixing bowl, mix together brown sugar and flour using pastry blender or 2 knives, cut in butter until mixture is crumbly.
Remove 1 cup of mixture and set aside.
To mixture in large bowl, add baking powder and salt, then using a fork, lightly beat in vanilla, milk and egg.
Beat until mixture is smooth. Pour batter into prepared pan.
In small bowl, combine chocolate chips, nuts and coconut.
Sprinkle reserved mixture over batter in pan, then sprinkle chocolate chip mixture.
Spread evenly and bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool bars completely before cutting.
Store in airtight container. Makes 24 brownies.

recipes.title: Tomato - Pear Relish
instructions: Cook 1 hour slow.
Add pimentos the last 3 minutes.
Makes 5 pints.

recipes.title: Tomato Bouillon
instructions: Saute onions in butter.
Mix with remaining ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes.
Freezes well.
Makes 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Tomato Salad(Excellent)
instructions: Mix all except tomatoes.
Pour over tomatoes and serve. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Saute onions in butter in 4-quart soup pot until transparent. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add stock; bring to a boil and add rice.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Peel and dice tomatoes and add to pot along with tomato juice and chopped basil.
Cook over low heat another 15 minutes.
Add salt to taste.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Tomato, Rice And Bean Casserole
instructions: Saut pepper, onion and celery in oil until very lightly browned.
Chop tomatoes and add with chili powder to sauted vegetables.
Mix together rice and beans in a separate bowl.
Layer in a 9 x 13 glass dish half rice mixture, half grated cheese and half of tomato mixture.
Repeat.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Tortilla Turnovers
instructions: Brown ground meat, mashed up.
Drain off fat.
Add seasoning mix and 3/4 cup water.
Bring to simmer, cook until most of liquid is absorbed.
Place tortillas on ungreased baking sheets.
In center of each, place a portion of meat mixture.
Sprinkle meat with cheese, onion and salsa.
Bake at 500° just until cheese melts, this just takes a minute or so.
Remove from oven and fold over, melted cheese will seal turnover.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Tostada Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Brown beef and drain fat.
Add 1/2 cup tomato sauce and the taco seasoning.
Mix well.
Line bottom of 2-quart flat casserole with 2 cups corn chips.
Crush the remaining chips and set aside.
Spoon meat mixture over corn chips in dish.
Combine remaining tomato sauce and the refried beans. Spread over meat.
Bake, covered, for 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese and crushed corn chips.
Bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes more.
Serves 5.

recipes.title: Traditional Southern Fried Okra
instructions: Combine cornmeal, salt and pepper in plastic bag.
Add okra and shake well to blend and coat 1 cup of okra at at time to cornmeal mix.
Put 1/4 cup oil into a cast iron frying pan and heat until hot.
Add coated okra a little at a time until brown.
Yield about 10 servings.
(Add additional oil as needed.)

recipes.title: Treasure Cookies
instructions: Cream together the shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs, peanut butter and vanilla. Add flour, baking powder and soda.
Mix thoroughly. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes. Remove from baking sheet at once.
Yields 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: True Blue Cheese
instructions: Blend all ingredients.
Yields 1-1/2 cups of dressing.

recipes.title: Tuna Apple Salad
instructions: Mix together with small amount of Miracle Whip.
Chill. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Tuna Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 450° (hot).
Cook broccoli stalks 3 minutes and drain.
Place in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Cover with tuna.
Mix soup and milk, pour over tuna.
Sprinkle potato chips over top. Bake 15 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Tuna Cheese Coneys
instructions: Chop eggs and add all the ingredients; fill buns.
Wrap in foil; heat 30 minutes at 250°.
Serve hot.
May be made ahead and refrigerated.
Serves 4 to 8.

recipes.title: Tuna Cheese Spread
instructions: In a large bowl combine cottage and cream cheese.
Beat until smooth.
Add tuna, one can at a time, blending until smooth after each addition.
Add remaining ingredients.
Chill and serve with crackers.
Yields 4 cups.

recipes.title: Tuna Chow Mein Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.
In large skillet, cook and stir celery, onion and green pepper in butter until onion is tender.
Stir in tuna (with liquid) and remaining ingredients.
Pour into ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Sprinkle with reserved chow mein noodles.
Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Tuna Crunch(Delicious Microwave Recipe)
instructions: Combine celery, onion and butter in a 1-quart microproof casserole.
Cook, uncovered, on High (maximum power) for 5 minutes, stirring once during cooking time.
Drain tuna and flake with fork.
Add tuna, soup, 2/3 can of noodles and cashews to onion mixture.
Stir carefully.
Cover and cook on High (maximum power) for 2 minutes.
Stir mixture lightly.
Top with remaining noodles.
Cook on High (maximum power) for 3 to 4 minutes or until hot.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Tuna Fish Snacks
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.
Spread on small toasted rounds or squares of bread.
Brush with melted butter.
Place under broiler until golden brown.
Makes 24 snacks.

recipes.title: Tuna Rio Grande
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in square baking dish.
Stir in chili sauce.
Crumble tuna into the chili and margarine.
Top with cheese, then with prepared muffin mix.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 375°.
Cut into squares.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Stir together all ingredients until well mixed.
Makes 1 1/4 cups or enough for 4 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad And Rice
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate.
Makes 2 quarts.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad Sandwich Filling
instructions: Mix all ingredients; refrigerate until serving time.
Makes 1 1/4 cups filling (3 or 4 sandwiches).

recipes.title: Tuna Salad(Tuna Salad Is A Lot Like Egg Salad.)
instructions: In a bowl, mix all ingredients together and serve on sandwich bread or on top of a lettuce leaf.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Tuna Supreme
instructions: In saucepan, cook celery and onions in butter until tender. Blend in soup.
Gradually stir in milk.
Add tuna and pimento; heat and stir occasionally.
Garnish with parsley; serve on toasts.
Makes approximately 4 servings.

recipes.title: Tuna Tetrazzini
instructions: In saucepan, cook onion in butter until tender.
Blend in soup, water and cheese.
Cook over low heat until cheese melts; stir occasionally.
Add tuna, pimento, parsley and spaghetti. Heat; stir occasionally.
Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Tuna Vegetable Slaw
instructions: Break tuna into large chunks in a bowl.
Combine mayonnaise and lemon juice in a bowl.
Mix well.
Add remaining ingredients to tuna; mix well.
Pour dressing over salad; toss lightly.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Tuna Waldorf Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Makes 1 3/4 cups.

recipes.title: Tuna With Spaghetti
instructions: Saute the onion and green pepper in oil in a large frying pan. Mix in the tuna fish, tomato sauce, water, garlic powder, oregano, salt and pepper.
Cook for 10 minutes.
Pour tuna mixture over spaghetti.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Tuna-Cheese Twist
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°.
Lightly grease the cookie sheet.
Mix tuna, olives, celery, green pepper, onion and 1/4 cup of the soup. Mix baking mix and 1/2 cup cold water until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes.
Gently smooth dough into ball on floured cloth-covered board.
Knead 5 times.
Roll dough into rectangle 14 x 11 inches; place on cookie sheet.
Spoon the tuna mixture lengthwise down the center of the rectangle; sprinkle with 1 cup of the cheese.
Make cuts 2 1/2 inches long at 1-inch intervals on the sides of the rectangle.
Fold the strips over the filling.
Mix egg with 1 tablespoon of water; brush over the dough.
Bake until light brown, 15 to 20 minutes.
Mix the remaining soup and 1/2 cup cheese and the milk over medium heat, stirring occasionally until hot. Serve over slices of twist.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Tuna-Corn Chowder
instructions: Combine soup and milk.
Mix in curry powder.
Add drained tuna and corn; stir until well distributed.
Heat on medium, stirring constantly, until very hot.
Dilute with some of the hot water if desired.
Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Tuna-Egg-Cheese Overnight Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole dish.
Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
This recipe can be cut in half.

recipes.title: Tuna-Rice Special Casserole
instructions: Put rice, bouillon cubes, water and seasonings into heavy 3 quart saucepan.
Add celery, olives, green pepper, mushrooms plus liquid and tuna.
Cover tightly and bring to boil.
Turn heat down and simmer for 20 minutes.
Garnish with green pepper rings.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Turkey - Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Chill 2 hours before serving.
Serves 8 to 10 people.

recipes.title: Turkey Chop Suey
instructions: In saucepan, cook onions in butter until tender, but not brown. Add turkey, broth, celery and water chestnuts.
Heat to boiling.
Combine water, soy sauce and cornstarch.
Stir into turkey mixture. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.
Add bean sprouts and heat through. Serve on hot rice.
Sprinkle with roasted almonds.
If desired, pass additional soy sauce.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Turkey Crunch Casserole
instructions: In large bowl, stir together the first 8 ingredients.
Combine mayonnaise and soup; toss with turkey mixture.
Turn into greased casserole dish and sprinkle top with noodles.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Turkey Grape Salad
instructions: Combine turkey, celery, grapes and mayonnaise or salad dressing.
Season with salt and pepper. Toss lightly.
Serve on greens; trim with grapes.
Makes 6 servings.
May add nuts.

recipes.title: Turkey Hash Au Gratin
instructions: In a medium skillet, over medium-high heat, combine turkey and onion. Cook 5 minutes or until turkey is no longer pink.
Add potato, breaking up larger pieces of potatoes with spoon, if necessary. Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add salt and pepper.
Into 1-quart ovenproof casserole, lightly coated with vegetable cooking spray, bake turkey
mixture in a 375° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
Top casserole with cheese and continue baking until cheese melts. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Turkey Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a large 8-quart stockpot.
Add onion, garlic, and celery; saute over medium-high heat 3 minutes.
Add chicken broth and next 5 ingredients.
Bring to boil; reduce heat, and simmer at least 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Makes about 4 quarts.

recipes.title: Turkey Stroganoff
instructions: In saucepan cook green pepper and onion in butter until tender. In 1 1/2-quart casserole, blend soup and sour cream.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until hot. Stir.
Sprinkle with additional paprika.
Makes about 4 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Turned-On Burgers
instructions: Combine pepperoni, cheese and mustard.
Shape ground beef into 12 thin patties.
Top 6 patties with cheese mixture; cover with remaining 6 patties.
Press edges together and seal.
Broil or pan-fry.
Serve on buns garnished with onion, tomato, pepper and radish.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Turtle Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar, oleo and milk in heavy saucepan (2 1/2 to 3-quart size).

Bring to full rolling boil, stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat until candy thermometer reaches 234° or soft ball stage, stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat; add chocolate and stir until well blended.
Add remaining ingredients and beat until well blended.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cool at room temperature.
Cut into squares.
Makes 3 1/2 pounds.

recipes.title: Twice Baked Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cut each potatoes in half lengthwise. Scoop out centers, leaving 1/8-inch shell.
Mix potatoes, 2 tablespoons margarine, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg with an electric mixer until smooth.
Stir in 2 cups marshmallows, pineapple and 1/2 cup marshmallows and walnuts; spoon into shells.
Toss remaining margarine, marshmallows and walnuts; sprinkle on top of potatoes. Bake 20 minutes.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Twin Meat Loaves
instructions: Soak bread in milk.
Add eggs and beat.
Add meat, salt, pepper, onion, Worcestershire sauce and poultry seasoning.
Mix thoroughly.
Form into two loaves.
Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake,
uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.
Top with catsup or chili sauce and cook 15 minutes longer.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Twin Mountain Coffee Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl.
Cut in shortening until crumbly.
Beat eggs with milk.
Stir in dry ingredients.
Fold in blueberries.
Pour into greased 8-inch round cake pans. Sprinkle flaked coconut over the top.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
Yields 16 servings.

recipes.title: Two-Week Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage, onion and pepper.
Add celery and pimentos. Sprinkle sugar on top; do not stir.
Bring other ingredients to a boil.
Pour while hot over the veggies.
Cover, without stirring; refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
The older it gets, the better. Serves 12 to 14.

recipes.title: Uncooked Cucumber Relish
instructions: Grind all peppers and onions with fine blade of grinder. Sprinkle salt over same and let it stand overnight.
Drain well and add remaining ingredients.
Stir well.
Put in sterilized jars and seal.
This makes 5 pints.

recipes.title: Upside-Down Supper
instructions: Heat oven to 400°.
Mix ham, beans, corn, cheese, onion and Worcestershire sauce.
Turn into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and bake 15 minutes.
Mix remaining ingredients; spoon over hot meat mixture, spreading batter evenly to edge of casserole. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes.
Cut into wedges.
Invert each onto plate.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Van'S Banana Bread
instructions: Mix together shortening, sugar and eggs, using mixer.
Add bananas, apples and orange juice.
Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Add dry ingredients by hand.
Mix together nuts and add gently into the batter.
Place in greased long, large loaf pan (4 1/2 x 2 1/2 x 13-inch).
Bake at 350° for about 60 minutes.
Makes 1 large loaf.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream(Custard)
instructions: Mix flour, sugar and salt. Beat eggs into milk.
Slowly add to flour mixture. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. When cooled, add half and half and vanilla.
Pour into freezer container and finish filling with milk.
(I usually cook the custard the day before and refrigerate overnight.)
Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

recipes.title: Vanilla Sauce For Apple Dumplings
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch in saucepan.
Gradually stir in water.
Boil 1 minute stirring constantly.
Stir in butter and flavoring.
Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in bowl.
Beat in eggs, one at a time. Add milk alternately with wafer crumbs, mixing well.
Stir in coconut, pecans and vanilla.
Pour into prepared tube pan.
Bake at 275° for 2 1/2 hours.
Yields 16 servings.

recipes.title: Vegetable Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve cream cheese in warmed tomato soup; set aside.
Heat 1/4 cup water until warm and dissolve gelatin.
Combine gelatin with cream cheese and soup; cool.
Add vegetables to cooled mixture.
Pour into large square cake pan.
Chill until firm. Yield: 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl; blend well.
Spoon mixture onto a 6-inch square of aluminum foil and fold to make airtight.
Label as Vegetable Dip Mix.
Store in a cool, dry place and use within 6 months.
Makes 1 (about 2 tablespoons) package of mix.

recipes.title: Vegetable Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni.
Drain and cool.
Add vegetables and mix well. Combine milk, vinegar, sugar, mayo, salt and pepper.
Add to macaroni mixture.
Chill at least 4 hours before serving.
Better if left overnight.
Keeps well.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400°.
Lightly grease pie plate, 10 x 1 1/2-inches.
Heat 1-inch salted water (1/2 teaspoon salt to 1 cup water) to boiling.
Cook until almost tender, about 5 minutes; drain thoroughly.
Mix broccoli, onion, green pepper and cheese in pie plate.
Beat remaining ingredients until smooth, 15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute with hand beater.
Pour into pie plate.
Bake until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
Refrigerate any remaining pie. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Vegetable Platter
instructions: Peel carrots.
Cut in half crosswise and quarter lengthwise. Snap beans and cut in half.
Cut roots of leeks and remove coarse outer leaves.
Cut off all but 2 inches of the green tops.
Cut in half lengthwise.
Place chicken broth in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Add green beans and return to boiling.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.
Add leeks and carrots; return to simmer and cook, covered, 6 to 8 minutes or until tender.
Drain. Arrange on platter.
Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with parsley.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Vegetable Rice Salad
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir first five ingredients until smooth. Add remaining ingredients.
Toss to coat well.
Cover and chill. Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Vegetable-Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Place 1/3 cup chicken broth, celery, carrots and potatoes with spices in a large saucepan.
Cover and cook over medium heat until vegetables are tender.
Stir occasionally.
Stir in remaining broth.
Bring to a boil and add noodles.
Cook until noodles are tender.
Stir in chicken.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer until heated through.
Makes 6 (1 1/2 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Vegetable-Lentil Chowder
instructions: Combine lentils, water and salt in large saucepan.
Cook, covered, over medium heat for 30 minutes.
Cook onion and green pepper until tender.
Combine all ingredients.
Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Makes 6 large servings.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Cottage Cheese Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients.
Bake in oiled flat casserole and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.
Serve with brown gravy or cranberry sauce.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Supper
instructions: Cook rice; use package directions.
In large skillet, saute onion and garlic in oil until tender.
Add zucchini, green onion, pepper, oregano and salt.
Cook until crisp and tender, about 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and beans; cover and heat through.
Serve on hot rice and sprinkle with cheese.
Serves 7.

recipes.title: Velveeta Cheese Fudge
instructions: Melt cheese and margarine in top of double boiler.
Sift cocoa and sugar together until smooth (at least 6 times).
Mix into melted cheese mixture.
Blend with wooden spoon.
Add nuts and vanilla.
Mix well.
Press into lightly buttered 9 x 13-inch pans. Let set.
Makes 7 pounds.

recipes.title: Velvet Cheese Soup
instructions: In a soup pot, combine the butter, onions, celery, carrots, and bell pepper.
Saute until vegetables are tender but not browned.
In a large saucepan, heat the broth, half and half, and milk.
Add the flour to the vegetables.
Mix well.
Add the boiling water and the milk mixture.
Stir well. Add the cheese in small pieces.
Reduce heat to low and stir until cheese melts. Taste and adjust seasoning, if needed.
Makes 1/2 gal.

recipes.title: Velvety Custard Pie
instructions: Thoroughly mix eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla.
Slowly stir in hot milk.
At once, pour into unbaked pie shell.
Dash top with nutmeg.
Bake in very hot oven (475°) for 5 minutes; reduce heat to 425 and bake for 10 minutes longer or until knife inserted halfway in center comes out clean.
Cool on rack.
Serve cool or at room temperature.
Yields 1 pie.

recipes.title: Waikiki Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef, cracker crumbs, onions, egg, salt, ginger and milk.
Shape mixture by rounded tablespoonfuls into 1 1/2-inch balls.
Heat shortening in large skillet until melted.
Cook meatballs over medium heat, stirring occasionally until done. Remove meatballs from skillet and keep warm.
Drain fat from skillet.
Mix cornstarch and brown sugar in same skillet; stir in reserved syrup, the vinegar and soy sauce until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens.
Boil and stir 1 minute.	Add meatballs, pineapple and green pepper. Heat.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Walnut Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat eggs until light.
Add remaining ingredients.
Spread in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Do not overbake.
Cut into bars while warm. Roll in powdered sugar.
Makes approximately 18 bars.

recipes.title: Walnut Cheese Log
instructions: Beat cheeses, margarine and salt together until smooth.
Stir in half the walnuts; all the pimiento and olives.
Chill mixture for easy handling; shape into log or ball.
Roll in remaining walnuts; chill until firm.
Serve with crackers.
Makes about 1 1/2 pounds of spread.

recipes.title: Walnut Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine the chicken, walnuts, raisins, celery, and apple. Toss to mix.
Combine the dill and mayonnaise and mix well.
Stir just enough of this dill mayonnaise into the salad to coat the mixture.
Just before serving, spoon onto curly leaf lettuce. Serve with assorted crackers or melba toast.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Walnut Fried Shrimp
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp, leaving tails intact.
Rinse well and set aside.
Combine flour, pepper and salt; stir well.
Combine milk and eggs; stir well.
Dip shrimp in egg mixture; dredge in flour mixture.
Dip shrimp in egg mixture again and dredge in ground walnuts.
Place coated shrimp on a wax paper lined baking sheet; cover and freeze 2 hours.
Fry shrimp, a few at a time, in deep hot oil (350°) 3 minutes or until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Serves 3.

recipes.title: Walnut Stuffing
instructions: Melt butter called for in stuffing mix
package directions. Add celery and onion. Cook until tender, but not brown. Add water called for in package directions.
Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Stir in stuffing mix, parsley flakes and walnuts.
Makes 5 1/2 cups stuffing.

recipes.title: Warmer Kartoffel Salat(Variation With Sour Cream)
instructions: Cook potatoes in salted boiling water until fork-tender; peel and slice and

add onion. In a large skillet, cook bacon and remove from heat; remove bacon and set aside. Pour off fat. Return 1/4 cup to skillet. Add flour and sugar and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add sour cream. Add potatoes, onions and half of the bacon. Toss gently. Add rest of bacon and parsley. Serves 10.

recipes.title: Water Chestnuts With Bacon
instructions: Wrap 1/2 slice bacon around each water chestnut; fasten with toothpick.
Place water chestnuts in oven-proof dish; brush with mixture of soy sauce and sherry.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Yields about 20.

recipes.title: Wedding Cakes(Cookies)
instructions: In medium bowl, with mixer at medium speed, cream butter or margarine and 1/2 cup sugar until light and fluffy.
Add vanilla and flour; continue beating, just until well mixed.
Stir in nuts. Cover; chill dough for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Shape dough into 1 inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Let stay on cookie sheet 2 to 3 minutes before removing to wire racks.
Roll in remaining confectioners sugar. Cool completely, then roll again in confectioners sugar.
Makes about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Weekend Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, cocoa, soda and salt in large mixing bowl and mix well.
Heat water and margarine in saucepan until boiling.
Pour over dry ingredients and mix.
Beat in buttermilk, eggs and vanilla.
Pour batter in greased and floured 15 x 10-inch pan.
Bake in 400° oven for 25 minutes.
Makes 18 servings.
Serve warm or cold with favorite topping.

recipes.title: Weeknight Fajitas
instructions: In large bowl, pour dressing over chicken, green pepper, onion, garlic and oregano.
Toss lightly and refrigerate at least 10 minutes.
Drain.
Stir-fry chicken mixture until chicken is browned and no longer pink.
Stir in tomato.
Wrap tortillas in dampened paper towels.
Microwave on High 45 seconds to 1 1/2 minutes or until softened.
Fill tortillas with chicken mixture.
Serve with salsa, no-fat sour cream and no-fat Cheddar cheese.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: West Coast Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter.
Blend in flour, mustard, Worcestershire, paprika and milk.
Cook, stirring until thick and smooth.
Stir in cheese until melted.
Remove from heat; add 1/2 cup olives (sliced and drained), shrimp and crab.
Bake in buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole for 25 minutes at 350° or until bubbly. Garnish top with remaining olives and parsley.
Serves 5 to 6. Good with buttered rice.

recipes.title: Western Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in loaf pan and bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours.
Makes about 8 servings.

recipes.title: Western Meat-In-One
instructions: Brown meat in oil.
Add garlic, salt, onion, green pepper and chili powder and saute for 5 minutes or until vegetables are limp. Mix in tomatoes, kidney beans and rice and turn into a 2-quart casserole.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with olives and cheese.
Continue baking for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Serves 6 to 8 people.

recipes.title: Western Pralines(An Old Favorite From The Early 1900'S)
instructions: In a large (3 1/2-quart) heavy saucepan combine sugar, soda, buttermilk and salt.
Cook over high heat about 5 minutes.
Stir often and scrape bottom of pan.
Mixture will foam up.
Add butter and pecans over medium heat; continue cooking, stirring constantly, and scraping bottom of pan until candy reaches soft ball stage.
Remove from heat and cool slightly, about 2 minutes. Beat with a spoon until thick and creamy.
Drop from a tablespoon onto sheet of aluminum foil or waxed paper.
Let cool.
Makes about 20 pralines, 2 inches in diameter.

recipes.title: Western Style Eggs
instructions: Cut peppers in strips.
In large bowl with fork or whisk, beat eggs, water and pepper until mixed; set aside.
In 12-inch skillet over medium heat, cook red and green peppers in 2 tablespoons hot salad oil until tender.
With slotted spoon, remove peppers to bowl with egg mixture.
In same skillet, on high heat in 3 more tablespoons hot salad oil, cook mixture until it begins to set. With spatula, lift edge as it sets, tilting pan to allow uncooked portion to run under.
Crumble corned beef over egg mixture. Reduce heat to medium low; cook, covered, for 10 minutes.
Makes 6 main dish servings.

recipes.title: Whipped Nonfat Milk
instructions: Place ice water and lemon juice in small deep bowl.
Sprinkle dry milk powder on top.
Beat until stiff enough to hold soft peaks with a rotary beater (about 15 minutes) or use an electric beater.
Fold in sugar substitute.
Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: White Chocolate - Macadamian Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream butter, shortening and sugars.
Add vanilla and egg. Sift together salt, soda and flour.
Add to creamed mixture.
Add nuts and chocolate.
Bake at 325 degrees on parchment paper until light brown. Makes 24 servings.

recipes.title: White Grape Punch 7Rom Southern Living
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients.
Chill well and stir in club soda just before serving. Yields 3 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: White Sauce Mix
instructions: Mix together; store in refrigerator until ready to use.
When ready to use, use 2 tablespoons mix in saucepan and 1 cup liquid (makes 1 cup sauce).

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Pancakes
instructions: Stir together dry ingredients with a whisk.
Beat the eggs slightly and combine with the milk, then add to the dry ingredients.
Stir in oil.
Heat the pan (nonstick), but do not grease it.
Pour batter into the pan by large spoonful.
Cook over medium heat, turning once when bubbles come to the surface and pop and the edges are slightly dry.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Baron
instructions: Gently cook rice, water and 2 teaspoons salt (covered) for 45 minutes.
Drain.
Brown beef.
Rinse mushrooms; cut tips off stems. Slice and saute with onion and celery in butter 5 to 10 minutes. Combine soy sauce, sour cream, salt and pepper.
Add cooked rice, beef, onion, mushrooms and celery mixture and almonds.
Toss lightly.
Place in 3-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.
Add water, if needed.
Season to taste.
Stir several times and garnish with few almonds.
Serves 12 to 16.

recipes.title: Wild Rice With Pecans
instructions: In large saucepan, melt the butter over moderate heat.
Add onions and saute 5 minutes.
Stir in wild rice, coating with butter.
Pour in stock; bring to boil and stir.
Lower heat; cover tightly and simmer, stirring occasionally for 1 hour.
Add the water; stir in white rice.
Cover and steam 20 minutes longer or until both rices are tender.
Stir in the pecans and basil. Serves 4, easy to double.

recipes.title: Wine Drop Cookies
instructions: Dissolve soda into cold coffee.
Cream ingredients together. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Bake at 375°.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Winnie'S Chili Beans
instructions: Brown together the ground beef, onion and garlic.
Drain excess fat.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Winter Strawberry Muffins
instructions: Thaw strawberries.
Sift dry ingredients together in a large bowl.
Stir in pecans.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, oil and strawberries.
Stir into dry ingredients.
Mix lightly. Spoon into greased muffin tin.
Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°.
Yields 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Winter Treats No-Bake Snowballs
instructions: Mix butters and sugar well.
Add cocoa and oats.
Mix until dough will form.
If it is too gooey, add a little more oats. Form teaspoons of dough into balls and roll in coconut. Refrigerate for an hour or until firm.
Makes 24 balls.

recipes.title: Wisconsin Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook vegetables until tender; drain.
In saucepan, melt butter.
Add onion; cook until tender.
Stir in flour; cook and stir 2 or 3 minutes until bubbly.
Stir in soda.
Gradually add milk and broth.
Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer, stirring, until mixture thickens slightly, 10 to 15 minutes.
Add cheese and red pepper; stir until melted.
Garnish with parsley.
Makes about 4 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Wolverines
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine powdered sugar and salt; stir in peanut butter.
Add vanilla, stirring until blended.
Shape into tsp. size balls and dip into chocolate.
Refrigerate 20 minutes to harden.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Wy'S Waffles
instructions: Beat eggs and add buttermilk; stir in remaining ingredients. Beat with a rotary beater until smooth.
Cook in hot waffle iron. Makes about 3 medium to large waffles.

recipes.title: Yale Beets
instructions: Place beets in greased casserole dish.
Mix flour, salt and sugar together.
Combine with butter, water, orange juice and lemon juice.
Cook until thick, about 5 minutes.
Stir occasionally.
Pour over beets and bake in oven for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Yams With Orange Sauce
instructions: Cook yams until tender in water.
Remove skins and slice into greased casserole dish.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over yams.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Yellow Jacket Corn
instructions: Cook bacon until crispy; drain and crumble.
Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon drippings in skillet.
Add corn, green pepper and onion.
Cook over high heat for 5 minutes, stirring often; stir in bacon, tomatoes, salt and pepper.
Spoon mixture into a highly greased 2-quart shallow baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Yummy Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender; cool, peel and grate.
Heat butter with soup.
Blend in sour cream, onion and cheese.
Mix with potatoes and spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Cover with corn flake crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to one hour.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Zesty Oil-Free Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Refrigerate for all flavors to blend.
Yields 3/4 cup.
Each 3 tablespoons contains only 3 calories and no fat.

recipes.title: Zippy Chicken Strips
instructions: Cut chicken into 3
x 1-inch strips and place in a shallow dish. Combine the next 3 ingredients.
Pour over chicken.
Cover dish and marinate 30 minutes. Combine flour, pepper, salt and paprika.
Dredge chicken pieces in flour mixture.
Fry in hot oil (375°) until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Stir together Bisquick, cheese and pepper.
Stir in eggs until moist.
Fold in zucchini.
Heat oil.
Fry 2 tablespoons mixture for each round 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Makes 12.

recipes.title: Zucchini Burger Italiano
instructions: Cook zucchini, uncovered, 1 to 2 minutes.
Drain.
Cook meat, onions and garlic until meat is brown and onions transparent. Stir cooked rice, tomato sauce, salt, pepper and oregano into meat mixture.
Combine egg, cottage cheese and shredded cheese.
Layer in casserole dish zucchini sprinkled with salt, meat mixture, cheese mixture and another layer of zucchini.
Sprinkle with salt. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese around edge.
Bake 10 more minutes.
Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Zucchini Honey Bread
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients; stir in pecans.
Peel zucchini, if desired; shred enough zucchini to measure 2 cups. Combine zucchini and the remaining ingredients; add to flour mixture, stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened.
Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 5 minutes, or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pans 10 minutes; remove from pans.
Let cool.
Yields 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Zucchini Italiano
instructions: Wash zucchini, slice thin.
Heat oil in 10-inch skillet.
Add onion; saute until golden.
Add zucchini, sprinkle with salt. Toss.
Cover.
Braise about 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pickle
instructions: Wash zucchini and cut into thin slices.
Peel and quarter onions and cut in thin slices.
Cover vegetables with water and add salt.
Let stand 2 hours, then drain thoroughly.
Bring remaining ingredients to a boil and pour over vegetables.
Let stand 2 hours, then bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes.
Pack in hot sterilized jars and seal.
Yields 3 pints.

recipes.title: Zucchini Raisin Cookies
instructions: In mixing bowl, cream shortening and sugar.
Add egg and beat well.
Stir in zucchini; set aside.
Combine flour, baking soda, spices, baking powder and salt.
Add to zucchini mixture and stir until thoroughly combined.
Stir in raisins.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 375° until golden brown for 12 to 15 minutes.
Cool in pans for 2 minutes before removing to wire rack.
Cookies are cake like. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Zucchini Souffle
instructions: Cook zucchini until tender and drain.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic salt.
Combine egg yolks, sour cream and flour. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into sour cream mixture. Place 1/2 of zucchini in a baking dish.
Top with 1/2 sour cream mixture and 1/2 of the grated cheese.
Layer remaining zucchini, sour cream mixture and cheese.
Melt butter and stir in bread crumbs.
Sprinkle over top of cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Zucchini Vichyssoise
instructions: Saute onion in oil.
Add zucchini, chicken broth, basil, nutmeg and pepper.
Cover and simmer until tender.
Puree soup. Return to pan and add milk.
Serve cold or hot.
Makes 6 entrees or 10 to 12 small courses.

recipes.title: Zucchini, Onion And Carrot Saute
instructions: Wash zucchini, but do not peel.
Cut into thin slices.
Put into a 10-inch skillet.
Add carrots, onions, salt, black pepper and basil.
Pour olive oil over top; stir gently until well mixed with vegetables.
Over medium heat, saute vegetables for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover vegetables; cook 5 minutes longer.
Remove cover; stir and cook about 10 more minutes, until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Serve hot.
Makes 4 servings.
